articleTitle: Reputation model for C2C commerce with filtering merchandise categories
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the large number of buyer and seller agents in C2C commerce, the process managing to establishing trust relations using previous repeated direct interactions is difficult to achieve. In a loosely connected e-market, the best way to establish trust relations is probably with the help of the commendation coming from the buyer agents who have traded with the same seller agent. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the commendation is partly determined by the similarity of contents between historical and present trades — context relevance which is identified through the merchandise categories in this paper. With the concepts — buyer's merchandise-categories reputation and buyer's recommended reputation filtering merchandise categories — being proposed, and the experience cumulative function used for calculating the buyer's recommended reputation and the equation used for aggregating seller's reputation being designed, a reputation system based on SPORAS is improved. Finally, compared with SPORAS, the benefits of filtering merchandise categories to manage reputation in C2C commerce are analyzed according to the excellent experimental results shown.

articleTitle: Research of learning resource dispatching based on campus grid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Concerning the low scheduling ratio caused by complicated QoS process and precise match in learning resource scheduling of campus grid, the authors classified and defined QoS parameters. Finally simulations were performed to compare the performance of the maximum matching scheduling algorithm with that of the multiple QoS-based resource scheduling algorithm. The paper improve a mode of learning resource dispatching which fit to campus grid, also improve the algorithm of multi-level resource dispatching.

articleTitle: Constructing electronic commerce pattern of agricultural enterprise in Sichuan earthquake area: Based on atomic pattern theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: E-commerce pattern has been a hot research theoretically and practically. Most agricultural enterprise and their information system in Sichuan province suffer a heavy damage in earthquake. The reconstruction of the information system plays an important role in construction of enterprise informatization. Firstly, the atomic pattern theory is introduced and its advantages are analyzed in this paper. Secondly, by expanding the pattern of business agency network, the new e-business pattern of agricultural enterprises is presented. Finally, this paper analyzes the pattern elements, including its component, core competitive ability, the key success factors and the technical guarantees.

articleTitle: Study on information management system for emergency public health events in university
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Emergency Public health events in University has seriously threatened the safety of university students and how to avoid them as much as possible has also become a problem needed resolving perfectly. A lot of specialists give some preventive measures for them and construct a perfect long-term mechanism for them, but few specialists sdudy the information management system on the internet. This paper shows stucture and functions of an information management system for Emergency Public Health Events in university. The information management system consists of health knowledge education module, report module for university students physical parameters, statistical analysis module, video management module and student information management module. The system provides a new way to settle Emergency Public Health Events in university.

articleTitle: A study on relationship value in E-business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This research identifies the dimensions of relationship value in E-business and tests the effects of relationship value dimensions on customer loyalty. Findings of the study indicate that relationship value includes three relationship benefit dimensions and two relationship cost dimensions. These five dimensions influence customer loyalty indirectly via relationship satisfaction and relationship commitment. Relationship benefits influence customer loyalty positively, and relationship costs influence customer loyalty negatively.

articleTitle: Examination of UTAUT model in an ERP postadoption environment: An empirical study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This research presents an empirical study on UTAUT model in an ERP post-adoption environment, investigating the moderating effect of mid-level management support on the relationship between subjective norm, perceived behavior control and behavior intention. Using data gathered from ERP users in a large-scale enterprise, we showed that perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, subjective norm, and perceived behavior control are critical cognitive beliefs influencing the behavior intention to use the ERP system. In addition, the hypothesis of moderating effect of mid-level management support has not been supported by strong empirical evidences. Theoretical implications and limitations are discussed.

Author Keywords: Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology

articleTitle: An incremental LS-SVM learning algorithm ILS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Least Square Support Vector Machines (in short LS-SVM) reduces the complexity of standard SVM to O(n2). Both SVM and LS-SVM are not suitable for the large scale regression problem. This paper proposes a modifies LS-SVM based on increment datasets, all samples' knowledge is accumulated and some samples is discarded effectively in the incremental learning process. The numerical experiments on benchmark datasets show that the proposed algorithm is considerably faster than the standard SVM and the classical incremental algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the network system survivable status's assessment and forecast model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, taking the survivability of trusted network as the background, the key issues of network survivability are analyzed. Taking account of the uncertainty, randomness of network system, by introducing cloud model and deterministic finite automation, the status of network system is described and detected in this paper. Based on cloud model, this paper proposes the network system status's assessment and forecast model. Moreover, the analysis and confirmation of associated theory are given. Finally, the feasibility and rationality of this model is further confirmed by the aid of simulation experiments. At the same time, this model, which is proposed in this paper, also enlightens a new way for study on the survivability of current complex network system.

articleTitle: System dynamic model of leading high-tech industry growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article constructs the model of dynamics of leading high-tech industry (LHTI) growth by system dynamic method. Then the article takes electronic and telecommunications equipment industry for empirical analysis. The results show that the dynamics of leading high-tech industry growth is a complex dynamic system including multiple cyclic feedbacks and synergistic effect of science and technology innovation, market demands, enterprises competitions and government behavior; the role of the government in LHTI's growth isn't regulating directly or promoting it but making good use of the synergistic effect of science and technology innovation, market demands and enterprises competitions with each other and with government itself; the adjustment keystone including loosen the government regulation, inspire the ability of independent innovation of enterprises, further increase the input of R&D and professional works' education, and show the specific way by making a decision game at last.

articleTitle: Conceptual framework and theoretical development on CLV research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As the customer relationship management is highly recognized by more companies and has put it into practice, how to have a full life cycle management of targeted business customers has become the actual customer management issues for common concern. The definition of customer lifetime value, qualitative and quantitative studies in this paper were retrospectively analyzed and summarized, the analysis of customer lifetime value model of the current situation and existing deficiencies were made and from various angles the direction of future research which further clarify the customer lifetime value for the important role of enterprises, and relevant research findings will be used to provide information to verify and expand in the context of the market.

articleTitle: Research on the dynamic mechanism of enterprise innovation behaviors: An empirical analysis framework for endogenous factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the mechanism theory as well as the competence theory, this paper sets up a conceptual model to analyze the relationship among innovation mechanism and innovation capability of entrepreneurs as well as the enterprise innovation performance, and carries out empirical test on samples of 124 enterprises to verify the hypothesis. The analysis results show that there are significant positive correlations between enterprise innovation mechanism and innovation performance, together with between enterprise culture and innovation mechanism as well as the entrepreneur's innovation capability and enterprise innovation performance.

articleTitle: The model analysis of the tacit knowledge diffusion process in enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, a comprehensive analysis of the characteristics of the proliferation of tacit knowledge and tacit knowledge diffusion process is built based on the diffusion process of tacit knowledge epidemic model. It concerts the analysis of the time line of the proliferation of tacit knowledge, as well as enterprises (groups) between the information transmission and the proliferation of tacit knowledge the time path of the inner links. With the multi-source information epidemic model of a simple form of heterogeneity of expansion, the paper has raised the probability of the proliferation of tacit knowledge epidemic model as a theoretical model in the expansion of individual choice.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper divides the internet promotion into two categories, and analyses the consumer choices with different experience internet purchases adapting the method of researching investigation. In order to build market share, highlight distinct advantages and increase purchase rate of customer in the increasingly competitive market, the results of the research provide some advice to online retailer.

articleTitle: Incentives to and countermeasures for China's current illegal salt rampancy: A perspective from a static game of complete information
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the current situations of China's salt monopoly system, this paper establishes a static game model of complete information to analyze the "incentives" to illegal salt trafficking. Using the thoughts of “trigger strategies” in infinitely repeated games for reference, this paper designs an institutional arrangement to suppress illegal salt and puts forward a number of illegal salt suppression strategies, such as to build up a reputation for “a strong salt regulator”, to enhance the efficiency of supervision and reduce the cost of investigation, to strengthen the penalties for trafficking in illegal salt, to implement different degrees of supervision and investigation on salt-producing enterprises with different marginal costs of production and so on.

articleTitle: Value evaluation of enterprise information based on grid-fuzzy borda number analytical method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The value evaluation of enterprise information is one of important parts of enterprise information construction. The paper firstly summaries the current circumstance of value evaluation of enterprise information from China; then, a set of evaluation system of enterprise information is constructed on the basis of referring to the booklet <<Indicates System of China's Enterprise Information>> published by Ministry of Industry and Information Technologies of the Republic of China at year 2002; In the section three, the model of value evaluation of enterprise information, which is on the basis of grid-fuzzy borda number analytical method, is built, and we give the detailed computing steps; Finally, the effectiveness of this method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: The model construction of the third party participated in closed-loop supply chain coordination based on evolutionary game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: While the rapid development in the global economy, the resource crisis and the environmental pollution intensify day by day. How to achieve the win-win of the economic efficiency and environmental benefit becomes an urgent problem to be solved. Therefore, the closed-loop supply chain as the forward logistics and the reverse logistics for the organic approach is being getting more and more attention and application. But with the ongoing reverse logistics, the third-party reverse logistics began to appear. How to coordinate the benefits between the third-party reverse logistics and the manufacturer is a focal point. In this paper, we do the research by the evolutionary game theory to get the issues of closed-loop supply chain coordination, and then use the demonstration to prove it.

articleTitle: The study of asymmetric information in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the level of the information society getting deeper, the E-commerce, as a new business mode, has developed rapidly with its unmatched advantages. However, a problem of the E-commerce is also getting striking, that is the asymmetric information, which would become an important factor inhibiting the development of the E-commerce. This paper analyzed the performance, the cause and the disservice of the asymmetric information during the E-commerce, and brought out several corresponding solutions, hoping to provide some reference for the future study.

articleTitle: Study on priority order of public goods supply in China rural area based on the economic effects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on endogenous growth theory, this paper analyzes the effect on economic growth of national agricultural expenditure, compulsory education, health care and social security in rural area using the 1994 ∼ 2008 time series data. Through Co-integration test of the associated data combined with error correction model and state-space model, it shows: in the short term, agricultural expenditure has a positive economic effect; however, heath care and social security has a negative effect. In the long run, the order of economic growth impact is agricultural expenditure, health care, education, and social security. Therefore, according to economic growth effects, rural public goods supply priority sequence should be agriculture expenditure, heath care, compulsory education and social security.

articleTitle: The research on the construction of virtual enterprise's core competence in the network environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

Virtual enterprise is a new organizational form flourished in network economy age. After analyzing the influence of network on core competence, this paper puts forward strategies on the construction of core competence in virtual enterprises.

articleTitle: Signaling game analysis on B2C transaction of online pharmacy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Online medicine sale is an important form of pharmaceutical enterprises in developing e-commerce. As the particularity of the medicine compared to other products, how the customer judge the quality of the medicine sold by online pharmacies have received special attentions. The paper analyzes the process of transactions between online pharmacies and customers using the method of signaling game and establishes a signaling game model of medicine transaction. In the model, the price of medicine is selected as a signal of pharmacies to transfer their own quality types. The separating equilibrium and pooling equilibrium of the two sides in transaction are obtained. The study has some reference value for customers to judge the quality types of online pharmacies, and then improve transaction efficiency of online pharmacies.

articleTitle: Modeling usage intention and its antecedents based on information asymmetry theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Much of our prior knowledge of information systems (IS) usage is based on its acceptance or continuance without understanding whether users are likely to use the IS or not. Prior models of IS usage provide a limited understanding of one's intention to use the IS, given that IS usage or continuance does not necessarily suggest the subsequent use of the IS. Even if people use particular IS, there is no guarantee that the users always use the IS. This study proposes an IS usage intention model based on the information asymmetry theory to compliment previous studies that mostly focus on IS usage or continuance without considering the possibility of its use. For IS usage research, this paper proposes one of the earliest usage models of IS. For practitioners, this study provides some guidelines for IS manufacturers on how to derive the most return on their system development efforts with a successfully high usage rate in the market for their newly usage systems.

articleTitle: Tentative exploration about blending learning: With landscape art for example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Landscape art is an important professional core courses, is a comprehensive literature, painting and architecture, sculpture, calligraphy, arts and crafts. This courses has a strong theoretical, artistic and practical. Based on landscape art course as an example, this paper has tentative exploration about blending learning. First it introduces the connotation of the blending learning theory, compares the traditional teaching with the E-learning, discusses the comparative study and practice in the landscape art and exchanges on the practice of teaching, in order to make reference to related.

articleTitle: KFDA e-Learning system for civil Petitions: Technical specifications of the internet certificate issuing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Existing security of Internet has principally focused on preventing leakage of the user's data to others by applying the cryptographic technology to the data transmission and receiving process between the Internet system and the user's computers, and the source-viewing on the web browser. However, with an increasing number of government entities including the “e-government” of the Republic of Korea issuing a wide range of certificates through the Internet, the data security on the users' computers, along with the existing security concept, is becoming ever more important. In other words, the data protection system from the conventional security concept can not prevent data leakage through the output equipment. When being printed out, temporary files are stored inside the computer in the decrypted form, and, adding to the existing web-viewing related security, this calls for a brand-new security measure for the print-out process as well. Accordingly, an Internet Certificate Issuing System for “Civil Petitions e-Learning” needs to be designed so that it only allows a simple source-viewing by the additional use of the other separate code system than the web pages, or it leaves no temporary files behind in the computer during the print-out process.

articleTitle: A study on the impact of online brand community interaction model on brand loyalty — Focusing on the online automobile brand community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper takes the online automobile brand community as an example, importing ‘interactivity’, the concept of sociology, into online brand community study. It follows the logical way as ‘How does interactivity embody among the online communities → How about its deepening process? →What the results of interactivity will be?’, that is, ‘formation of the relationship (Interaction) — deepening of the relationship (identification)-result of the relationship(brand loyalty)’, makes systematic study through the method of combining theory and case analysis together, and puts forward the marketing strategic direction for online brand communities.

articleTitle: Affects of China's nonfinancial sector's outflow foreign direct investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper factors affecting china's outflow foreign direct investment are analyzed through the panel data of China's nonfinancial sector outflow foreign direct investment to 21 host countries, the cumulative number of host country's anti-dumping cases against china, host country's per capita national income, the standard of China's export to host country, and exchange rate of RMB to the host country's currency from 2003 to 2006. The test results show that firstly anti-dumping exerts significantly negative effect on China's outflow foreign direct investment; secondly export is one of the important deterministic factors to China's OFDI; thirdly per capita national income is a prominently positive factor to China's outflow foreign direct investment; fourthly exchange rate of RMB has an inconspicuous influence on China's outflow foreign direct investment

articleTitle: The operating efficiency empirical study of housing provident fund
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Housing Provident Fund (HPF) has been now imple­mented in most cities in China, while there are some variations in the operation of HPF scheme, especially in the debates of HPF operating efficiency. This paper, based on the input-output, chooses the contributing capital, the repayment of loan principal and the contributing persons as input index, the total captial for drawing and loaning, the number of loaning persons as output index, and sets up the DEA model of HPF system. Then, using the DEA model, this paper evaluates the operating efficiency of Shanghai HPF scheme from 1999 to 2009 year, measures annual relative efficiency value, analyzes the results in the efficacy and puts forward some suggestions to improve its efficiency.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The study of evolution game on capital supplying and demanding trusting behavior based on the bounded rationality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Because of the credit risk between both the supplier and the demander of funds in capital market, the article introduces the evolutionary game theory to behavior of the supplier and the demander in capital market, and builds the evolutionary game model of trusting behavior, and then draws a copy dynamic phase diagram. Finally this paper analyzes the influencing factors and gets the conclusion that the trusting behavior in the capital market is influenced by real income of trust, expected income of credit and long-term cooperation between the two sides.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Multi-objective multi-execution mode resource-limited optimization of fuzzy project scheduling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is always a research hot spot of resource constraints project scheduling. However, with development of economy, project scheduling environment is also changing, some uncertain factors influences project scheduling seriously. It is resource constraints fuzzy project scheduling. This paper studies the problem of resource constraints project scheduling, and it also researches more exec-mode pattern project scheduling which is more realistic. In this paper, it designs a new optimization algorithm that is GLS (a new optimization algorithm — GLS is proposed in this paper). Based on linear weighted utility function, GLS combines the multi-objective combinatorial problems into single objective combinatorial optimization problem, then generates target weight coefficient vector to solving minimization problem. At last the authors prove certain advantages of this proposed method comparing with contrast validation methods.

articleTitle: Theoretical research on structural equation model based on principle of entropy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The theory of entropy is an effective tool to solve the uncertain problems, which has a variety of applications in social and natural sciences. Based on the theory of entropy, the basic concepts and principles of entropy and information entropy, maximum entropy and probabilistic distribution are introduced comprehensively and systematically. The modeling method of structural equation model (SEM) mainly includes the linear structure relations based on the covariance structures (LISREL) and the path method based on partial least square (PLS). These two methods have different requirements for data. LISREL requires observed variables with normal distribution, while PLS has no strict restriction on data. The theory of entropy is used in the modeling research of SEM, and the entropy model with data normal distribution is established by introducing the criterion and constraint condition of maximum entropy, and thus the normal distribution is determined. According to this the modeling method of SEM is determined. Therefore, the modeling idea based on the theory of entropy is a useful exploration for the modeling theory of SEM.

articleTitle: Research on a dynamic adjust crawling algorithm for guiding the topic crawler through Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The problem of Tunnels is always the focus of topic crawler. Based on the study of VSM, the paper added the impact of the text structure of web documents to the topic similarity, improved VSM text classification algorithm to make the prediction more accurate, and applied to the dynamic adjustment topic crawler algorithm through the tunnel. By analyzing the influence by features of Web Community and tunneling, taking the genetic factors of parent page and child pages into account, applied to the web page similarity calculation. In order to improve the shortcomings of the traditional tunnel method, this paper designed a new algorithm to make crawler dynamically adjust the K values according to the corresponding calculated strategy during crawling the pages, Making Web Community and tunnels to form a relatively complete thematic clusters to improve the web crawl rate.

articleTitle: The behavioral intention to adopt e Computer Assisted Instruction: Explore the role of Perceived alienation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Organizations invest abundant resources to deploy e-Computer Assisted Instruction systems. The performance of e-CAI is partly depending on employees' intention to adopt it. This study, based on the integrated framework of TAM and IDT, explored the role of organizational alienation. The analysis of 264 samples supports TAM. Alienation was found to negatively affect behavioral intention, though statistically insignificant. Perceived compatibility was accidently found to negatively influence intention.

articleTitle: E-learning and Chinese higher education transformation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The E-learning is refers to one non-tradition study pattern, using the numeral technology and the digital media to disseminate, and support and enhance teaching. E-learning has brought the new thinking method to the learner, has expanded the media application space. Today, networking develops fast, the E-learning made use of the network learning method. The article, aiming at the problem of China higher education, elaborates characteristics of the E-learning, plays the advantage of the E-learning, makes two more organic combine, and provide the enlightenment for the reform of China higher education.

articleTitle: Construction of web-based business information service system in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Development of the Internet brings new vitality to business information service. Traditional business information service system can no longer adapt to this new environment. Therefore, on the basis of analysis of the main bodies, information resources and their relations of the business information service system, this paper then discusses its operating mechanism, finally describes three typical practical applications — agricultural business information service system under government-driven model, Alibaba.com under enterprises-driven model, social commerce information platform, hoping to provide some guidance for construction of multi-level, multichannel business information service system.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of non-equilibrium change of forest resources distribution in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper is to study the problem of the macro-allocation of Chinese forest resources, to make a evaluation model of non-equilibrium change of forest resources distribution in China based on Gini coefficient theory of economics, and combining Chinese national status and forest condition. Macro-allocation of forest resources is related to the ecological security, the improvement of inland environment and sustained development in economic society. From practical research results, we have found that there is a Lorenz curve on forest resources. The degree of the Lorenz curve is high, comparing with different time, the degree of the Lorenz curve is becoming higher. The forest resources Lorenz curve shows that the forest cover ratio increases, but our country hasn't achieved successfully even distribution. The process from forest distribution non-equilibrium to forest distribution equilibrium is not obviously, which is reasonable slowly and long, conversely the tread of non-equilibrium is forwarding. The suggestion is to bring the requirements to improve forest resources distribution non-equilibrium into planning of the forest strategy in China.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the family financial planning based on low-carbon ideas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The relationship between energy consumption and economic structure in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper investigates the influence on energy consumption by economic structure in China using panel cointegration and Granger causal test with panel vector error correction (VEC) model. The panel cointegration test reveals the long equilibrium relationship between energy consumption and economic structure in China. The Granger causal test with panel VEC model reveals the unidirectional causality from economic structure to energy consumption and the bidirectional causality between energy consumption and economic growth in the short and long run. The influence on energy consumption by economic growth is greater in the short run and the influence by economic structure is greater in the long run. Thus when the “energy saving and emission reduction” are in work in China, more attention should be paid to the measures involving the economic structure adjustment. The measures include decreasing the proportion of the high energy consumption industries and supporting the development of the service industries. Thus the target of “energy saving and emission reduction” will be achieved without influencing the economic growth.

articleTitle: Evaluation track of performance measurement systems from principal-agent perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the evolution of enterprise systems¸ management theories and operational objectives, the performance measurements have developed in a variety of methods. In this paper, we take principal-agent theory as the basic axis in order to analyze its production, take management theory as timeline, combining with Historical and Comparative Institutional Analysis to analyze the historical evolution. In the two axes, this paper analyzes¸ evaluates and finally brings forward measurement's direction.

articleTitle: The effects of openness and indigeneity on Growth: Evidence from nonparametric panel data model with two-way random effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper contributes to the globalization debate by studying the overall effect on growth of openness and indigenous factors. The empirical results show that the openness factors averagely promote growth whereas the indigeneity factors have a negative effect on growth. The conclusion is robust in parametric and nonparametric models. Industrialized economies score relatively high in terms of performance in both factors, but there is a high threshold beyond which the effects of these factors on growth are slower. Among the developing economies, openness is a necessary and pre­requisite condition for growth, but the achievement of a high level of indigeneity is more important for sustainable growth.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Two aspects of cellular radio systems design are covered in this work. First, is a way of evaluating a cellular system with a given configuration, including coverage, co-channel interference, and traffic capacity considerations. Second, based on this evaluation scheme, Simulated Annealing is used to improve the system performance by varying system parameters such as site channel assignment, site power, antenna azimuth, and antenna down-tilt. The main improvement of this work over previous reports is two-fold. First, calculations of the co-channel interference are direct. In comparison, a common practice is to use a compatibility matrix or similar measure for interference. A single number is then used to characterize the interference between a pair of sites / cells, which is an over simplification because interference varies for different points in the cell served by a site. It is the collective results of all other cells using the co-channel and not only just between the two sites. Furthermore, interference in both directions, uplink and downlink, need be included. Uplink is the weaker link in general and is commonly ignored in the compatibility matrix. The second improvement is that the entire area distribution of traffic is used in this work as opposed to the common practice of using total traffic at each site.

But in recent years, its development shows a certain degree of fluctuate and non-equilibrium. So we apply the panel data DEA method to evaluate the economic benefits of the zone around Bohai in this paper, and measure the regional economic benefits form 1986 to 2008 in these regions. By the analysis, we find that the overall level of the Bohai region has a higher economic efficiency, however, there is some decline since 2002 and the non-equilibrium development of regions is still very prominent.

According to the existing theories, systematic risk monitor indexes are built and transferred into layer-structured model of AHP by certain intrinsic mechanism, and moreover, the weight of each index can be obtained by AHP algorithm. Then the significance of each index is determined and the key indexes can be selected as the most important aspects of financial derivative instrument. It is proved to be practical and feasible. This application can warn the incoming danger of financial derivative instrument in time and minimize the threat of financial derivative instrument.

abstract: Based on the evolution of enterprise informatization and its variation characteristics, this paper offers an insight into enterprise informatizaion's impact on corporate strategy in accordance to library and empirical research. In the light of the “four elements of strategy” theory, which was put forward by Ansoff, corporate strategy has been decomposed to discuss elements effected by enterprise informatization on each stage. The results show that the impacts on corporate strategy increase with the upgrading of informatization, and the third stage has the most significant increase. Then the theory research result is verified and amended by the survey of 79 enterprises' senior and middle management staff. Besides, the trajectory of influence changes of informatization on strategy and its characteristics are also derived from the survey. All in all, the research results of this paper provide reference to corporate strategy planning and mastering the laws of enterprise informatization's development.

articleTitle: Changes in carbon emissions from energy consumption & analysis of influencing factors: Using STIRPAT model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of economy, China has experienced constant rise in carbon dioxide emissions. The present research focus, therefore, has been on how to reduce its emission. This essay is based on STIRPAT model, selects 1995–2008 as samples, makes quantitative analysis of the correlation between carbon emissions from energy use and population, richness, energy intensity and industial structure, and then employs ridge regression function fitting. The research results show that China's energy consumption is coal-based. Although energy consumption efficiency is on the increase, carbon emissions from energy use also show an upward trend. The relation model fitting between carbon emissions and economic growth didn't present Kuznets curve. It proves that with economic development resources consumption has imposed increasing pressure on enviroment. China has to optimize industrial structure, and promote engergy consumption efficiency, transform energy development ideology and push the development of low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: Impact of inward FDI on the host country's capability development of investment abroad: Experience from China and India
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the core issue that "whether FDI inflow will play a catalytic role in the host country's outward FDI". We select two big developing countries China and India, using an extended IDP model to have an empirical test. The result shows that, the original logic of IDP theory is established for both countries, that is, the level of economic development is an important factor that affects host country's capability of outward investment; while in terms of inward FDI's direct impact on outward investment capability China and India are different. According to the test, China's inward FDI does not have significant direct effect on its outward FDI; while the inward FDI in India does for the country.

articleTitle: The feature and reasons of development about B2B e-commerce in Beijing of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: B2B e-commerce in Beijing as the capital of China developed quickly and ran above average level in the country. The features is particular, such as the rapid development of B2B e-commerce, ranks first of B2B and outsourcing service in small trade, the 6 categories service platform formatted of B2B. And B2B e-commerce has become a mainstay of Beijing. It has obvious development advantages and huge development potential. But there are some problems, such as, consumer attitudes, information technology, marketing and business models. In future, we should enhance the overall layout and policy support of the government, integrate and found characteristics platform relying on existing development basis, continue to create the capital of e-commerce brands.

articleTitle: Application of dynamic CPM optimal algorithm based on constraints in construction progress
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the basis of traditional CPM, considering the effect of time constraints and process constraints, this paper studies the dynamic adjustment method of network time parameter, simulates the uncertainty of project task duration through applying Monte Carlo techniques. Then establishes a model of dynamic CPM optimal algorithm based on constraints and takes the calculation of project examples. The algorithm accesses not only the critical path and its statistical properties, but also the interval duration, minor critical path and the conflicts that may occur, providing more decision-making information for construction schedule for project management.

Based on matching algorithm research, the paper has improved the tuple structure of Rete algorithm which has the high reputation, has provided an improved rule matching model for the realization of rules engine, has certain innovation, high theoretical significance and practical value. abstract: Based on the heralded pair-coherent states sources, the Vacuum+Weak decoy state protocol focused on BB84 is presented. From the simulation results of the final key rate over the distance, which shows that our method improve the QKD performance and obtain higher key generation rate than that of the active decoy states method.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: China mobile multimedia broadcasting (CMMB) has a strong need and a huge space for development. However, there still exist many problems for CMMB. Its operating mode is not clear and service quality is difficult to meet customers' needs. Firstly, the gaps model of service quality and the theory of service blueprint are introduced. Then, combined with the CMMB service process, its service quality perception gap model, service quality standard gap model, service quality delivery gap model, service quality communication gap model and service quality integration gap model are constructed. Finally, the constituent elements of CMMB service process are discussed and its service blueprint is built based on the theory of service blueprint, and then its optimization measures are proposed from a business process optimization, human resource management optimization and the optimization of service blueprint key points in order to improve the service quality of CMMB service process.

articleTitle: Modeling VaR for international portfolios
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article models a value at risk (VaR) for financial institutions to manage the market risk of international portfolios in highly integrated global financial markets. Being different from both the Kupiec (1999) model and the Chen and Liao (2009) model for portfolios only valued in one currency, this model splits portfolios into two parts one valued in a domestic currency and the other in foreign currencies. It can be regarded as an incorporation of the Kupiec (1999) model and the Chen and Liao (2009) model, and is more suitable to fit the real world. Using Christoffersen's independence test (1998) criterion, the proposed model is also reliable for international portfolios before and after the subprime mortgage crisis periods.

articleTitle: Simulation platform for grating diffraction experiment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: We had established a simulation platform for grating diffraction experiment using visual basic. Wavelength of incident light, grating constant and the number of total slit determined the picture of grating diffraction experiment on the screen. The type of experimental picture was decided by the number of total slit. When the number of total slit equaled to one, it was single slit diffraction, there was a light and biggest band on the center of picture. When the number of total slit equaled to two, it was double silt interference, distance between every near two band was equal. While the number of total slit was greater than two, it was grating diffraction experiment. The picture from the simulation platform had well agreement with that form half wave zone method.

articleTitle: Time varying travelling planning model and algorithm for maximal utility
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A time varying travelling planning problem is proposed. The problem considers three constraints: (1) node's residing time and edge's travelling time are time dependent in networks; (2) the traveller has different preference for each node; (3) the available maximal travelling time is limited. The travelling networks are represented by time aggregated graphs (TAG) firstly. Then, a label method is designed to solve the problem. Finally, an example is demonstrated and the application is discussed. Compared to time expanded graph (TEG), the approach has suboptimal solution, but it reduces the computational cost significantly.

articleTitle: Analysis of dependence in China and oversea stock markets under subprime mortgage crisis — Based on Markov switching model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Three-regime Markov switching model is used to approach the changes of dependence structure in the stock markets of China, Hong Kong, Japan, Britain and Australia before and during the American subprime mortgage crisis. It is found that the dependences decrease in Australia, Britain and Japan. However, correlation between China and Japan presents an increase. Meanwhile, correlation model based on copula theory is used for comparative analysis. It indicates that dependence changes during the subprime crisis and volatility increases in all markets. The highest dependence is exhibited in the stock markets between Australia and UK, while markets between China and the other four markets display low dependence comparatively. Besides, we regard the Markov switching model as a better way to capture the volatility of stock markets than the traditional method.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, the listed companies which declared holistic listing between September 30th of 2003 and December 31st of 2009 have been chosen as research samples. And then, the different stock market reactions of group companies' holistic listing based on the four holistic listing models proposed by State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) have been analyzed empirically. The empirical result shows that the positive responses led by companies which listed holistically through private placements are stronger than those through other models. With this conclusion, rational choice for holistic listing models can be made more reasonably.

abstract: Based on the CH Model, this paper takes into account of the relationship between the technological innovation and intellectual property protection, intellectual property protection and economic development level and human capital, and makes an econometric model to test the impact of technological innovation, intellectual property protection on the structure of China's imports selecting the time series data from 1985 to 2007 years. The regression results show that there are more significant positive impact of technological innovation and GDP per capita on the structure of China's imports, while significant negative impact of intellectual property protection and human capital on the structure of China's imports. articleTitle: The collection and processing of data from secondhand housing market: Based on dynamic monitoring system for urban property price
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In recent years, dynamic monitoring is widely used in the real estate market. Based on the dynamic monitoring system for urban property price, this paper focuses on the data collection and processing. Results of calculation show that the method is consistent with the actual situation, which means that it can provide reference for government decision-making.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Analyzing the influential factors in using open educational resources
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: OER(Open Educational Resources)is no longer strange to us. It is developed rapidly and had many achivements. It has attracted a great attention by UNESCO and many countries. The research in OER is deepend gradually. Many scholar have been attracted by OER. In this paper, we will present four aspects of analyzing the influential factors in learner's using of OER. They are performance factor, difficulty expectation, resource conditions and group influence. There are some ideas for the OER's future development and construction. These will be a reference to the further research.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The GPS design of hull bottom section based on the modern manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In connection with the problem of the bottom of the ship hull sub-modular design, General products structure of the hull bottom is proposed to be improved. Because of the specialty to the ship, Classification of ABC members is applied to optimize existing general products structure. Similarity theory and fuzzy recognized theory are applied to categorize and simplify the complex hull block, numerous accessories. The reliability of the general products structure is tested through the experiment.

articleTitle: Comparative research in several major benefit-evaluation models of sports event
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The traditional benefit-evaluation models of sports event all focus on the economic values, the comprehensive benefit of sports event, however, go beyond the scope of economic field. This paper enumerates several major benefit-evaluation models of sports event, classifies these models in light of different benefits, and compares the advantages and disadvantages of these models in order to find the scopes of application.

articleTitle: Data envelopment analysis on efficiency evaluation of city circular economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: City cycle economy is a sustainable development strategy in coordinating comprehensive development among economy, ecology and society and realizing that the city, man and nature are in harmonious. On the basis of the establishment of a reasonable economic efficient city appraisal target system, we applied data envelopment analysis to calculate the city loop economic development efficiency of 17 cities of Henan province in 2007, and the results showed that eight of the cities were of effective recycling economy, another nine were relatively invalid. Finally, we made optimize path analyses to those cities with relatively invalid city cycle economy through projection.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of effect of knowledge diffusion on innovation ability of organizations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The innovation ability of organization is notable positive correlated with knowledge stock. That is to say, the more the knowledge stocks are, the stronger the innovation ability. For each organization, the accumulations of knowledge stock are not only from self-learning, but also from social-learning which means knowledge diffusion. Therefore, firstly, the network structure of social-learning is analyzed. Secondly, the knowledge accumulation model is constructed based on self-learning, social-learning and knowledge depreciation. Thirdly, a simulation analysis is made on the effect of knowledge diffusion on the innovation ability of organization with the index of average knowledge stock (AK) and deviation level of knowledge stock (DK). The results indicate that: (1) the knowledge diffusion can effectively improve the innovation ability of organization, especially when the self-learning ability is low and with the increasing of knowledge depreciation.(2)The knowledge diffusion will make differentiations of innovation ability among these organizations and leads to clusters with different innovation ability.

articleTitle: The effective use of clickers in freshmen classrooms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Clickers a wireless-keypad used in class-polling systems that enable students to answer questions during lectures. Such systems provide an interactive teaching environment with real time feedback for students and teachers on the progress of teaching and learning. Clicker use is becoming more widespread amongst faculty as a means of engaging students in US. However, there is few papers report its effectiveness to Chinese students. In this paper, we will introduce our experiment results in using clickers to enhance active learning in introductory physics lectures in China. The effectiveness of this approach at engaging students in class and confronting misconceptions pertaining to Electricity and Magnetism will be discussed. We compared students' performance of clicker sessions with non-clicker sections and we also compared the performance for both US students and Chinese students. The results from post-test indicate that students using clickers achieved a significant gain in conceptual learning.

articleTitle: Effects of strategic alliance on China's technological progress
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Along with the development of knowledge economy, the level of technology becomes core competitiveness of a country's economic advances. As the costs of R&D increases, multinational companies have formed strategic alliances to share resources, especially technology. In this paper, with the time series data from 1985 to 2008 of China, we made an empirical test to measure the impacts of strategic alliance on the technological advances in host country. The results show that: China's domestic independent R&D is the main factor of technological progress. Besides, technology spillover of strategic alliance also significantly promoted the technological progress, while the technology monopoly produces technology extrusion effect which can impede China's technical progress, and it is not notable. Our findings suggest that China not only rely on its own technological innovation but also make full use of multinational strategic alliance to promote local technological progress through technology introduction and absorption, and eliminate adverse effects at the same time.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The sustainable development evaluation of energy and chemical engineering base of Northern Shaanxi region
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to provide a systematic evaluation method to the sustainable development of energy and chemical engineering base of Northern Shaanxi region. As one of the abundant region which has minerals such as coal, oil, gas and halite in China, the growth of energy and chemical engineering base of Northern Shaanxi region is crucial to the economy development and society stability of the northwest and even the nation. The author makes use of AHP and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, takes Northern Shaanxi region as an example, builds evaluation model from five aspects which are economic, social, resources, environmental and intelligence, and conducts systemic evaluation. The conclusion demonstrates that the sustainable development level of the base of Northern Shaanxi region has greatly improved in nearly five years, but still needs further efforts.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The method to select industrial transfer to the less developed region — Taking Lankao Henan for example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research on motivation of corporate social responsibility based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The negative externalities of businesses brought serious social and environmental problems. Based on externality theory and game theory, the auther in-depth analyzes intrinsic motivation of corporate social responsibility. He points out that corporate social responsibility will increase production costs, so companies will not take the initiative to raise the level of social responsibility. Through the analysis of corporate social responsibility profits, the paper reveals that if the government lack reasonable system to regulate corporate behavior, then the firm, pursuiting maximizing profit, will choose the Nash Equilibrium of consumpting public resources, and not take the initiative to fulfill their social responsibility to seek the Pareto Equilibrium of the whole regional optimal, which results in high output and low returns. The research finds that the Government should strengthen the publicity of corporate social responsibility, privatization of corporate social responsibility benefits and establishment of corporate social responsibility system and other means to guide and standardize the corporate social responsibility.

articleTitle: Research on trust evaluation model for enterprise knowledge dissemination
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the development of economy, knowledge management is becoming a key approach to mold enterprise core competence. Trust has an important impact on knowledge dissemination which is the critical section of knowledge management. But in current research on knowledge dissemination there are few people studying trust evaluation mechanism. In this paper, we analyses effects of trust on enterprise knowledge dissemination and features of trust. Then we proposed a dynamic trust evaluation model, which considers features of trust and knowledge. The model is designed to regard actual factors of organization knowledge dissemination progress including participants, time and environment. All the work is expected helpful to enterprise knowledge management fulfilling process.

articleTitle: Demand forecasting method in logistics management based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper surveyed a novel demand forecasting method in logistics management based on Support vector machine. Firstly, a sliding time window is built and data in the sliding time window are employed to construct the model. Then we set up the demand forecasting model based on support vector regression. Results showed that this model proves to be effective and applicable for the demand forecasting in logistics management.

articleTitle: Game analysis on the behavior of Chinese designated hospital for social medical insurance in the least competitive area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Designated Hospital System (DHS) is the provider network formed by Chinese local government to provide service to the insured of Social Medical Insurance System (SMIS). This paper is an attempt to discover the problems of DHS in the least competitive situation by setting up a behavioral game model. We conclude that Designated Hospitals (DHs) have incentive to provide services at lower quality after they are in DHS, which runs in the opposite direction to what the government planned.

articleTitle: Improving autocorrelation and RFM autocorrelation performance of TD-ERCS sequence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Chaotic sequences have been widely used as pseudorandom sequences. But some well known chaotic sequence has poor autocorrelation, or after modulation, autocorrelation performance become poor, and their applications are limited. Such as TD-ERCS sequence, not only has poor autocorrelation performance, but also its RFM signal has poor autocorrelation, too. Based on recently presented APAS theorem, we modified TD-ERCS map to DS-TD-ERCS map, and DS-TD-ERCS sequence has excellent autocorrelation and RFM autocorrelation performance and has simple structure, whereas its other performances are remained invariant or become better, and can be used more widely.

articleTitle: How public investment promotes growth — Under cooperative game framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A public investment model based on cooperative game is established to analyze the public investments made by local governments. The model seeks to increase per capita income and decrease per capita income gap. Shapley value method is applied to solve the model. The principle of Shapley value is that one's payoff should be equal to his/her contribution. Experiment research demonstrates that the contribution rate of public investment may vary greatly from the public investment proportion.

articleTitle: Bank's E-business effect on the residential consumer behaviour in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Setting in the background of global economic fluctuation, the relationship between E-business of commercial bank and consumer behavior is a new issue in China. At the present, the profit of commercial banks in China mainly comes from traditional business (deposit and loan business), showing a great gap in the development of intermediary business when compares with banks abroad in developed country. Without any doubt, electronic information technology has brought enormous change in both financial industry and consumption filed. Based on the consumption model of Keynesianism, the study obtains a consumer spending extended model, which covers the usage of electronic payment tools, including internet banking payment, bank card payment and so on, also other relative factors. Meanwhile, through metering method, the essay attempts to analyze the influence of electronic application to banks on consumer spending and propensity to consume by using the data derived from consumers in Guangzhou and Zhuhai recently. The research result indicates that the absolute payment of bank card and E-bank rising will lead to not only the boost of private consumption, but also the enhancement of expense tendency, especially for those who has the experience of using the service of electronic banks before. Therefore, the electronic application to banks plays an active role in reducing the transaction cost, increasing the consumer welfare, enlarging the internal demand, stimulating economic growth and so on. At last, in accordance with the past and current consuming situation, the essay presents some suggestions on the improvement of electronic bank, ranging from policy, mechanism, to law and other aspects.

articleTitle: Inventory model optimization by considering different modelling strategies for defective percentage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper provides an inventory model, by allowing defective items and completely shortage backordering and investigates the features of the inventory model by modeling the defective percentage as the crisp number, the random variable and the fuzzy number, respectively. The optimization algorithms are developed and the optimum solutions in three modelling cases are given respectively. Finally, the numerical examples are illustrated the features of the model and quantitative comparisons are performed.

articleTitle: Board members' degree of SMS listed company and firm performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper authors studied the relationship between the board members' degree structure and firm performance by SPSS 16.0. The empirical study of this paper shows that Chairmen, other executive directors and independent directors' degree are not significantly correlated to firm performance. But, when introducing the variable Board size, we found the proportions of directors with doctor degree and directors with master degree (relative number) are positively correlated to firm performance. However, the scales of directors with bachelor degree and directors with college degree are not significantly correlated to firm performance. So, the more directors with high educational background in the Board, the better it is to improve firm performance.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of web-based system for graduation thesis management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the popularity of online education and e-learning, it is necessary for universities to realize the online management of graduation thesis, which is one of the most important teaching processes. In this paper, the technology solution including JSP + Tomcat + SQL Server 2005 is used to implement a web-based system for graduation thesis management, which can standardize the whole management process from thesis guide to oral defense. Based on requirements and feasibility analysis, technical solutions, system structure and core functions of this online system are introduced. Then, focusing on the system implementation of some core functionality, the key technologies are analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: Web-based visitor data management for China's trade fairs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Exhibition organizers around the world strive to make their fairs more competitive domestically and globally. Countries with mature exhibition industries, such as Germany, USA, and the UK, have focused greater attention in recent years on the use of web-based technologies for managing fair visitors' data. Similarly, many of China's fairs are increasingly using web-based technologies, although at a slower and less systematic pace. This paper examines different ways that web-based technologies can be effectively applied to the data collection and database management of trade fair visitors' trade-related information. The paper discusses the web-based management of visitors' data pre-fair, on-site, and post-fair

articleTitle: Cost competitive response and simulation based on the analysis of game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The enterprise must consider the idea of rivals and pay attention to the response due to the independence of management concept and message block under dynamic business environment. This paper establishes cost competitive response model with analysis tool based on game theory and discusses the advantage of cost competitive response and management idea of cost competitive simulation in detail, in order to formulate and implement the competitive strategy and overall strategy of enterprise to provide more powerful theory and technology support.

articleTitle: Analysis of government-led rural infrastructure financing mechanism model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper studies the financing mechanism of those infrastructure projects which need to be subsidized by the government, are marketable and endowed with quasi-public characters. By model analysis, this paper studies the dynamic game process of complete information between the government and investors, as well as the cooperative game process between the investors and the banks.

articleTitle: Research on optimization method of regular expression in data validation based on DFA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Regular expression is one of the most powerful input control technologies. However, processing regular expression for computer is difficult. This paper proposes a method to match token string by using the Min-DFA which is equal to regular expression. In this method, the input regular expression is converted into an equivalent NFA, and then, DFA. After that, a minimizing procedure can be executed. Finally, a Minimal DFA can be maintained by the system and can be used to matching the string which is equal with it. Examples showed that our method optimized the procedure of data validation.

articleTitle: Research and design of public service system of China's geological survey results
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Geological survey results have great economic and social value, which are of basic and strategic importance, in the course of national economic and social development. This paper comparatively analyzed domestic and international public service of geological survey results, from the aspects of service purpose and targets, service methods and means, service institutional system and regulatory policies. It is found that effectiveness of current geological survey results are affected by the existing decentralized information service systems, disjointing with demand and service, unclear incentive mechanism, and so on. Based on the analysis of these issues, this paper constructs and designs China's public service system of geological survey results, with National Geological Data Center as the core platform, to meet the demands of geological survey results. In addition, some supporting mechanisms including pricing mechanism, classified information management mechanism, and service incentive mechanism are suggested.

articleTitle: Analysis of the degree distribution of a multi-community consumer-producer network with both growing and rewiring dynamics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Many consumer-producer networks appear with community structure, and evolve with both growing and rewiring dynamics. In the present paper, we analyze a multi-community consumer-producer network model with both growing and rewiring dynamics. The growing rate and rewiring rate in each community evolve with time due to the interacting of communities. We prove that the steady degree distribution in each community of the multi-community consumer-producer network model is equivalent to that in a consumer-producer network model without community structure.

articleTitle: Research on requirements prioritization management of trustworthy software product
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Requirements priority set of trustworthy software is an importance activity in product requirements engineering, which is conducive to incremental development and stability of trustworthy software product. From the perspective of comprehensive analysis, this paper analyzes and discusses the connotations of trustworthy software requirement and requirement priority thoroughly, and puts forward three-layer scale priority classification for the general trustworthy software and two-layer scale priority classification for the complex trustworthy software., and also gives the detail process of functional requirements priority set and trustworthy requirements sorting. Finally, this paper analyzes the key factors of requirements priority set.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The analysis of the South-North Water Diversion Project's social risk based on risk conduction mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A trust model based on theory of evidence for e-commerce environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The internet allows anonymous peers to transact between the peers who have no information about each other. This maybe dangerous for the trader if the other trader is malicious for some special purpose. Trust management is an effective way to reduce the deception, imitation, and so on. A new trust model is presented in this study for the purpose of overcoming the fault in some extant models. The new trust model is based on theory of evidence and can handle different trust evaluation scales, which has a higher performance than the trust models based on Bayesian probability. The proposed model can also effectively depict the trust evaluation course and merge the computational result based on different trust evaluation scales.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Taking students as essentials, quality as foundation in cultivating advanced practice-oriented talents in Yantai University

articleTitle: The 3+3 model of the formation and evolution of the regional industrial division structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This thesis selects the specialized division structure as the research object, sets the specialized division structure as the dependent variable, the specialized division income as the independent variable, transaction efficiency as the parameters, constructs models that three microeconomic entities make choices of the specialized division among the three different products and infers the models with the inframarginal analysis approach. The result shows that the specialized division structures among the microeconomic entities are evolving into complete specialized ones.

articleTitle: Mobile electronic payment program design based on credit models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper describes the characteristics of electronic payment and the features of credit model and so on. And we focus on the solutions of how to embed credit model into mobile e-payment. We hope the study will help in the development of mobile electronic payment.

articleTitle: An X-method to get sensitive information
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A new approach, which is so called, to get the sensitive information is presented. The X-method consummates and improves the randomized response technique (RRT). It makes up essentially the limitation of Warner and Simmons models. It confirms both the deference of the individuals and the accuracy of the information. The result can be used in various sensitive information survey, such as the total number of the cheating students in examination, under table income, tax dodging, and ladies age, etc. It has potential applications in designing electronic device systems for information processing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on E-commerce taxation from an angle of China
