articleTitle: How to crack “resource curse”?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The phenomenon of resource curse means a wrong selection of developmental model, which stems from unreasonable institutions not the fault of abundant resource. A good institutional arrangement can coordinate manufacturing sector and resources sector and make natural resources become an economic booster to sustainable development, no longer a "resource curse." In the case, stagnation of economy development because of resource exhaustion will disappear. This paper tries to explore the reason of formation of resource curse in order to giving suggestion of success transformation of economy resource-based.

articleTitle: The governance models based on pricing in innovation ecosystem of hi-tech enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The innovation eco-system of hi-tech enterprises is an innovation system based on component/module with the character of knowledge difference, coexistence and co-evolution. The unfair interest distribution between member enterprises will initiate opportunism behaviors, whereas the technology permit pricing becomes the base weapon of effective governance. Abundant cases in terms of pricing contribute to demonstrating that the governance models of the innovation ecosystem involve the club model based on the access right and patent licensing, the radial model characterized by authority control and deeper cooperation, together with the penetration model in which cooperative enterprises at first obtain large customer scale through network effects arising from open source, then gain from the differentiated services and personal demands of platform.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The relationship between government regulation and technology options in telecom market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comparative advantage analysis of China's vegetables export trade — Based on comparison of Japan and Korea
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comparison and revelation of quality management of China's domestic typical auto enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The research on online independent learning model based on computational thinking
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The online independent learning is one of the topics, which is currently focused by educational technology. Computational thinking is another important concept that international computer field widely concerned on. With the feature of online learning model, this paper builds Online Independent Learning Model Based on Computational Thinking (OILMCT). Comparing with the traditional teaching model, the OILMCT makes a great improvement in developing learners' self-building knowledge and the capability of innovative thinking. Not only improve the learning efficiency, but also make learners' computational thinking capability getting progress.

articleTitle: The study of experimental models and teaching platform in the electronic experiment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the electronic experiment, we put forward three kinds of experimental educational models: "innovation experiment" model, "virtual experiment" model, "green experiment" mode, and applies them to construct the experimental teaching platform in multi-level and multi-forms. In paper, it is given that the specific content and implementation methods for the three kinds of experimental models. And what roles the experimental teachers should play are discussed. Finally the interaction between the experiment content and the international background, the social background and other factors are analysed. This will undoubtedly have some enlightening to building a new experimental teaching model and developing new demonstrating experiment, designing experiment and innovating experiment.

articleTitle: An prediction study on the visitors per-day amount of Shanghai World Expo2010 based on web search data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The web search data, which recorded hundreds of millions searchers' concerns and interests, reflected the trends of their behavior and provided essential data basis for the prediction study of the visitors per-day amount of Shanghai World Expo2010. This paper firstly analyzes the correlation between web search data and the visitors' amount per-day of Shanghai World Expo2010, and then builds a conceptual model to analyze the web search data and the trip of visiting Expo2010. On the basis of this, the paper checks the co-integration relationship between web search data and the visitors' per-day amount of Shanghai World Expo2010, and predicts the visitors' amount of seven days.

articleTitle: Energy diversification and sustainable economy growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Energy diversification is very important to the sustainable economy growth. In this paper we develop an endogenous growth model and analyze some major relationship between the energy diversification and sustainable economy growth. The dynamic optimization results of the model show that the technology progress will make great contributions to the energy diversification and the specialized energy R&D plays an important role in the energy diversification process, which can accelerates energy supply source expansion. Propelled by the specialized energy R&D, energy diversification will redistribute the labor force among different sectors, offset the adverse effects of diminishing marginal return of factors, and help economy step into sustainable growth e entually.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The review and prospect of theoretical research on knowledge integration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Human resource competency model based on quality culture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Quality culture is the core of corporate culture, which is fundamental strategy to achieve long-time competitiveness. For building quality culture, employee's competency is most important factor. In this paper, the Author firstly expounded the quality culture, and analyzed human resource competency required by quality culture. On these bases, human resource competency model was established; finally application on this model is partly illustrated.

articleTitle: Analysis on influencing factors about residents' training willingness on "Improving tourism area human environment"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Tourist's revisit willingness is directly influenced by human environment nearby tourism area, it becomes more and more important to improve the tourism area human environment to develop the local tourism well. Based on the sampling survey data from surrounding residents of Maijishan, national 4A scenic spot in Tianshui city, this paper empirically analyzes the influencing factors about residents' participation willingness to "Improving Tourist Area Human Environment” (hereinafter referred to as ITAHE) training by establishing logistic regression model. Research shows that the most obvious influence factors of training participation willingness are: residents' gender, education level, acceptable training expenses, cognition of relationship between local tourism and economic development; Factors such as residents' age and family numbers and so on have no significant effect on residents' training participation willingness. It is concluded by improving residents' cognition level that tourism can not only promote local economic development level, but also increase their incomes, and training for free, which are helpful to guide residents to participate in the training, so as to promote local tourism health, sustainable development.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Stratetgic network design for urban-rural integration logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The urban-rural relationship is an important social and spatial connection in a fairly long time in China. With the development of the urban-rural integration, the logistics service demand between two sides is increasing today. So the design and optimization of logistics network between city and rural area is consequentially a very important issue, which plans, implements and controls the efficient, effective dual-direct flow and storage of goods, services and related information between the point of producing area and the point of consumption in order to meet customers' requirement. In this paper, we formulate an integrated dual-direct multistage logistics network model with considering the direct shipment and direct delivery of logistics. Since such network design problems belong to a class of NP-hard problems, a genetic algorithm-based heuristics with associated numerical results is presented and tested in a set of problem by an exact algorithm to show the effectiveness of the proposed approach. A solution of a network design would help in determination of the capacities and location of facilities.

articleTitle: A data embedding algorithm using the voice activity detection of G.723.1 codec
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To take advantage of the non-speech intervals in voice signal, a data embedding algorithm based on the voice activity detection technology of G.723.1 codec algorithm is introduced. Based on the G.723.1 algorithm, a hybrid voice activity detection technology is implemented, which includes adaptive energy detection algorithm and linear predictive coding-based voice activity detector algorithm. In G.723.1, voice signal is encoded into three types of data frames: 1) active frame; 2) silence insertion descriptor frame; 3) untransmitted silence frame. The date embedding algorithm can be identify that whether the current frame is active speech or non-speech by detecting the code symbols, and then embed the secret data in non-speech frame to transmit. The experimental results show that the ratio of the embedded data transmission bitrates and the maximum voice signal transmission bitrates is up to 50% in the general voice calls sequence without reducing the voice quality. The algorithm effectively improves the utilization of the channels and is widely used in the applications of Voice over IP and video conferences.

articleTitle: Strategy and numerical analysis for sellers based on Priceline
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the famous reverse auction website Priceline, the following two situations are modeled for sellers: one is that customers bid and then sellers decide to accept or reject, and the other is that sellers set a price-limit before customers' bidding. Theoretical analysis proves that both the models are equivalent, which means the expressions of the optimal value function and the optimal price for sellers are the same separately. Three demand functions are considered of the second situation in numerical analysis with the following properties: 1) the marginal revenue increases in the remaining time, 2) the price-limit is monotone in the remaining time and items, 3) and the optimal value is the concave function of the remaining time and items separately.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent fuzzy logical terminal for fault diagnosis based on PDA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To overcome the difficulty of field fault diagnosis in the complicated circumstance of construction machinery, the intelligent diagnosis terminal is implemented based on fuzzy logic. A brief description of fuzzy logic diagnosis theory is introduced. The general architecture and function are presented, and using embed database, server-client structure and PDA-based terminal to realize the function. The hardware consists of PDA (Personal digital assistant), cradle and multifunctional DAQ card. As well the software is developed to carry data acquisition, remote communication, data query and fault diagnosis. It is due to the modular structure, the terminal is easy to be updated and integrated with other field testing system.

articleTitle: A study on the processing model of online customer reviews from DOC perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The development of internet and information technology provides customers a new opportunity to share their shopping experience online. Online customer reviews (OCR) have a significant value on purchasing decisions and corporate reputation management. However, how to aggregate and utilize OCR is a big challenge. This paper explores the OCR processing and proposes an OCR processing model by introducing relative theories from three-dimensional perspectives of demanding, ordering and centralization. Moreover, we study on the formalization of the three-dimensional OCR processing model. Case analysis shows that the processing model proposed in this paper can provide practical ideas and methods for further improvement of OCR processing.

articleTitle: The innovative profit mode of third-party payment platform in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: No corporation can gain significant development without profit-making methods, so do third-party payment corporations. Even though third-party payment corporations have huge user group, effective profit mode is still the precondition for the corporations to create greater service value. This paper analyzes the broad prospects of third-party payment platforms, and divides its current profit mode into two stages, i.e., absolutely-free mode to partially-charged mode. Finally, this paper raises four innovative profit modes for third-party payment platform.

abstract: This paper aims to present the roles of computers in computer-assisted language learning (CALL), discuss different classification of CALL programs, and propose some practical suggestions for CALL application in English language instruction in tertiary institutions in China, through metacognitive strategies training.

articleTitle: Modelling resource constraint to radiating area of urban agglomeration — Based on theory of endogenous economic growth and gravity equation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Urban agglomeration becomes increasingly important because of the globalization of world economies. Constraints of quantity and quality of resources influence mostly the radiating area of urban agglomeration. A method of relationship of resource constraint and radiating area of urban agglomeration is presented. Based on the methodology, models are constructed using the theory of endogenous economic growth and gravity equation. The discussions on the models have been specified to give recommendations for the development of urban agglomeration.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The analysis of the targeted promotion difference between discount card and score card
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The 2×10 experimental method is conducted in the paper to research the consumers' different opinions on owning wishes, acquiring method preference and promotion effect of discount card and score card. The “2” represents two kinds of loyalty card — discount card and score card. The “10” represents ten measured variables, including the owning wishes of loyalty card, the preference of the three kinds of acquiring methods of loyalty card(“buying” that is to spend some money buying a loyalty card, “buy gift” — that is to buy a certain amount of products can get a loyalty card without extra expense, “buying+10” that is to buy the products and add 10 yuan to acquire a loyalty card), the “card purchase ”cost accepted by consumers on “buying” loyalty cards, consumed sum “threshold” accepted by consumers on “buy gift” loyalty cards, the consumers' acceptance degree of “buying+10” loyalty cards, the consumers' information search will of products, the consumers' information search behavior of products, the consumers' repurchase behavior, the consumers' oral spreading will, the perceived value of loyalty card after being used. The research shows that consumers have a stronger will on the discount card than on the score card. Consumers' preferences of three ways to obtain discount cards are almost equal but consumers prefer to get score cards by “buy gift” and “buying+10”. When the discount card and the score card can be obtained in the same way, the cost of the two cards which consumers are willing to pay is different. There are three aspects: The first, as for the way of “buying” loyalty card, the purchase price of discount card accepted by consumers are basically same as that of score card. The second, as for the way of “buy gift” loyalty card, the amount of “threshold” which consumers are willing to pay for the discount card is higher than that of score card. The third, as for the way of “buying +10” loyalty card, it is easier for consumers to accept the discount card than to accept the score card. The information search will and the information search behavior of discount card members is less than that of score card members but the repurchasing behavior of both loyalty cards members is almost the same. The oral spreading will of discount card members is stronger than that of score card members and the perceived value of discount card after being used is higher than that of score card.

articleTitle: The application of variable fuzzy model in dam deformation evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the fact that most of the control factors of dam deformation behavior are fuzzy, and there exist no clear and absolute boundaries between different deformation grades, the variable fuzzy model is firstly applied to the dam deformation evaluation. Compared with other methods, the model could scientifically identify the relative membership degree and function between sample index and standard interval of each level index, and it can reasonably determine the evaluation level of each sample by varying model and its parameters. Firstly, the grade standard and the method of index normalization are determined. Secondly, the variable fuzzy model of dam deformation behavior is established. Finally, a case study is given and the results show the stability and suitability of the variable fuzzy model. Furthermore, compared with the existing evaluation results with the variable fuzzy model, the evaluation information between adjacent grades is described more detailed.

articleTitle: Research on bidding decision-making approach for construction enterprises based on group TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper advanced a decision-making model aiming at the bidding decision-making problem of construction enterprises on the basis of group TOPSIS. First, based on the fact of policy-makers preference issues that existed in decision-making and in order to narrow and reduce the phenomenon of great error brought by decision-makers' preference, this paper addressed an assumption that decision-makers were rational, and this paper formed a decision-makers position matrix; then, the multi-attribute decision-making integrated values given by group decision-makers to the bidding projects comprised a matrix, of which the entropy theory for data mining was adopted in this paper to determine the attribute weights; finally, the optimal decision-making conclusion was made based on TOPSIS method. Eventually, the feasibility and practicability of the model is verified by the example.

articleTitle: An analysis of joint development of China's e-commerce and modern logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Modern logistics and e-commerce is the most growth in a new industry. Electronic trading patterns comply with economic globalization and important changes in modern production and consumption patterns, while modern logistics is provided the possibility for these changes. With the joint development of e-commerce and modern logistics, we can set up efficient logistics operation mode within the enterprise, and save the cost, improve efficiency through the mutual use of resources in the external. These need close coordination and cooperation in technology, management model, information transmission, services and social economic resources integration and so on, which promote each other and coordinated develop.

articleTitle: Tacit and explicit knowledge spillover on regional economic growth: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Though the influences of explicit knowledge spillover on economic growth in China have been widely discussed in previous studies, the effects of tacit knowledge spillover and the relationship between tacit and explicit knowledge spillover have been less systematically investigated. This paper assesses how and to what extent tacit knowledge spillover contributes to regional economic growth in China. Moreover, the relationship between tacit and explicit knowledge spillover is also investigated in this study. Empirical results show that knowledge spillovers, both of tacit and explicit, import contribute significantly, with similar impact, to regional economic growth. The analyses also suggest the existence of tacit spillover as well as international knowledge spillover. Moreover, a positive relationship between tacit and explicit knowledge spillovers has been supported by the demonstration result.

articleTitle: Evaluation of overseas students' performance in Chinese courses using statistical learning

abstract: It is necessary to evaluate overseas students' performance in courses learning, which is closely associated with university-level management. In this work, based on supervised statistical learning, the training set includes overseas students' marks written on their assignments, and some other attributes. Nowadays, combining different classifiers is proposed as a new direction for the improvement of the classification accuracy. Therefore we adopt such strategy to construct the whole classification system which includes Support Vector Machine, Artificial Neural Network and Binary Decision Tree, using the voting methodology. Among other significant conclusions it was found that the proposed algorithm is appropriate to be used for the construction of a software support tool.

abstract: In recent years, with the financial reform and the deepening of financial innovation, commercial banks are facing increasing operational risk. Operational risk refers to the bank risk due to internal processes, employees, system defect, improper operation, or the direct or indirect losses under the impact of external events. This paper makes comparative study on the operational risk of listed commercial banks in China with managerial scale by income model.

articleTitle: The impact and implication of interest rate adjustment to risk management for Chinese commercial banks: Based on interest rate sensitivity model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Under the background of economic globalization, interest rate risk has become one of the most important risks for commercial banks in China. However, Chinese commercial banks are not sensitive to changes in interest rates because of the long-term control of interest rate. With the development of the process of marketization of interest rates, the interest rate risk of Chinese commercial banks will increase. Based on the interest rate sensitivity gap model, we analyze the interest risk of the commercial bank which is brought by rate adjustment in China. Then we make some recommendations for risk management.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the integration of quality methods: To realize multiple quality performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the concept of “big Q”, the company's quality target is diversified, thus the implementation of quality management methods in enterprise shows integrating trend. The question is: can the integration of quality methods applied effectively promote the multiple quality performance? This paper aims to investigate the integrated effect of ISO 9000 systems, National Quality Award (NQA) and Six Sigma on multiple quality performance. Based on the literature, six hypotheses are formulated. A set of 543 empirical data was obtained from the Continuous Improvement Survey in 10 countries. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was used to test the hypotheses. The results indicate that a significant association between integrated quality methods and multiple quality performance. The findings will provide empirical evidence to theoretical analysis of integrated quality management methodologies and lay a good foundation for integrating management systems.

articleTitle: Impacts of inter-organization partnership on information systems planning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Under the background of Inter-organizational cooperation extensively existed, the development and implementation of organizational Information systems planning (ISP) has to deeply consider the current and future needs, the internal and external resources available, and the organizational and inter-organizational applications. The IT strategy should be flexible and scalable for further expansion of applications and further development of application standards. ISP should focus on the formation of information systems norms, centralized management of information resources, systems integration, information technology security, etc. Integration of business processes from various organizations and effective communication among staffs with different organizational culture are also the key points.

articleTitle: The study of value model of mobile advertisement based on analysis of users' attitude
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Mobile advertisement is billing information disseminated by mobile media, which aims to sale products and service by influencing users' attitude, intention and behavior. In this paper, the mobile advertisement refers to the advertisements sent to consumers'cellphones in the form of Short Message, which broadly exists in mobile marketing. With the rapid rise of the mobile internet business, mobile advertisement will certainly be a powerful tool in mobile marketing. However, few research articles reveal the factors valued mostly in the mobile advertisement, which not only impedes the development of mobile advertisement, but also goes against to form the value chain of the mobile business. Thus, this paper establishes value model of mobile advertisement, analyzes and tests the effect of each factor which affects the value of mobile advertisement. The results show that reliability influences the value of mobile advertisement mostly. Advertisements with high sending frequency and advertisements without permission will make the value of mobile advertisement decrease.

articleTitle: Construction of training information management system of Cenozoic peasant workers in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Training information management system of the Cenozoic peasant workers is making full use of computer networks and information management function to base training management of peasant worker on information. The system enables information sharing among the Cenozoic peasant workers, training institutions and enterprise. As the enterprise inquires about the peasant workers training condition, training enthusiasm of peasant workers is improved, and human resources management is more standardized. This article based on analysis of the role of training information management systems of the Cenozoic peasant workers, has developed the general structure of the system and described the function of each system module, Finally, proposed the way of system management and realization, promoted the design and the implementation of training information management system of the Cenozoic peasant workers.

Finally, it shows the science and rationality of the model using data in recent years of China's listed companies.

articleTitle: Research on the interactive evolution mechanism of manufacturing and service industry based on dissipative structure theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The Brusselator model of interactive evolution between manufacturing and service industry was presented based on dissipative structure theory. This article discussed the arguments such as the relationship of manufacturing and service industry, the development order, their proportion and so on by the analysis of the model. The main findings were as follows: (i) Logistics, marketing, maintain and other traditional producer services would counteract the total development level of service industry. But the producer services which could help add intrinsic value to product such as R&D, management consultation and others could promote service to develop.(ii) The interactive evolution of manufacturing and service industry was an alternative process priority.(iii) The service scale should be consistent with manufacturing scale, manufacturing efficiency, catalysis efficiency of manufacturing to service, promotion efficiency of producer service to manufacturing and market efficiency. And it should be kept in finite interval. (iv) In the recent years, the proportion of service in GDP continued to decline, the main reason was that our market efficiency was still too low. The key of developing service was to increase the market efficiency.

articleTitle: An empirical study of service quality and tourist loyalty in the tourism mobile commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: While the importance of tourist loyalty has been recognized by academic researchers for at least four decades, adequate tourist loyalty models have not been developed or validated. This study presents a tourist loyalty model of tourism mobile commerce and explores the relationship of service quality, tourist satisfaction, tourist trust and tourist loyalty. The structural model was tested on a sample of 291 tourists at Guilin in China. The empirical validation of the conceptual model supports the research hypotheses. Technology quality and function quality affect the tourist satisfaction, which positively relates to tourists' attitude loyalty as well as tourists' behavior loyalty. The link between tourist satisfaction and tourist trust was also confirmed. These research findings contribute to a better understanding of how tourist satisfaction affect tourist loyalty, and this study offered an approach to help improve service quality toward tourist loyalty.

articleTitle: Study on the incentive mechanism of knowledge transfer from the service provider in outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper builds and solves a Hotelling model to explore the incentive mechanism about the knowledge transfer from the service provider in outsourcing. The results show that the incentives from the client can improve the knowledge transfer effect level of the service provider efficiently, and the equilibrium piece rate is lower for the higher service provider's degree of (constant absolute) risk aversion, larger service provider's effort costs and greater outsourcing risk. In additional, the client's incentive level can also enhance the client firm performance efficiently.

articleTitle: Design and realization of farm produce online transaction system based on the browser/service architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: An online transaction system was developed to meet needs of online exhibition and electronic trading platform construction for rural farm produce markets through applying the software tools Studio.NET 2005 and Microsoft SQL Server 2005. Function module structure of farm produce online transaction system was designed, system data flow chart and data entity attributes were described, typical system interfaces were given, and corresponding business process was summarized, based on the current state analysis of rural farm produce markets. Practices showed that this platform system with functions such as information release and online transactions, had improved the business efficiency and informatization construction level of farm produce trading. Designment and realization of online transaction system provided a solution for informatization construction of rural farm produce markets, and this system makes characteristic agriculture products more convenient and efficient to be exchanged.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the development of Chinese stock market, more and more attentions have been paid to the prediction of financial risk of listed companies. So far, our studies on financial risk prediction model have achieved a lot, but the rest ill existed some faults because of the limitation of surrounding conditions, the most prominent of which was the simplification of variables selection. Theoretically, earnings per share(EPS) can reflect the profitability of firm most, but operating cash flow per share can reflect the quality of EPS most. In addition, firm's cash numbers can be influenced by the change of market and financial environment directly, so we can decide and measure the financial risk through the comparison of cash flow during a certain period. This article expects to make progress on financial risk prediction model by taking cash flow information into account.

articleTitle: A study on cooperative members' investment behaviors based on the multi-stage dynamic game model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Farmer Cooperative Organization Plays an important role in developing agricultural production and rural economy, but it is instable and fluctuates for lack of funds. By analyzing their decision making behavior based on the multi-stage dynamic game model, the author found out that individuals of farmer cooperatives tend to have herd behavior in investment decision making. The results of the study show that one effective solution to the funds shortage is to first attract those capable core individuals who possess more social capital to invest into the cooperatives, since other individuals will be affected by them to invest.

Author Keywords: investment behavior of individual in cooperatives

articleTitle: Study of the GNIP management model in post-disaster reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Combining the characteristics of Government Nonprofitable Investment Project in post-disaster reconstruction, this paper analyze the function cost in each stage of life cycle using the function analysis system technique theory, then establish the life cycle cost analysis model for functions, and will be illustrated by a case of post-disaster reconstruction according to the various segments at all stages of the project management according to the function of project management model.

articleTitle: International competitiveness of agro-products in Zhejiang — An empirical study based on Double Diamond Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Zhejiang is one of the largest Provinces as an agro-products exporter. This paper analyzes the factors, both domestic and international, that influence the international competitiveness of agrio-products by applying Double Diamond Model. Finally, we propose some countermeasures for improving the international competitiveness of the agro-products in Zhejiang province.

articleTitle: The local government financing efficiency: An evaluation based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Nowadays in china, the local governments have a strong financing need under the circumstances of financial and administrative asymmetry. Various approaches have been tried and their efficiencies are different. This paper uses the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to assess the efficiencies of three financing methods which are commonly used by the local governments. The result shows that the efficiency of local bonds financing is higher than that of land financing and platform financing. platform financing lacks efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the application of the large-system theory in the production arrangement of oil fields
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The comprehensive production arrangement is one of the optimal decision problems concerning the oil field development plan. It is a complex large scale system problem which includes multi-objectives and multi-factors and consists of many segments. For such a problem, we cannot do the research work segment by segment insolently. It is necessary to give a integrate study on the problem as a whole. Therefore, it is meaningful to find an effective method to solve the production arrangement problem as well as the development plan of an oil field. This thesis begins with the practical characteristics and importance of the oil field production arrangement. It gives then the description of present research situation of the oil field development plan. The research approaches and the characteristics of large-system theory are also presented. On this basis, the oil field production arrangement model is established. The model is resolved by means of decomposition — coordination principle of objective coordinate algorithm of large-system theory. In order to coordinate the demand of best output arrangement between the whole and each district of the oil field, it revised the objective function, and then, inferred the solution algorithm for the model.

articleTitle: Research on the characteristic of fractal patterns of the relationship between input and output of Zhejiang province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to analyze the input-output structure in urban areas of China, this paper investigated the characteristic of fractal patterns of Zhejiang province using the model of fractal structure of the urban areas and that of C-D function. Labor, land, investment and energy are chosen as the input factors and GDP the output factor, and the dynamic similarity analysis is carried out on the relationship between the factors of input and output during the year of 1990–2008. The results demonstrate that there is apparent characteristic in time series, and the scale factor b presented in this paper is of the character of fractional dimension. And in addition, we can reach the conclusion that the structure of the input-output system in urban areas of Zhejiang is on optimizing.

articleTitle: Research on the e-commerce basing on Web3D technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the shortcomings of current online virtual stores, the concept of the three-dimensional ecommerce model is proposed by combining with the new demands of e-commerce and features of Web3D technology in this paper which emphasizes the inevitability of the usage of Web3D technologies in e-commerce, On this basis, the paper describes a designing strategy of virtual online shopping mall which is based on the Web3D technology through analyzing the implementation of Web3D. The main functions and features of the system are discussed in detail, the basic design ideas of the system was also illustrated. A three-dimensional virtual shopping environment is provided for the user.

articleTitle: Does low inflation imply low inflation persistence: New evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper investigates the nature of China inflation persistence over the recent 12 years employing a bootstrapped median unbiased estimator that provides correct asymptotic coverage. Empirical results show that inflation in China remains highly persistent during the past decade. This finding suggests that low inflation does not imply low inflation persistence.

articleTitle: Service innovation for adjustment of agricultural structure: Management model of “Three Fives”: Based on the practice of Jili District Government in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the promotion of agricultural structure adjustment, Jili District Government in Henan Province cultivated the management model of “Three Fives”, i.e. the organizational model of “Five Alliances”, the operational model of “Five Links” and the management model of “Five Unions”. It has been proved that it is of great help to the adjustment and optimization of agricultural structure if the government plays a better role of bridge or ties and performs its functions of comprehensive services. In details, the government should integrate various resources, such as scientific institution, financial department, peasant, company and media to construct modern agricultural organization and provide technological information, research resources, project, start-up capital and scientific demonstration for peasants; establish a public service platform to provide information service for peasants' cultivation, base management, company organization, factory's processing, market forecast and scientific service for the development of product market; establish an agricultural management platform to realize unified management and supervision of the whole process, including seed supply, technical training, product label, product pricing and marketing.

articleTitle: Economic growth and industrial pollution: Evidence from the urban panel data in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the urban panel data in China from 2003 to 2008, this paper explores the relationship between economic growth and industrial pollution including industrial wastewater, industrial SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission and industrial soot emission. The results confirm an inverted-U or environmental Kuznets curve (EKC) relationship between economic growth and industrial pollution in China. For most cities, industrial wastewater and SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission will keep increasing as per capita GDP grows, while industrial soot emission has been on the decrease with the economic development. Meanwhile, industrial structure, technological progress and FDI have some effects on the relationship between economic development and industrial pollution.

articleTitle: Expert finding in virtual learning community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Virtual learning community has become an important way for people to acquire knowledge in this Internet age. Usually, users post their questions online and wait others to review the post before any answers could be offered. Yet more than often, those who maintain domain knowledge concerning specific questions, which we will call expert, may not be able to notice these questions in time due to the tremendous amount of posts in a forum. This leads to long waiting period for questioners, and even unresolved questions. To tackle this problem, a solution based on forum expert finding is proposed in the paper. The proposed method performs analysis on existed data of forum, attempts to figure out experts in the learning community and therefore provides proactive service for users. It improves efficiency of answering process and eliminates waiting period of users.

articleTitle: Study on the platform of dynamic inspection for land resource based on business-driven model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this article it is shown that the Land Law Enforcement and Supervision Management System of Chengdu has been established based on the mode of platform thought and the strategy of “centralized management and distributed application". It is realized via integrating the mobile GIS technology, CDMA wireless communication, network real-time differential positioning service, the workflow platform and WebService, and so on. In this system, land inspectors use the portable PDA terminal to collect accurate field data, and then to transfer it to the data center in real-time via CDMA wireless communication. Finally all the transferred data is saved, processed and managed in database based on business model. The foregoing process, therefore, constitutes a platform for the dynamic inspection of land resource, which could be used for the land law enforcement and inspection, the interception and prevention of illegal land use, the collection of accurate field data in real-time, mobile office, the investigation of illegal cases and the punishment for those who shall be held accountable, and the transfer of cases. The platform comprises four parts: the Satellite Positioning Service System Based on the Virtual Reference Station, the GPS-PDA Dynamic Inspection and Data Acquisition System, the 3-level Network Management System for Chengdu Land Law Enforcement and Supervision, and the Digitalized Monitoring Center for Chengdu Land Law Enforcement.

articleTitle: An method of estimating ratio coefficient to distribute benefit in industry-university cooperation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: How to apply the mathematical model to determine the ratio coefficient of distributing benefit in industry-university cooperation is a difficult problem. Based on the terms of payment mode is mixed this paper studied benefit distribution in industry-university cooperation, This paper deduced the formula for calculating the best ratio coefficient through build the mathematical model, Finally use the specific data of AB corporation co-operative project made confirmatory calculation to illustrates the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Inventory and cost model of three interrelated supply chains with various uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A three interrelated supply chains model which is the combination of the horizontal supply chain and the vertical supply chain is proposed in this paper. A control model of inventory and cost with uncertain parameter, multi-production time-delays and multi-disturbance inputs is developed, and the robust H» control strategy is used to control its uncertainties. The study shows that through the static feedback control of three interrelated supply chains inventory state, it can make the supply chain achieve the goal of controlling parameter uncertainty and restraining uncertainty disturbance effectively, and provides a robustness strategy for enterprises with re-use of the production waste to deal with uncertainty disturbance.

articleTitle: Research on third-party e-business model of small-and-medium enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Small-and-medium enterprises, as the most active group with the greatest development potential, are the backbone of implementing the national strategy, innovating independently and promoting the industrialization of science and technology, which can represent the future of China's economy. As the grim situation of global economic integration and internationalized competition, the small-and-medium enterprises are facing the unprecedented difficulties of the existence and development. However, the rapid popularization of the e-business has brought a new chance for them. The urgently concerned problems for all small-and-medium enterprises are how to play their own strengthens and explore a appropriate e-business development model, which has not only great significance for the survival and development of the small-and-medium enterprises but also profound influence to the sustainable, healthy and stable development of China's economy.

articleTitle: Application of the grey system model to development of biogas in the city of Huixian
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a renewable energy, biogas is not only an important part of the development of rural new energy, but also an important aspect of sustainable development in China. In this paper, with the date from 2003 to 2009, we use the method of grey correlation model to analysis the influence factors of rural household biogas in the city of Huixian. The results point out: the factors that affect rural household biogas, from big to small, are numbers of technicians, rural per capita net income, construction cost of biogas digesters, amount of livestock manure, and subsidy. Besides we make the GM(1, 1) model and forecast the development trend, then give some correlation suggestions for rural biogas in the city of Huixian.

articleTitle: Student organization system based on the knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As the intense disturbance of organization survival environment and rapid development of information technology, knowledge and human capital become important economic factors of replacing resources and financial capital Student organizations made up of university students are non-profit organizations, which possess liquidity characteristics, valid existence and maintaining a good survival level become the key issues to be researched by such organizations. The paper selects university students Career Planning Center of Harbin Science and industrial university as research objects, discusses the new problems of such organizations. On the basis of analyzing problems and reasons of career planning, the paper constructs knowledge management model, puts forward specific improvement projects and establishes career planning management flow chart based on knowledge management, in the end proposes operation safeguarding measures.

articleTitle: Comparative research on the predicted and the actual audit opinion of Chinese listed companies on GEM board
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper uses the existing model to forecast the audit opinion in 2009 and makes the comparison between the predictions and the actual audit opinion based on the data of Chinese listed companies on GEM board in 2009. The results show that the predictions match the actual audit opinion. It means Chinese listed companies on GEM board maintain a good auditing quality. Moreover, the financial report and the financial disclosures satisfy the relevant regulation.

articleTitle: Dynamic relationship analysis of the two stock markets with a Canada stock market factor: Study of Italy and Germany countries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The empirical results show that the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC) and the bivariate AGARCH (1, 2) model appropriates in evaluating the relationship of the Italy and the Germany's stock markets. The empirical result also indicates that the Italy and the Germany's stock markets is a positive relation. The average estimation value of correlation coefficient equals to 0.878, which implies that the two stock markets is synchronized influence. Besides, the empirical result also shows that the Italy's and Germany's stock markets do have an asymmetrical effect. The return volatility of the Italy's and Germany's stock markets receives the influence of the positive and negative of the Canada's stock return volatilities, and the variation risks of the Italy's and Germany's stock market returns also receives the influence of the Canada's stock return volatilities. The explanation ability of the bivariate AGARCH (1, 1) is better than the bivariate IGARCH (1, 1) model.

articleTitle: Identification analysis of influencing factors of informationization construction in rural areas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the basis of systematically analyzing external factors and internal factors of the informationization construction in rural areas of Jilin Province, this paper mainly analyzes the factors of basic conditions, economic environment and social environment of the informationization construction in rural areas. It determines the key factors of the informationization construction in rural areas of Jilin Province by using “DEMATEL” method, and it is of realistic significance to determine the next goal and path of the informationization construction in Jilin Province.

articleTitle: The effect of free trade area on technology innovation: An analysis of mechanism and empirical test
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Under the trend of economic globalization, the domestic and international markets are very competitive. The establishment of free trade area (FTA) makes member countries much easier to communicate with each other and introduce advanced technologies, so technological innovation ability of the member countries can be promoted through trade, FDI, etc. Such effects are testified in this paper with the R&D input-output function and time series data of the representative countries in NAFTA, ASEAN, such as America, Canada, Mexico, Singapore and China. The empirical results show that after entering into the FTA, each member country's innovation level is enhanced obviously, however, the impacts are different for the member countries of different FTAs.

articleTitle: The pig order price game based on quantity and quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Order-driven healthy breeding of pig industry chain organization pattern is the research themes of the article it takes over from the local pig breeding pattern in health promotion and has been widely departure of two scenarios. Use of organizational behavior theory and game theory, based on the contractual relationship between the subjects discussed aquaculture processing and marketing of the main subject and the slaughter pig prices of goods between the revenue sharing game behavior, basing the results of the analysis on the game, and further discussed the impact of communication between the stability of order relations of frequency and depth of subjects related to the size and type of risk preference of the main factors, the introduction of health and promotion of culture mode on the stability and the stability of the significance of order relations for China healthy breeding of pig industry chain promotion and industrial development model provides a theoretical and empirical evidence.

articleTitle: A dual pseudo random sequence digital watermarking algorithm based on DCT
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a improved algorithm to embed and detect the digital watermark in digital image. And it uses a highly efficient and practical programming tool MATLAB to achieve a block-based on DCT domain digital watermark embedding and extraction validated. First, transform the watermark information into a binary string, with dual unrelated normal pseudo random sequence of real numbers representing the 0 and 1 of the watermark information embedded in the image of the DCT middle frequency coefficients. After these attacks based detection of correlation matrix to extract the correct watermark. Demonstrate the robustness and invisibility. Propose some improvement methods.

articleTitle: Development of standard device for steam flow measurement used condensing weighing method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The standard device for steam flow measurement is developed on the basic principle of condensing weighing method. The basic principle, structure, and main technical measures of the device are introduced. And the experiment was conducted to validate the device stability. The development of this device would produce great significance for the relevant research projects of steam flow measuring.

articleTitle: The empirical study on the relationship between information technology capability and innovation performance: The moderating role of learning commitment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: More and more organizations begin to employ information technology capability strategy in the dynamic and complicated environment, but from the information technology capability to innovation performance, it should be some effects of other variables. And also, the focus point of relevant research changes from whether it should be build the information technology capability to the mechanism of how to construct the information technology capability and possible difficulties in this process. Based on previous studies, the study makes all explorative study of the relationship between information technology capability and innovation performance. Then the moderation effect of learning commitment on the relationship is discussed and examined empirically by developing structural equation models using partial least squares method with evidence from Chinese's firms.

articleTitle: The influencing factor analysis of water-saving irrigation technology adopted by farmer: A case study in Heilongjiang
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Within the context of increasingly scarce water resources, improving the utilization rate of irrigation water on protecting food safety problems plays an important role. On the basis of the survey data of 364 farmers in Heilongjiang Province, this paper used the cumulative logit model to analyze the factors influencing water-saving irrigation technologies, and the results showed that: the relation among factors such as education level, cultivated area, the proportion of crop income, government support etc. has a positive correlation. Therefore, the water-saving irrigation technology may be properly promoted and implemented if the educational level of farmers is raised, the government subsidies for irrigation technology are increased and the farmers cultivated scale is expanded.

articleTitle: Tourists' preferences of Chinese EDI in information search based on series of discriminant analysis of cross-cultural marketing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Definitely, it is difficult to find either memorial or external information of tourism destinations for international, especially intercontinental tourists. But for them to be fronting variety of Chinese destination image, and to be attracted to some destinations, diversiform etourism websites developed by international travel agents are demonstrating a potent instrument. Accordingly, based on 78 English etourism websites picked from searched 3130 websites through Google Search, extracted 33 EDI characteristics designed independent variables are extracted. And depended on Alexa Traffic Details, the countries' usage percentages were obtained. Series of discriminant analysis (DA) were utilized to estimate the cross-cultural tourists' preferences of EDI determinants. Findings are that preferences of tourists are existing, the classified significance of EDI characteristics is prompting, and international tourism market segmentation oriented continental plate is proposed.

articleTitle: The economic transition of Shanghai based on 3-IN entrepreneurial model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The economic development of Shanghai now is strictly restrained by exhausting of fossil fuel, deterioration of ecological environment and lacking of raw materials and natural resources. How to break through the bottleneck and find a sustainable way of growth becomes a matter of prime importance to Shanghai. The 3-IN (Internet, Information, Innovation) entrepreneurial model proposed in this paper is based on the Long-Tail theory. It is more feasible to realize in the urban economic environment like Shanghai.

articleTitle: A theoretical explanation of collective forest tenure reform mode in China — Based on two level evolution game model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In China, collective forest tenure reform is the process of repeated games among three stakeholders about central government, local government and farmers. It includes not only macro-level game between central government and local government, but also the micro-level's which between local government and farmers. This paper analyses the process of evolutionary stable equilibrium in collective forest tenure reform with two level's evolutionary game model and proposes it should consider benefit maximization of game subjects, encourage institutional innovation coming from micro-level and improve supervision mechanism to avoid the local government's "rent-seeking" behavior in collective forest tenure reform in China.

articleTitle: Governance mechanism, expropriation and controlling shareholders' shares
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on agency theory, this study discusses how a firm arranges its controlling shareholders' shares in order to eliminate the expropriation on minority shareholders. The study finds that the controlling shareholders' shares should at least exceed some proportion. The stronger the level of internal monitoring is, the higher the quality of external governance mechanism is, the lower the lowest controlling shareholders' shares to eliminate expropriation will be required. The study also finds that the internal and external corporate governance mechanism can be complemented each other, and co-determine the lowest controlling shareholders' shares required to eliminate expropriation. In addition, the ability of controlling shareholders to obtain private benefits has also an important impact on the required lowest controlling shareholders' shares.

articleTitle: Analysis on the impact of rural commodity circulation on China's rural economy at different phases — Based on panel data for 31 provinces
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper groups the panel data of rural commodity circulation and rural economic growth of 31 provinces from 1990 to 2008 into three phases and made quantitative analysis of the impact rural commodity circulation on our country's rural economic growth by bring in variable intercept model. The results show that rural commodity circulation can significantly improve rural economic growth and its influence coefficient would decrease before increasing.

articleTitle: Outlier detection based on Voronoi diagram for high frequency financial data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: High frequency financial data possess unique features absent in data measured at lower frequencies, and analysis of these data poses interesting and unique challenges to econometric modeling and statistical analysis. The Traditional outlier detection method is based on statistical models, such as ARMA and ARCH, which require special hypotheses and are inappropriate to apply to high frequency data. This paper proposes a novel outlier detection method for high frequency financial data, which called Voronoi based Outlier Detection. Experiments show the new method performs effective in outlier detection for both daily and ultra-high-frequency financial data.

articleTitle: Optimization of "charging-parking" combined parking deck based on computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: China is already the world's fastest-growing car market and is going to be one of the world's biggest PHEV's markets. Motivated by both of the PHEV's and traditional vehicles' parking requirement in urban area and the upcoming off-board charging demand from PHEV owners, It is very urgent to construct combined parking decks, which contain both charging space and parking space, in urban area to satisfy those demand. In this paper, we develop a series of analysis to optimize the construction of “charging-parking” combined parking deck based on the computer simulation technique. We discover that the relationship among different factors includes: (1) The configuration of the parking deck should be reasonable; (2) The customer's average balking rate is relevant to the configuration of the parking deck and the PHEV's market share; (3) The average leaving state of charge only depends on the rated power of charger.

articleTitle: Study on coordinative utilization problem of land-use under the urban-rural integration background: A case study of Chengdu experimental zone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to realize the coordinative utilization problem of land-use under the urban-rural integration background, In this paper we took Chengdu city as an example, constructing the urban land coordination evaluation system which based on the coordinative degree model and selected the evaluation factors from the resources environment, economy and society. Systematology, statistics and coordinative degree model were used for this case study. As one of the Coordinating Urban-Rural development experimental areas in China, experiences of Chengdu city can help us to analysis the coordinative utilization problem in land-use planning and management efficiently.

articleTitle: A risk evaluation method based on evidence theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Lots of uncertainties exist during risk evaluation. This paper takes advantage of the evidence theory during processing uncertainties to solve the problems in risk evaluation. By modeling the hierarchy index system of the risk objective, calculating the value of evaluation indicators and fusing the uncertain information, this paper illuminates the common steps showing how to use the evidence theory to value the risk. This paper offers a new and more reasonable method to deal with the uncertainty in risk evaluation.

articleTitle: Research and Application of the Bayesian financial distress prediction model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Dataset used in financial distress prediction is unbalanced. The traditional machine learning method such as neural network and support vector machine is premise with the hypothesis that the class distribution is basically balanced. The classification of unbalanced dataset inclines to the relative majority samples results in the lower identification of the minority while the conventional down-sampling results in the important information loss of the majority class. A financial distress prediction model is established based on the complete dataset of the listed companies in China by expressing the profile of expert knowledge in the way of prior probability combined with the Naive Bayesian. It is proved that compared with the classic machine learning method model, the new model gets the better predictive validity.

articleTitle: Asset pricing and systematic liquidity risk: Empirical evidence from the China stock market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this study, we examine whether aggregate market liquidity risk is priced in the China stock market. We define a bivariate Garch(1, 1)-in-mean specification for the market portfolio excess returns and the aggregate market liquidity. The findings, based on daily data, suggest that risk of market return sensitivity to aggregate market liquidity and volatility risk of liquidity are priced in the China over the period December 16, 1996 to November 8, 2010 while whether market risk is priced is uncertain.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper studies the status quo and developing trend of electronic commerce. The enterprises of high-end manufacturing industry should adjust its development strategy by take advantage of electronic commerce. It can rapidly promote the overall level of manufacturing through adjusting the global technology integration, exerting comparative advantage and reducing cost. By playing junior advantage, it become the qualified competitors in globalization tide of business quickly. At the end of this article, we state that advanced manufacturing electronic commerce should have three characteristics.

articleTitle: The feasibility study and the business models establishing of innovative service patterns on tourism enterprises' network experiential marketing — Taking the Chinese Ethnic Culture Park as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid development of Internet, Online shopping and online entertainment has been becoming the living patterns of Chinese consumers. The real-time interactivity of Internet makes it different from other consumer environment, which brings good opportunities to online customer's experiences and the development of brand services. This paper is taking the Chinese Ethnic Culture Park as an example, using online and offline questionnaires to study the innovation service patterns and business models which are Website-based, seeing network users as the ultimate customers and the tourists' experiential marketing promoted. The results of study show that using network platform and launching video and writing, which are infectious and could reflect the natural and humanistic characteristics of tourist enterprises, is a mutual need of both network users and tourism enterprises. In addition, it not only can bring Internet users the travelling experiences they are looking forward to, but also can arouse their strong interests in tourism enterprises and their products, so that it can achieve the goal of promoting the tourism enterprise's popularity and reputation.

articleTitle: CBLOS: Improving local outlier detection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new technique for local outliers detection based on clustering. In terms of the local data behavior, we construct a formula for computing cluster-based local outlier score (i.e. CBLOS) within clusters. Using real-world datasets, we demonstrate that CBLOS can be used to efficiently identify outliers.

articleTitle: Exploration on model conceiving of universities organization change based on learning organization theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: After explaining the concept of universities and colleges, and review the relative research of the learning organization and learning university, the issue analyzed the necessity and possibility of the universities organization change based on the learning organization. Based on the learning organization theory, the issue advanced the basic principles of the model conceiving and then the issue tentatively put forward the universities change model under the view of leaning organization based on the ‘three stage model of change management’ theory. At last, the issue advanced the basic paths of carrying out the change model from the aspects of lay dimensionality and content.

Author Keywords: the change of universities and colleges

The integrated model was empirically tested with 260 online social network users. The results indicate that all hypothesized paths are supported by our data. Based on the research findings, we offer discussions.

articleTitle: Study on internal control system of the state-owned commercial bank computer systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to reveal “double-edged sword” effect in the information construction of state-owned commercial banks (SCBs), confirmatory factor analysis is used in this paper. By internal control system design in SCBs information system, single-dimension scale test, reliability analysis and validity testing, confirmatory factor analysis can effectively reveal the correlation between the information construction and the internal control of information system in SCBs. For illustration, the collected copies are 201 independent accounting units in four state-owned commercial banks nationwide, in which 194 copies are valid. The empirical results show that the effectiveness of sample composition is stronger, factor loadings on the corresponding factor of each indicator is greater than 0.5 for the critical value. The minimum value of Cronbach's α is 0.7129 and the sample reliability is higher. Model fitting works well, and has high convergence validity without the need for revision. The empirical research has revealed that the internal control of Chinese SCBs information system is still in a non-mature state that needs to be improved.

articleTitle: Food safety traceability model based on EAN.UCC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Due to constant food crises, food safety has become a hot topic. With the safety of food now commonly recognized as credence attribute, consumers have to rely on the trust they have towards producers, retailers and regulators to ensure potential health impacts are minimized. The distortion of food safety information in the food supply chain is still the key point of the food risks control. By building up a food traceability system based on EAN.UCC, each section of supply chain can be supervised, from cultivation, production, packaging and retailing to consumption. Food safety traceability is considered to be the most important method for food safety control.

articleTitle: Research of online trust in C2C electronic commerce based on website institutions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Online trust crisis restricts consumers from online business; as a result increasing trust of online business is an important approach for developing C2C electronic commerce. From the view of customers, the paper compartmentalizes online business trust into three aspects: trust to online environmental, trust to websites and trust to sellers, and then carries an empirical research in antecedents of the three types of trust. Through the multiple regression analysis on questionnaires, the result shows that: individual trust tendency has an positive effect on trust to online environment, trust to websites and trust to sellers, however, the regression coefficient of the environmental trust is the biggest among the three coefficients; the validity of the reputation feedback the real name authentication the third party payment, the interaction and communication have an significance positive effect on the trust to websites, among them the regression coefficient of the validity of the third party payment is the biggest; The seller's reputation has a significance positive effect on the trust to sellers but the seller's scale has no significance effect on it.

articleTitle: The consistency validation method of the DODAF described Models based on meta-data Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to improve the compatibility and commonality of the consistency validation method of the DODAF described Models, and to achieve the data-centered system architecture development methods, a consistency validation method of the DODAF described Models based on meta-data Model is proposed in the paper. Firstly, the concept and the content of the DODAF meta-data Model are introduced, and the essentiality of the consistency validation method of the system architecture based on meta-data Model is analyzed. Secondly, the theorem to judge the inconsistency among the DODAF described Models is proposed and proved. Thirdly, the method of analyzing the inconsistency among the DODAF described Models based on the theorem above is researched. Finally, the method is demonstrated by a typical example.
