articleTitle: Towards a maturity model of knowledge management competences as an organisational capability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The resource-based view of the firm is used to study the role of organizational knowledge in establishing sustained competitive advantage. The concept of t Riege he organisational knowledge capabilities development analyzes the organisational capabilities in three principal dimensions: Knowledge Management (KM) infrastructures, KM processes and KM competences. However to better determine this concept; it is important to know what the impact of each dimension in organizational transformation is. In this work, we are interested in the impact of KM competences as an organisational capability in the context of organizational transformation and learning for business performance. Indeed, the literature in knowledge management, management and information technology shows that the development of the organisational capabilities is strongly related to the use of a maturity model. However, there is very little work on the literature which develops a specific maturity model for KM competences as organizational capability. For this reason, the objective of this paper is to propose a KM Competences maturity model (KMCMM) for KM competences that shows an organisational transformation.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of open teaching management and control system based on QFD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Teaching quality management and control is the important measure to raise the efficiency of teaching management, to improve the teaching level of teachers, to ensure the quality of students, to increase the employment rates of students and satisfaction degrees of enterprises. This paper analyzes the application of QFD(Quality Function Development) in open teaching management and control system, discusses the main functions of the open teaching management and control system based on QFD.

articleTitle: The research and realization of the system of the timeliness assessment of E-government web sites based on the semantic analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In today's Information Age, E-government has become increasingly important to government management and services. However, most E-government websites fail to maintain timeliness, which to a certain extent limits the function of the government and damages the government's image. Currently, studies on web information timeliness assessment are not yet mature with only a few experts and scholars involved in the field. Thus, how to assess the information timeliness on government websites has become a serious problem. Over recent years, Chinese segmentation has increased the efficiency of useful information access with constant technology development, which makes it possible to use semantic analysis to assess the timeliness of websites information. In this context, we propose a semantics-based assessment system to evaluate web timeliness. We will build an assessment system model to evaluate the timeliness of related news websites. Our evaluation results are highly consistent with expert assessment.

articleTitle: Evaluation of enterprises liquidity value based on the relative entropy-topsis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The financial crisis occurred in the recent years has provoked managers to pay more attention to liquidity risk, especially the effect to the enterprise value. According to this, the paper gives an aspect to evaluate enterprise value from the view of liquidity. Firstly, choose indicators to describe the liquidity. Then, establish the optimization model based on the principle of relative entropy which is between the objective and subjective evaluation result, and then get the weight proportion as well as the importance of objective and subjective evaluation results to the combination weigh. Finally, construct an evaluation model with topsis, which not only considers both the experts opinions and objective information, but also gets a more comprehensive result with the spatial concepts.

articleTitle: Internet-based intelligent test system for computer drawing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Developed a website in VB.net, and the nuclear judging engine in C language, in order to realize managing, tutoring, practising, testing, feeding back, answering questions, BBS et al for Computer drawing course Internet-based. By SQL server database at background for interchanged data. Dividing the knowledge points to different tables and saving them into database. Users could login and browse the website, download the item pool package, finish homework by client software, and the result could be packed automatically and then uploaded. The system judges automatically and gives the score, and feeds back the detail information by different color, line styles, texts et al instead of reading and appraising manually. Saving a lot of manpower and material resources. It's in time, accurate, objective and impartial.

articleTitle: The method and Application of the attribute measurement system analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The consistency ratio and Fleiss' Kappa is described in this paper for the specific use. This paper analyzes attribute measurement systems through the consistency ratio and Fleiss' Kappa coefficient, and applies them to the evaluation of plug gauge commonly used in the production of electronic components. This paper also explains how to implement the attribute measurement systems analysis through the sample collection program and measurement strategy in the electronic components industry, and proposes evaluation methods and suggestions for improvement to the attribute measurement systems.

articleTitle: Design of human-computer interaction helmet for wearable computer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A kind of human-computer interaction helmet for wearable computer is designed after the analysis of working principle of eye tracking and voice interaction. The helmet is composed of helmet mounted display and its adjusting device, box, eye tracking device, backboard, helmet support, earphone, microphone, etc. Each element's position relation and system function are described in detail. Combined with the characters of the helmet, the calibration principle of the eye tracking system is anatomized and the calibration flow is ascertained. The human-computer interaction is realized based on eye tracking and voice channel. The helmet with great flexibility and advantage enhances the interaction reliability and extends the application fields of the wearable computer.

articleTitle: IT/IS project selection: A grey multi-criteria decision model approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: IT/IS (information technology/information system)represents a substantial financial investment for many enterprises. Then, to select a suitable IT/IS becomes important and difficult. How can a new IT/IS project be selected in an easy, cost-effective, and collective manner? We need a tool that will help decision-makers select potential new IT/IS projects. Generally, IT/IS project selection is a multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) problem. Hence, we propose a new method based on the grey MCDM. Grey theory is one of the methods used to study uncertainty, being superior in the mathematical analysis of systems with uncertain information. Then, the paper aims to extend the TOPSIS with grey theory. We conduct a case study to show how this method can be used and discuss the results.

articleTitle: Research on the development of geological information cluster services in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This electronic document researches on the clustering development of the geological data services. As a main carrier for public service of geological work, the importance of geological data service is realized, and demand for them increases steadily, but the qualities and types of geological information and the service model can not meet the society demand with the development of new technique and the information ear approaching. Government should utility the geological information manage systems and network technology to carry out the construction of the cluster geological information service to improve the management level of geological information and serve society better. Government should establish national and provincial geological data centers as platforms, and digitalize the geological data in the centers to establish different kind of databases. Distributed data services should be centralized on the one-stop information service websites by means of data management system and network service system, so the society can get three kinds of geological data services: core metadata, public data, customizable data via internet as well as backbone network, so as to meet the needs of economical and social development as much as possible.

articleTitle: Coordination for the travel package of flight and accommodation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper studies how a hotel and an airline cooperate to provide the travel package of accommodation and flight. Since the hotel and the airline make decisions autonomously, this paper builds Stackelberg game model to solve this travel package problem. It obtains the equilibrium of the cooperation of the hotel and the airline; derives the effects on the equilibrium, of the hotel and the airline capacities, standard price, etc.; analyzes the ones on the total additional revenue and its sharing by numerical study; designs a coordination mechanism to maximize the additional revenue produce by the package.

articleTitle: The analysis and strategy of information asymmetry in e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of electronic information technology and internet, e-commerce has been a new means of market transactions, which take a huge advantage in market for its convenience and openness in information acquisition, transmission, and communication and transaction costs. However, the moral hazard and adverse selection resulting from information asymmetry induce imbalance between the interests of both parties, reduce the efficiency of resource allocation and violate the fairness and justice of social development. Therefore, in order to promote and facilitate the e-commerce, this paper arms to analyze the effects and causes of the information asymmetry and propose relevant measures.

abstract: With the development of the Rough Sets and Neural Network, dynamic prediction research on financial crisis has become as a developing trend. Based on this situation, this paper makes use of the Rough Sets' attribute reduction technique to reduce the financial index firstly, then imposes the Neural Network to train network so as to establish financial crisis alarming model to drop out enterprise's crisis. According to the analysis, we find the model's prediction accuracy is very high, therefore, it can provide the effective investment basis for the listed companies' investors.

articleTitle: Mobile E-commerce security analysis based on DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Mobile E-commerce will become the strategic significance of global trade and the effective way of information exchange as a trade of mobile internet. Mobile E-commerce will become the strategic significance of global trade and the effective way of information exchange as a trade of mobile internet. The openness of mobile networks and mobility of mobile terminal have brought many advantages to the development of mobile commerce and the promotion of work efficiency, but the safety of mobile commerce is still the bottleneck of application. For this reason, the DEMATEL method has been used to analyze the factors that influence the security of Mobile E-commerce in his paper, modeling Mobile E-commerce security evaluation index systems, with the using of MATLAB, calculating one factor to the impact of other factors as well as the impact of severe degree, which can get causes severe and the degree of centrality for each factor, and sort the many factors, ultimately determine the main factors that impact the security of Mobile E-commerce. This article can provide a reference for the relevant e-commerce enterprises and the relevant decision-making departments, which have important practical significance to guide the relevant departments to improve the safety of Mobile E-commerce and promote the development of Mobile E-commerces. This electronic document is a “live” template.

articleTitle: Analysis of farmers' willingness of agricultural techniques training and the restraining factors: Survey to 511 farmers in Ningbo city
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper analyses the demands and wishes of farmers' participating in production techniques training on the base of surveying 511 farmers in Ningbo's 8 counties. The paper discusses the constraining factors from the aspect of subject, object, and training system, and researches the attending training and satisfaction influencing factor by running Tobit model and regression model. The researcher finds that the most preferred cultivating content is training on excellent variety techniques, the favorite way of training is learning by visiting, the most preferred training time span is one day, and the favorite training schedule is flexible time adjusted according to farming season. The farmers' training actions are affected by the following factors: gender, village cadres, planting size, sources of income and other factors. The satisfaction degree in the training affected by whether the training ground is fixed, whether the training content is production techniques, whether the organizer takes the advice of those who are willing to be trained, and whether the teachers are experts and so on.

articleTitle: A study of China strategy sovereign wealth fund
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A model is designed to analyze investment strategy of Chinese sovereign wealth fund (SWFs) based on specific investment objectives and investment fields, regarding SWFs as one part of the whole economy. The research focused on the establish conditions, the optimal scale and the impact on the whole national welfare of China strategic SWFs. The theoretical analysis and simulation suggest that the establishment of strategic SWFs depends on the increase of the national welfare instead of the returns on investment. And the more the strategic SWFs hedges the national development risk, the more the whole national welfare increases.

articleTitle: The open cluster innovation mode and evaluation of innovation efficiency based on DEA of high-tech enterprises in Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The status in quo and necessity for making open technological innovation of High-tech enterprises in Yangtze River Delta are introduced based on industrial clustering, combined with the background of the global financial crisis and the character of economic development in Yangtze River Delta. And the open technological innovation mode is brought forward for High-tech enterprises in Yangtze River Delta according to analyze the mechanism of its open innovation after industrial clustering. Then an open innovation model and its process model are made for discussing the content and importance of open innovation, and a DEA method is used to evaluate innovation efficiency of high-tech enterprises in Yangtze River Delta. Finally High-tech enterprises could improve their dynamic innovative ability and core competitiveness depending on industrial clustering and open innovation.

articleTitle: Design of a trainning and experimental platform based on multi-protocol communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper designed a communication platform, based on multiple protocols and aimed at building automation system, which can be used for technical training and experiment. The platform adopts an ARM Cortex-M3 micro-controller and owns abundant peripheral circuit and interface. With embedded TCP/IP protocol stack and file system, it can implement data file transmission easily. The host software is developed with C# language and can upload or download data between the platform and the host PC. We also implemented static Web function on the platform. With the homepage, the equipments interfaced with the platform can be showed in details. Through JPEG coding and decoding technology, a TFT-LCD is used for image display. Finally, multiple protocol such as CAN RS232 and RS485 are interfaced to the platform and then connected to Ethernet via necessary conversion

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring of the security for the large construction with wireless FBG sensor network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The security monitoring of the large construction is always a problem for the city management in the world. The wireless fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensor network applying to security monitoring for the large construction is one of the rapidly developing means. In the paper the feasibility analysis of the real monitoring with FBG sensor network is introduced. The wireless FBG sensor network composed the FBG temperature, strain and pressure sensor and wireless network communication technology is discussed. Some crucial basic problems, such as sensor characteristics, data acquisition and transmission, networking, real-time data processing and displaying, and the wireless sensor network development are also analyzed. The FBG sensor network with the ability of forecasting and warning has wide potential application perspective in real-time permanent monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on selection of third party logistics enterprise based on goal programming
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The advent and development of the third party logistics (TPL) of china promotes the economic development powerfully, and is the economic growth important source, meanwhile has the important role to the enterprise's development and the promotion of the competitive power, how to choose the best third party logistics enterprise is continuous matter of concern for the enterprise. The article determines indicator system of the selection third party logistics enterprise using balanced score card tool from the strategic angle of view, apprises and chooses TPL enterprise through the goal programming method, and finally carries on the demonstration analysis, so as to provide certain reference value for the enterprise in the choosing third party logistics enterprise.

articleTitle: Discussion on the application of virtual situation design of electronic shopping
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Currently virtual reality technology has a positive impact on the consumers' behavior of online shopping. The interface design of the three-dimensional dynamic visual sense meets the more people's experience of visual perception from technical point of view. But there is little research on the virtual situation design of electronic shopping. The paper clarifies that virtual reality technology shall be combined with situation design through the animation experiments on the hypothetical shopping situation. If technology is combined with the design, consumers' friendly user experience will be improved. People will get more pleasure from online shopping. And it elaborates the principles and methods of design.

articleTitle: On the simulation application for teaching practice in the course of motion control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Computer simulation technology, which with application of software platforms likes FLASH, MultiSim and MATLAB/SIMULINK, was introduced into teaching progress, considering the existing teaching situation and features of the motion control system. By combining the theory explaining and simulation results together, it become more easy to reveal and exposit the essence of the lecture, more specific and straightforward to make the teaching process become, moreover, it help students to understand abstract theory and key segments of the motion control system better and stimulate their learning positivity, thereby achieve a outstanding teaching result.

articleTitle: Scheduling parallel multiple capacitated machines with sequence-dependent constraint
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper introduces a new kind of parallel machines scheduling problem. Each job has a minimal processing time and all the machines are multiple capacitated machines in this problem. Each machine can process at most β jobs simultaneously according to the First-In-First-Out discipline, and the completion sequence and completion time interval between two jobs are restricted by the plan. A CSP model and a heuristic algorithm are put forward. The algorithm contains two stages, in the first stage, a method of job assignment based on expected starting time is presented; and in the second stage, the timetable is output to minimize the objective function. Computational tests reflect that both the model and the heuristic are feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: The study on a comprehensive evolving network model based on mechanisms of node otherness, node deletion and double preferential attachment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The theories on the complex evolving network models have been researched separately based on the mechanisms of node otherness, uniform node deletion and double preferential attachment (DPA). This paper integrated these three mechanisms that obviously exist in real networks, and proposed a comprehensive evolving network model based on these three mechanisms. The paper performed analytic deductions, calculated the degree distribution, and generalized the scale-free model. And the results show that the comprehensive model has the scale-free feature, and the three mechanisms have different influences on the degree distribution, which were also validated by simulations.

articleTitle: Investment style analysis of open-end funds in China: Return-based quantile regression analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, we use quantile regression estimate and data from 2001 to 2003 to analyze the investment style for different types of open-end funds in China. The main result is that the investment style of growth funds, balance funds and value funds in China share some commonality. They all prefer investing in large-cap, mid-cap growth stocks and small value stocks. Value fund prefers value stocks to growth funds and balance funds, and it invests evenly between growth stocks and value stocks. By analyzing the change in investment style of Hua-xia Large-cap fund using quantile regression, we obtain some very inspiring conclusions.

articleTitle: Research on 3D modeling and application in urban emergency management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed the key steps in the 3D modeling of digital city, and established 3D geographic information platform combine with the construction of urban emergency rescue, systemically expound the concrete measures and approaches of the 3D GIS development in the microscopic field, provide crucial technological channels to rapidly build large-region real scenes, and explore its specific applications in urban emergency management.

articleTitle: China water environment information disclosure system based on Web-GIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In connection with the lack of the information platform of China water environment information disclosure system at present and combined with the innovation of national water environment management system and public needs about water environment information disclosure, the paper discusses the system design of China water environment information disclosure system, which includes system structural design, user, function and database design; Further, a platform of China water environment information disclosure has been realized with the support of Web-GIS. The disclosed information includes: the national major water environment monitoring information and evaluation information, national provinces and main cities water environment behavior information and evaluation information, public participation information. With the water environment information disclosure, the public, enterprise and government can more deeply realize that some economic activity will bring problems of water environment and there are a lot of deficiencies in water environment protection work; The pressures from the public can impulse enterprise or polluter to take related measures to protect the water environment, that can reduce the water environmental pollution caused by the economic development; At the same time, water environment protection work will be strengthened by using the power of the public; On the other hand, we should take measures, such as information disclosure, public participation and so on, to protect the water environment, and mobilize all social forces to joint participation in environmental protection.

articleTitle: The research of web users' behavior analysis based on Web Log Mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the coming of the time of Internet, the number of the websites is growing in geometric progression. How can withhold the customers and how to make websites stand out above the rest are the problems in managing the websites. This article aims to analyze the behavior of web users. Firstly log data were collected from the web server, after data preprocesssing, a URL-UserID relevant matrix is set up with URL as row and UserID as column, and each element value as the users' hits. With the help of fuzzy clustering algorithms and Warshall algorithms, the similar customer groups can be discovered by measuring similarity between column vectors. By using the result of the model, we could analyze the behavior of users and improve the customer relationship management. Finally, Examples of the web log data of Guangdong Industry Technical College prove the validity and effectiveness of the algorithms.

articleTitle: Research of suppressing VFTO for 500kV GIS substation based on EMTP/ATP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper introduces very fast transient over-voltage caused by disconnecting switch operation of GIS. ATP-EMTP simulation program is applied to analyze the very fast transient over-voltage of 500kv GIS substation. The effect of protection measures on equipments is compared and analyzed, such as adding opening and closing resistor, R-C absorber, and Ferrite Rings. Also the measures are analyzed with considering the actual situation. This research thinking takes safety and economy into account, which can provide new reference for the engineering.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of design quality measurement system concerning tour electronic commerce website in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to reveal the implementation efficiency of tour e-commerce, factor analysis is used in this paper. By quality measurement system design of tour e-commerce website, pretest and pilot test, single-dimension scale test, reliability analysis and validity testing, factor analysis can effectively reveal the correlation between web site design elements, web site content elements, web site feature elements and web site effect elements. For illustration, the collected copies are 260, the effective questionnaire returns-ratio are 100%, which has satisfied the requirement that the questionnaire returns-ratio is not lower than 20% in the data investigation. The empirical results show that the effectiveness of sample composition is stronger, factor loadings on the corresponding factor of each indicator is greater than 0.5 for the critical value. The minimum value of Cronbach's α is 0.7023 and the sample reliability is higher. The empirical research has revealed that the construction of tour sites is basically a lack of clear tour theme, which has not effectively been able to reflect the main development direction of tour enterprises.

articleTitle: A study on Green Supply Chain Management of enterprises based on self-locking theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper firstly carries on quantitative analysis of self-locking phenomenon in mechanics, then bring it into GreenSupply Chain Management of enterprises, on this basis established the Self-locking theoretical model that enterprises adopt Green Supply Chain Management, analyzed some factors that restrict the adoption of GSCM. Supposing one enterprise isunder self-locking condition, in the foundation of adjusting various aspect weights, provided the adopters of GSCM with some countermeasures.

articleTitle: Does reform of non-tradable shares change liquidity premium? Empirical study from China a share market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: After reform of non-tradable shares to complete, along with limits sells the stock in batches going on the market, the increase of tradable shares proportion has the remarkable influence on liquidity level in China A shares market, thus also changed the liquidity premium. This paper uses panel data model, selects two liquidity variable from different angle, tests and analyzes the liquidity premium before and after the reform. The result shows that: the liquidity premium exist in market before and after the reform; because of the market liquidity condition improving, negative effect between illiquidity and expected return strengthen, namely stocks with low liquidity have higher expected return.

articleTitle: A study on the flow of economic factors during the process of urban and rural integration by system dynamics modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper studies the basic framework of economic factors mobility framework during the process of integration of urban and rural from the perspective of system dynamics. By positive feedback of economic factors mobility, the causal loop diagrams of human resources, technology and funds are analyzed. Furthermore, a flow chart and system dynamics model are established. Vensim PLE is used to simulate and test the validation and application value of model. The simulation results show that the model could fit the revolution of practical integration effect, and provide valid suggestions for regional economical management.

articleTitle: Use BP neural network to evaluate teacher's teaching quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The teaching work is the center work of the school, and the teaching quantity evaluation is the core and base of teaching evaluation. The teaching quantity evaluation plays an important role in the process of promoting the healthy development of school teaching work and improving the teaching quality. This thesis expounds the design and implementation of artificial neural network applied in teaching quality evaluation, and builds the modal of artificial neural network applied in teaching quality evaluation by introducing and analyzing the traditional teaching quality evaluation. According to the examples to evaluate and analyze the model, application of BP neural network in teaching quality evaluation is proved to be feasible. This model possesses strong functions of study association and fault tolerance, moreover both its analysis results and process approach the metal process and analysis method of human brain, which greatly improves the accuracy for teaching quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Evaluating the eco-efficiency of Heilongjiang province with DEA approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Eco-efficiency is an instrument for environment assessment that indicating how efficient the economic activity performs toward to its environment impacts. This paper conducts an eco-efficiency analysis for city industrial systems in Heilongjiang province by using the DEA method proposed by Kuosmanen and Kortelainen. Using the data of 14 cities and areas in Heilongjiang province from 2005∼2009, an empirical study is employed to illustrate the results of cities' industrial eco-efficiency. The results indicate that only Daqing city is eco-efficient, and most cities or areas are still at low level of eco-efficiency. Then the study carries out the discussion and puts some suggestion.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper the educational E-government of Jilin Province has been explained in detail from two aspects, construction and management, intending to provide some ideas to administrative department in charge of education for reference and supply some guidance in theory and methods for constructing educational e-government systems to all levels of educational institution, schools and some related departments.

articleTitle: Hierarchical model framework of e-business model for e-business model innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is important for enterprise to innovate e-business model to gain competitive advantages. Innovation of e-business model attracts interests of academia and industry. The concept of E-business model has been ambiguous for a long times, with each researcher using it in a different meaning depending on the context of discussion. The ambiguity hinders the research on the e-business model and it is necessary to study the concept of ebusiness model for e-business model innovation. Anchored on static and dynamic perspective, a hierarchical concept framework, including role model, scale model, model organism and recipe model, is proposed. The concept framework will provide necessary bases for further research on company's innovation of E-business model.

articleTitle: The evolutionary path of technological capability and the choice of niche market: A longitudinal research from QOK corporation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The evolutionary path of technological capability and the choice of niche market in a niche firm, which is an important topic in innovation and strategy research, is of great significance to how domestic firms to access, to use, to protect technological capability in order to gain competitive advantage. Based on a case from QOK company, this paper is building a model to examine the dynamic relationship between the evolutionary path of technological capability and the choice of niche market. There are three results: (1) In the initial stage (or the early stage of a new market entry), a successful niche firm would utilize its imitation capability to enter an industrial section with low competition and high profitability with differentiation strategy. (2) In the development process, the niche firm's technological capability was improved by technology diffusion, when a moderate entry into diversified markets was positively related to the improvement of the firm's technological capability, as well as an excessive entry was negatively related to the improvement. (3) Developed to a certain size, the niche firm developed its core technological capability through the choice complementary asset and its indigenous innovation, and began to focus on its core niche market.

articleTitle: Brief analysis of internet-aided english majors information query and translation study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the data from the English Majors network-assisted translation and learning in Dezhou University, by employing the questionnaire survey, this paper makes a careful analysis about the assistance of the network from multi-level perspective. According to my related survey, the network has become indispensable in students learning, and however the teachers' guidance and supervision are much needed for the proper and effective use of network-assisted learning.

articleTitle: Integration process and mechanism of agricultural industral chain and technology chain: A link model for the supply and demand sides of agricultural technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to solve the low level of technology, high repetition rate, low rate of Conversion of technological achievements, and other similar problems in Chinese agricultural industry. This pape builds a link mechanism between the demand and supply sides of technology about Chinese agricultural industry. Different from previous studies, this paper narrows the scope of the integration of the agricultural industrial chain and technology chain into two-dimensional framework. Around the core of Technological innovation and the construction of modern agricultural technology chain, focused on the integration issues and relevant actors' behavior in agricultural industrial chain and the agricultural technology chain. This paper extends the existed integration theory of agricultural industry chain, builds the integration model, and the integration processes, mechanism of agricultural industry chain and technology chain were analyzed.

articleTitle: The improvement of higher education service quality based on SERVQUAL model

abstract: Students are the object of higher education services from marketing perspective. This paper investigates the satisfaction of higher education service from students by questionnaires based SERVQUAL model, analyzes the current quality of higher education service, and gives the suggestions of improving quality of higher education service.

articleTitle: An evolutionary game analysis on the cooperation decision-making of informal and formal finance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By establishing a cooperation decision-making evolutionary game model, this paper analyzed the dynamic gambling process and the inflection factors of gambling result. The gambling process has two types of ESS: one is that both sides adopt "non-cooperation" strategy, the other is that both sides adopt "cooperation" strategy which leads to the optimal ESS. Which type of ESS does the dynamic gambling process converge on? It depends on not only both sides' learning speed and analytical skills of information but also the initial states of economy, policy and law environment.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the influence factors of Chinese money supply fluctuation based on VAR model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper analysis GDP, commodity prices, foreign exchange reserves and issuing amount of stock's influence on broad money supply(M2) by using unconstrained vector auto-regressive (VAR) model. Through Johansen co-integration test, impulse response function analysis and Granger causality test, the author finally thinks that there is a long-term equilibrium relationship between the four variables and Chinese M2. GDP, the foreign exchange reserves and issuing amount of stock are the Granger reasons of M2. Commodity prices will have positive impact on M2 in the short-term, but it's not the Granger reason of M2. GDP and foreign exchange reserves have long-lasting positive impact on money supply, while issuing amount of stock has both short-term negative impact and long-term positive impact on M2.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Theoretical mechanics for teaching abstract concepts exist, the result is not intuitive problem, computer simulation technology into teaching them to, help students understand and absorb knowledge, improve teaching efficiency. Encourage students to learn by analogy, the operating results visualization to enhance students programming skills and creative ability.

articleTitle: The practice of research learning in the “basic of computer hardware” course
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: “Basic of computer hardware” is one of the important courses for the student in Software Engineering. This course introduces the hardware to the student. How to let student interested in this course is very difficult. In this paper, research learning is introduced in this course. At first, we discuss how to develop the research learning in this course, then a platform named Minisys is introduced to let student do research more easily.

articleTitle: Game theory analysis on constructing incentive mechanism for professional manager
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the conditions of modern market economy, professional managers have played a central part in the development of enterprises. The key to retaining and making full use of professional managers for enterprises lies in improving employment system and incentive mechanism of enterprises. In this paper, we analyze incentive compatibility mechanism for professional manager, according to game theory, and propose that enterprises should formulate optimal contract, establish reputation system and build the institution of supervision and punishment, in order to improve incentive mechanism for professional manager.

articleTitle: Based on TOPSIS value engineering in manufacturing enterprise logistics cost management application research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Value engineering, as an important part of modern management methods vigorously advocated by the country, plays a significant role in terms of improving the management level of manufacturing enterprises' logistics cost. This paper uses the principle of value engineering to manage manufacturing enterprises' logistics cost, and applies TOPSIS methods to the segment of functional evaluation of value engineering; finally verifies the practicality and feasibility of the methods. To some extent, it is presented to give reference to domestic manufacturing enterprises' logistics cost management.

articleTitle: Analysis of knowledge transfer process and model building
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper analyzes the mechanism of knowledge transfer, and summarizes five key elements, including knowledge sender, knowledge receiver, the knowledge to be transferred, knowledge transmission process and knowledge absorption process. Four crucial steps complete the whole procedure of knowledge transfer: emergence of knowledge demand, choice of demanded knowledge, and transmission of knowledge by coding and absorption of knowledge by decoding. Accompanied with knowledge transfer is transformation between implicit and explicit knowledge with patterns of socialization, externalization, combination and internalization (SECI). The paper suggests that knowledge increment in quantity and quality may arise as a result of knowledge transfer. In order to demonstrate comprehensively the elements, procedure and result of knowledge transfer, Vessel Model of Knowledge Transfer is advanced as three-dimension system to elaborate on how the knowledge flows from sender to receiver, how demanded knowledge is acquired and transformed between implicit and explicit forms, and how knowledge increment comes into being.

articleTitle: Supply chain coordination with options contract for the three-level pull supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

Two models are proposed respectively. One is a supply management mechanism without applying options contract. The other is that with applying options contract. To the two models, corresponding analysis and calculation example are given. The conclusion is presented that the expected total profit with options is more than the other.

articleTitle: Interaction quality effects on customer satisfaction from the perspective of customers' perception — The empirical test from online stock trading
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Online trading is fast-growing in recent years. But interaction between service employee and customer is still the key element of customer perceptions and evaluating services. This paper constructs a structural equation model which consist of interaction quality as antecedent, perceived risk as mediating variable, and the customers' perceived value and satisfaction as consequences, to study the effect between the interaction quality and customer perceptions. Using survey data from 305 online stock investors, the empirical results show that service attitude and behavior can significantly reduce the perceived risk and improve customer perceived value and satisfaction, but expertise will increase customer perceived risk.

articleTitle: Research on the level of noncompliance in student loans with floating rates based on evolutionary games
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Since the student loans in China, the noncompliance risk has deeply affected and troubled the development of student loans policy. As the price of student loans, the interest rate directly affects the behavior of student. In this paper, we regard the repayment of student decision-making as a multistage strategic choice, so the noncompliance of students in previous period should be considered into the formulation of the interest rate in current period. By analyzing the behavior of students and banks based on evolutionary games under the floating-rate policy, we will explore the noncompliance factors and provide a theoretical reference for policy recommendation.

articleTitle: The study of parameter structural estimation of first price auction based on the case of risk aversion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a parameter structural estimation used in many fields, improved MLE (maximum likelihood estimation) only applies to the case of risk neutrality, which cannot explain agents' behavior well. This paper generalizes the method to the risk aversion case when there exists two kinds of bid numbers, and gives a simple estimation procedure. Monte Carlo simulation experiment with four different risk aversion parameters including risk neutral case is used to verify the feasibility of the estimation procedure. The experimental results suggests that the estimation procedure can do a reasonable job in estimating the structural parameters of the first-price sealed-bid auction for risk aversion as well as risk neutrality cases, which provides an new idea for the application of the improved MLE.

articleTitle: Thoughts on the motivating the practical leadership in country: A perspective based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: National medium and long term talent development program (2010–2020) has put forward the specific objective to build a team of rural practical talents, which is an important and urgent strategic task to be carried out by local governments, organizations and farmers together, a major strategic decision which, based on the overall development of the Party and nation, is made to help thoroughly implement the scientific concept of development, and the new requirement not only for our country's talent strategy but also for its purpose of constructing a well-off society in an all-round way. In this paper, we first built a model of constructing rural practical talents and obtained that rational farmers would compared their costs with benefits, and we also made a further analysis of why there was blurring and distortion in the information of constructing rural practical talents they had received. From the perspective of game theory, we constructed the game model of simultaneous action among farmers with the initial endowment, the static game model of the complete information of grass-roots organizations, and the game model between farmers and grass-roots organizations, between grassroots organizations and local governments under different probabilities, in order to reflect on the construction of rural practical talent teams.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of educational resource management platform based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In view of existence problems in present Educational resource management system, Educational resources management platform based on the knowledge management was supplied in this paper. And the overall construction design proposal of Platform was given. The characteristics of knowledge management and the function of each component in the structure is analyzed. Knowledge Evaluation and knowledge ranking algorithm is designed. Four major functional components Including Educational resources management, Educational resources organization, intelligent retrieval of Educational resources and personalized content recommendations of Educational resources are achieved. Experimental results show that the platform has good scalability with the application value.

articleTitle: Study of dynamic game between B2B e-commerce platforms — Based on the perspective of charging method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper first constructs two different third-party B2B e-commerce platforms according to the different ways of charging methods, and then analyses of the dynamic game between the two platforms. In the dynamic game, I establish a triangular model to describe the distribution of the seller, and on this basis, I construct a nine-cell matrix of the dynamic game to measure the results of the game accurately, finally, I select some data to apply to the dynamic game of third-party B2B ecommerce platform.

articleTitle: Financial constrain and hedging needs: Effects of firms' cash holdings in product market competition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Financial frictions in capital market affect the impact of firms' cash holdings in product market competition. Based on the measure of financial constrain and hedging needs, we analyze the effects of these two factors in the effects of firms'cash holdings. It shows that financially constrained firms will get more market share if they hold more cash reserves. And when the correlation between a firm's cash flow and its investment opportunities is low, its hedging needs is high and prefers reserving cash, so more cash holdings of firms with high hedging needs have more significantly positive effects on firms' competitive performance.

articleTitle: Application of BOT Investment Model on Land Consolidation in Beijing Valley Areas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the accelerated urbanization process and economic development of Beijing valley areas, the land conflicts between Beijing municipal construction and agricultural production become serious. Land consolidation which reforms land parcels to remove fragmentation and produce ideal blocks, is an effective means to solve the problems. But land consolidation is a public infrastructure with large amount of funds facing shortage of funds for construction and poor operational management issues. Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model is a new model encourages the participation and direct investment of the private sector in land consolidation. This article focuses on analysis of how the use of BOT Investment and construction on Beijing valley areas, finally some suggestion were put forward to application of BOT model.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The study of self-organizing network learning community from the web3.0 features
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of internet technolog specail the comming of web3.0 era, a more intelligent and personalized network learning community appears. The web3.0 technology bring about a big improvement on the mode of information collection, transmission, and interaction. This paper introduces some new features of web3.0 technology in the application of the application of network learning communication, and analyzes the some new functions and the trend of self-organizing network learning community based on web3.0 technology.

articleTitle: Approach on Support System for external environment of geologcial survey
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Geological survey is an important foundation for sustainable development strategies. External environment of geological survey refers to the stakeholders and the relationships among them in the process of geological survey. With rapid development of economy and society, survey activities have been seriously hampered and external environment of geological survey has deteriorated gradually because of the disputes among these relevant stakeholders. Based on the results of interviews and questionnaires, we summarize the status of external environment and discover the deeper causes of these disputes from the management point. In this paper, we also put forward several suggestions on support system of external environment in order to resolve these disputes related to geological survey.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between current account imbalance sustainability and financial crisis: Evidence from the U.S. and China in subprime crisis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper empirically studies the stationarity and sustainability of the U.S. and China's current account using quarterly data from 2001 to 2009 to research the relationship between current account sustainability and financial crisis. Based on cointegration theory, it adopts ADF unit roots test, Granger causality test, Engle — Granger cointegration test, develops cointegration model and error correction model of import and export. The findings are shown as follows: (1) Current account deficit of the U.S. is non-stationary and it can't sustain in the long run. (2) There is a long-run equilibrium relationship and a dynamic self-correction mechanism between import and export because both of them are cointegration. Therefore, China's current account surplus is sustainable in the long run. (3) One of inducement of financial crisis is non-sustainability of current account imbalance.

articleTitle: An empirical research in service industry about relations between relationship benefit, customer value and relationship quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the 21st century, the company's marketing activities need to be changed from a purely productoriented sale to customer-oriented. The enterprises should build a good relationship with the customers so as to win their attention and support to the product or at least its information. This paper established the framework of relationship benefits-customer value-relationship quality, and proposed the hypothesis. We designed an empirical research with questionnaire in the fitness industry, and used structural equation model to analyze the data collected. The data verified the hypothesis, and we made further discussion on the results and pointed out the study deficiencies.

articleTitle: A modified DEA Model to analyze efficiency of enterprises' R&D in the different areas of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper uses a modified DEA Model to make an assessment of Chinese enterprises' research and development activity of thirty-one areas in 2009. The result shows (1)R&D enterprises exhibiting in most areas is DRS. (2)The efficiency of enterprises' R&D is approximately consistent to the level of that area's economy development. (3) The scale efficiency changes a little in different regions while the technical efficiency changes much. Based on these findings, this paper gives the direction to improve enterprises' performance.

articleTitle: Substantial analysis of the relative factors between economy, population and carbon produtivity — Based on 28 provincial administrative units' panel data (from 1999–2009)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: How to realize the low-carbon economy has drawn great attention of our government in recent years. This paper will base on the nature of the low-carbon economy to construct a metric model by analyzing 28 Chinese provincial administrative units' panel data which are from 1999 to 2009. The finding proves that there really exists a long-term balanced relationship between carbon productivity, economy and population; GDP and carbon productivity prove the positive relation, while population and carbon productivity prove the negative one. The basic carbon productivity differs relatively one province from another in China, especially from variable regions. Basing on the conclusion of all the findings, the author will present three policy suggestions :first, the provinces should make full use of their self advantages to develop the economy, so as to improve the carbon productivity depending on the economic increase; second, the provinces which are abound in natural resources should actively push forward the transformation of the industrial structure; third, we should further stabilize the achievements of the birth control policy, and then reduce the life carbon consumption.

articleTitle: A study of interest game of the intensive model for resource development enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: For a long time, resource development enterprises have executed the resource development model of extensiveness in China, resulting in resource depletion, environmental pollution and ecological damage and other issues. The intensive development model is one important way to get sustainable development for resource-based enterprises. The paper sets up the interest game models between resource development companies and the government, other companies, employees and the citizen.

articleTitle: Design of accounting information system based on E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: E-commerce era brings much change in Accounting Information System. It's a trend now for enterprises to employ Ecommerce accounting information system to maintain the competetive advantage. Based on the event accounting theory, combined with data warehouse technology and event-driven theory, The paper beyond the current theoretical framework of the accounting cycle, construct the system model of E-commerce accounting information system with decision analysis, intelligent processing.

articleTitle: Research on collaborative operation of environment-friendly steel enterprise supply chain based on game analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to improve the environment-friendly steel enterprise (EFSE) dynamic competitive ability and sustainable development ability, the measures to improve collaborative operation of EFSE supply chain was put forward. The model based on game theory was built to analyze the collaborative operation process of the EFSE supply chain and the factors affecting it. Results show that keeping long-term cooperation with supply chain members, improving cooperation environment gradually, and establishing a fair and honesty assurance system are necessary to implement EFSE supply chain collaborative operation.

articleTitle: Regulatory capture: A rational action in business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper studies three simple models of regulatory capture under three different economic conditions. In the traditional capture theories, efficient firms prefer capturing government and pretending to be inefficient to get subsidies or pay less tax so that the social welfare could be reduced. In most Chinese researchers' opinions, firms who capture governments to go into the markets have inefficient cost. However, the analytical results based on three models suggest that capturing government is a rational action of firms who have efficient cost; furthermore, these firms can also improve social welfare.

articleTitle: The agricultural products' value creation in electronic commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to grasp the essence of electronic commerce and dual economic growth, it is adopted comparing the value theory of labour in Marxism economics with the value theory of factors in western mainstream economics. The results are as follows: it is scarce use value provided that produces added value in production fields; value creation also exists in circulation fields by realizing market value of the scarce use value efficiently and timely; electronic commerce can enhance value creation, integrating commerce flow and logistics through smooth information flow efficiently; in dual structure restrained by agricultural development, it is crucial to promote the agricultural products' value creation. It can be concluded that electronic commerce is beneficial to integrating the available resources and stimulate dual economic growth by promoting agricultural products' value creation.

articleTitle: Research on the protection algorithm and model of personal privacy information in internet of thing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the development of information and communication technology, network age coming silently, it will be caused a new personal information leakage risk by the Ubiquitous Computing applications. This paper introduces the individual privacy information forms of expression in networking technology, and then puts forward with the secure multi-party computation to achieve personal information protection. Otherwise, we describe the process and the algorithm of implement. At last, we build in a conceptual model according to the layered theory of the network information on privacy protection.

articleTitle: Financial development, FDI and economic growth: Evidences from Chinese provincial panel data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper use 29 provincial regions (excluding Tibet and Chongqing) panel data, analyses through the financial development make load to the non-state sector and foreign investment sector, reducing the efficiency of the banking sector taking impact on economic growth found that: First, to increase non-state credit scale to promote economic growth in our country. But increase the size of credit scale in FDI sector had no significant effect to the central and western regions' economic growth; Second, the increase of the foreign investment sector credit scale to reduce the credit expansion negative impact to economic growth in the whole country and the eastern and western. But also the increase to non-state sector credit scale to reduce the positive effect on economic growth, this phenomenon in the central region was not significant. In this point of view, FDI has a crowding-out effect to the domestic non-state sector in the credit markets.

articleTitle: Science and technology innovation team efficacy evaluation based on Fuzzy-Markov model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This study establishes science and technology innovation team efficacy evaluation model by the combination of balanced and employees scorecard. Our measurement focuses specifically on team- and individual-level efficacy by fuzzy evaluation method. Meanwhile, the markov model is built effectively to calculate the increment of members efficacy in team compared to individuals independently. We also proved that as an important structure of technology and economic activities, innovation team could not only save resources but also improve human efficacy to help orgaziations achieve bertter performance.

articleTitle: The development of MicroBlog promoting the construction of learning resources in learning community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Learning society is the one in order to support lifelong learning. Community is the basic unit of society and building learning community have to establish the concept of lifelong learning for training individuals to the pursuit their own knowledge systematically and their comprehensive and sustainable development. Network, especially the recent popular Micro-blog which has corporated mobile Internet and traditional Internet perfectly, has a great influence on people's study, work and life. What's more, it has a huge breakthrough in the aspect of communication effect, last but not least, it has promoted the construction of learning resources of learning community.

articleTitle: The influence of RMB exchange rate fluctuations on the export trade of wooden furniture: The empirical research based on the real effective exchange rate from 2005 to 2009
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As an important economic lever, exchange rate is an important factor that influences on the development of national and regional foreign trade. Through observing the data of RMB real effective exchange rate and our country's wooden furniture export from January, 2005 to December, 2009, this paper constructs the measure economics model, and carries out stationarity test, cointegration test and Granger causality test and makes use of the Ordinary Least Squares and Eviews5.0 to make regression analysis, which makes empirical analysis on the quantity change relationship between RMB exchange rate fluctuation and wooden furniture export. The conclusion is that there is long-term cointegration relationship between RMB real effective rate and wooden furniture export of our country, but RMB real effective exchange rate do not influence on the export of wooden furniture remarkably, which we can see that exchange rate fluctuation is not the only decisive factor that impacts on the export of wooden furniture of our country.

Author Keywords: RMB real effective exchange rate fluctuation

articleTitle: Innovative horizontal alliances between electronics giant and digital archives institution: A case study of Qisda LED lighting device from Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Like anywhere else in the world, Taiwan has been making great efforts in to promote the industrialization of digital archives and related industries, with Taiwan National Digital Archives Program (NDAP, 2002–2006) was launched in 2002 to facilitate Taiwan E-Learning and Digital Archives Program (TELDAP, 2008–12). Related promotion of industrialization mechanism deals with similar or same obstacles in aspects of mechanisms of cooperation and authorization. With a successful case, this paper illustrates how to establish archive cooperation mechanism through innovative thinking. The first part of this paper simply introduces achievements that have been made during these eight years and strategies that have been applied for promoting digital archives industrialization since the implementation of NDAP in 2002. Next, features of the digital archives industry and obstacles in increasing the production value are analyzed in the second part of this paper. Then, inspected from the entire cultural theory and economy, in the third part, the author concludes that to achieve a sustainable development and develop the output value, digital archives products must be integrated with storytelling so as to promote product value, and big companies are motivated to introduce digital archives and strengthen the cooperation mechanism. articleTitle: Research on influence factors of commerical bank's capital adequacy ratio
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this article, a Multi-Regression Model is established to analyze the interrelations among those influencing factors related to the capital adequacy ratio (CAR) of banks based on some cross section data of 17 commercial banks in China from 2000–2006. It is found that the CAR is in positive correlation with bank capital and profit, assets income ability, historical influence and securities market but in negative correlation with the loan concentration ratio of banks.

articleTitle: Investigation about broadcast scheduling in fuzzy Hopfield network based on the Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To overcome resource conflict occurred in data broadcasting among nodes which are shared and interferential each other on radio channels in sensor network, in the article we propose fuzzy Hopfield neural network(FHNN) in order to solve TDMA broadcast scheduling problem of wireless sensor network. We considered it as discrete energy minimization problem and mapped it into Hopfield neural network with the fuzzy c-means strategy to realize TDMA schedule for nodes in communication network. The fuzzy Hopfield neural network(FHNN) increases the convergence rate and decreases the processing time for broadcast scheduling problem. Simulation confirms that FHNN could be applied to the Internet of things which is covered everything all over the world. It could improve the visibility and control of the supply chain.

articleTitle: The using of activity-based managament models in Dalian hotel enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Nowadays, Dalian is a city blessed with many beaches and ideal places for tourism. Thus, one of the main sources of income is tourism. The growth of Tourist Sector in Dalian consists of well organized hotels and apartments similar to the best of the world. Hence, the need of information about costing is essential and crucial. The cost methods used are similar to the ones used in other sectors such as product industry. The method of Activity-Based Management(ABM) along with new technologies in computing can provide huge amount of information for the present situation, pinpointing all the problematic areas. The scope of this article is to discuss the outcome of implementing Activity-Based Management models in the high level hotel enterprises.

articleTitle: A Research of the anti-price equilibrium of bank card consumption
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Since the birth of the first bank card in 1950's, bank card has become one of the most important financial tools. Bank card industry chain constitute the bank card associations, issuing banks, acquiring banks, related products and technology suppliers, which is a bilateral market. The bank card has become a typical network product. Currently, there are still contradictions between businesses and banks, which is the result of the unbalance distribution of profit among banks. In this paper, based on the bank card POS transaction mechanism, authors extend the anti-price equilibrium model of Shy. We compare different banks' transaction business in some respects of equilibrium price level & profit level and discuss the pricing factors and price profit changes by extending the anti-price equilibrium model.

articleTitle: Research on fourth-party logistics construction mode of chain enterprises based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Cloud computing represents the future direction of IT industry, which will lead the profound changes of information technology construction and IT application in other industries. In the business world, chain operation is developing rapidly, and has achieved worldwide success. This article analyses characteristics and inadequacy of logistic information construction for current chain enterprises, discusses development direction of fourth-party logistics construction for chain enterprise based on the perspective of cloud computing application, then especially analyses how to use cloud services to accomplish goods distribution path planning calculation and establish goods distribution strategy of chain enterprises based on fourth-party logistics, and finally the flow charts of UML models are given. This paper is with great significance in guiding the fourth-party logistics construction of chain enterprises based on cloud computing.

articleTitle: Taichung science park Wi-Max system planning — The signal of the coverage optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By the institute for information industry commissioned planning and design of Taichung in central Taiwan Science Park WiMax wireless network system, the whole Chungke area is 3 km by 3 km. All antennas are directional and are mounted to the sides of 7 buildings, A basic requirement is that the area coverage being at least 90 %. The system starts out with 25 sites, to achieve the required 90 % coverage and minimize the number of sites used, SA (Simulated Annealing) is used. An optimal selection of 8 sites covers 91% of the service area.

articleTitle: A study on electricity price subsidy mechanism of biomass based power generation of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the background of global financial crisis and abnormal climate, low-carbon economy has become an optimal choice for the sustainable development of all countries. The biomass based power generation industry is an important way of developing low-carbon economy as well as a way of improving the energy structure of China. At present, the biggest problems of biomass based power generation industry in China are the lack of marketing mechanism, the incomplete price incentives including government subsidies for biomass based power generation, as well as the imperfect pricing mechanism of biomass based power generation. Based on analysis of industrial chain of biomass based power generation, this paper uses mechanism design theory to analyze the electricity price subsidies for biomass based power generation industry. We build an electricity price subsidy model to analyze the mechanism of how the related factors influencing each other and put forward some policy suggestions for electricity price subsidies for biomass energy power generation industry.

articleTitle: Discussion of informatization teaching design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Under the direction of constructionism, informationization teaching design is a new type of developing teaching design based on some basic mediums such as multimedia and network. This paper discusses the basic principles of teaching design, main content and design method based on informationization teaching design. It plays an important role in setting up ideas of informationization teaching, developing informationization teaching design and organizing informationization teaching practice.

articleTitle: Research on DB2 for z/OS application performance tuning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper focuses on the research of DB2 for z/OS application performance tuning. DB2 for z/OS is a successful commercial DBMS which is widely used worldwide especially in global top banks, retailers and health insurance providers etc. Five different methods are proposed in this paper to tune DB2 for z/OS to get better performance. Concrete lab materials and results are provided to verify the proposed methods.

articleTitle: The regularity estimates for the solutions of general elliptic equations in Orlicz spaces
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Let Ω be an open set in high dimension Euclidean spaces R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>, and let L denote the second order elliptic operator in the general form, which will characterize many of the original phenomenon of nature. As a very useful space, Orlicz space L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Φ</sup> includes many classical spaces such as L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sup> space, where 1< p < ∞ and Φ is a convex increasing function. The purpose of this paper is to use the stopping time technique and establish the regularity estimates in Orlicz spaces for the second order derivatives of the solutions to the general second order elliptic equations and their Dirichlet problems. We will obtain that, if u is the solution of the Dirichlet problem to the equation Lu = f for any given data f, then the weak solution u as well as its gradient ∇u and second order derivatives ∇<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> u can be controlled by the data f even in the Orlicz spaces.
