articleTitle: The analysis of wiki application in virtual resources construction in network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Wiki is a social software, which is an accumulation and share of explicit knowledge. It attracted more and more attentions. This article analyzed the situation of wiki technology applying into educational resources, and concluded the orientations of education. At last, the article proposed the strategy of wiki applying to virtual resources contraction in network, which edified the contraction of virtual resources.

articleTitle: Research on asset-liability management model of China insurance companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, asset-liability management model of China insurance companies is brought forward. Model's objective function is to maximize risk adjusted income, which not only considers the absolute income of insurance and investment business, but also the cost of risk capital occupied. In developing model's constraints, the business and regulatory characteristic of China insurance companies is considered entirely. Case study of a life insurance company is carried out to simulate the asset-liability management. The asset-allocation strategy is reached, also the influence of solvency rate on allocation is discussed.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of information hiding based on RSA and HVS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To better protect the security of information, this paper proposed an information transmission scheme which combined the cryptosystem and information hiding. The scheme pretreated the information firstly by making use of the RSA arithmetic which belongs to the public key cryptosystem, and then took advantage of the improved LSB which based on the Human Visual System to make the cryptograph hid in the 24 bits BMP image and transmitted it. The embedding and extracting process of secret information in the scheme were discussed in detail. Also, the result of information hiding achieved by this scheme was given. The principle of the scheme is simple, and it is easy to implement. The experimental result suggests that the scheme is efficient and has good practical value.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An analysis of management credit risk in e-commerce of China

articleTitle: Fast approach to simultaneously determine existence and classification for string patterns in a payload
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: We proposes an approach for simultaneously determining whether a target string is included in a payload database, as well as the class attribute pertaining to the string. The proposed approach employs a Bloom Filter and a CMAC neural network, which compose a two-layer architecture. The first layer, the Bloom Filter layer, is responsible for a preliminary checking for the existence of the target string. The CMAC neural network, on the second layer, further eliminates false positives resulted from the first layer, while the class attribute of the target string is simultaneously responded. We utilized the car license plate in Taiwan for verifying the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed approach. The class attributes included make, type, color of the cars. Experimental results showed the proposed approach is suitable to serve as a frontier for a thorough database searching. With proper control of the memory usage, the proposed approach is also ideal for mobile devices where a consistent query time could be achieved regardless of the number of the plate numbers. The error rate for misinterpretations of class attribute in the second layer is also considerably small.

articleTitle: ARIS-Oriented training method of ERP system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper proposes an ARIS(Architecture of Information System)-Oriented training method of ERP(Enterprise resource planning) system. Firstly it shows the drawback of current training method. Then the method suggests that lecturer can teach the knowledge of ERP within the framwork of ARIS, and gives the relationship between five views of ARIS and the key factors of ERP training. The advantage of this method is that trainees can grasp the whole concept of ERP more efficiently.

articleTitle: Application of decision support system in the conflict analysis of enterprise merger and acquisition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Enterprise merger and acquisition has been the highlight of our commercial life. Since China's Anti-Monopoly Law (AML) took effect, intense conflicts arise among anti-monopoly and those enterprises. Many researchers are interested in dealing with and solving these conflicts. In order to help decision-makers resolve these conflicts, we propose in this paper to use the decision support system based on the graph model for decision aids. The general objective of this paper is employing the graph model to model the Coca-Cola /Huiyuan Juice's merger case in 2008 and using the decision support system to calculate the stabilities for the case, and then furnish valuable advice for designing merger policies.

articleTitle: Non-length limit large number operation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Calculation of large numbers is the foundation technique to the procedure of computer encryption and decryption. Unfortunately, the operation capacity of our today's computers cannot satisfy our needs. In another word, computer software today cannot perform the calculation of large number that incorporates hundreds or thousands of digits to accuracy. In particular, division of large numbers is the hardest out of all basic calculations functions (that includes: Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication and Division). In our traditional way of calculation, obstacles exist when we perform division, in particular through the trial method to obtain an accurate dividend. This paper presents the method to calculate division of large number with simple algorithm and straight-forward concept, which can be applied on both microcomputers and single-chip microcomputer. This method of calculation to calculate division of large number has not been attempted by other academic researches. Therefore if would like to share my findings in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of video parallel processing on a hierachical multiprocessor system on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Recently there has been a growing interest in models and methods targeted towards the design of video stream parallel processing, and the applications tend to be highly bursty and dependent parallel. As a result, the most existing models are not suitable for dealing with such system design. In this paper, we present an Event Count Model (ECM) to capturing the timing properties of video stream processing in the hierarchical system structure; and we also use Continuous Markov Chain modeling and high level colored time Petri net to describe the multiprocessor system architecture and co-design of software and hardware. Simulations of the asynchronous and concurrent interactions of system, and formal co-verification approach with CPN Tools is proposed and a case of h.264 encoder on MPSoC is used for illustrate these explanations.

articleTitle: Analysis of characteristics of undergraduate students based on SNA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The appearance of imaginary community has been an effective medium to study the communication among students. It is of great importance to understand the features of communication among members of the communities. To analyze the relationship in the virtual learning communities, methods such as SNA, indicators including communities net graph, K-core, integrity and density have been applied to study the characteristics of net mode, net communication, status of members in the communities and key members and knowledge net groups. The findings of the research are as follows: different study groups are formed among members of the virtual learning communities. The status of key members and their duties are interrelated. Key members play a significant role in the management of the communities.

articleTitle: Empirical study on customer switching costs influence factors of online shopping
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Numerous studies show that switching costs have an impact on customer loyalty as an important factor, so the customer switching cost has become a hot spot. Many scholars had depth research on the role of switching costs and customer loyalty, and few people are concerned about the antecedents influence factors of switching costs. The research is based on the background of the Internet-online shopping, using multiple regression analysis and empirical analysis, research results showed that the factors that affect the switching costs is product complexity, irreplaceable, online empathy and credibility. And different factors influence on the different levels of switching costs. Through the effective control of these pre-factors, we can help enterprises to improve the customer switching costs, ultimately to maintain the customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Study on the dynamic conditions of initial generation of gully in loess plateau
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the fact that severe water erosion is mainly caused by a few torrential rains of the year, this paper derives relationship between runoff velocity variations, energy increase in per width runoff and runoff concentration caused by nonuniformity of slope, with mechanical analysis of the main dynamic, surface runoff on the slope. The result shows that the value of energy increase in per width runoff is proportional to (B/b)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8/3</sup> and inversely proportional to H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/3</sup>, (in which the B is the initial slope width; the b is the slope width after runoff concentration; the H is runoff depth). When the runoff depth is 1cm, with the increase of B/b, the E which is the energy in per width runoff after runoff concentration increases significantly compared with E′ which is the energy in per width runoff on the uniform slope. Particularly, the E can increase 2156.30 times for the E′ in the case of the B/b is 10. Because of this situation is very normal in the nature, this conclusion has important practical significance. Compared with the intent runoff, the runoff on the uniform slope can greatly increase the probability of the scouring force rolling in the unit area of surface, which exceeds the soil shear strength. That leads to the soil shear failure in the wetted perimeter of flow section, and the probability of forming the waterway and erosion rill. With the development of this process, the erosion rill extends and develops gradually. And this process could be longer for the uniform slope.

articleTitle: Research on the operation model of environmental value chain based on transaction cost theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Many countries have made and implemented more and more environmental protection laws and regulations, and the consumer's environmental consciousness is also becoming stronger. In this situation, corporation must re-build its own environmental value chain (EVC) to achieve competitive excellence. By taking the environmental influence into consideration, EVC conquered the imitation of the traditional value chain, and integrated the economical value and ecological value into value analysis. EVC is becoming a much more important organization of environmental governance because its advantage in incentive mechanism, saving information cost and governance cost. However the establishment and operation of EVC is affected by many factors. Based on transaction cost theory, the paper gives a systematic research on the organizational mode, driver, and driving manner of EVC. It indicates that transaction cost have important influence on the organization and operation of EVC, and then affects the performance of EVC. The results of the paper also have important inspiration for public department to make environmental governance policies.

articleTitle: A comparative study on the allocation of production factors of citrus in the U.S.A and China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Adopt American citrus for contrasting, use regression model and weighting least square technology estimation for fitting the elasticity of the costs of labor input, chemical fertilizers, planting protection as well as the organic fertilizers of unit output of Chinese citrus, and then the optimum allocation of production factors and the corresponding optimum unit output of American citrus and Chinese citrus are figured out. The result indicates: Firstly, in comparison with that of American citrus, the factor allocation of Chinese citrus is much unreasonable; Secondly, the input of chemical fertilizers in China is found too deficient to meet the need of optimum allocation; Thirdly, increasing labor input is the best measure to optimize current resources allocations of Chinese citrus; Finally, the contribution rate of technology progress of Chinese citrus (47%) is much lower than that of American citrus (77.85%). At last, some recommendations for government are provided to promote Chinese citrus development.

articleTitle: The slowdown of China's monetary velocity: A viewpoint from both short time and long time
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The main target of monetary policy in China is the money supply, and according to the quantity theory of money, the national income, price level and the monetary velocity must be studied in order to set up the goal for money supply, which is harder to measure because it's affected by many other interactive variables. In this paper, the monetary velocity, growth rate of money supply in the short time and especially its trend after the subprime crisis is analyzed firstly, then the model of monetary velocity is set up in a longer time from 1990 to 2009, showing that monetary velocity is going down in the long time. Finally, this trend and its reason are revealed.

articleTitle: Scientific management in classical books circulation using the time sequence mining method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article introduce the time sequence mining method. The method is practically used to analyze the classical book circulating data of the Library of Harbin Institute of Technology. Th rules of classical books borrowing and returning are found and the circulation trend in one day and one year are showed. And then the result of data mining is analyzed. Some scientific suggestions about the circulation service are proposed.

Author Keywords: the time sequence mining and analysis

articleTitle: The application of E-business in the car sales: An analysis based on performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper, at first analyzed the characteristics of car sales in China; then designed performance model and introduced the input data that the car sales had used E-business and the car sales income of every 12 countries, calculated the appropriate level of performance, found out the difference and advantage of China compared with other countries; at last, proposed effective strategies which was suitable for Chinese characteristics and used e-business in car sales.

articleTitle: Discussion on building the employees competency model of an informatization enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of Knowledge-based Economy, especially the Internet technology as the representative of information technology keeps on having impact on the traditional human resource management, which demands the informational reform of traditional human resource management. It is a long-standing problem as to how to learn about, employ and cultivate personals and naturally as well as a hot concern of Information enterprises. Successful organizations everywhere have determined that it is critical to understand the competencies which are necessary in order to attain strategic objectives. On basis of the analysis of primary information technology enterprises, model design, using competency models to assess employment candidates and employees as well as other elements, this paper expounds and proposes the assumption of the models of human resources of information technology entrepreneurship in the hope of providing reference for setting up competency model for informatization enterprise.

articleTitle: Impact of trade liberalization on farmers' welfare∗: — From the perspective of consumption and price transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of trade liberalization on farmers' expenditure in terms of price transmission pathway. As the first step, price transmission pathway is analyzed of how trade liberalization affect domestic consumption price. Then the impact of price changes from trade liberalization on farmers' expenditure is explored. The findings show that trade liberalization has brought significant different impacts on the price of different commodities, and thus different impacts on farmers' expenditure of different regions and income brackets.

articleTitle: On educational investment and economic growth: An empirical study in Australia
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Australia is known for its high quality education, how effective of Australian educational investment is a question worth discussing. On collecting 1980 to 2008 Australia's date on educational investment and economic growth, this article use Feder-model to analyze educational investment's total contribution to economic growth in Australia and its spillover effects to non-education sector. The study shows that: Australian educational investment has a high overall contribution to economic growth. Investment in education increase by 1% can promote economic growth of 18.808%, which is much higher than the world average. However, educational investment in Australia has little spillover effect on non-education sector. Investment in education increase by 1% only can promote non-education sector growth 0.126%. Australia should work to strengthen the cooperation and exchanges between education sector and non-education sector and to promote the spillover effects of educational investment.

articleTitle: Design of baking shunt autocontrol system of large aluminum reduction cell
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Aiming at low control accuracy in welding and dismounted the shunts by hand as well as too many subjective factors in manual recording data in the process of baking of aluminum reduction cell, we have designed a set of baking shunt auto control system. The system mainly contains two parts, baking shunt switch and the control system composed of Programming Logic Controller as well as industrial personal computer, realizing the function of automatic supervision as well as recording data and analysis by itself in baking of large aluminum reduction cell.

articleTitle: Digital photoelasticity method used in the stress test
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the traditional photoelastic experiment, We have to get isochromatic and isoclinic stripes, to be a very tedious work. Most of the work requires manual operation to complete, low efficiency, low precision, thus limiting the accuracy of results. This article uses a digital photoelastic image processing method, using phase shift technique, re-derivation and demonstration of the phase difference formula to reduce the calculation error. Digital Photoelasticity technology measurement accuracy has been improved. To further improve the digital photoelastic technique was useful to explore.

articleTitle: A study on the establishment of financial crisis early-warning model for A-share listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based up on accounting information of the listed companies on China's A-Share Market, this article attempts to establish a financial crisis early-warning model which is capable of predicting company financial crisis while analyzing the causation of such crisis by adopting a distance discriminant analysis. Compared with the previous research concerned, the said model comprises the following: integrity crisis early-warning model, business efficiency predictive model, financial structure predictive model, growth capacity predictive model, and repayment capacity predictive model, therefore the application of those predicting results has higher accuracy. It will be able to assist the manager in detecting potential financial crisis in due time as well as discovering the reason, while stakeholders may also use the model to make the right decision.

articleTitle: Research of radar system reliability based on dynamic programming theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Reliability of an equipment system has an important influence on its continuing efficiency. With settled life-span distributing functions of the radar complex system parts, by using the dynamic programming theory, the diversification of the system's reliability during its usage can be evaluated. Thus the status of the system is directly acquainted with in time, and the overhaul can be arranged.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The structuration theory on CRM diffusion: IT governance issues
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This research investigates the role of IT governance in CRM diffusion, based on the structuration theory of technology assimilation and the literature on IT governance. We conceptualize decision execution mechanisms of IT governance as including two dimensions — vertical advocacy from top management and horizontal coordination between business and IT managers, which are assumed to facilitate CRM use and value creation. Further, we investigate the moderation effect of decision making structures. We analyze a dataset of 133 Chinese firms in various industries. We find that: (1) Both vertical advocacy and horizontal coordination significantly contribute to the three stages of CRM diffusion, especially CRM use and business process performance; (2) decision execution mechanisms are more effective in facilitating CRM diffusion under a centralized decision making structure where top management makes decisions on CRM initiatives. In particular, vertical advocacy has a greater effect under such a centralized structure, while horizontal coordination has a greater effect under a decentralized structure; (3) CRM use improves firm performance mainly through creating operational and strategic benefits in customer-oriented business processes.

articleTitle: Impacts of sulfur taxation on the Chinese macroeconomy and industrial sectors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper builds a CGE model for evaluating the impacts of sulfur taxation on Chinese macro-economy and industrial sectors. Some major findings are: 1) the imposition of sulfur taxation promotes agents to substitute no-sulfur and low-sulfur contained energy for high-sulfur contained energy, and causes industrial sectors' input structures of labor, capital and energy to vary differently; 2) with the ratio of sulfur taxation increasing, low-sulfur contained coal changes from the alternative to be alternated, and its output takes on an inverted U-shaped; 3) except that energy sectors' output prices with sulfur taxation imposed on production process are higher than that imposed on consumption process, the difference of impacts on the real economy between these two imposition process is tiny; 4) the three ways of tax revenue use, retained in government, returned to firms, and returned to residents, all produce the negatively small impact on the real GDP, moreover, among the three ways, the negative impacts of the second way on the real GDP, import, and export, are the smallest, and on the disposable income and welfare of the residents are middle. Finally, we put forward some policy suggestions according to the above-mentioned results.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Application of texture-based method in simulating river flow based on virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper presents the application of texture-based method in simulating river flow, describes its detailed process for flow simulation, uses the test model to analyze the impact laws of background noise texture, spatial distribution and temporal changes of noise texture, transparency coefficient on the flow simulation effect, studies the noise texture enhancement technology and real-time generation of attribute texture. The method is applied in simulating flow field based on virtual reality technology with the reach between Three Gorges Project and Gezhouba Project of Yangtze River as an example. The result shows that there is a wide application prospect of the texture-based method in the field of water conservancy.

articleTitle: One new business model of m-commerce based on value nets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the development of 3G, the trend of tri-networks integration and the diversification of customers' needs, the traditional linear value chain business model cannot meet the needs of users any more. So to rethink of business models of mobile commerce becomes a necessity. This paper firstly states the relevant concepts and then analyzes the business model based on value chain as well as its disadvantages. Finally, this article constructs a customer-centric business model of m-commerce based on value nets, which integrates the main advantages of each entity well. This model breaks the liner thinking and makes the entities on the original value chain interact dynamically in accordance with the principles of best value.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Application of knowledge management in mordern enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research on public investment, private investment and economic growth in the global financial crisis: A preliminary model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Financial crisis in 2008 brought a heavy blow to the global economy. How to resist this crisis and improve economy growth was an important question faced by the government of many countries. This paper focuses on the influence of public investment, private investment on economic growth. First, according to Ak model, the mathematic model is built to analyze the dynamic relationship between public capital and private capital. Subsequently, the impacts of public capital and private capital on economic growth are discussed. Basis on this, some valuable conclusions of the above are educed and tested by the practical institution of Chinese economy.

articleTitle: Incremental-best-relay selection scheme in coded cooperative networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Incremental relaying is introduced to the multi-nodes coded cooperative system. The Incremental-Best-Relay selection scheme in coded cooperative networks is proposed based on opportunistic relaying selection strategy. The outage probability and average spectral efficiency are analyzed and simulated. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can achieve higher average spectral efficiency while keep the same outage probability as opportunistic relaying-coded cooperation, and an optimal average spectral efficiency also can be found as the average ratio of signal to noise (SNR) is fixed.

articleTitle: Batch model and simulation of hybrid system based on thermodynamics laws
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: For the hybrid system exists manufacturing / rework / remanufacturing at the same time, the paper studies the effects of reverse logistics due to quality defects and product recycling on batch strategy of the hybrid systems. The traditional manufacture's batch model was established considering the impact of rework and remanufacturing. On this basis, the impact of the disorder costs on the model was took into account based on the laws of thermodynamics, and the optimal batch strategies in both cases were obtained aimed at minimize the cost per unit time. Above two cases were carried out a comparative analysis by the way of simulation applications, and the impact of the variety of parameters in both models on the model run results was analyzed.

articleTitle: Does earning management meet analysts' forecasts? — A perspective of earnings surprises of Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper uses distribution test and Ordinary Least Square (OLS) regression model and cross-sectional Jones model to get the evidence which listed companies manage their earnings in order to meet analysts' forecasts. The empirical analysis concentrates on the companies which disclosure analysts' forecasts information in 2009. The findings generally indicate that companies tend to use earnings management to improve their financial numbers and subsequently reinforce their compensation and meet analysts' forecasts. We find out that the motive is significant when earnings surprises lies in sections of (−5%, +10%). The results suggest that policy makers and investors should assess earnings quality in conjunction with management activity. Investors may use earnings surprise as supplemental signals about the lack of permanence of earnings innovations.

articleTitle: Research on pureXML performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Most of the current mainstream relational databases integrate XML processing capacity. However, different DBMS adopts different framework and implementation method in processing XML data. This results in different XML processing capacity. DB2 adopted pureXML to store XML data in the newest version. The paper focuses on pureXML technology research and compare it's performance with the current popular database product Oracle and SQL Server. Detailed lab materials and results are given to provide the useful references for choosing proper relational databases to process XML data in practice.

articleTitle: Dollar standard, overshooting of exchange rates and RMB exchange rate regime reform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Overshooting of exchange rates is an important factor in exchange rates regime choice, so it is valuable to study the overshooting of RMB exchange rate for RMB exchange rate regime reform. This paper analyzes the influence of Dollar Standard on overshooting of exchange rate with dynamics general equilibrium method under new open economics macroeconomics model. It reveals that the greater the influence on Chinese import and export by dollar standard, the more severe overshooting of RMB exchange rate. However, it's a necessary trend to adapt more floating exchange rate regime because of the rising of Chinese GDP, international status of RMB and the reducing of dollar standard's influence on China.

articleTitle: An experimental study on the primary model of the application of computer simulation to scientific discovery learning in middle school physics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Computer simulation is usually considerd as an instrument for the scientific discovery learning because it can offer an open exploring learning environment for the learners. Based upon the present researches, we analyzed the activity structure of scientific discovery learning. Moreover, based upon the teaching situation and the earlier investigation, we placed computer simulation as an experimenting and exploring aspect for the scientific discovery learning to offer an environment of experimenting and exploring for the students. Grounded upon this, we designed a primary model of computer simulation that applies into the scientific discovery learning in middle school physics. Compared with the model of scientific discovery learning which are based upon the real situation, the primary model shows almost significant promoting effects upon the students' mastery of the principle knowledge, significant promoting effects upon the students' intuitional understanding, significant promoting effects upon the students' ability of the flexible application of the knowledge, and some negative effects.

articleTitle: Study on shared-platform of massive E-government map based on the OGC service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper the construction of Chengdu land resources E-government system is taked as an example. Combine each service of land resources closely, the existing fundamental data and the thematic data are integrated. By using present information technology, the sharing model and the solution of releasing and sharing the massive data based on the OGC service are proposed. The integration and application of the platform, the existing business systems, the approval systems and so on with the SOA architecture are done. Online sharing and applying massive E-government map based on network is implemented, and the goal of networks intercommunication, resources integration, systems interconnection, data and information sharing is achieved.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stimulating effect on civilian car consumption to economic development: Empirical research of Sichuan Province based on VAR model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Car consumption is becoming a new hot consumption, and automotive industry is positioned as the a pillar industry, therefore it will become a new driving force to boost economic with the health and stable development of China's national economy. This paper analyzes the stimulating effect on the civilian car consumption to economic development based on the VAR model using temporal series of Sichuan Province from 1990 to 2009, then uses impulse response function and variance decomposition to portray the correlations between economic growth and car consumption. The result shows that there exists a strong positive response between them, and big potential to enhanec the growing of economic.

articleTitle: The relationship model between suppliers and Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the new economic situation of logistics and procurement, the relationship between suppliers and manufacturers still exists crisis, even fight ceaselessly. This research devotes to solve this question effectively. On the basis of reading a large number of related literatures, this article mainly adopted literature research methodology to propose its own system frame, which means by deeply analyzing the relational crisis between suppliers and manufacturers, it proposes a feasible solution of this issue. It hopes to form a joint decision-making system on the basis of incentive mechanism and on the premise of bilateral information-sharing and knowledge-sharing, therefore it can optimize the overall interests and realize the fundamental shift in relations between the two parties.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On quality control and management mode of architectural construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a special commodity, the architectural products are directly related to people's lives and property. With the construction boom, the quality of construction arouses more concern from people. In this paper, we first propose that the important way to ensure and improve the quality of the project is the effective quality control and management. Then, as the basic principle of quality control, the principle of "quality first, customers first" is presented. In addition, another important principle is put forward, namely, taking people as the driving force of quality control, active control as the main part, the quality of construction is controlled comprehensively in the whole process, with the participation of all related people, taking the quality of materials into consideration. Furthermore, we propose quality control measures, in which objective management is implemented so as to perfect the quality-managing system, and human-oriented enterprises' quality culture is established through relying on technological progress and practicing total quality management. At the same time, we suggest that the sound and effective quality management mode is an important guarantee of quality control. And in the process of construction, quality control and management play an important role. Carrying out quality control and management can fully reflect the purpose of project quality management, which can overcome the blindness and randomness in the work of quality and avoid the passiveness, thus enhancing the activity, directedness and orderliness in quality control. Quality control plays a positive role in ensuring the construction process, reducing the project costs and smoothly achieving the overall goal of project quality, which can continuously improve the project quality and further promote the overall economic benefits of enterprises.

articleTitle: Space reconstruction based Biomimetic Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper presents a new scheme for off-line recognition of totally unconstrained handwritten numerals. The work is motivated by two approaches: Affinity Propagation (AP) clustering and Biomimetic Pattern Recognition (BPR). It can relatively classify the samples by calculating the distance to the relative subspace. The training sample space is constructed by the AP algorithm and BPR theory. The posterior probabilities based on the class condition are estimated to reduce the rejection caused by the space overlapping with low misclassification. Experiments have been performed with Concordia University CENPARMI's handwritten digit database and Nanjing University of Science and Technology's handwritten amount database. Experimental results indicate that the proposed classifier has a higher recognition rate than the traditional classifiers.

articleTitle: Carbon tariff: A TBT game based on expected benefit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper first introduces the background and the reason of carbon tariff, and then probes its rationality and its nature as a TBT. It holds the view that carbon tariff is a TBT game between developed countries and developing ones based on expected benefit. In the short term, developed countries tend to impose carbon tariff as long as expected benefit from low-carbon environment is high enough to offset the trade retaliation measures from developing countries; in medium term, technology and equipment transfer is most probably the equilibrium, with both carbon tariff and trade retaliation measures abandoned; while in the long run, developed countries are motivated to upgrade carbon emission standard as an trade barriers. Whether or not developed countries will take the action depends on the expected loss from developing countries' technology upgrade and expected retaliation.

articleTitle: The bargaining sets for fuzzy cooperative game with non-transferable utility
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, we extended the concepts of the bargaining sets, which were proposed by Davis-Machler<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> (1964) and Mas-Colell<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup> (1989) in classical cooperative game theory, to non-transferable utility fuzzy game. We proved that there exists the inclusion relation between them under the condition of not only in superadditive non-transferable games but also in non-transferable fuzzy games. Therefore, we claim that the new concept of bargaining set have practical significance and theoretical value.

articleTitle: A new multi-signature scheme based on bilinear pairs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: An identity-based multi-signature scheme is proposed by using bilinear pairs technology. The scheme uses user's identity information such as email address, IP address, telephone number as public key so that it erases the cost of forming and managing public key infrastructure and avoids the problem of user private generating center generating forgery signature by using CL-PKC framework to generate user's private key.

articleTitle: Income, income gap, and employment under public investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The parameters of multi-objective multi-constraint public investment model to increase per capita income, decrease per capita income gap, and increase employment rate were analyzed. The rules were found that how tax rate, savings rate, and transfer loss rate affected three objectives applying 2009 China statistical data.

articleTitle: Non-binary social choice preference profile's properties and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: When the rational social choice function is been studied, it is usually been assumed that the social preference domain is complete. In reality, the social preference some times can not be complete, which gives rise to problem of non-binary social choice, and the concept of determining set has been the important concept in the study of social choice. Based on these this paper tries to analyze the properties of determining set of non-binary social choice function which meets certain constraint conditions, and deduct two property theorems on preference profile of non-binary social choice function. These property theorems can provide a new way to prove Arrow's impossibility theorem.

articleTitle: Designing the general mode of junior mathematics instruction resources based on the integrable ware idea: Design and thinking of junior mathematics “probability” integrable ware cell warehouse
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Constructing digital instructional resources of junior mathematics plays an important role in mathematics curriculum reform of basic education. By analyzing the research actuality of digital instructional resources on basic education home and abroad, it is often found that there exist some problems. With regards to them, this thesis presents a new way — design of instructional resources of junior mathematics based on integrable ware idea on one hand and provides theoretical guideline for instructional resources of junior mathematics on the other hand. The present study constructs general mode of instructional resources of junior mathematics based on the integrable ware idea and with special attention to the analysis of three stages of the build-up of integrable ware system such as the break-up, categorization, management and assembling of integrable ware. According to the general mode, “probability” integrable ware cell warehouse is designed and developed and then the result of this research is verified in practice.

articleTitle: The application of association rules mining in data processing of private economy statistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Private economy is very important in the modern society. But there are some problems in statistical data of it, such as untruth and shortage. The quality problems of statistical data of private economy have received more and more concern from the government and society. Association rules learning is a method of data mining. The article tries to use association rule learning to process statistical data of private economy and analyze the results to improve the quality of statistical data of private economy. Finally the article provides some exploratory comments and suggestions about the application of association rule mining in private economy statistics.

articleTitle: Evaluation of emergency management information system service quality under information Chaos
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Emergency management information system is an important tool for emergency management. The evaluation of emergency management information system service quality has crucial significance to meet the information needs of government, departments, public, and to make a better use of emergency information. Nowadays, most of the present research on the evaluation of emergency management focuses on emergency management capability. It is a new task to evaluate the emergency management information system service quality from the users' satisfaction under Information Chaos. Based on the conclusion of the historical achievement and implementation experience of emergency management information system, first, we analyze the elements of emergency management information system service quality from the perspective of users' satisfaction. Second, the evaluating marks of the elements are described as blind number and its average value is calculated. Then, we calculate the index weight using entropy method. Last of all, an example is designed and it shows the feasibility and applicability of the model.

Author Keywords: emergency management information system service capacity

articleTitle: The study of SOA-based Community Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Community informatization is an another information technology hot spot after the construction of e-government, e­commerce, and can be regarded as the extension of the e-government to the smaller level of administrative division. Community Management Information System is the core components and also the main element for the successful construction of the community informatization. This article, which refers to the SOA-based Community Management Information System, studies not just the simple applications of the Community Management Information System, but targets more on the construction of a new knowledge structure and mental attitude — the basic idea of which is the management information system architecture model based on SOA (service-oriented) and the purpose of which is to develop a kind of community-based management information system that is low-cost, changeable on-demand, loosely coupled and appropriate for business processes for grassroots, by using the SOA service architecture.

articleTitle: The construction of technical support system for the conversion of patent achievements based on knowledge discovery in databases
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Aiming at the low conversion rate of the patent technological achievements, the paper puts forward an idea about conversion support system of patent technological achievements based on knowledge discovery in databases. Combined with Information Retrieval and Statistics, the system uses clustering, association and SVM (Support Vector Machine) to achieve the goal of the patent Data-Mining at both the macro and micro. Then, the system discovers the unknown information of the designated patent, which provides important references for the consumers such as enterprises, universities, research institutes to make decisions.

articleTitle: Research of multimedia teaching strategy based on Internet virtual teaching platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The multimedia teaching have widely applied in the university, but it's also insufficient considering the teaching effect. Developing the multimedia teaching based on the network virtual teaching platform makes uses of the network 3 mian characteristics — breakthrough time, spatial, the region limit. It may stimulate students' study enthusiasm, and enhance the teaching validity, even strengthen students' learning capability.

articleTitle: Analysis on the implication of information service in second life in Chinese university libraries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Second life, is a 3-dimention virtual world based on internet and a product of virtual reality technology. In 2003, American Linden lab firstly opens SL to the public. After logging in SL, users can quickly and directly check the object's information such as location, environment, with no limitations of time and space. This results in the integration of virtual world and the real one. Things like service, manufacture, entertainment and education are applied in virtual world now. Chinese university libraries, as an important base of education and head of the world of Chinese libraries, play a very important role in information supply. Therefore, this paper demonstrates the possibility of SL in Chinese university libraries from request, cost, security and Humanities.

articleTitle: Internet of things technology application in the food supply chain management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is very important to exchange and share the unified information for the numerous participants in food supply chain because of the market uncertainty and the high Logistics requirement. On the basis of introducing the connotation and the work flow of the internet of things (IOT), the paper analyzed the effect of IOT in each link of the food supply chain. It is showed that the real-time, accurate information sharing which realize the intelligent recognition, location, tracking, monitoring and management for food can improve the efficiency of food supply chain and the degree of food safety. The national industrial policy and the laws and regulations should support IOT because the development of it needs not only technology, but also the integration of each related industry.

articleTitle: The Application and system design for RFID technology in China urban public traffic management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With China's increasingly accelerated urbanization, urban public transport issues emerge as constraints on the city's rapid development. While RFID technology is a key technology of Internet of Things, as a non-contact automatic identification technology it has broad application prospects in urban public transport management system. This article focuses on RFID technology principle and development process, through the analysis of China urban public transport management problems and deficiencies, we put forwards an improved urban public transport management system which was based on RFID technology from urban public transport intelligent management and RFID technology application perspective.

articleTitle: A study on key technologies in the development of mobile e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the evolution of mobile network from 2.5G to 3G, the development of e-commerce to the mobile e-commerce contributes to the fact that mobile e-commerce will be the important content in the future mobile application. The present paper introduces in detail the advantages and disadvantages of core technologies appeared in recent years which support the development of mobile-ecommerce and analyzes mobile e-commercial system based on the development platform of J2ME, which provides such Internet Protocol support as HTTP and TCP and ensures that communication terminals can steadily and reliably access all the information on the Internet. Further studies will be focused on security problems generally exist in the mobile e-commercial system and the solution to these problems.

articleTitle: Influence brought about by cutter distortion in exact NC lathe physical simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to the materials of the part and cutter, taking the cutting parameter into account, this paper calculates the cutting-force and cutting-journey using experience formula, calculates the distortion quantity considering the actual instance when machining, calculates the cutter's distortion quantity when heated according to the cutting-heat produced during cutting process, analyzes the cutter's distortion when forced after predigesting the mechanics model, then forecasts the machining error brought out by the displacement change between cutter and part. Based on Windows and Visual C++, the system is developed by C++ language, and instructs Matlab to draw curve according to the result calculated by the mathematical model in order to manifest the simulation results in the pattern of data and curve.

articleTitle: Construction of deep web information retrieval system in e-commerce field
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the increasing number of e-commerce sites, how to get a quick search about the information you want from thousands of e-commerce networks is becoming an urgent problem. In this paper, we present a solution to this problem, first, domain knowledge is established according to the e-commerce field, then we build a deep web information retrieval system based on e-commerce to help users find the goods they want quickly from different e-commerce sites, this system is established by deep web interface extraction, interface integration and interface AutoFill technology.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on government information Rent-Seeking and response measures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A Jess knowledge-based data quality analyzing framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Successful data quality analyzing depends on the business rules. We present a knowledge-based framework for data quality analyzing, which carries out the representation of business knowledge by production rules and performs Analysis and cleansing operations automatically by Jess engine driver; The framework provides a systematic approach for domain knowledge representation, supports the complete life-cycle of data quality and is extensible.

articleTitle: A regression model on effective exchange rate of RMB based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: RMB exchange rate becomes more uncertain with 2008 financial crisis. The relation between RMB exchange rate and the impact factors is worth to study. In this paper, a regression model between RMB exchange rate and the economic indicators is obtained by Random Forests (RF) method, where the economic indicators is also selected with RF. In addition, the comparison experiments between RF, support vector machine (SVM) and multiple linear regression method show that RF method achieves a better result.

articleTitle: Architecture and key technologies of learning resource management based on Grid system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The highly efficient and stable collaborative computation platform for learning resource management can be constructed on the basis of Grid computing technology, combined with Peer-to-Peer (P2P) computing technology. This paper proposed the architecture and key technologies of the Grid incorporated with P2P structure, and correspondingly web services with LDAP access grid node was designed. Learning resource ontology was introduced and used for resource stored and accessed with the WSRF.

articleTitle: Study on E-commerce recommendation based on content analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By using content analysis, 101 journal articles about E-commerce recommendation between 2000 ∼ 2010 year have been statistically analyzed in the text, and the four categories of E-commerce recommendation framework include theoretical overviews, E-commerce recommendation technology, security system of E-commerce recommendation and the recommendation applications, which have been establishment. The text detects the research and development of E-commerce recommendation in the hot areas for nearly ten years. The research shows that the recommendation research are focused on algorithm, especially the collaboration filtering algorithms, but security system of E-commerce recommendation and the recommendation applications are the weak link, so through analyzing development trend of the recommendations can provide support for future study of E-commerce recommendation.

articleTitle: Research of style-based clothing image retrieval
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Facing a great mass of clothing images on the Internet and the improvement of image retrieval result, text-based image retrieval has not perfectly meet the needs of people. Content-based retrieval increasingly shows its powerful search capabilities. But its problems, such as semantic gap and precise search, have not been resolved very well. Image for the clothing, this paper put forward that using clothing style domain knowledge in image retrieval can to some extent solve the semantic gap and precise search of clothing image retrieval, and give a test and verification.

articleTitle: Research on B2B e-commerce site information architecture based on user experience
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: User analysis is the premise of website information architecture. While ultimate purpose of website information architecture is to achieve a good user experience. This article expounds the theory of user experience and information architecture, and then discusses the model of B2B e-commerce site information architecture based on user experience. In the whole process of information architecture, the model emphasizes that user analysis is the foundation of information architecture, and the user experience is the criterion of evaluate information architecture.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on CSI 300 index futures arbitrage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The comparison research of concept map tools
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Concept map is one of teaching and thinking tools, which was made by Professor Novak in the last century 60s, and it is also an effective tool for knowledge organization and representation which has a huge prospect in teaching and knowledge management applications in educational institutions, enterprises and government. There are a variety of professional concept map tools now. We selected four of them and compared with each other from four aspects, like interface design, graphics and visual effects, relations setting function, import and export file types and collaboration, so that it could provide reference to those who use concept map tools.

articleTitle: Development status, the existing problems and development trends of the Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The Internet of things are predicted for the global information industry after the Internet and another wave of technology and the economy is seen as promoting the development of a new round of information industry, and promote economic restructuring and transformation and upgrading of a key technology. This paper study the Internet of Things technology for the current situation and existing problems and development trends, analyzes the development of the Internet of things to be the status of technology, forecast the trend of technological development of the Internet of things, Point out the Internet of things that the technology exists and urgent problems.

articleTitle: Study on customer loyalty evaluation in the age of electronic commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The problem of customer retention in EC (Electronic Commerce) environment is studied. After the basic theories of customer retention are summed up, the foundation of customer retention-customer loyalty is analyzed, and the manifestation and decidable factor of customer loyalty in EC environment, this dissertation formulates a strategy that is "enterprise must be loyal to customer", and sets up the synthesis evaluated quota system in terms of customer value for enterprise. Then comprehensive evaluation model is built based on AHP(Analytic hierarchy process), experts decision and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, the results Can help enterprise to measure customers' wills and behaviors in time, and to formulate the marketing strategy.

articleTitle: Research on domestic B2B e-commerce profit model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In our country B2B e-commerce shows a trend of rapid development after it go through different phases, and how to steady profits is the source power for B2B e-commerce to continue to develop. The author takes Alibaba for example to analyze its profit model and gives some improvements. I hope the experiences can provide useful enlightenment for the improvement of northeast equipment manufacturing's B2B platform.

articleTitle: Designation and application of cloud computing terminal equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Cloud computing applied more and more widely, but cloud computing terminal equipment is missing on the market. According to the current characteristics of cloud computing and users' needs, raised a total solution for cloud computing terminal equipment and discussed the key technologies in-depth. From selection of hardware and software designation to system testing, this paper does a complete introduction. Through analyzing the characteristics of the Remote Desktop Protocol, found shortcoming of RDP protocol and improved its performance by reduced the transmission data. Good display of this solution increasing customer satisfaction, which lay a good foundation to open foreign markets.

articleTitle: Mining weighted association rules based on weighted Fp tree
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The article presents a new algorithm for mining weighted frequent itemsets without generating candidate, which based on weighted Fp-tree and the weighted model proposed by Feng Tao. For solving the problem that the weighed support may be bigger than 1, the weight set of attributes was normalized. The new algorithm is testified to satisfy weighted downward closure property and an effectively mining pruning strategy base of weighed Fp-tree is structured. Thorough research and scientific analysis, the new algorithm solves the problem that the importance of association rule does not increase with the amount of attribute in practical application.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The empirical research on the relationship between employees job stress and performance in Public Transportation Group
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Understanding restaurant consumers' reaction toward the iPad menu
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The impact of the iPad has been radically big in the world. There are restaurants having provided services by substituting Apple's touch-screen iPad for their printed menus recently. Thus, the objective of this study was to propose and test a research model involving both cognitive and affective components that can influence potential restaurant visitors' behavioral intention to visit by way of influencing their value perceptions. Structural equation modeling was used to analyze the model. Theoretical and practical implications of the outcome were addressed.

articleTitle: The Empirical analysis of online shopping network factor on the perceived risk
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Some results of researches show that consumers are inclined to reduce perceived risks rather than maximize perceived benefits when they are making purchase decisions. After a mass of questionnaire surveys through the campus students, the effect of Internet factor to perceived risk and perceived risk to purchasing intention were revealed by using structural equation model (SEM) analysis. In the end, focused on how to bring consumer perceived risk down, we try to explain risk perceptions how to affect consumers' purchasing intention. The corresponding administrative suggestions on shopping site and online retailer are proposed.

articleTitle: Mortgage loan pricing model unde the default risk
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper use the option pricing theory, based on the risk of default under the mortgage related to pricing model. Mortgage loan risk compensation will be converted to put option with the different strike price.

articleTitle: Witkey websites based education of art and design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Witkey pattern can not only create a new employment model, but also affect the education model. Witkey websites have great influence on education and students because they can help more and more students with studying and finding jobs as new network platforms.

articleTitle: The game theory between government and developer of real estate in the real estate market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As in the real estate market, the relationship of government, real estate developers and consumers have clear game features, this article use the model of incomplete information dynamic game, Signaling Game theory and the Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium model to analyze the game between the government and real estate developers, and then analyze that using the introduction of policies to regulate the real estate market, to guide price trend is reasonable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the effectiveness of the Senior Managers' Compensation Incentive of the listed companies in Shenzhen stock exchange
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The mode of government intervention in financial security: Simple game and empirical research in incentive regulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Paper analyzes and does the empirical research on the government intervention model of financial security. First, it analyzes the simple game premise of the incentive regulation of financial security. Second, it builds a simple game mode and explains the operational mechanism of the incentive regulation to analyze the difference between the incentive regulation model and cooperative game. Finally, it analyzes the feasibility by empirical research and also gives some suggestions and thinking. The study concludes that China can effectively minimize the financial risks through the incentive intervention model in the background of the financial globalization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Shift-share analysis on the structure of tourism market — A case study on Hainan in-bound tourism market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Performance measurement of the U.S.'s service management and its enlightment to China: Examples from the transportation service subsidy of the United States
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The service subsidy has become vital for all the countries through service sectors development. In this article, the author firstly designed a framework of service subsidies for government decision-making according to the definition of the service subsidy and its functional features. Then, a detailed explanation of three tiers of performance evaluation indicators (such as key indicators, referential indicators, etc) was elaborated. With the DEA approach, the article then evaluated the performance of the direct expenditures subsidies received by the transportation sectors of the U.S. The result indicated that the service subsidy worked well m the transport sector in the U.S despite of some flaws and the future subsidy should be adjusted accordingly. As the matter to China, the author suggested that the monitoring and supervising is necessary during we grant service subsidies, which might help to optimize the effect of such policy and minimize the possible negative impact. Meanwhile, we should track the tendency of the international rules of service subsidy when we formulate such policy, in case that the domestic policy cause some negative effect over the other countries through trade and rise trade disputes.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the opportunities and challenges of the cloud computing for Chinese medium-sized and small enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The existence of solutions for economic equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Economic behaviors of the economic system, including products priced and the price of E-commerce, can be attributed to economic equilibrium problems which research the price which both the supply and demand can accept in the market economy. The existence of solutions for economic equilibrium in finitely continuous topological spaces is presented without linear and convexity structure. Some result of the solutions for economic equilibrium are studied by Browder fixed point theorem and Ky Fan's minimax inequality are studied in topological spaces. The research provides a basis theory for economic departments.

articleTitle: An intelligent blind rod and navigation platform based on ZigBee technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article introduces an intelligent blind rod and navigation platform based on ZigBee technology. This blind rod can detect and analyze the situation on road and warn the blind to avoid obstacles by ultrasonic measurement. The navigation platform based on ZigBee technology can help the blind know different directions the path leads to. This intelligent blind rod can better serve for the blind's independent travel.

articleTitle: The research on students' studying attitudes and behaviors caused by modern teaching media
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper manages to evaluate students' attitude and behavior caused by modern teaching media through that used in physical anatomy teaching. In order to make a further study, documentary method, questionnaire method, structured observational method, logic analysis, mathematics statistics method are used in this paper. The result shows that modern teaching media can be successfully improve physical anatomy teaching, and welcomed by students. Furthermore, modern media makes teaching design optimized, and influence actively towards students, closely touch the teaching aim.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study on the conceptualization of group citizen behavior of enterprise
