publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Fuzzy analysis method in risk management of the insurance companies for oneself
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Firstly, this paper tries to resolve the risks which are faced by the insurance companies with some subsystems of risk factors, and gets fuzzy identifying models of subsystems through fuzzy indirect identifying method and approximate degree. Secondly, we build the total systems fuzzy optimal model gradually which is used for the risk orders of the insurance companies.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of cultivated land resource grid management system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the explosive growth or population and rapid development of economy, basic farmland conservation and the management of cultivated land resources have been paid more and more attention by researchers and government. The content of cultivated land resource grid management and its function were analyzed. According to the goal of cultivated land resource management system and the architecture of grid, the main structure of cultivated land resource management was established. Finally, the implementation flow of cultivated land resource management was discussed in detail. It provided essential theoretic base and technical support for the popularizing of cultivated land resource grid management.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An empirical study on the relationship between China's output, inflation, and money supply
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A research on logistic regression model based corporate credit rating
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the foundation of credit evaluation theory, comparing these representative evaluation methods that be widely used both at home and abroad, the article sets up the credit evaluation model. The empirical analysis takes the Shanghai Stock Exchange 50 Index constituent stocks' credit rating data as samples which released by Dagong Global Credit Rating Co., Ltd. With the application of statistical analysis, this paper also selects six financial factors to be the main indications from the fifteens. Thus Logistic model is established under these factor scores to evaluate the credit status of enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis and simulation application for reverse supply chain based on TP and retailer take-back
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research on organizational structure based on Viable System Model: How to diagnose the problem of management from the view of knowledge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The model of present structure of organization limits the development of knowledge-organization in the knowledge economy society. It is very crucial to construct the new form to deal with the complexity of organization from the view of system. In this paper, the evolution process of organization structure is been described. Then the new structure of organization is been built based on Viable System Model in order to effective knowledge management. In the end, the new structure is applied to diagnose the problem of knowledge management in organization. By using this, the manager can improve the situation that the problem occurs. The Viable System Model helps us find the alternative structure of organization to manage the knowledge effectively.

articleTitle: To study medical service quality with structural-equation model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper proposed three scholars PZB "service quality model" as the basic theory of SERVQUAL scale, with patients who come into contact with the medical care service quality interviews to determine the degree of importance of each index. Then on the joint use of the spss and liserl software, we get the data of the relevant results. Then analyze the results of the processing and integration of the amendment of the initial model, test hypotheses, ultimately get the quality evaluation model for the medical industry. Finally in accordance with results of the questionnaire survey data to make recommendations to improve medical institutions draw direction and future focus of the appraisal of the medical work.

articleTitle: Research on ontology-based emergency response plan modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Emergency Response Plan is the core and criteria of emergency response incidents process, which should be formalized further for the reason of improving its sharing and interoperability. In this paper, combined with van der Aalst's meta-model, we expanded the model to be a plan-program ontmodel, regarded the plan as a template with constraints and variables, described constraints of time, space, roles and routing, changed the program generation to be constraint satisfaction problem, and released the formal definition in the end.

articleTitle: The application of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in the sustainable development of Wuhan tourism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is a quantitative decision method that aims at multi-index questions, which is difficult to quantize directly with accurate figures. Regarding at the evaluation of the sustainable development of Wuhan tourism, this paper uses the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation theory, establishes the multi-level model of comprehensive evaluation, quantize the factors that originally has fuzzy and quantitative characteristics, improves the scientific and correctness of evaluation. This evaluation method is simple, feasible, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Operators to dilate and erode color impulse noise images based on the morphology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By analyzing the numerical characteristics of impulse noise images, in order to resolve spreading-noise problem resulted from dilating and eroding images base on mathematical morphology, an algorithm of dilating and eroding color impulse noise images based on mathematical morphology is proposed. The result of the experiment demonstrates that the new algorithm has same effect as traditional algorithm of dilating and eroding images, but also suppresses impulse noise.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research on project management for Inter-Organizational Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Inter-Organizational Information Systems (IOS) project implementation is the process of seeking dynamic balance among various organizations' strategies and structures, pursuing the specific project goals based on organizations' mutual cooperation while following each other's information systems strategy with the of adopting of IT to support inter-organizational communication, and establishing the application portfolio in which information systems align with inter-organizational business processes. The paper discussed the five steps of IOS project implementation as, pre-project preparation, requirements and information norms, information sharing mechanism, application mode, system implementation, etc.

articleTitle: Implementation and its application of an algorithm of word segmentation on full text match in Chinese
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Chinese word segmentation is the basis of Chinese information processing. The studied achievements about Chinese word segmentation have been summarized in brief in this paper from the basic theory of word segmentation. A binary word segmentation algorithm based on word dictionary has been chosen and studied by combing actual requirements to match Chinese description texts of the transaction projects for supply and requirement on e-Commerce, and an actual automatic matching system has been also designed and implemented by using the binary word segmentation algorithm and combing the techniques of pattern match and etc.

Author Keywords: transaction match for supply and requirement

articleTitle: Service efficiency analysis of civil airports after the localization reform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Chinese aviation industry embraces a new age after localization reform. This paper analyzes the efficiency change of 30 civil airports using DEA. It has found that most of the operations are invalid though the efficiency has improved since 2006. We also predict the inputs of airports in 2012, which lead to the best performance. For some airports with low efficiency, the inputs must be reduced to improve the aggregated technical efficiency. Otherwise they can only be wasted.

articleTitle: An demonstrative analysis on volatility features of RMB exchange rate based on ARCH Family Models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With RMB exchange rate reforming, the volatility range of RMB exchange rate increase quickly, and financial institutions are facing the high risk of exchange rate too. Based on ARCH Family Models, the volatility of US$ / RMB exchange rate were measured and analyzed in use of the variance — covariance method, in the end, the article come out a few volatility features of RMB Exchange Rate.

articleTitle: The analysis of anti-dumping actions based on the game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a frequent use of trade protection means in today's international trade, the anti-dumping affects the development of the world economy and trade cooperation to some extent. Basing on the theory of static and dynamic game model, the article analyzes the traders' motivation of anti-dumping actions and the product pricing strategies in consideration of anti-dumping duties. It suggests that a trust and cooperation mechanism is good for the world trade liberalization and global economic development.

Author Keywords: Static game model of perfect information

articleTitle: Discussion on the computer simulation experiment system used in college physics experiment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Computer simulation technique used in Physics Experiment has changed the traditional model of experiment teaching. It solves the problem of the shortage of teaching resources and it is helpful for the students to carry out the opening study. Meanwhile, a few disadvantages of Computer Simulation Experiment have been mentioned. The opening and simulation degree of the simulation system needs to be improved. However, the computer simulation technique is a really useful tool for the teaching of Physics Experiment.

articleTitle: System dynamic model for sustainable development of coal industry and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Coal is an important basic energy in China, the sustainable development of coal industry is relation to the national economic and security. After systemically analyzing the feature and the state of development, system model of the coal sustainable development was created by using the tool of system dynamic. Then different development modes are sifted and sorted by utilizing fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model in group decision making in order to put forward the optimal development mode for the coal industry in inner mogolia. The results indicate that the sustainable development pattern is prior to other modes in terms of the financial, resources and overall environment efficiency, which is also the best mode of coal industry development in inner mogolia.

articleTitle: Extracting and cleaning data from semi-structure Chinese texts
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Data mining helps to uncover valuable information from raw data in large volume. However, the latter usually comes in text instead of structured form, and contains noise which makes analysis difficult. Therefore, it is of vital importance to extract and clean raw data before in-depth analysis are applied. This paper presents a new approach to data extraction and cleaning from semi-structured Chinese texts. Experimental results show that it can effectively prepare data for mining.

articleTitle: The model study of market friction based on idea of entropy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Market friction is an important factor of the study on market efficiency. The friction in physics produces entropy, and in the market model, market friction make an unstable state to generate entropy. We establish the market model and analyze this by multiple factors. Our model can effectively reflect the study results of market friction by other economists. Through the complex model, we get some results. The market friction may contribute to the optimization of local transactions. If there is no market frictions, the stock is equivalent to currency, and the sure market friction will make the consumption indifferent among different individuals. Lastly, we design some experiment models to study the friction more effectively and in depth.

articleTitle: Forcasting the precipitation in ShiJiaZhuang based on Grey Marcov model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Basing on the annul precipitation during 1955–2007 of shijiazhuang situated in Taihang Mountain Pedimount region, the Grey Marcov model was set up. Using the model and the data in 2007, The research forecasted the precipitation of 2008–2015. The result indicates: Grey Marcov model is better than GM(1, 1) on showing the dynamic of the list, and has more useful value; According of the biggest state transfer probability, the result of the Grey Marcov Model inosculated the precipitation in 2008 and 2009 which displayed the accuracy of the Grey Marcov Model.

articleTitle: Reorganization of assets to improve performance of the private economy? Based on the empirical data of listed companies on Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Hu
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, with a focus on specific types of businesses in a particular region, the performance was discussed before and after asset restructuring by building a theoretical model of private enterprise. The reorganization of assets 125 Intra Regional private listed companies was as samples in Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share market since 2001–2007, using factor analysis and multiple linear regressions, analysis of changes in private enterprise performance status before and after reorganization. The empirical results show that: Listed Private performance of corporate restructuring will be decreased significantly in the reorganization of the year, sustainability is obviously inadequate; on the same time, impact factors of transaction types, transaction sides relevance, ratio of the largest shareholders, equity balance degree are directly associated with the reorganization of performance. Finally, related measures improving the Intra Regional Comprehensive performance was proposed.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the manufacturing work process of logistics automation systems, new technology development of logistics automation systems project management and transformation become the focus of many manufacturing managers. This paper which uses the idea of project management, designs user management control systems of the palletizing robot project, and uses VC++ to simulate motion control system, and it is well controlled.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: SEO is a kind of search rule of the search engine, it is optimized by the structure, the key word, the title, links of the website and so on, and then improve the placing of the website in the rank of search engine, thereby let the users to find them quickly and improve the Visit Count of the website. Furthermore, the enterprise should improve the conversion rate of e-commerce site by optimizing the webpage.

articleTitle: Comparison between solar and GSHP scheme for hot water supplying
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of solar hot water systems and heat recovery ground source heat pump hot water system and comparation of energy consumption between two systems through a practical project. The heat recovery ground source heat pump hot water system is a reasonable scheme in NanJing for its energ efficient. It provide a basis for choosing hot water system.

articleTitle: The study of technology acceptance based on gender's differences in ERP implementation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the DAVIS TAM model, this paper studied the gender's differences at technology acceptance in ERP implementation. Through carried out the survey in two company which have implement ERP, the author found that male employee have more stronger perceptions in useful and usability in ERP implementation than female, while female have more higher perceptions in easily use in ERP implementation than male. This study indicated the differences of male and female in information technology acceptance and expanded the DAVIS technology acceptance model in ERP practical application. The research also gives an advice to enterprise human resources department that in some key positions, candidates need to be considered at their gender differences.

articleTitle: The research on open teaching model based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The open teaching method can not only help students achieve the knowledge construction on their own initiative, but also master the effective learning strategies as well as contribute to the development of their learning habit. The introduction of the engineering education concept of CDIO is quite helpful to overcome the drawbacks of the traditional open teaching. Taking the engineering education concept as the guiding principle, we can build an open teaching model with 4 layers, which is based on the four stages — conceiving, designing, implementing and operating. The application of this teaching model can promote the outcome of the open teaching method.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The research on network course evaluation of university based on fuzzy-AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The evaluation model and index system of university network course are established based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and analytic hierarchy process (AHP) in this paper. The feasibility is analyzed by the instance and the result shows that the evaluation model can give the scientific and reasonable evaluation for the network course. So it provides a certain reference for the evaluation of university network course.

articleTitle: Study of the impact of investor's mind on the financial asset short-term price behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Following other people's study, In this paper, we get a short-term price model of risk asset on the investor's maximize utility. Using this model to analyse the influence that the investor's foreground price expectation and foreground risk expectation and risk elusion degree to the short-term price of financial asset can get that the Investor's Mind has greatly influence to the short-term price of financial asset.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of personalized search model on user's interest
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The traditional information retrieval technology can not satisfy the personalized queries. To solve this problem, we have researched and improved the standard BP algorithm to find user's potential demands, and finally an improved BP neural network algorithm based on personalized search method is proposed. The experiment shows that the algorithm can effectively enhance BP algorithm convergent speed and avoid falling into local minimum, and significantly improve the recommendation quality of the personalization system.

articleTitle: An optimized grey model and its application in predicting thefinancial investment to science and technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The grey model GM (1, 1) is one of the important components in the grey systems theory system. According to the modeling mechanism of GM(1, 1) model, based on the analysis of the flaws of the existing grey model GM(1, 1) the method which consists of the most superior initial value, which is solved in the constraint that all components of GM(1, 1) modeling sequence X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(1)</sup> fit smallest error sum of squares and the optimized background value was proposed. The improvement of existing GM (1, 1) model was made. The novel GM (1, 1) was constructed and it was compared with the existing three kinds of GM (1, 1) models in the modeling precision. The research findings indicate: Compared with the existing GM (1, 1) models, the modeling precision (simulation precision and forecast precision) of the novel GM (1, 1) model is the highest.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic integration model of Guanxi resources in the entrepreneurial process based on Chinese Cultural context
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Since traditional research on the importance of Guanxi resources to the success of entrepreneurship is from the static point of view, this paper builds a dynamic integration model after redefining different types of entrepreneurial processes and Guanxi resources, which puts forward how to integrate relatives, acquaintance, favor and transaction relationship in four different entrepreneurial phases, namely opportunity identification, resources-obtaining, company survival and growth.

articleTitle: The research of tree crown volume's fractal characteristic based on three-dimensional laser scanning imaging system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The three-dimensional laser scanning technique is a new mapping technique which is another technological revolution followed by GPS in mapping area. The most feature of this technique is high-accuracy and high-speed and close to the original shape. So the three-dimensional laser scanning technique is a hot topic in mapping area at home and abroad because it breakthrough the traditional single-surveying method. This text according to acquire the standard tree data in Xiaolong mountain of GanSu Province by three-dimensional laser scanning imaging system, and collecting the data of tree crown volume and tree crown area. Meanwhile this text calculated the fractal dimension of tree crown volume, which their correlation coefficient are all over 0.8. The results showed that fractal dimension of tree crown volume in this area are between 1 and 3, and the fill degree of leaves first gradually show increasing along with the increase of the diameter then gradually depressed, which accord with the species' bionomics characteristic in that area.

articleTitle: Influence factor of China's export country distribution — The empirical study base on gravity model by panel data during 1997–2008
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper establishes a gravity model of trade by panel data such as China's export to its 25 primary international trade partners etc during 1997–2008. And the model embraces time trend variable which divides the samples into 12 groups. Through the empirical study we find that China's export country distribution per annum is impacted in various extent by China and its trade partner's GDP, China and its partner's GNP per capita, the great-circle distance between two countries' capital, FDI from partner to China, China's import from its partner, whether both the partner and China are APEC members, whether partner is China's important entrepot trade partner, whether trade partner is earlier member of related free trade agreements which China would sign in the later.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise happiness management based on Maslow's hierarchy theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Maslow's hierarchy theory reflects the essence of human nature and what meet human demand is the experienced process to obtain the sense of happiness. This article has been divided into three stages of happiness sense experience of every level by building gradient model between human demand level and acquired happiness sense. Establishing models of affecting different factors of happiness sense and proposing the assumption of “happy people” and management strategy of enhancing staff's happiness sense, we have also explored various factor and basic principle affecting happiness sense by making use of basic methods of systematic science.

articleTitle: Game model of vertical cooperative advertising under asymmetric channel power
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Channel power, as an important influence factor for the decision, behavior and benefits of the members in the supply chain affects the cooperation program. The paper establishes two different game models of cooperation advertising based on a variety of different channels power structure, it gets the equilibrium outcomes and compares the cooperation efficiency, the impact of parameters for profits and decision variable under two game models. The results demonstrate that, the cooperative advertising inputs of the manufacturer has positive correlation to its profits, the distributor's profits, and the cooperative advertising cost of the distributor. Whatever the channel structure is, cooperative advertising is marketing policy that is propitious to both members of the channel.

abstract: The FastICA algorithm and the natural gradient algorithm is widely used in blind signal separation, as the two more popular algorithms in the areas of the ICA, because they can find implicit in the observation data in the independent component. However, they each have drawback, such as, online data processing and mass data(such as image data)processing tasks, we need that FastICA algorithm is faster and more efficient; the same time we also hope that the nature gradient algorithm can not only deal with symmetric distribution of the signal, but also asymmetrical distribution of the signal. Therefore, this paper establishes a fifth-order convergence of the Newton iterative algorithm as a basis for improvement of the FastICA algorithm; farther more the paper also gives an improved natural gradient method which is used for symmetrical distribution of the signal and asymmetrical distribution of the signal.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Profit allocations in knowledge alliances is a critical factor which must be considered before alliances formation. This paper analyzes the characteristics of profit allocations in knowledge alliances from the two angles of intrinsic drivers of alliance formation and cooperative games. On this account, the paper provides two-person profit allocations model and multiplayer profit allocations model based on Nash bargaining solution, then deduces an formula of multiplayer profit allocations under the conditions that alliances partners have the same contribution to the alliances, and verifies the formula's effectiveness as an approximate solution, the result predicts that the approximate solution can be used as an effective solution to resolve multiplayer profit allocations.

The results showed that the level of regional coordinated development of four regions of Henan province improved significantly, but obvious regional differences existed, the average level of city group of central China, west Henan and southwest Henan were highest, then were Huang-Huai Region. We take the maximum loss of the investment as the measurement of risk, and construct a safety space for the risk-averse decision maker. In this bound, we obtain the optimal expected utility decision under a fixed risk-taking.

abstract: In connection with the problem of hull blocks virtual assembly sequence planning. Improved genetic algorithm is proposed to be applied. In connection with multi-layer assembly structure of hull blocks, Hierarchical optimization method is proposed to solve the problem. The optimal solution is always lost in the iteration process when Traditional genetic algorithm is applied, the problem could be solved through drawing the association diagram, generating the initial population, optimizing the initial population, and establishing adaptive function. Because of the slow convergence to traditional genetic algorithm, Boltzmann variational proportion is applied on the selectivity of reasonable control. It is verified through calculating example that the hull section virtual assembly sequence planning could be calculated on the method, and a range of relevant parameters are also obtained.

This structural trade financing model is concise, easy to operate, and will definitely meet the need of development of structured trade finance in the early stage of our economy.

The whole sale price is connected with the capital and the reserved profit of the retailer. By discussing the model, the optimal wholesale prices of the manufacturer are acquired when the retailer's reserved profit is zero or more than zero.

articleTitle: Study on the framework and implementation technology of information systems for Knowledge Alliance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: From three views of conceptual view, knowledge-related activity view and functional view of Knowledge Alliance Information Systems (KAIS), several models for understanding the concept of KAIS and its application structure are proposed. From the conceptual view, a T-type application model for KAIS is outlined, which illustrates the content, extension and the application goals of KAIS. From the knowledge-related activity view, a three-level model to describe the underlying logic among the activities of knowledge application, knowledge management and information processing is posed. From the functional view, core functions of KAIS and the key technologies for their implementation are described. This paper will be helpful in understanding the concept of KAIS and be beneficial in the process of designing the structure of KAIS systems in real applications.

abstract: It is important to establish a systematic and effective approach to evaluating funds for both the investors and the managers of funds. However, evaluation of funds involves with significant uncertainty associated with the experts' judgments. To deal with the problem, fuzzy set theory is employed to model experts' subjective judgment, based on which a fuzzy FWA method is formulated for the evaluation of funds by considering the risk, the profitability, the consistency and the fund manager's performance. abstract: The research of the efficiency of different market structures is a lasting topic for the theorists, and the answers to this problem are not as same as each other. This paper uses an extended Stackelberg model with multi-participator and multi-stage to analyze the choices of the leading company and the following companies in the dynamic game, and compares the optimal quantity, the price and the profit of each company. The result is that proper degree of industry concentration is desirable, and the market structure containing one leader and many followers is dominant for consumers and is efficient and stable.

Based on the description the modes, the entrepreneurship education goals and orientation, teaching staff, curriculum system, practice system, security system, evaluation system were analyzed. By building up and analyzing the enterprise's attitude evolutionary model, IS integration is useful to make enterprise employees take IS with a support attitude, and this positive temperament around enterprise facilitates the realization of IS value. So, IS integration is the sufficient and necessary condition of IS value realization.

articleTitle: Institutional quality and changing organization of international production networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: We construct a general contract model with continuous institutional quality from 0 to 1, which extend the normal GHM model by embedding institutional quality (reversible level of investment) into Nash bargaining and defining the residual claim rights as the control right over the assert produced by relational specific investment. Combining this model into Helpman — Krugman trade theory, we then assess the changing mechanism of trade to FDI and outsourcing under intra-product specialization. We find that: i) the scope and modes of international production are determined by tradeoff between transaction cost and producing cost under specific technology level. ii) Other things equal, the improvement of institutional quality in south will extend the scope of international production (especial in FDI modes) and upgrade the relative technology level of production there. iii) The relative technology progress in south will induce international intra-product specialization and production transfer, and changes the FDI mode into outsourcing.

articleTitle: A study of the reliability and its influencing factors of financial analyst's forecast
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The reliability of earnings forecasts could help investors make decisions. There are many factors which could affect the reliability of earnings forecasts. In this study, we test the of factors influence the reliability via regression model. The regression model shows that the forecasting error is related to the factors of motivation of earnings management, the foreseeable of earnings, the amount of agencies and auditing agencies; and the forecasting error is unrelated to the factors of earnings fluctuation and company size. The reliability of average which is affected by many influencing factor is distinct. The reliability would rise along with the development of the analyst profession.

articleTitle: Technology shocks and the dynamic response of labor employment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, we empirically investigate the dynamic effects of neutral & investment-specific technology shocks on labor employment in China. Under the assumption that investment-specific technology shock is the unique source of secular trend in relative price of investment goods, we find that labor employment increases (decreases) in response to a positive investment-specific (neutral) shock in an identified SVAR with long-run restriction. We argue that empirical results obtained in one-neutral-shock model do misrepresent the important short-run dynamics of employment to different technology shocks in the actual economy.

articleTitle: A quantile regression analysis of educational returns and income inequality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper starts from the methods of caculation and decompostion of Gini coefficient, in which we take urban pupulation as an increasing function of education, and analyzing the composition effect and compression effect of education on income inequality. We make a simulation of this model, using OLS and quantile regression method, and find that there is an inverse-U shape relationship between income inequality and education. We reckon that one cannot take education as a main cause of income disparity and income inequality, just because the educational returns of higher income group are larger than that of the lower income group. Our analysis focuses that, even if the income disparity between urban and rural keep expanding in the future, the improving of educational level will accelerate the transion of population which finaly reduce the urban-rural income inequality. In a word, the improving of educational level will finaly reduce the urban-rural income disparity and income inequality.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is of important significance in financial market risk analysis if we are required to study the relationship between the financial data. Aiming at this issue, modeling of several related structure functions (Copula) is analyzed and method is proposed on the dependence structure of portfolio in this paper. Results show that financial market risk with the traditional statistic analysis is estimated to be less than the risk related structure function. The t-Copula to the risk can describe comprehensive and the Clayton Copula to conservative type of investors is more applicable. The computational results on VaR supported the study conclusion.

articleTitle: Fuzzy optimization model for container shipping of sea-carriage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The optimization model of container shipping of sea-carriage based on fuzzy linear programming is established to maximize the profit of a shipping company. The objective function is to maximize the shipping profit. The variables include the number of heavy and empty containers shipped by lines, the shortage number of heavy containers and the renting number of empty containers from requiring ports. The constraints include meeting the need of heavy and empty containers required, weight and volume limit to lines and supplying ability for empty containers The number of empty containers supplied and storaged is fuzzy. The fuzzy programming is translated to an integer programming and Lingo 9.0 is used to solve the model. Simulation is done under varied parameters to show the effectiveness of the model to optimize the shipping plan. The model can be used to optimize container shipping plan of sea-carriage to a shipping company and raise its profit.

articleTitle: Regional effect of FDI inflow: Perspective from exchange rate fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article establishes the econometric model to analyze the regional effect of FDI inflow from the perspective of the exchange rate fluctuation. In general, FDI is thought as the composite bundle of capital stock, know-how and technology. Based on the econometric analysis, it could be inferred that the fluctuation of RMB exchange rate has the impact on the regional effect of China's FDI inflow besides the wealth and cost effect. The level of RMB REER show different effect on the inward FDI in different recipient area especially in Central China. Meanwhile the FDI inflow from different sources is also influenced by the RMB REER. Finally the policies regarding both exchange rate policy and FDI inflow utilization have been proposed.

By systematic analysis about impacting factors of low-carbon production level of Pb-Zn enterprise, an evaluation system of low-carbon production level of Pb-Zn enterprises was build based on the five dimensions — the resources and energy use, production technology features, utilization, pollutant emissions and low carbon concept. The model was established based on fuzzy mathematics and AHP. The effectiveness and practicality of evaluation index system and model were verified by the empirical study, so as to provide the theoretical support and methodological guidance for the decisions of Pb-Zn enterprises and government management.

articleTitle: SNN Neighbor and SNN Density-based co-location pattern discovery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Concerning co-location pattern mining research, the definition of co-location instance in classical algorithms is clique-based. Considering the drawbacks of this definition, this work proposes a novel definition: SNN Neighbor and SNN Density-based co-location instance. Then the paper illustrates the significance of this conception and a SNN Neighbor and SNN Density-based co-location pattern mining algorithm is realized. At last, a plenty of experimental results on synthetic and real data sets show this approach is correct and flexible, and can discovery more interesting patterns that clique-based methods fail to. Further more, our solution is faster and takes less memory consumption than traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Research on the methods of payment via the Internet and mobile phones
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Among the effective ways to improve competitiveness by operators are to cut the queuing time for users to pay in the business hall, to make payment convenient and to lower operating costs. Payment via the mobile phone or the Internet is realized by building up effective application software systems in the original billing platform and banking payment system, transferring funds from the currently — owned bank account to the e-purse for payment and coding and delivering the information of payment for users to inquire, check and confirm. Once users confirm the payment, funds in the e-purse will be transferred to operators' bank accounts, realizing the just-in-time payment. Only prompt report of loss of mobile phones would be needed to prevent users incurring further damages in case mobile phones are lost. Apart from being applied to the billing system, this method is being expanded into e-commerce projects.

articleTitle: Real-time interactive multimedia system scheduling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As most today's multimedia systems use multi-core processing platform, PFair and a range of algorithms developed from it can achieve good scheduling results for the frequent interactive task scheduling running on these systems. But, these algorithms don't care much about the processor assignment for different stages of the periodic tasks. It will lead to task migrations between multiple threads and add extra space and time overhead. In this paper, focus on the features of interactive periodic tasks system, we improved the basis PFair algorithm by adding the time frame control and changing the local periodic tasks scheduling to limit task migrations. It could improve efficiency of the system and ensured fairness at the same time.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to achieve a clear purpose of value chain model, we sort out a number of factors, such as its participants, structure and mechanism, which influence mobile e-commerce value chain. This study applies and extends the value chain theory of Porter, and reconstructs it into two parts, the basic value chain (the value chain to achieve the conditions of mobile commerce) and supporting value chain (the value chain of mobile commerce application from the processes from production to sales). We also construct the model for various parts of value chain and finally present and analyze the mode of value chain by using the example of mobile payment. At the end of the article, we combine the results and our real situation of mobile commerce applications and put forward a number of conclusions including various suggestions.

articleTitle: The study on the linkages between the stock index futures market and the stock index market: The empirical analysis of the HS300 index futures market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper, used the data of HS300 index and HS300 stock index futures, studies the linkages and interaction between the stock market and stock futures market in China, which is based on the VAR model, Vector error correction model, Johansen cointegration analysis, The Granger long and short causal relationship test and The Hasbrouck variance decomposition method. It is concluded that stock market has close relationship with stock futures market in the long term. The stock futures market also has good influence on the price discovery of the stock market. In the long run, the stock futures market would be the reason why the stock market changes and the stock market also would be the reason why the stock futures market changes. But the stock futures market has the greater influence on the stock market. Wish these conclusions have a great use for reference to the risk control of regulators and investors.

The merit is that describing the trend of the stock's closing price from intrinsic value and volume of the stock. Therefore, it avoids the non-measurability of other state variables and has more advantages to the application in practical stock market. Basing on Internet consumers' concerns about privacy violation, this paper establishes a structural equation model of the factors of Ecommerce usage which is testified through empirical research. Then we discuss the relationship of Internet industry self-regulation, concerns about government surveillance and concerns about privacy, and their effect on consumers' E-commerce usage.

In addition, the method for contextualization of assembly was proposed. Engineering application architecture of assembly context was given and a hierarchical model of it was established.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Most past studies on the urban-rural differences in consumption structure implicitly assumed that the urban-rural differences are self-evident, and, as a result, these researches are not founded on sound statistical basis. In light of this negligence, by putting dummy variables into a basic AIDS model and testing the significance of their coefficients, a t Test is performed in order to give a statistical conclusion as to whether there exist significant differences in consumption structure between urban and rural residents, which would be useful as reference for related researches. Results show that significant differences only exist in some types of expenditures.

Acquisition capability is regarded as a key factor to acquisition success, and composed of structure, process, learning, institution and team. Finally, future research suggestions about acquisition capability are brought up.

articleTitle: A Game Analysis on the cooperation strategy among Industry, University and Research Institute
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By the C-D function, Game model was constructed based on R&D investment-capital investment cooperation in Industry, University and Research Institute. Then R&D investment, capital investment and cooperation profit of three different cooperation strategies were comparatively analyzed Firstly it had found out that the proportion of cooperation profit of the University and Research Institute was so important that it could lead the semi-inner cooperation strategy to be fail or to be success. Secondly if the outer cooperation strategy was regarded as the limited case of the semi-inner cooperation strategy, it was also a special case of the inner cooperation strategy. If the outer cooperation strategy was regarded as the dynamical situation, its equilibrium was less than the inner cooperation strategy equilibrium Lastly that the inner cooperation strategy equilibrium had more pareto advantage than the equilibriums of the other two strategies had been proved So the inner cooperation strategy should be encouraged and the non-efficient semi-inner cooperation strategy should be regulated by our government

articleTitle: Trustworthy business process state space reducing by using time constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A business process definition method is given and a kind of dynamic semantics is appointed to this business process definition. The dynamic semantics is expressed as a finite state automata and can be used to analyze the trustworthiness of business processes. A state space reduction algorithm is proposed to solve the state space explosion problem which exists when there are a lot of concurrent activities in process model.

articleTitle: The evolution path and layer model of telecom network agent-based
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Telecom network is an open complex self-organized systems, Agent aggregation is the fundamental mode of the evolution of telecom networks. This paper analyzes the evolution of telecom networks with Homogeneous Agent aggregation and heterogeneous Agent aggregation. And according to the level of Agent aggregation, the evolution of the telecom network is divided into four levels, namely combining network layer, convergent network layer, harmonious network layer and chaotic network layer. Then, the evolutionary layer models of telecom network are built.

articleTitle: Research on the external performance evaluation of supply chain enterprises based on catastrophe progression method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In recent years, supply chain enterprises' performance has becoming the common concern of scholars. Supply chain enterprises' performance includes not only internal performance, but external performance. Under this background, this paper first chooses suitable economic indexes, then, establishes an index system of the external performance evaluation of supply chain enterprises; next, builds an external performance evaluation model by adopting catastrophe progression method of the catastrophe theory; at last, evaluates the external performance of the supply chain enterprises.

articleTitle: Explanation on “annuities puzzle”
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The traditional theory of annuity demand thought a life-cycle consumer who pursued the maximization of consumption utility should fully annuitize all of their savings. The phenomenon that their theoretic conclusion does not accord with the reality was called “annuities puzzle”. Establishing a savings expected utility model that involves term insurance, annuity and security, we discuss the optimal choice of saving behavior of expected utility maximizers. We demonstrate that people without a bequest motive annuitize all savings if the annuities available are actuarially fair. If the annuities available are loading and there is no long-lived gain, or there is a bequest motive, full annuitization is not optimal. The conclusion then explains the “annuities puzzle”.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A 5.8ppm/°C bandgap reference with a preregulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A voltage reference is introduced in 0.5μm BiCMOS technology in this paper. With curvature compensation, a low offset operational amplifier and a temperature-compensated preregulator, the temperature coefficient of the reference has achieved 5.8ppm/°C from −55°C to 125°C. The preregulator also reduces the power supply dependence of the reference. The reference's PSRR at DC is 92dB.

articleTitle: A methodology for domain ontology construction in information science
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Domain ontologies have been widely acknowledged as fundamental in supporting knowledge-based applications. To reduce the bottleneck of knowledge acquisition in the construction of domain ontologies text mining techniques have been used. This paper proposes a methodology for building domain ontology for information science through extraction of knowledge from related literature and thesaurus. It involves collecting domain-related vocabularies, developing the domain concept hierarchy, and defining the properties and relationships between concepts. The core concepts in information science are selected by applying social network theory and the relationships between concepts are discovered by hierarchical clustering method. Our methodology can be applied to other domain ontologies, such as computer science and management science.

articleTitle: How to improve the teacher-students' educational technique ability in the information society
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the deepening and expanding of various methods of information dissemination in the field of education, educational technology of teachers has received more and more attention. Teacher-students are reserve personnel and reinforcements, whose educational technology will have a critical impact on teachers' professional quality and the development of education. At first, this paper analyzes the problems about the training of teacher-students in education technology, then introduce solutions to the problems targeted.

articleTitle: A new method of phase uniformity correction in multi-channel receivers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to enhance the performance of multi-channel systems, a new method for phase uniformity correction is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the phase variances among each channel can be regulated roughly by a single inductor is introduced, and then a more precise method is proposed by adjusting the varactors of 90/180 degree phase shifters assisted by a Phase Locked Loop (PLL). The analysis proves that the later accurate phase adjusting method can achieve zero-degree phase error among channels of a multi-channel system. How to propose phase correction procedure in an application design of a multi-channel super-heterodyne receiver for adaptive phase adjusting is described in details.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation of knowledge spillovers in the Triple Helix innovative mode — A case study of “3-zone interaction” in Dalian
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to evalue the effectiveness of the university-based knowledge spillovers in the Triple Helix innovative mode of university-industry-government relations. The data of industrial enterprises of Dalian High-Tech Industrial Park, R&D zone and Dalian University of Technology from 1999 to 2009 was analyzed. Then, based on the improved knowledge production function, the estimation was made using OLS as well as 2SLS regression. The results proved the hypothesis, which is the regional innovative system can benefit from university-based knowledge spillovers, especially from the tacit knowledge spillovers embedded in the higher skilled labor. The dual-cooperation between enterprises and government is not an effective institutional arrangement compared with the Triple Helix mode. A new model describing the knowledge spillover effects in the regional level was proposed and the empirical analysis confirmed its validity.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of training system for Engineers' automatic Engine Room Control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to the requirements of the World Maritime Organization STCW Convention, the training of seamen for practical operation was strengthened. Access with VISUAL BASIC and database technology, we developed a simulation system for Engineers' Automatic Engine Room Control training. In the teaching process, teachers use pictures, animation-based video and multimedia PPT presentations as the main teaching material, and students can review by themselves with the help of this software. This system not only reduces the workload of teachers, but also overcome the lack of equipment. And the system significantly improved the efficiency of their learning.

Author Keywords: the training of seamen for practical operation

articleTitle: A process-oriented perspective on realization of IT business value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Information technology (IT) is a driver and enabler of change, which business value is achieved by process change, but literatures about IT business value creating have been largely confined to economical level, industry level, and firm level. Disquisitions on mechanism of IT business value are scarcely, especially form process perspective, which hampers our further explore the process of IT value creating. The current work focuses on informational effects of IT from a process-based perspective, and there are three informational effects of IT as follow, from low to high level, automatization of organizational routine, digitalization of process artifact, and innovation of process intelligence. These effects improve firm's performance and create IT business value by upgrading management processes capabilities and business processes capabilities.

articleTitle: User interest discovery based on Web Usage Mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to the user's access sequence, whether clustering can extracte the effectively user's interest model is closely related to the algorithm of identifying user's access affairs and clustering. This paper fully consider the impact on user interest mining of the topology and order of web papers. So, this paper advanced AER algorithm, new similarity formula and FCR algorithm. Finally, this paper tested and verified the AER algorithm and FCR algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of the international entrepreneurship of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises in He'nan province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Modeling the management system of coal miner's unsafe behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The coal miner's unsafe behavior is regarded as the most fundamental reason for coalmine accidents took place frequently in China. By dividing coal miner's behavior into three stages of task selection, action pattern selection and practical action, the generating process of coal miner's unsafe behavior was analyzed, and the performance type of coal miner's unsafe behavior was revealed. By regarding management behavior as two parts of designing behavior and managing behavior, the relationship between management behavior and miner's unsafe behavior was analyzed. On this basis, the process and the numbers of coal miner's unsafe behavior during a certain period were described, and the management system model of coal miner's unsafe behavior was constructed. It provides the precondition of further research on the effectiveness of different management behavior, and coalmine safety management system.

articleTitle: Design of integrated cost and contract management information systems for mega project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This research designs a concept of integrated cost control, contract management and information collaboration in the Project Management Information System (PMIS), based on the EXPO 2010 Shanghai construction project. In our model, the “Basic Unit of Public Information (BUPI)” and “Contract Control Unit (CCU)” are originally discussed to create the relationship between the cost control and the contract management, and to meet various demands from project managers and owners in mega projects. A static framework in the context of web-based project information platform is introduced later to examine this concept, where different information of project level, contract level, and CCU level can be shared and integrated effectively. This research initially bridges the gaps between the cost control and contract management especially for mega project in the construction industry, and the result can be applied in both academic and practical fields.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: An equilibrium analysis of software damages in end-users group infringement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Preventing the group infringement of software endusers has great significance in improving knowledge management and realizing the knowledge assets' value. And damages system is important measures of preventing the group infringement. This paper analyzes the characteristic and equilibrium condition of compensation of software end-users group infringement based on the theory of equilibrium in economics. Then an equilibrium model of determining software damages in end-users group infringement is put forward. At last, this paper makes an empirical analysis by using a practical case. This paper suggests that we should consider the balance of interests between the owner of software and the software end-users. The software endusers in group infringement are usually at large, and punitive damages for software end-users should be applied in more cases. This paper also suggests that several factors should be considered when determining damages including the profit of the owner of software, network externalities of software, the probability of detecting the software end-users infringement, the probability of bearing liability if detecting infringement, the number of the software end-users, and the number of the consumers buying authorised software.

articleTitle: The efficiency evaluation of traditional industries from the perspective of industrial transformation based on DEA — Case study of Taicang, Jiangsu
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The traditional industry is a basic industry of Taicang city, therefore in the process of industrial transformation and upgrading, we should attach great importance to the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries. In this paper, we select 18 industries from the industrial enterprises above the designated scale of Taicang city in 2009 as a representative of the traditional industries, and select seven input and output indicators, such as the net fixed assets, industrial output, then use DEA model to evaluate the input and output efficiency and scale efficiency of traditional industries. The results show that the traditional industrial sectors of Taicang city are different not only in size but also in technical efficiency. The overall efficiency of the traditional industrial sector is not high, and the task of restructuring and upgrading is arduous.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The core competence of enterprise: Facing the economic fluctuation

articleTitle: Economic impact of 2010 World Expo on Shanghai based on VAR model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the impact of 2010 World Expo on the economic growth of Shanghai via a dynamic VAR model. In this model we take the fixed assets investment, new employment population, new tourist income as influence variables, and take GDP (Gross Domestic Product) and House Hold Consumption as influence object. By establishing VAR model (Vector Autoregressive Model) and utilizing impulse response analysis, we investigate the persistent influence of 2010 World Expo to economic aggregate and House Hold Consumption of Shanghai. Finally, we adopt variance decomposition analytical method to describe the impact on tourism demand of each variable. Our findings indicate that the World Expo contributes much to GDP and House Hold Consumption of Shanghai after 10 quarters, with the contribution degrees of 7.46% and 18.4% respectively.

articleTitle: The construction of 3D model of safty culture system in CNPC's oil factories
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: CNPC (China National Petroleum Corporation) makes safety engineering and management to be the most important thing to do according to the requirements of China's State Council. It is never being ignored to carry on HSE system strictly and deeply in the oil factories, the oil production units. The oil factories abide by the top-shaped framework to construct the safety culture system. The model is proposed from three dimensions such as better leaders, line liabilities and regional management. Finally, the tactics and measures to implement 3D model are discussed to ensure the safety production in oil factories.

articleTitle: Research of a new digital campus supported by synergistic learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Nowadays, information technology has emerged much many new features, for example, mobile learning, micro learning, synergistic learning and so on. Focusing on these new features, this paper discussed how to construct a digital campus to fit to these new features of IT, which mainly include Synergistic Learning and its implemental methods (scripts and enabled technology), micro and mobile learning, ubiquitous learning and so on.

articleTitle: The total factor productivity growth decomposition of agricultural production in east regions: Based on panel data of 2000∼2007
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper analyses the total factor productivity growth decomposition of agricultural production in east regions of 2000–2007 with stochastic frontier production function approach, split total factor productivity changes into 4 components: technical Progress, technical efficiency change, scale efficiency, allocative inefficiency. The result shows: rate of total factor productivity increase is 7.09% on average in 2000–2007 of east agricultural production, The influence on increasing in total factor productivity is mainly technical progress, allocative inefficiency and scale efficiency. The technical progress is the main motive force, accounts for 103.41% on average, scale efficiency accounts for 7.56%, the change of technical efficiency is the downward trend, accounts for 1.55% the influence of resource distribution is reverse, accounts for 9.42% on average. Improving the agricultural production technology efficiency level in the east, need to popularize agriculture's new variety and new technology, adjust resource allocative structure.

articleTitle: The development path of low carbon industrial clusters in China based on green supply chain management model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The effective way to tackle climate change and realize sustainable development is developing low carbon economy. It is well known that low carbon industrial clusters are counted as the crucial part with significant impact on the low carbon industries' international competitiveness and boosting low carbon economy. The paper starts with the inner link between low carbon industrial clusters and green supply chain, introduces a green supply chain management model of low carbon industrial clusters with specific instructions according to the current situation and existing problems of industrial clusters in China. In the end, the development path of low carbon industrial clusters from three layers is put forward based on the result of analysis.

articleTitle: Research on security management system PRS-ISMCS of information system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Security issues of information system is becoming increasingly important as information is a kind of critical asset and the normal operating of information must be built on secure information system. In this paper, elements of information security risks and their relationships are analyzed and the three-dimensional security system model PRS-ISMCS and improved management process PRS-PDCA of information system are built from such views as process controlling, resource protecting of information system, and security objectives based on the characteristics of information system.

articleTitle: Research on regulations for the price level of highway toll
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article is based on the natural monopoly attribute of highway industry and clears the necessity, goals and benefits of regulatory constraints on the price level of highway toll firstly. Secondly, after comparing monopoly price, marginal cost and average cost, those are three main methodologies for price regulation, the most reasonable means to determine the regulatory price level is put forth. Thirdly, by drawing lessons from implementing state regulations of the developed countries on the natural monopoly industries, our country's price level model of highway toll is built.

Author Keywords: the price level of highway toll

articleTitle: Industry Remedy mechanism for anti-dumping measures: Based on two-period duopoly game model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Industry remedy effects for anti-dumping measures are the result of interest game between importing and exporting countries. Anti-dumping measures take impact on domestic and foreign industries by changing the strategy decision of the enterprises, in order to. Then a two-period duopoly game model is established so as to analyze the economic effects on import and export countries' industry of antidumping, and the mechanism of industry remedy effects for anti-dumping measures is clarified from the economic theory.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of multi-dimension factors on store price image
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Store price image is becoming the key of prevailing market of retailing. By systemized the world-wide achievements, the thesis brings up the four-dimension factors of the price level, cost performance, price promotion and price fairness in store price image. By means of the explorative factor analysis, the thesis constructed the price image model and demonstrated it. It is tested that the four-dimension is provided with good reliability and validity, and retailer should enhance the whole price image based on it.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Does flight exist in stock, Treasury bond and corporate bond markets? — Empirically study based on security market in China

articleTitle: Research on the critical factors affecting a buying organization's adoption of the B2B electronic marketplace
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A B2B electronic marketplace (e-marketplace) can theoretically create much business value, but the realization of this value depends on its successful adoption. Since the adoption of the e-marketplace involves multiple aspects, it is necessary to explore a set of critical factors that determine the adoption decision. This research proposes such a set of factors from both transactional and relational perspectives in the position of buying organizations. By a Delphi study, this research identifies perceived benefits, readiness to adopt, network effects of the e-marketplace, inter-organizational trust, and perceived pressure as the critical factors.

articleTitle: Improve the ability of businesses to realize energy-saving and emission-reduction by the application of system integration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Due to the exhaustion of global resources and its conflict with ecological environment, businesses, as the main consumer of resources, should have made good use of information resources management technique to realize energy saving and emission reduction. However, the embedded-in development mode, the mode taken by Chinese businesses in the application of information system, makes it difficult for information systems from different stages to be integrated to each other. This paper, based on the concept of SOA information system integration and corresponding to the application status of information systems in manufacturing industry, puts forward technique strategies for system integration.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Analysis of theory and practice of network course construction and application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a new type of teaching mode, network course is fusing with computer network technology, multimedia technology and specialty course organically. It plays an assignable role in modern teaching under network circumstance. Teaching-training is the main approach to promote teaching-training informationization. Based on the aim and theory of network course construction and application, this paper analyses the practice of construction and application of network course, and also discusses how the instructors give play to strong points to network circumstance, optimize teaching process of each specialty and explore the new type of teaching mode for each course.

articleTitle: An interval multiobject assignment method based on decision-maker's risk attitude
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to propose a new method for solving the multiobject assignment problem with interval numbers. In the method, firstly, risk attitude parameter is employed to represent the decision-maker's (DM's) risk attitude in uncertain environment. Secondly, interval numbers are transformed into crisp values using interval mapping function based on the risk attitude parameter, and the assignment problem with interval numbers is transferred into the traditional assignment problem, which can be solved using Hungary algorithm. Furthermore, the situations that the number of persons is not equal to the number of jobs are also considered in this paper. Moreover, the steps of method for solving the multiobject assignment problem with interval numbers are given. Finally, the feasibility and validity of proposed method are illustrated by a practical example.

articleTitle: Research on stock's trend after raising limit based on multi-level association rule
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Stocks transaction accumulated a large number of history data. Analyzing these data and finding out correlations is very important for investors to make policy. It can avoid operating blindly. China adopts raising limit policy based on immaturity of China stock market. These artificial limits send a massage to investors that raising limit is connected with trend in days to come. This paper analyses stock's data after raising limit and find out the correlations of raising limit with trend in days to come using multi-level association rule. Also make invest proposal to stock of raising limit.

articleTitle: Research on the theoritical boundary of the business model concept
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The conceptualization of the business model has plunged into a dilemma of no consensus on its concept for a long time. In order to establish a distinct business model construct for further empirical study, this thesis elaborately explores its boundary, and finds that in essence it is a kind of value-creating mechanism constructed by a series of variables with causal correlations rather than a lot of complementary, parallel ones.

articleTitle: Study on half-loose mode dominanted by mobile communication network for regional teaching research of rural teachers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By means of the achievement of informationization construction in Modern Distance Education Project in Rural Primary and Middle Schools, web-based regional teaching research has become a widely adopted teaching research form for rural teachers to improve their professional ability. Compared with computer network, mobile communication network has obvious advantages of time and space span. Half-loose mode dominated by mobile communication network for regional teaching research can make effective use of rural teachers' fragmentary time for study, impel them to build learning team with long-term participation stickiness, help problem-solving originated from teaching situation, stimulate reflection and interaction on deeper level, and promote teachers' professional development. All these supply beneficial experiments for proportionally improving the levels of teaching research for rural teachers in the new situation.
