publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Dynamic fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of construction project management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The construction period of large projects is usually quite long, so only assessing the final effects is far from enough. This brings up the study of the dynamic effectiveness evaluation of project management. Introducing the theory of dynamic evaluation, this paper has established the dynamic effectiveness evaluation model for it. A dynamic fuzzy evaluation method is adopted to carry out to evaluate the effect of the project management at during different period. Besides, the result is compared with that of dynamic weighting method.

articleTitle: A quotient space reduction for large-scale support vector machine datasets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Againsting the low efficiency of training on large-scale support vector machine, use quotient space method to deduce a new sample reduction method, quotient space reduction(QSR). Unlike the traditional reduction methods, QSR brings the concept of “Granularity” into reduction method. It has two stages: CGR and FGR. In CGR, use KDC reduction to build the quotient space of original problem set with coarse grain-size. In FGR, build another quotient space with more fine grain-size. By changing the reduced intensity according to the number of redundant points remained, QSR gives a higher compression ratio and accuracy. Apply the new method to the large scale SVM social spam detection model. The detection model speed up obviously.

articleTitle: The effect factor on cash investment of non-financial listed company in USA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to investment method, this paper investigates investment in four parts: cash outflows direct investment, cash inflow direct investment, and cash outflows indirect investment and cash inflow indirect investment. This paper uses four indexes as proxy variable to describe the expansion and contraction of the cash flows of investment. Furthermore, the author studies the influence factors of the public company investment lagging autoregressive distribution model. The empirical research shows that the internal and external factors have different functions, in the investment decision-making.

articleTitle: A research of the adoption of innovation diffusion model on the ICT companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: ITU(ITU, 2004) said that in 2000, the market size of ICT industry had occupied 6.4% of the global GDP. And one of its important report showed that ICT industry contribute most to the prosperity of world economy. It also considered that innovation is the key point of ICT industry. While, there are more and more scholars attaching importance to the innovation diffusion model because of its great value to the economy. So many scholars and experts studied about product/service innovation diffusion of ICT companies and had put forward some classical research methods and diffusion models. Different from the former researches, this paper mainly discussed some of the most popular diffusion model's fitness in different ICT companies.

articleTitle: Study on the simulated reinforcing bar test system suited to web teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the multimedia tools of Flash MX, AutoCAD Photoshop7.0, it is possible to obtain the simulated multimedia test teaching system of reinforcing bar tests in this paper. According to the reinforcement theory and the calculating methods, depending on the large test data base, the test methods, the test steps and the test phenomenon have been reached in the system. At the end of the simulated test the qualification of the reinforcing bars is judged based on the proper GB. There are six modules in the simulated multimedia reinforcement test teaching system, which is the main menu module, the reinforcement choice module, the parameter calculation module, strength judge module, the demonstration test display module and the conclusion presentation module. Because of the simulation, the interaction and the repetition, the simulated multimedia reinforcing bar test teaching system can not only be helpful to the classroom teaching, but also can be used in web teaching, which can meet the various requirements of personnel training.

articleTitle: A note on the Lucas imperfect-information model: Linear projection and the normality of the variables
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The Lucas imperfect-information model is still one of the main macroeconomic theories investigating the microeconomic foundations of sluggish adjustment of nominal wages and prices. This paper derived the rational expectations of the relative prices of the individual producers in Romer's approach of the model by the method of linear projection, and show that the normality assumptions on the variables of the Lucas Model is not necessary, the independence assumptions between the variables can be relaxed by the non-correlationships. Finally, we argued that the linear projection is a more natural way for the forecast of the economic agents.

articleTitle: Synergy-Field theory: Research on transformation dynamic of E-commerce systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The measurement and assessment of the complication of E-Business System's evolution is a challenging project for the researchers. By introducing field theory in natural science into the study of E-Business System, this paper puts forward the theoretical framework of “Synergy-Field”. It reveals the process and level of the transformation of E-Business System and makes judgment and prediction of the status and direction of the system's cooperation according to the quantization description of E-Business System Synergy-Field. On the basis of dynamics, the paper constructs the cooperative field equations for Synergy-Field and further completes the design of the theoretical structure of the cooperative field. Therefore, the quantitative expression of the endogenous disturbance and exogenous disturbance, and the long-term and short-term responses to the disturbance could be contained in a unified theoretical paradigm.

articleTitle: Design of electronic seal system based on PKI
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To ensure the integrity and non-repudiation of electronic documents received or sent by e-government affairs and protects their confidentially and effectiveness in transmission, this paper presents a solution for the electronic seal system based on PKI security system with a core of CA, and detailedly designs every module of the electronic seal system. It can resolve the safety problem of electronic document's stamp and signature, and assures the authenticity and reliability of electronic documents.

articleTitle: Application of IPTV based on digital learning environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a new media, IPTV has brought new development impetus and ways of thinking to the modern education. With the development of information and the integration of media, it has great practical significance and research value to build a digital learning environment based on the IPTV. This research builds an open digital learning environment by making good use of the advantages and interactive function of IPTV and combining the practical situation of video teaching, based on the analysis of current digital learning environment, in order to adapt the changes in the information age. With the wealth of educational programme and the development of video coding technology, IPTV will play a greater role in the future.

articleTitle: The empirical study of Shandong's home appliance manufacturing industrial cluster based on complex networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In recent years, home appliance manufacturing industry has become one of the pillar industries in Shandong Province. However, due to the declining corporate profits, home appliance industry has transferred to other provinces that have more favorable policies and better supporting conditions. And that make its leading-edge gradually weakened in china. This paper acquires dates of the home appliance manufacturing and related business over decades years from Shandong Statistical Yearbook, applying complex network theory and Pajek software to carry out the research on home appliance industry with characteristics of mathematics and statistics such as distribution, the average path Length and aggregation coefficient. This paper gave an explanation on how to reach the higher evolution with the effect of inclusive and outside environment. It can give much more theoretic support for the development of home appliance industry and also has some referential value in guiding the practice of regional industrial development. In addition, positive analyses through web survey research prove that the research results are basically the same as actual situation. This actually has some referential value to the development of Shandong Province's home appliance industry chain.

abstract: The 1990s consensus among labor economists is that skill-biased technological change labeled the wide use of computers and IT since late 1970s, lifted up the demand for skilled workers so as to increase the college premium, i.e., wage inequality between different educated groups. However, 1990s consensus is not consistent with the fact that college premium declined in some decades. Challenging the pessimistic 1990s consensus, this paper develops a long run evolution model that captures the influence of skill-biased technological change on the wage inequality. The proposed dynamical model, in which both of the technological change and wage inequality are endogenous, indicates that considering the education efficiency, skill-biased technological change would increase the wage inequality in the short run, while the wage inequality would decline finally in the long term, if the efficiency of education system is at an appropriate level.

articleTitle: Research on position conflict of customer order decoupling point for instant customerization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Preprocessing method of personalized need for instant customerization is proposed. Method about quantization tolerance relation and average normalization is used to deal with personalized need information. Fuzzy C-value cluster method is used to cluster personalized need information. Grey prediction theory is used to predict the need trend of client base. Detection method of position conflict for customer order decoupling point (CODP) in instant customerization is proposed based on fuzzy constraint theory. Constraints set of CODP position is expressed using fuzzy constraint and fuzzy constraint net is constructed. Fuzzy constraint satisfaction problems are decomposed into common constraint satisfaction problems. Interval propagation algorithm is used to resolve constraint net. Resolution method of position conflict for CODP in instant customerization is proposed based on game theory. Conflict negotiation goal is set up using value-engineering method and the model with multi-goal cooperative games is set up. Conflict negotiation model is set up according to the solution of cooperative games model. Bayesian decision method is used to determine concessive value and conflict is negotiated based on adjustment of satisfaction degree.

abstract: This paper studies a three-stage stackelberg game of seller and the auction house in a sealed-bid auction model with two parameters of a reserve price and a commission rate. We discuss two kinds of models. In the model one, the auction house is the leader and seller is the follower; in model two, seller is the leader and the auction house is the follower. We get the revenues of both seller and the auction house and then obtain the optimal reserve price set by the seller and the optimal commission rate set by the auction house for the two models. Finally, we conclude that the Pre-emptive strategy is the best strategy for the seller and the auction house for the two models and that the model two is a win-win model for the seller and the auction house since the revenues of both the seller and the auction house are more than that in the model one, respectively.

The approximate substitute for the original model is also called response surface (RS). After analyzing the drawbacks of the existing response surface methods, propose an adaptive regressive polynomial response surfaces method using quadratic functions with domain decomposition. During the iteration for updating RS set through Latin hypercube testing, the roughest cells are selected and split along the roughest dimension direction to decompose the domain. After the RS set is accurate enough according to some criteria, the domain combination process is executed to unite the adjacent cells so that the number of the response surfaces in the RS set can be eliminated while keeping the given accuracy.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In recent years, more fierce competition in telecommunication industry and fast development of mobile Internet value-added services result in continuing declination of market shares of China Telecom, which takes fixed telephone and little smart system as primary businesses. It is necessary for China Telecom to apply data mining tools to predict customer churn so as to raise the pertinence of customer marketing decision. This paper takes E9 Package project of China Telecom as an example and builds an improved customer churn prediction model based on CRISP_DM. The result shows that modeling on C5.0 algorithms with the condition of considering fault classification loss has lower utilization cost and higher prediction effect, comparing with CART algorithms.

articleTitle: Spatial density distribution computing and disposal site selection optimizing of garden-wastes in the urban area of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) of vegetation cover on study area is computed based on Remote Sensing (RS) images, and then it is used as a weight number to calculate spatial density distribution (SDD) of garden-wastes according to the amount of wastes resources. Spatial analysis functions of geographic information system (GIS) are adopted to treat quantitative analysis on site selection of both centralized disposal sites and local disposal sites based on the SDD. In the analysis process, both location-allocation modeling and service area modeling are referenced. Research result can provide necessary information for the site selection and administrative decision, which is critical to effective utilization of waste resources.

articleTitle: Intellectual property, self-protection and innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper builds a model with self-protection and product differentiation parameters to study the problem whether the firms' self-protection can substitute the intellectual property protection system. The main result is that the firms' self-protection can substitute the intellectual property protection system to some extent. The firm's self-protection could be improved with the reduction of intellectual property protection. While the level of self-protection achieves a very high standard, it will bring the adverse effect on innovation and production. On the other hand, the existence of product differentiation can reduce the level of self-protection. Therefore the firms' self-protection measure is a reasonable supplement to the nation's intellectual property protection.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper combines the customer profitability analysis model and RAROC model to establish customer relationship loan pricing model based on RAROC. This model herits the advantage of RAROC model, such as risk management, capital allocation, measurement performance and value management etc. It combines the conception of revenue contribution in customer profitability analysis model with the conception of risk contribution in RAROC model. This overwhelms the limitation of Customer profitability analysis model which can only be used when bank and customer have long time business cooperation relationship.

articleTitle: Regional industrial structure optimization model for the cooperative game
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Optimization of regional industrial structure is an in important matter for the macroeconomic. Affter analyzing the impact factors of regional industrial structure optimization, cooperative game theory is utilized to establish the optimization model of regional industrial in this paper. In the end, the players correspond to the different industries, strategies set to different combinations of industries and the utility function of each industry to the composite function of the proportion of added value, labor productivity and environmental pollution. Then Shapley value algorithm is introduced to seek out the core point. A numerial example for Kunming is presented to demonstrate the feasibility and effetiveness of the model.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the tourism e-commerce rising in the global, people's demand for online tourism information and business is increasing. More and more various types of tourism websites are appearing, and competition among them is stronger. Hence, how to improve the competitiveness of tourism websites is an urgent problem. Based on the past researches on the competitiveness of tourism websites, after considering tourism websites' characters and the business requirements, three evaluation indexes of website design, information setting and effect are chosen to evaluate the competitiveness of tourism websites. When the evaluation indexes are determined, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method is used to calculate the index weight, and then the ranking list of the competitiveness evaluation of some tourism websites in China is obtained.

articleTitle: Evaluation model for the location of residential real estate development based on rough set
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Utilizing the fundaments of attribute reduction of rough sets theory, a kind of computational method for evaluating indicator weight of the locations of residential real estate development is introduced. Combining the subjective weight and objective weight, a kind of synthetical judgment model for the locations of residential real estate development which is based on rough sets theory is established so that the evaluation results are more scientific and objective. Finally the usability for this method is verified through living examples.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between knowledge-creating leadership behavior and the performance of team innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the basis of literature review, a hypothetical model on the relationships between knowledge-creating leadership behavior and the performance of team innovation was brought forward and then the model was tested by means of a questionnaire survey (608 valid stylebooks were obtained). The results show that knowledge-creating leadership behavior plays a positive role in the performance of team innovation.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, the originality of the Internet of Things (IoT) is introduced. Then the different visions are discussed. After this, the technologies and applications are analyzed. Based on these, the issues are displayed. In the end, the conclusions are drawn; we should utilize IoT while we must try hard to find the solutions to the issues.

articleTitle: Drivers and barriers in the acceptance of mobile payment in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Integrating the prospective user's cost and perceived risk with Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), we propose a research model and collect data by survey to investigate the determinants of the mobile payment acceptance in China. By revising the hypothesized model based on the data analysis by SPSS and AMOS, it is tested empirically that in the user's acceptance of mobile payment, performance expectancy and social influence are the drivers, whereas cost and perceived risks are the barriers. The findings of this study have a number of important implications to both researchers and the mobile payment service providers.

Author Keywords: Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT)

articleTitle: Evaluation on security system of internet of things based on Fuzzy-AHP method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is the third wave of IT revolution after the computer revolution and the Internet revolution. This paper discusses the current development of IoT and its related technologies and applications, focusing on the security of the IoT. We propose a four-level security index system based on the three-level architecture of the IoT. FAHP method is used to evaluate the various indicators and to find the key indicators as the key to the IoT security development. We also offer some recommendations on IoT development at the end.

articleTitle: Overview and analysis of cloud computing research and application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: After the concept of Cloud computing-the Revolutionary development and progress in IT industry — was born in Google, the IT software and services vendors, universities, enterprises, etc, join in the process of research and application of cloud computing. This paper firstly aims to the current cloud computing research and application and analyzes the characteristic of cloud computing. The powerful cloud computing ability helps the enterprises adopt IT ERP software and reduce cost and investment in hardware-software. Then mainly focuses on the software as a services (SaaS), platform as a services (PaaS) and infrastructure as a services (IaaS) that cloud computing-based on. Software on-demand changes the pure SaaS model to PaaS/IaaS. Pay-Per-use and on-demand is the megatrends in the future software model, especial ERP software model.

articleTitle: Factors influencing the adoption of e-government in Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Governments around the world are working continuously in order to improve services for their citizens. However, the success of these initiatives is dependent not only on the government support but also on the citizens' willingness to use these services. To implement e-government successfully, it is important to determine the factors related to its adoption. This paper examines the factors influencing adoption of e-government services by the Pakistani citizens. Factors that have been explored in the extant literature present inadequate understanding of the relationship that exists between ‘adopter characteristics’ and ‘behavioral intention’ to use e-government services. These inadequacies have been identified through a systematic and thorough review of empirical studies and also by conducting expert reviews from the government officials, software engineers and academic researchers to get their perception according to the context of Pakistan. On the basis of thorough review of literature and expert reviews conducted, an integrated conceptual model is developed and proposed by integrating the influential factors which have been highlighted by the various researchers into a single comprehensive model. In this context, this paper describes and tracks in a fruitful way the factors related to the adoption of e-government services and also proposes conceptual model according to the context of Pakistan.

Author Keywords: DeLone and McLean IS success model (D&M)

articleTitle: Study on an interoperable cloud framework for e-Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As technologies like virtualization and cloud computing assume important places within the IT landscape, in this paper, we firstly introduce the current situation of e-Education in China, then present the interoperable cloud framework using open source software for e-Education public service platform, at last make proposals of the integration and interoperation standards roadmap of educational cloud and service. Our aim is to provide open standards-based cloud services for e-Learning and e-Research and e2-Govement, building the cloud computing-based e-Education services environment.

articleTitle: A study of online virtual fitting room adoption based on UTAUT
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: User acceptance is one of the key fundamentals for development and success of virtual fitting room. This paper integrates the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology(UTAUT) model and perceived risk into a comprehensive model of online virtual fitting room adoption. To empirically test the model a survey is administered to 226 online virtual fitting room users. Structural equation modeling(SEM) is used to evaluate relationships between these concepts and intention to use. Results indicate performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence and perceived risk all have a significant impact on online virtual fitting room intention. Security concerns and privacy concerns were shown to significantly influence perceived risk. Implications for research and practice are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on AJAX technology application in web development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The Internet site now is on the way to open, writeable, multimedia interactive platform, so as to adapt to the individual users' requirements of gradual high interaction. In order to meet this demand, AJAX (Asynchronous Javascript and XML) as a Web presentation layer technology, can build quick, flexible and dynamic Web applications. AJAX combines the techniques on CSS, javascript XHTML, XMLHTTP, DOM and so on, meets the construction techniques of the application based on Web, and solves the problem of server load heavy and slow pages load, creates more efficient and dynamic Web user interface close to the local desktop application. The paper introduces the Web application structure framework based on AJAX, describes the basic work mechanism of AJAX, with the record on system development of AJAX network model of state power plant boiler parts, provides a good solution for constructing Web application of high user experience.

articleTitle: A new optimization algorithm based on improved simulated annealing and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A new Genetic Algorithm was proposed based on the analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of the Genetic Algorithm and Simulated Annealing Algorithm. The genetic algorithm with optimum reservation strategy was served as the main flow of the new algorithm which combined the mechanism of improved simulated annealing. In order to get the global optimum solution, the improved simulated annealing took the double threshold value and kept the middle optimum solution to reduce the computing capacity and enhanced the convergence speed. Through the simulation test of a series of typical functions, the result indicated that the new algorithm can improve the convergence speed and the ability of jumping out the local optimum solution greatly.

articleTitle: MAODV multicast routing protocol based on node mobility prediction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Mobile Ad hoc network is a multihop and provisional automous networks without support of infrastructure, which is composed of a group of mobile nodes with wireless transceiver. Based on MAODV, the paper proposes NMP-MAODV multicast routing protocol for the link disconnection problem caused by node moving so that the node is out of its upstream node's signal range. The protocol improves the packet delivery ratio and average delay in highly mobile network using node mobility prediction and active-link switch. Simulation results prove the feasibility and effectiveness of NMP-MAODV in Ad hoc networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive image watermarking algorithm based on biorthogonal wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A new adaptive image watermark algorithm based wavelet transform is proposed in this paper. It can detect watermark without using the original image. The position where watermark is embedded is finded by utilizing the correlation between the neighbors of wavelet coefficient. The strength of watermark is obtained according to the edge. Thus a good balance between invisible and robust is achieved. Experimental result shows that this watermark algorithm is invisible and robust against some image processing operations, such as addiribe noise, filter, compression, incorporating attacks and so on.

articleTitle: A stock predition method based on PSO and BP hybrid algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of BP neural network (such as sensitive to the initial weights, easy to sink into local minimum, slow velocity of convergence and so on) in short-term stock prediction, a new stock predition method is created. Through optimizing initial weights of BP neural network by PSO of global stochastic optimization idea can the predition model which is based on the PSO and BP be built. Morever, by means of instance analysis and comparing it with traditional BP neural network forecasting method, the results show that it not only make the velocity of convergence increase, trainning error decrease but avoid to sink into local minimum and achieve better precision of prediction as well. It has some practical value in the stock prediction.

articleTitle: A trustworthy e-learning based on trust and quality evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Web-based e-learning can share and reuse learning resources and facilitate learning processes. But the difficulties of guaranteeing the quality and trustworthiness of learning resources make learners and educators have no enough confidence in participating in web-based learning. It is one of the major reasons impeding the development of e-learning. In order to build a quality assurance and trustable e-learning environment, a SOA-based e-learning model with quality certification and trust evaluation is proposed. By evaluation and trust computing, high-quality and trustable education services are recommended to learners. The evaluation model, trust computing formulas and typical e-learning interaction processes are described. A simulation system and case analyses illustrate how the introduced model would be deployed.

articleTitle: A method of embedded video surveillance based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to fill the gap of high efficient image processing module in embedded video surveillance system, the open source computer vision library (OpenCV) is introduced in the procedure of video stream server processing which is based on Embedded ARM system to complete various function of computer vision, an example of motion object detection algorithm is used to demonstrate the plan is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Background extraction and update method based on histogram in YCbCr color space
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In computer vision-based Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), one of the key techniques is to exactly detect the vehicles. The common way for vehicle detection is the background difference method. In this paper, we introduce several background extraction and updating methods and develop a new background extraction and update method based on histogram in YCbCr color space. By using YCbCr color space, the influence of illumination change and shadows is reduced. To solve the problem with change in background itself, we propose a background update method by using the pixel change count and histogram. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively extract and update the background information in complex traffic environment.

articleTitle: Evaluation of engineering camouflage effectiveness based on human visual attention mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To evaluate the engineering camouflage effectiveness impersonally and exactly, based on the theory of human visual apperceive, the model is constituted on the human visual attention mechanisms. The feature maps of spatial scales are presented upon the distilled intensity, color and orientation from the input picture. The saliency map is gained from the combination of conspicuity maps. The shift of focus of attention (FOA) are selected and measured in the mechanisms winner-take-all (WTA) and inhibition of return. The relation between the shift of FOA and target detection probability is constituted upon back propagation (BP) neural network, and the target camouflage effectiveness can be measured exactly. The experiment result shows this model possesses advantages such as exact elements, high determinability and operability.

articleTitle: The significance and effectiveness of Augmented Reality in experimental education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a branch of Virtual Reality (VR). With the development of this novel technology, the applications of the AR based education are attracting more and more attention. This paper points out the significance of AR-based experiment in education and illustrates the applications and effectiveness of AR-based experiment. We hope this can become a hint for the educators and researcher in China to be looking forward of the glorious future of AR technology in education.

articleTitle: A data quality framework applied to e-government metadata: A prerequsite to establish governance of interoperable e-services
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Data quality is becoming increasingly important in information critical systems and the data, also coined information product (IP)[1] is frequently considered as an item with equal importance to the physical product. Several frameworks for both data quality processes and data quality methods have been defined and are routinely applied to transactional and master data systems. However, it has been suggested that the same principles could also be successfully implemented for metadata repositories[7]. This article outlines how data quality processes and a data quality framework both based on semiotics[2] and Wang[1] are being applied to monitor and improve the content in an e-government metadata repository. In the work described here, the term data is used to denote data instances whereas metadata denotes the reusable data definitions.

articleTitle: The application of Hybrid Neural Network Algorithms in Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the advantages and disadvantages of the improved GA and LM algorithm, in this paper, the Hybrid Neural Network Algorithm (HNNA) is presented. Firstly, the algorithms use the advantage of the improved GA with strong whole searching capacity to search global optimal point in the whole question domain. Then, it adopts the strongpoint of the LM algorithm with fast local searching to fine search near the global optimal point. The paper used respectively the three algorithms, namely the Improved GA, LM algorithm and HNNA, to adjust the input and output parameters of the ANN model, and adopt the theories of the fusion of the multi-classifiers to structure the Intrusion Detection System. By repeatedly experiment, it is found that the HNNA is better in stability and convergence precision than LM algorithm and improved GA from the training result. The testing results are also proved that the detection rate of the multiple classifiers intrusion detection system based on HNNA learning algorithm, including all attack categories that has a few or many training samples, is higher than the IDS that use LM and improved GA learning algorithm, and the false negative rate is less. So, the HNNA is proved to be feasible in theory and practice.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Green construction management system for construction project
