articleTitle: A prediction study on the car sales based on web search data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The automobile industry is a pillar industry in the national economy, so it's of important significance to predict accurately car sales. On the basis of building theoretical frame of web search data and car sales, this paper selects keywords with the technology of auto recommendation, composes the keywords into composite index which can be used in the regression model of this paper, analyzes the relationship between the sales of car in different price ranges and the corresponding composite index, makes the prediction test, finally has the forecast results of car sales in different price ranges whose Prediction MAPE is less than 4 percent.

articleTitle: Optimized road network emergency restoration scheduling for relief distribution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to minimize the length of time required for emergency relief distribution, the decision-maker always considers damaged road network restoration as a strategy. Focusing on the interrelationship between relief distribution and road network restoration, we provide a transparent and feasible solution for solving optimized road network emergency restoration scheduling for relief distribution. Combining the road network emergency restoration and relief distribution, a combinatorial optimization model is developed in this paper. Consequently, a newly developed genetic algorithm is designed to solve this problem. A case study is presented to highlight the significance of the proposed model as well as the efficacy of solution strategy.

articleTitle: The research and design of embedded wireless video monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A design plan of WLAN Video Monitoring System based on the latest Imx 31 ARM11 hardware platform of Freescale and embedded Wince OS is introduced, including the main structure of the system and functions of each key module. The design of hardware circuit of the video capture, MPEG4 digital video compression and WLAN modules and the driver software implementation are also included. The system uses the MPEG4 encoding module inside iMX31 to encode the videos captured by the video capturing module, which are then read into SDRAM through HCI Interface and sent to Wireless Access Point by 802.11g module. These data then reach PCs through wired of wireless networks. The application on PC will receive, decode and play these MPEG4 encoded monitoring videos.

articleTitle: The application of cloud storage technology in SMEs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, information has become an important part of daily life. For enterprises, it plays an important role that make use of information effectively. From the perspective of information storage, combined with a popular topic of cloud computing, this paper focuses onthe importance of cloud storage. The theory and framework of cloud storage which is distinguished from the cloud computing is described in detail in this paper. It introduced the apply situation and the scope of cloud storage in the small and medium enterprises, and telled us how SMEs can choose their own cloud storage service. Showing the charm of cloud storage from the practical application examples. At last the topic analysed the status of cloud storage and future trends from a different point of view.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: E-government, government procurement and the development of e-Commerce: Korean experience and its implications
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Information governance as a basis for cross-sector e-services in public administration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Information governance and systematic work with metadata and semantics are important elements of the implementation of an open, transparent, accessible, accountable, user-friendly and service-oriented public sector. Top management commitment is crucial in order to achieve necessary attention and sufficient budgets. Management needs to be aware of metadata and semantics as important enablers for the goals set forth in strategies and requirements from ministries. Documentation of economic potential and cost savings will help to get attention among decision makers, but today, few trustworthy sources are available. The development of cross-sector services and the demand for reuse of public service information, both in the public sector itself, but also for commercial services, underpins the importance of well-defined information. Participation in cross-sector e-Services demands the establishment of metadata repositories and ontologies as obligatory parts of the public sector information governance regimes.

articleTitle: Empirical study on Electronic-Business Capability Conceptual Model: Based on dynamic capabilities view
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to test and verify Electronic-business (E-B) Capability Conceptual Model based on content analysis of the interviews with the top managers about their views and experiences of E-B implementation published on some important websites proposed in our former study [1]. A survey methodology was used to test the theoretical model. From descriptive statistical analysis, item analysis, and factor analysis on 72 data, we complement and improve the former theoretical model from 23 items to 20 items, and decompose E-B managerial skills and E-B technology resources from enterprise internal and external point of view to two sub-dimensions separately. Our research will help organizations to identify and obtain sustained competitive advantage through E-B application.

articleTitle: The research on Search Engine Optimization based on Six Sigma Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In information times, the website Management is becoming hot topic. And Search Engine has more influence on websites, so many website managers are trying to make efforts for Search Engine Optimization (SEO). But only do scientifically exploring the key factors of SEO, Could avoid unnecessary invest and help managers to achieve prospective effects. So the paper is trying to study the factors affecting SEO and the way how to do SEO, then putting forward the approach to bring it into effect by Empirical Research based on Sis Sigma. The purpose is to help websites managers to improve their fames and create more economic effectiveness and social effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on HDFS-based web server cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of the internet and ecommerce, all kinds of Web-based applications become the focus of software development for its convenient, fast and easy operation, simultaneously, most of these web applications have a large number access and concurrent access volume. This requires that web applications have higher performance, especially higher concurrent performance. One main approach to improve web application performance is the clustering technology. Web server cluster is a system consisting of several servers which run the same web application server, the system acts as one server for clients. Web cluster can dispatch the requests to different nodes to improve the effectiveness and stability of the entire application. The traditional web cluster has obtained some achievements, their form of organization can be classified as two types: one is based on the DNS, the other based on distributor (Dispatcher), but all run on the application server level, this paper presents one web cluster which built on a distributed file system HDFS, this kind of cluster can take advantage of the schedule and load balancing algorithm of the HDFS to achieve its scheduling and load balance purpose, which is a innovative way to build the web cluster.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: From customer satisfaction index to service quality: A new quality concept in the e-government performance evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The state of the art and tendency of privacy preserving data mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As a new branch of data mining, privacy preserving data mining has become more and more important in the information security field. This paper first presents an insight into the principles of privacy preserving data mining, and then marks out the difference with normal data mining through three stages, including single data record methods, centralized dataset mining technology and secure multiparty computation problem. By studying and analyzing privacy preserving data mining methods, the present problems and directions for future research are discussed.

articleTitle: Customer relationship management based on data mining technique — Naive Bayesian classifier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rampant competition in the domestic and international business, the Customer Relationship Management(CRM) has become one of matters of concern to the enterprise. CRM takes the customers as the center, it gives a new life to the enterprise organization system and optimizes the business process. In an effort to help enterprises understand their customers' shopping behavior and the ways to retain valued customers, we propose data mining techniques. As a rising subject, data mining is playing an increasingly important role in the decision support activity of every walk of life. This paper mainly focused on the research of the customer classification and prediction in commercial banks based on Naive Bayesian classifier that accommodates the uncertainty inherent in predicting customer behavior.

articleTitle: Study on teaching of CAD based on GIS and 3D modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Due to the lack of flexibility and expansibility, traditional education methods of architectural CAD can't adapt to the university undergraduate teaching. A new teaching idea is proposed, which focuses on dynamic architectural landscape design by using technology of GIS and 3D modeling. Meanwhile, teaching organization, matched with teaching idea is put forward. As result, this reform of teaching not only promote students' learning interest, but also pave the way for students when they come into the community and face fierce competition in the industry after graduation.

articleTitle: A study of e-business applied to state-owned Xinhua Bookstores based on the view of book retail industry evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: E-business has reached every aspects of the publishing market since the American Amazon Online Bookstore came into being in 1995. Traditional bookstore entity business model is suffering an unprecedented challenge by the impact of e-bookstores. At the same time, the change in reading style is impacting the publication of traditional paper-based books. According to the industry evolution theory, the book retail industry evolution belongs to the Intermediating Evolution. Under this trend of development, it is quite necessary for the State-owned Xinhua Bookstore, which acts as the top leader in the national bookstores, to develop e-business. This paper exerts the industry evolution theory from the life-cycle view of industries, explains the concept and classifications of e-bookstore, analyzes the advantage and weekness of state-owned Xinhua bookstores implementation of e-business, and puts forwards the suggestions about e-business applied to the state-owned Xinhua Bookstores.

articleTitle: Analyzing core-periphery structure of complex product development using social network analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper explores the core-periphery structure of complex product development process from the perspectives of information flow and social network. We use the design structure matrix to display product development process, and employ the social network analysis to identify and explain the core-periphery structure in complex product development process. We discuss how to detect the core and periphery processes in product development based on social network analysis, and suggest that the importance of a product development process can be evaluated by the core-periphery structure analysis. The findings are explained in a real-world product development case.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An analysis of service outsourcing for SMEs: To take Zhejiang China for an example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Study on knowledge sharing in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In recent years, studies on supply chain and knowledge management are hot spots for the scholars at home and abroad. Based on studies on knowledge sharing in supply chain and by integrating supply chain with knowledge management, this paper inquires into the contents of knowledge sharing and knowledge transferring modes in supply chain and proposes the supporting system for promoting knowledge sharing in supply chain.

articleTitle: Evolutionary game of co-opetition strategy among port cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on customer choice behavior and port service substitution effect, constructing co-opetition model among port cluster, finding the equilibrium strategy profile for port cluster coordination through evolutionary game theory and analyzing the port selection of the best service and charges as well as maximum profit. With numerical example to verify the validity of the model, when the strategy profile moves from perfectly competition to perfectly co-operation, the optimal charge will increase while the best service improvement or not depends on the natural container basement, unit variable cost and service cost coefficient; due to long-term equilibrium state is perfectly competition strategy profile, there is a need for appropriate institutional arrangement to reduce the saddle-point position in order to achieve maximize profit for the overall port cluster.

articleTitle: Information sharing pattern of agricultural products supply chain based on E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Taking Xinjiang's tomato industry as an example, this paper analyzes the management of agricultural supply chain and the sharing pattern results of supply chain information under the atmosphere of E-commerce both at home and abroad, illustrates problems and solutions of current tomato industry supply chain information sharing in Xinjiang, demonstrates the implementation necessity and feasibility of supply information sharing based on E-commerce technology for Xinjiang's tomato industry, and then constructs effective information sharing pattern which can improve the efficiency of Xinjiang's tomato supply chain.

articleTitle: A research on the model of factors influencing consumer trust in mobile business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Mobile Business has extensive application prospects, and consumer participation is the key to the development of mobile business. In this paper, a model of factors affecting trust in mobile commerce is proposed. Through questionnaires and collected 310 valid questionnaires were carried out using SEM Analysis. Study confirms our model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of automobile after-sale service delivery system based on the customer value analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Application of signal analysis in seismic wave processing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Seismic wave is non-stationary signal, strictly speaking, the traditional methods of dealing with stationary signal cannot analysis non-stationary signal effectively, in this paper, the analysis of the seismic wave of the numerical analysis is based of linear time-frequency presentation and the signal toolbox of Matlab, the results of obtained are discussed and the measures are presented.

articleTitle: Optimization of the flow distribution of e-waste reverse logistics network based on NSGA II and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated method based on multi-objective optimization (NSGA II) and multi-attribute decision making (TOPSIS) to analyze the optimal flow distribution of e-waste reverse logistics network. Within the established multi-objective model, objectives concerning economic (total profit), ecological (accumulated energy consumption) performances and loss are considered. For the multi-objective optimization problem, evolutionary algorithm-based NSGA II (improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm) is used to obtain Pareto optimal solutions, which constitute the decision-making matrix of multi-attribute decision making, then through the Eigenvector, combined with the subjective preferences of decision makers to determine the weight of each criteria, Finally, TOPSIS is applied to determine the most satisfactory decision point.

articleTitle: Application of decision tree method in economic statistical data processing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Decision tree method is a powerful technology of decision-making system construction. The article introduces basic concept and algorithm of decision tree method first of all, then conducts data mining in economic statistical data through the introduction of decision tree method, and analyses the excavated information, thus proves that decision tree method can improve the quality of economic statistical data, in the end the article proposes some exploratory comments and suggestions for the application of decision tree method in economic statistics.

articleTitle: The impact of virtual community trust influence over consumer participation in online group-buying
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the aspect of virtual community trust, combining the theory of Electronic word-of-mouth and Technology Acceptance Model, to develop a deeper understanding of how virtual communities influence consumer participation in online group-buying, and to extract the key factors that impact consumer willingness to participate in online group-buying. The research involves survey responses from 314 individual consumers with online group-buying experience from China. The final results are used to provide suggestions to operators of online group-buying platforms, and to provide a different direction to academia for related studies, providing theoretical guidance and empirical evidence for the online group-buying marketing practices.

articleTitle: eDialogue: Government innovation in Norway
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper outlines the history, status and foresight of e-Government in Norway. Based on the technological development of e-Services in the Norwegian public sector we present the concept of e-Dialogues, and show how this innovation may be realized.

articleTitle: Leadership style and employee innovative behavior: The mediating effects of psychological empowerment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper builds the studying model through literature reviewing, and then tests the relationships and the mediating effect of psychological empowerment between leadership style and employee innovative behavior based on statistical analysis of 21 IT firm samples. The studying finds that transactional leadership has a significant negative impact on employee innovative behavior, and that psychological empowerment partly mediates the relationship between transactional leadership and employee innovative behavior. The study also shows that transformational leadership has a significant positive impact on employee innovative behavior, and that psychological empowerment partly mediates the relationship between transformational leadership and employee innovative behavior. At last, this paper puts forward some theoretical meanings and management inspirations, as well as the future research directions.

articleTitle: A brief study on clustering methods: Based on the k-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Clustering is the process of grouping a set of objects into classes. The clustering problem has been addressed by researchers in many contexts and disciplines. First, a process model for data mining and the typical requirements of clustering methods have been described. Second, the k-means algorithm and its advantages and disadvantages are introduced. Then the Iris dataset is used to specify the k-means algorithm. A taxonomy of clustering algorithms and complexity of several algorithms are listed in the end.

articleTitle: Research on the production system of an enterprise simulation base on WITNESS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: For a manufacturing enterprise, the production system is the principal in the competition among the enterprises. So improving the production system is an important means to enhance enterprise's competitive power. The paper takes an enterprise's production system as an example, to do simulation analysis for the whole system by using witness simulation software, and then the bottle neck which influences the productivity of system can be found. After analyzing the bottleneck simulation results, the essential influence factors can be found, and the improving methods can be put forward.

articleTitle: Open innovation of small and medium sized enterprises and R & D public service platform: A case about the VIC model of Zhangjiang Hi-tech Park
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Although evidence for open innovation practices has been provided for large MNEs, they have not yet been analyzed systematically for small and medium sized enterprises. In the paper, we study the relationship between value creation, transaction cost and open innovation of small and medium sized enterprises, and analyze whether R&D public services platform contributes to open innovation of small and medium sized enterprises. In order to understand how R&D public services platform supports open innovation of small and medium sized enterprises, we further analyze the VIC model of Zhangjiang Hi-tech Park.

articleTitle: Bankruptcy prediction in construction companies via Fisher's Linear Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on Fisher's Linear Discriminant Analysis, the paper proposed an early warning model to predict the bankruptcy possibility for construction companies in China. Sample and variable set of the study came from 56 privately owned Chinese construction companies and their financial ratios, and 27 companies' crisis occurred during the period 2008–2009. Kolmogorov-Smirnov test was used to examine the significance of the basic financial characteristics. The correlative analysis was used to exclude the influence of multicollinearity. Six financial ratios were determined to be significant. Based on these financial ratios, Fisher-LDA was applied to construct the bankruptcy prediction model. Availability of the bankruptcy prediction model was evaluated with other statistic models and intelligent technique (Bayes, PCA, Logistic regression and Neural Network) with the same sample data. The accuracy of the model reached 88.46% and 92.31% on the validation sample with two years and one year in advance respectively, which was better than other models. Results of the study show that our model has good accuracy in early prediction.

articleTitle: Study of the attack-resistance of national economy based on data mining analysis of the population flow social network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is a major aspect of social network analysis to apply data mining techniques to analyze relationship pattern and reveal social phenomena. And the analysis of attack-resistance of national economy is critical to a country and her people's livelihood. Previous studies of attack resistance of social network mainly focus on analyzing the attack effect on the network's connectivity, when a few nodes and edges are removed, for instance the internet attack research. However, the method is not applicable to the social network that is full-connected, such as a population flow network. Therefore, the paper proposes a novel attack evaluation method that considers the changes of nodes' importance before and after the attack. The method is applicable to the more general network. First, we get the number of floating population between all provinces of China based on the 1% national population sample survey in 2005, and the population flow data is used to construct the social network that reflect economical connection between all provinces; Second, the PageRank algorithm is adopted to compute the importance of each regional economy; Third, we analyze the attack resistance of nation economy when random and deliberate attacks at some regional economies and the links of them occur. The experimental results show that the deliberate attack at important province and link is more virtual to national economy.

articleTitle: Government Process Management under electronic government and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Government Process Reengineering (GPR) is the kernel of electronic government, but it has high risk. A framework for Government Process Management (GPM) based on stage of electronic government is presented in this paper. It can improve government performance and satisfy public's growing needs through end-to-end process excellence, while greatly reducing the risk. The real example of process reengineering in Beijing Municipal Bureau of Statistics is illustrated to apply this framework. Process modeling, process analysis and evaluation, process reengineering, and organization change are detailed for the example.

articleTitle: Development and implementation of a university research management information system based on rule engine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the modern information management systems, business logic may change with the constantly changing of external environment, the traditional method of MIS only continuously modified the code to meet the needs of customers. But with the frequency of modification the clients will not accept the high maintenance cost, so there is an urgent need for a new approach to develop the MIS. In this condition, the rule-based method of software development came into being. The MIS in this paper is based on the J2EE platform, which used the JBoss rules as the inference engine by adding business rules to complete the separation between application components and business rule components, when business logic changes, it only needs to modify the rule that is depended on by business rule components, which does not have any impact on the system code. Facts proved that the system we designed behaved well in the aspect of availability, ease of operation and the speed of dealing with business logic.

articleTitle: Using association rules mining to provide personalized information in e-government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: E-government makes user get government information more and more conveniently. However, user is often drown in information. Therefore, e-government attempt to offer more convenience through personalized information. Association rules mining is a good tool to provide personalized information. This paper discussed e-government concept and types, then put forward one method to provide personalized information in e-government with association rules mining. An example was also presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the dynamic supervision system for land enforcement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper takes the business demands of regional land of land enforcement and supervision work as the orientation, directs at the problem of internal and external industry verification judgment, data entry report and storage management, through combining the GIS tool and professional model, based the existing GIS to redevelop and establish a new law enforcement surveillance management information system which involve several functions, such as data standard input, the scientific auxiliary inspections and the achievements automatic Aggregation. This new system can be used to assist the work of daily inspection.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: How virtual brand community influences on consumer-based brand equity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: With 4R-theory study new marketing strategy for China's SME — Blog marketing application Web2.0
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A model to support the authentication of mobile business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Identity authentication and access control are the most important aspects of internet security. The traditional method to implement them is achieved through an API between the authentication and access control service provider with an application strengthened with one-time password. These methods do not meet the security demands and a new identification mechanism is required. We present a multilevel smart authentication mechanism which defines four different alert levels in the system according to user's requirements, using three different authentication techniques. It will not only introduce systematic safety, but also more convenience to the user.

articleTitle: The implementation and deployment of the virtual lab education system based on virtual server
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the development and deployment of the virtual education system SEI-VLab, which is based on the "Remote Lab" developed by Microsoft Corporation. In order to coordinate the need of the institute teaching, some improvements are added, such as user management, virtual machine management, laboratory manual management and so on. This system improves the management of virtual machines and raises the system use efficiency by using the COM monitoring programming connection which was provided by Virtual Server and Virtual Machine Manager. The operation of this virtual laboratory teaching system will not be influenced by the time. We can use remote login and carry out the online experiment. This offers great convenience to the students and they can do the experiment after class. Regarding the teacher, the deployment of the virtual laboratory will be more advantageous to test classroom instruction achievement and raise the teaching efficiency. Regarding the institute, the completion of the virtual laboratory saves the investment cost of hardware construction to a certain extent. Now the system has finished debugging and all functions have been achieved. It is already deployed in the actual teaching environment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On ICT and green growth from a sustainable perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Intelligent surveillance system used one new method of image recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In surveillance system, because of vidicon and object moveing, the images of a object are very different, a method which can identify objects nicely is required. The wavelet moment has the invariant of translation, scaling and rotation, so it is applid to distill images' eigenvalues. In this paper, a ameliorative SCNN (Self-organized Competitive Neural Nework) classes objects. The results show that this system is practical, reliable and timely.

articleTitle: Research on application of customer satisfaction index model — View_based on PLS and information entropy-weight method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Customer satisfaction index model belongs to the structural equation model (SEM). The modeling method of SEM mainly includes the linear structure relations based on the covariance structures (LISREL) and the path method based on partial least square (PLS). These two methods have different requirements for data. LISREL requires observed variables with normal distribution, while PLS has no strict restriction on data. So PLS is more suitable for modeling SEM. Entropy is the degree of irregular of the system. In SEM, the latent variable is the measured through observed variable. Less of information entropy of some measurement leads to lager of extent of variation and the provided information capacity, and more important role in latent variable in the measurement. The information entropy-weight method based on objective weighting is applied, which can avoid the subjective factors on the valuation of the observed variable. In this paper, the supermarket corporation is taken as an example; the path coefficient formation process of customer satisfaction index model is confirmed by means of the software of SPSS13.0 and SIMICA-P12.0. The results show that the scientific and practical modeling methods offer reference and consulting for customer satisfaction index model, and even for modeling SEM theoretically and practically.

articleTitle: Research of CRM system based on the environment of E-business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In E-business age, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) has become a key factor in business success. Recent interest in relationship management and relationship marketing has led many firms to consider how to improve customer retention rates. In this paper, authors studied the characteristics of CRM system based on the environment of E-business, and supplied the solution of CRM system in E-business environment, and discussed the implementation of CRM under E-business environment. We hope this paper will be an exploratory study and designed to provide reference for the theory community and the business community.

articleTitle: Research of enterprise information resources integrated management and rights and benefits sharing system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Nowadays the competence among companies has changed into the competence among supply chains. The determinant that assures information resource integrated management successfully delivered is a good rights and benefits sharing system, which in this article was divided into management-coordination system, cost-earning system, and coordination signal transmission system. This article started from the definition of both rights and benefits sharing system and integrated management, and then analyzed the relationship between them. Focused on information sharing system, which was among the companies and within supply chains, this article divided the information sharing system into two parts in the research: within one company and among the different companies.

articleTitle: Users' acceptance behavior for m-commerce based on Customer Perceived Value and TAM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: From the perspective of users, the current paper mainly studied users' acceptance behavior for mobile commerce based on Customer Perceived Value (CPV) and Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). In this article the research model was established and the empirical analysis was carried out with the selected interviewers. Research found out that all the factors of CPV, except Perceived Ease of Use, have remarkable influence on users' behavior. Meanwhile the consumer innovativeness, the development and compatibility of m-commerce also have certain influence on users' acceptance.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship among personality trait, working attitude and turnover intention
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Through the positive analysis of 373 employees who come from all kinds of enterprises and institutions in Wuhan and other areas, this paper examines the relationship among personality trait working attitude and turnover intention. The research shows that the locus of control significantly affects the working attitude of staff, and there is interaction between job satisfaction and organizational commitment which both affect turnover intention collectively, with the latter having stronger and more stable impact. Meanwhile, job satisfaction partially mediates the influence of personality trait and turnover intention. and organizational commitment fully mediated the influence of personality trait and turnover intention.

articleTitle: Reversible watermarking algorithm for wireless sensor network using method of multi-node negotiation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Watermark technology has been used for verifying the integrity and correctness of sensor collected data. However, most of the watermark technologies used in wireless sensor networks are not reversible. The embedded watermarks make some damage to the sensor collected data. In this paper, based on difference expansion algorithm, we propose a reversible watermark algorithm aiming to solve the data recovery problem in wireless sensor networks. Target on the sensors' loosely organization problem and sensor's weak defensiveness problem, the proposed algorithm splits the whole watermark into several segments and assigns the segments randomly to sensors, which enhance the ability to resist collusion attack. Meanwhile, we use a pair of synchronous random number generators for sensors and the sink to solve the data freshness distinguished problem.

articleTitle: Construction project collaboration management based on the BIM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The construction industry is shocked by the advance of Building Information Modeling, every country works hard to realize the BIM. And the application of collaboration management to manufacturing industry achieves good results since its setting. The paper analyses the application situation of the use of Collaboration management within the project management and the existent problems, such as difficulties in the information sharing and the information can't deliver smoothly. The process of project collaboration management is put forward. And the paper also discusses that the BIM creates for the phase of the design, bidding and construction, which makes the delivery of the Information smoothly and let the collaboration management more efficient. At last, it comes to a conclusion that it is necessary to set a new project organization up before using BIM during project management.

articleTitle: The three-dimensional teaching mode of ERP course in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article focuses on the teaching mode of ERP(Enterprise resource planning) course in colleges and universities in China. It puts forward an innovative three-dimensional teaching mode, composed of three main parts. The new experimental arrangement is good to improve the students' practical ability, innovation and teamwork ability. It changes the ERP course from "teaching" to "learning".

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Investegation based study on the environment and opportunities of mobile payment services in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis and countermeasures of project cost control in construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Adaptive intrusion prevention algorithm based on HMM Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Intrusion prevention technologies and mechanisms have been developed to enhance the network security. Model-based approach is one of the most promising approaches for intrusion prevention and intrusion detection, since it can reveal the hidden characteristic of time series. Hidden Markov Model (HMM) is a main time series model. In the implement of the intrusion prevention mechanism, the combination of fast adaptive clustering algorithm and intrusion prevention algorithm is used to redetection, which can adaptively update model, and raise speed of detection. Experimental results with the KDD Cup99 data sets demonstrate that false positive rate of the detection algorithm is lower than conventional model-based detection algorithm, while the detection rate is still kept in a good state.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the reasons and outsourcing decision of reverse logistics based on E-business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on the dynamic mechanism of R & D industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study on the China's ability of undertaking the international transfer of the service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Optimal system of single vehicle route based on mobile GIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Transport cost occupies a very big part of logistic cost. In order to reduce transport cost and advance transport efficiency, optimal system of single vehicle route is set up combing C/S and B/S structure based on real street and mobile GIS. The system integrates network, PDA, GPS, GIS and so on. Each part of the system is designed and realized integrating latest network technology, PDA, GPS, mobile GIS and object-oriented concept. The results show that the system realizes optimal scheduling and distributing of visualization logistic, guarantee transporting timely and scientifically, reduce management and transport costs greatly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on virtual community construction of e-commerce in the perspective of customers' trust
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Applications of data integration in thermal power infrastructure construction project management heterogeneous system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: There are often multiple heterogeneous information systems running simultaneously in current enterprise. The data sources of these systems are independent and closed of each other, making it difficult to communicate, share and integrate them. With the deepening of informatization applications, the needs of information exchange in enterprise interior, between enterprise and external, has become increasingly strong, so it urgently needs to integrate existing information, and share information. Data integration is achieved through data exchange between tables, mainly settle the problem of data distributional and heterogeneous nature. It is the premise to make the data structure public for integrated application, that is to disclosure the table structure, the relationship between tables, the meaning of coding, and so on. In the informatization process, by integrating the schedule management data of P3 system and project management system, importing/exporting the schedule data of both sides, avoid the problems of duplication of project schedule information input and information inconsistencies, and benefit the managers to make the right decisions quickly and intuitively to the project schedule status in infrastructure construction phase. This paper introduces an interface program developed through nested loop algorithm, and achieves data integration between power plant project schedule management heterogeneous systems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Thought on low-carbon urbanization strategy in Sichuan province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Study about Large Unified Symmetry for mechano-electrical dynamic systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, the new concept of the Large Unified Symmetry and conserved quantities for dynamic mechano-electrical are presented. The Large Unified Symmetry and conserved quantities for mechano-electrical dynamicsystems are studied by the relations between the three kinds of symmetries and the three kinds of conserved quantities. We worked on the Large Unified Symmetry and conserved quantity by the Noether symmetry, the Lie symmetry and the Mei symmetry, including the definition and criterion of the Large Unified Symmetry and conserved quantity deduced from them. The Large Unified Symmetry is a intersection set among the Noether symmetry, the Lie symmetry and the Mei symmetry. It will play an important role in the fields of modern science and technology.

articleTitle: E-business and manufacturing agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper identifies the chain-mechanism of e-business affects the manufacturing agglomeration from the view sight of trade costs. Considering trade costs as a mediator variable for this chain-mechanism, a mediating model is built. The empirical checking of 28 manufacturing industries shows that e-business could promote agglomeration through lowering the trade costs. This effect is still robust in technology-intensive manufacturing industries, but it gets a negative answer on the sample of labor-intensive and capital-intensive manufacturing industries.

articleTitle: The effects of Chinese factor on international commodity prices
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The consumption of international natural resources caused by contradiction of Chinese domestic supply and demand is often referred to Chinese factor. This paper analyzes the effects of the difference of Chinese import and export for natural resources (metal goods) to international commodity prices based on the data between Jan, 1999 and Jun, 2008. Through the establishment of VAR model and co integration analysis, we found there is long-run equilibrium relationship between Chinese factor and the international commodity prices. When the demand increases, the international commodity prices also increase. This phenomenon is related to besides the contradiction between supply and demand of China, and is also related to the change of international capital and the cycle of resources production. Finally, it gives some recommendations for establishing the price immune system on natural resources for China.

articleTitle: The game analysis of Consumer's choice in medical insurance pooled in municipalities level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Consumer's choice is always the key issue of the rational allocation of medical resources and the effective usage of health care funds. It's also one of the most important problems of the country's current health system reform. In this paper, through establishing the game model among the social insurance institutions, medical institutions and insured person, we analyze the overall process of the consumer's choice of medical institutions in the municipal health insurance. By using Nash equilibrium conditions of the model, we show how social insurance institutions regulate the consumer's choice through the insurance policy making, and thus ease the strain on the resources of quality medical health care and make rational expenditure of the medical insurance fund.

articleTitle: Influence of the Chinese monetary policy on the current macro-economy — Analysis with the FAVAR model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Facing the over-heating economy and inflation and so on, the Chinese government has taken frequent monetary policy in 2010 to resolve these problems. To fully understand the effects of these policies, this paper adopts the FAVAR model to analyze the relations between the interest rate, deposit reserve and the ten principal components of the Chinese macro-economic data. Findings indicate that these policies will not pay off obviously in the long run to slow down the over-heating economy, to prevent excessive fix capital investment, and to rid over-liquidity and inflation.

articleTitle: The interaction between capital structure and product market competition: Empirical evidence from Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The relationship between capital structure and product market competition is a field got much concern from economic scholars recently, but research works got so far seem to neglect their bidirectional relationship. Considering this deficiency, I take Chinese A-stock listed companies as research objects, and use a systemic equation model to test the bidirectional relationship between companies' capital structure and their product market competition intensity. The test results indicate that both debt ratio and product market competition intensity have statistically significant negative effects on each other.

articleTitle: Effect of the consumers purchasing behavior on policies in two-tier durables supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the optimization theory and utility theory respectively, the model of the pricing and quality decision for the manufacturer and that of pricing and ordering for the retailer are built, the consumers' utility model as well. The complex relationship is given between policies of the supply chain members and consumers' price/quality sensitivity. Conclusions are as follows. In any purchasing period, the optimal order quantity exists, and there is fixed relation among the retailer's optimal pricing, product quality level and consumers' price/quality sensitivity under a given order quantity. Finally, a numerical example is focused, which shows that the retailer could use price discrimination policy for consumers in every purchasing period, and the price for one generation of the product is decreasing with consumers' price/quality sensitivity. The product quality level and order quantity are all increasing with consumers' price/quality sensitivity under a given retail price.

articleTitle: Transshipments in dual-channel supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the transshipment operations in a dual-channel supply chain, which includes a traditional retail channel and an online direct channel. Previous study has shown that the implementation of transshipment among integrated firms can improve the revenue and customer service level, and also reduce the quantity of inventory. But in the dual-channel supply chain, firm in the traditional retail channel is competing for customers with the firm in the online direct channel. Can the transshipment operation still improve the performance of both firms when customers switching exists? There is little literature addressing this problem. To fill this gap we compared the transshipment strategy with non-transshipment strategy between competitive firms in a dual channel supply chain. It is concluded that transshipment operations do benefit both firms, subjecting to the customer switching rate and the transshipment cost.

articleTitle: Research on the joint innovation of independent brand model in Chinese corporation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The joint innovation of a corporation's independent brand has a great significance to the cultivation of the independent brand and the forming of innovation. Based on definitions of the corporations' independent brand joint innovation, the main body and the route, this study built independent brand joint innovation models of corporations led by different main bodies and then designed the framework for corporations which are at different scientific developing stages. This provides theoretical basis for the consummating and development of our country's independent brand joint innovation model.

articleTitle: Applied analysis of a supply chain management model in the construction industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The "vertical integration" management model that resulted in high consumption of resources, poor economic efficiency and weak competitiveness among enterprises, has been unable to meet the increasingly fierce competition in the construction industry. The implementation of a new type of management mode has become a top priority in the development of the construction industry. Based on the reality of construction industry this paper proposes the supply chain integration management mode in order to cope with the even fierce competition. This paper first introduces the construction industry supply chain, and then combining with the characteristics of the construction industry, describes the meaning and model of the construction supply chain integration and analyzes the feasibility of implementation of the construction supply chain integration. Finally, this paper discusses how to achieve the integrated management of the construction industry through four aspects including the organizational restructuring, business process reengineering, building information support system and security system.

articleTitle: Predicting price of target in acquisition by support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to predict the price of candidates in acquisition and evaluate its feasibility, this paper puts forward a model of price prediction of candidates based on support vector machine. The model is trained by the data of market deals which were made in the past. The result of simulation and test indicates that average error of prediction is percent 7.71. It also proves that SVM has better performance than BP neural network under the condition of small samples. SVM can overcome the limitation of hypotheses of econometrics and shortcomings of BP neural network that is low efficient and easy to fall into local minimum. Therefore, prediction model based on SVM has more advantages and wider prospect of application.

articleTitle: Group lending: Improving the opportunity of SMEs finance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In practice, group lending is a lending method for SMEs with high repayment rate. Theoretical and empirical researches demonstrate the improvement of the credit market by group lending from the bank's perspective, which prove that group lending has information advantages and has extrusion effect to the risk group. This paper studies the function of group lending to relieve the situation of SMEs' finance problem from the SMEs' perspective integrating the characteristics of group making. The research indicates that rather than individual lending, group lending can provide loans with better interest rate. The better interest rate can lower the success probability of the enterprises which meet the loan participation constraint condition and lower the yield requirement of the borrower's project, and finally improve the loan chances of SMEs.

articleTitle: Analyzing of driving-forces of economic growth: Based on Hebei province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The main issue of economic growth research is driving factors. This article explores economic growth driving factors' output elasticity and contribution rate in a sample interval, using extended Cobb-Douglas production function with Hebei's data between 2001 and 2008. It also analyses Hebei's characteristics of economic growth mode in the latest 8 years. The result of empirical study shows that our nation's economic growth type at present is still resource driven pattern, which means that the input of labor and capital plays the main driving action in increasing output growth rate, and knowledge innovation's promoting effect on output growth rate is not obvious. These empirical findings not only confirm the necessity and correctness of Hebei's practicing Reform and opening-up in experience, and also provide scientific accordance for Chinese government coming up with “scientific development”, “changing the style of economic growth” since 2005 and Hebei putting forward “building coastal economic and social strong province” in 2009.

articleTitle: Setting punitive damages system based on game theory in China's anti-monopoly law
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: China's Anti-monopoly Law absorbs the advanced idea of anti-monopoly law in the world, which forbids monopoly behavior rather than monopoly structure. Two game models are built, one of which is between government and monopoly enterprise, the other one of which is between injured enterprise and monopoly enterprise. The paper obtains that the probability of monopoly behavior is mainly affected by three variables: fines ratio in total sales revenue, the number of subjects participating in anti-monopoly and the multiple of compensation for the victims. Based on the definition and function of punitive damages, the paper proves the punitive damages encourage private participation of anti-monopoly, increase the probability to investigate, punish the monopoly behavior, create a strong deterrent effect, and then compensate for victims more fairly and more sufficiently. At the same time, the paper learns from the practice of anti-monopoly legislation in America and Japan, proves that the punitive damages to the anti-monopoly behavior have a positive impact on the effects of anti-monopoly, and puts forward China's Anti-monopoly Law should be set punitive damages system.

articleTitle: Time-diffusion synchronization protocols in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Recent advances in micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) technology have led to the development of small, low-cost, and low-power sensors. Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) consist of large populations of wirelessly connected nodes, capable of computation, communication, and sensing. In such networks, data from each sensor is agglomerated using data fusion to form a single meaningful result, which makes time synchronization between sensors highly desirable. Hence, time synchronization is a crucial component of WSNs, but achieving synchronization in WSNs, which combine stringent precision requirements with severe resource constraints, is particularly challenging. Instead of time synchronization between just the sender and receiver or within a local group of sensor nodes, some applications require the sensor nodes to maintain a similar time within a certain tolerance throughout the lifetime of the network. This paper surveys and evaluates that time-diffusion synchronization protocols based on a variety of factors like precision, accuracy, cost, and complexity.

articleTitle: Ontology auto-extension based on improved SVM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper researches on ontology auto-extension, which is a hot issue of semantic web. In this paper, technology related to information processing is used to automatically extend ontology instances from free text. Firstly, three tasks are identified after analyzing on ontology auto-extension. Secondly, a new binary tree (BT) is constructed based on the ontology taxonomy, and then it is used as the training and learning strategy of support vector machine (SVM) classifier. And the full strategy is regarded as Onto-BT-SVM model. The main advantage of this strategy is that the semantic of ontology is made full use of. Finally, Different multi-class classification strategies are compared to verify their impacts on classification effects. Experiment results show that the recall rate of Onto-BT-SVM model is 90.5% and the accuracy rate is 93.5%, which is satisfactory.

articleTitle: A grid-based distributed topology control algorithm for energy heterogeneous sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In clustering algorithm of wireless sensor networks, to solve the problem of excessive energy consumption in the cluster heads, an residual energy and node position synthesized grid-based distributed topology control algorithm is proposed in this paper. In cluster heads election phase of every round, it considers the residual energy and the average energy of all the nodes in each cluster, an optimal cluster head is elected in each cluster according to node position. In algorithm running phase the optimum cluster heads of the network is guaranteed, in the mean time, it is avoided to select the node with low energy as cluster head. Simulation results show that, in comparison with LEACH, HEED and DEEC, the node energy consumption is balanced and the network lifetime is efficiently prolonged in our algorithm.

articleTitle: Electronic word-of-mouth in China: A motivational analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the research of Henning-Thurau and Mee-Shew Cheung, the authors studied the motives of electronic word-of-mouth (e-WOM) in China. The findings reported here indicate that the motives of Seeking confirmation, Expressing or sharing positive feelings, Helping companies, Web convenience, Negative experiences had significant impact on e-WOM behavior. The different motives of e-WOM on different platforms are also found.

articleTitle: Survey of option game theory of R&D investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper generally analyzes the development history of option game theory about R&D based on the knowledge of common meaning of enterprise R&D strategy. Like other branch realms of the option game theories, the research of R&D investment option game theory comes from the innovative contributions of Smet (1991), Dixit & Pindyck(1994, 1996), Smit& Ankum(1993), and Smit & Trigeorgis(1997). On the basis of these papers, option game theory of R&D investment can not only handle the uncertainty of R&D or technology adoption, but also the problems of strategic technology adoption taking into account network effects, and the option game equilibrium of multi-stage R&D (or patent) competition. The latest development comes from these papers which consider asymmetric information or cooperative behavior. In sum, the general framework of option game theory on R&D investment is still needed to develop.

articleTitle: Decision model research of customers' first online shopping based on reference group influence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By introducing the reference group influence theory into the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) for the first time, this paper discusses the effect mechanism of three types of reference group influence and all the variables of TAM. The empirical study shows that at customers' first online shopping, (1) reference group influence of choosing and using website positively affects their perceived ease of use, attitude toward using, behavioral intention to buy and actual online purchase; (2) reference group influence of choosing product positively affects their behavioral intention to buy; (3) reference group influence of value expressing positively affects their perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, attitude toward using and behavioral intention to buy.

articleTitle: An comparative study on the effects of Transformational Leadership and Paternalistic Leadership on private firm's organizational performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on 308 samples of high-medium managers of private firms, we analysis the impacts of the highest manager's Transformational Leadership and Paternalistic Leadership behaviors on firm's organizational performance and it's mechanism. The result shows that: Transformational Leadership has positive effects, while Paternalistic Leadership, as a three dimensional construct, has no positive effects on employee trust to leadership and firm's organizational performance; the dimensionality of Paternalistic Leadership has interact effects to each other; Transformational Leadership take effect mainly through the path of Transformational Leadership-employee cognitive trust to leadership-employee's job satisfaction, while Paternalistic Leadership take effect mainly through the path of Paternalistic Leadership-employee's affective trust to leadership-employee organizational commitment and organizational communication.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of VMI policies for the multi-period IRP with stochastic demands
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The supply-chain-to-supply-chain business competition model creates the Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) management model for the retailers. The previous studies show that most of the conventional inventory management strategies apply fixed-quantity or order-up-to-level supplement methods, rarely mentioning the impact of supplement quantity cutting or non-order-up-to-level strategy on the total cost of the inventory routing of VMI management model. This study proposes the inventory management strategy with supplement threshold and upper limit, builds an inventory management model by the systematic analogical method and analyzes the effects of the inventory management strategy with combinations of different supplement thresholds and upper limits on the total cost of the inventory routing as well as the relatively changing situation of the inventories and transportation costs of the suppliers and retailers in a two-phase supply chain system of one supplier and multiple retailers under the condition that the demand time point and demand quantity of the retailers' customers are fixed and undetermined. When the system simulates the supplier to execute the inventory management, it firstly applies the supplement threshold after each supplement cycle to update the minimum inventory level, thus determining the collection of the supplement objects for the next supplement cycle and secondly determines the supplement quantity based on the upper limit of supplement. After that, it works out the optimal routine for supplement delivery and calculates the total cost of the inventory routing for the supplement cycle by linear programming method based on the analogue results. The study results indicate that the inventory management strategy combining the supplement-quantity-cut upper limit of supplement with the slightly-raised supplement threshold can effectively reduce the total cost, improve the vehicle utilization rate and maintain a certain service performance; moreover, it can delivery the supplement to more retailers during the supplement cycle to offer a new inventory routing management strategy for reference by the practitioner when making decisions.

articleTitle: Drivers and dimensions of web equity for B2C retailers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Great-perceived risk in online shopping has highlighted the importance of brand in virtual space. With the rapid growth of B2C businesses and fierce market competition, "web equity" is an important asset that B2C retailers can use to lower perceived risk and gain competitive advantages online. The main objective of this research is to explore drivers and dimensions of web equity of B2C retailers. Through an empirical study, we identified web awareness, online experience, and web trust as key dimensions of web equity, and web security, web design and order fulfillment are significant factors affecting web trust Additionally, web security, web design, interactivity, order fulfillment, and marketing communication are significant factors affecting online experience. Furthermore, web security, order fulfillment, and marketing communication are significant factors affecting web awareness. The paper also highlights the important role of web equity in mediating the relationship between web equity drivers and purchase intent on the web site. Managerial implications are discussed at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Term structure of interest rates and stock market cycle: Empirical analysis based on MS-VAR model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper made an estimation for three parameters (level factor, slope factor, curvature factor) time series with Nelson-Siegel model and data from Treasury bond market in China from 2003 to 2008. Supposing the evolvement of the vector of time series of three parameters is governed by a certain latent variable ruled by 2-regime Markov-switching, Markov-Switching VAR model is built which could reflect the influence of the latent variable on the term structure of interest rate of Treasury bond. Finally the empirical test was conducted and the results showed that the latent variable is the stock market cycle and the evolvement of the term structure of interest rate of Treasury bond is governed by the switching of the stock market cycle.

articleTitle: How do company reputation and perceived price influence customer loyalty in the Chinese personal financial planning industry?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: To understand the antecedents of customer loyalty from a service marketing perspective is crucial for both practice and academic research. We build and test a causal model based on data from Chinese consumers in the personal financial planning industry. Conducting the data analysis through structural equation modeling, we found that both company reputation and perceived price can enhance perceived value, whereas risk perception exerts negative influence on perceived value. In addition, perceived value directly affects consumer satisfaction and positive word of mouth and indirectly influences switching intention.

articleTitle: The influence of Russian capital market on economic growth: An empirical test based on Grey Incidence analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper uses the Grey Incidence Degree methods in Grey System, makes a empirical analysis about Russian capital markets and economic growth during the period 1999–2007, and the result is Futures market's futures trading volume and mutual funds turnover have a highest incidence degree with economic growth, combined with Russian's economic growth, reveals the vulnerability of the Russian capital market development, then give proposals to perfect the capital market that could withstand the financial crisis: fight for energy commodities pricing power and strengthening interregional especially China's cooperation on capital market.

articleTitle: The solutions to upgrade the IT in fastener manufacturing companies with government's guidance — Ningbo case
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the investigation on the application situation about IT in the SMEs of Ningbo, the main problems about the informatization of the fastener manufacturing companies in Ningbo were systematically analyzed, which indicated that the government's guidance is essentially necessary. Then the conclusions were drawn on the principles and suggestions that the local government ought to follow in the process of guiding traditional fastener manufacturing companies to better utilize IT in the SMEs. Some concrete countermeasures this thesis proposed lastly included that: (1) the government ought to support and assist the clustering fastener manufacturing companies to make a informatization planning, (2) to guide the both the division and cooperation within the industrial clusters to enhance their core competitiveness, (3) to regulate the markets for equitable competition among the fastener manufacturing companies, (4) to initiate the mechanism of right human resources management and the special inspiration in order to accelerate the optimal transferring of intelligentsia in the fastener manufacturing companies, (5) to create the credit database of the SMEs to cultivate the credit intermediary agents, (6) to speed up to formulate the informatization standards for the industry in order to amplify the community information service system and improve the informatization infrastructure, (7) to carry forward the innovation in the companies with utilizing of IT, (8) to accelerate the developing of e-commerce in fastener manufacturing companies, (9) to strengthen the classified guidance for advancing this sector's structure.

articleTitle: Overreliance, self-herd effect and internal control, risk management of organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The article first constructed a dynamic excessive reliance network model and presented a theory “self-herd effects of excessive reliance”, exploring that the principal's overreliance on the agents even resulting in his self-herd effect has great worse impacts on the organizations' internal control and risk management from the psychological perspective basing on the reality in which almost existing literatures are all from the perspective of institutional rule to research enterprises' internal control and risk management. Then I analyzed deeply its consequences by using domestic a few famous and typical cases, and further deepen the conclusion that because of the principal's excessive reliance on the agent even leading his self-herd effect on his misuse of competent people decision or not replacement employees periodically, the organization go to wreck finally. The article also presented some policy recommendations to avoid the above risks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Government regulations, institutional choices, and market effects — Take China's compulsory certification system as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The analysis of rural governance model which under the background of urban and rural coordination: Based on the investigation of Chengdu experimental district
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the construction of new rural, the choice of rural governance mode is relation to the countryside social economic stability and development. This thesis takes Chengdu experimental district for example, analysis the logic path of rural governance practice innovation and governance model transition. Point out that under the background of coordinating urban and rural development, carry out the rural governance model of “county center township send village conduct” is the effective choice in the short term. With the improvement of farmers' unionization level and villagers' autonomy become mature, the long-term choice will be “rural autonomy.

articleTitle: Is there trade opportunity of China's fresh apples in the EU market?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper explores the trade opportunities for China's fresh apples in the EU market. A nonlinear simulation model, which is based on monthly data, is utilized to investigate the effects of tariff cuts and abolishing export refunds on quantities sold and prices for different suppliers. Main emphasis is put on trade relationships between EU and China. The findings show an EU tariff cut on fresh apple imports provides considerable export opportunity for China. Abolishing export refunds on China's fresh apple export would have limited economic impacts on EU but substantial negative effects on China's fresh apples in the EU market.
