articleTitle: Construction and analysis on the source model of competitive advantage of Ningxia wolfberry industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Related literatures about the source of cluster competitive advantage are reviewed. A total of six sourcing factors of cluster competitive advantages are summarized, which are the external scale economy and scope economy, the regional resources, the government function, the reduction of transaction cost, the effect of learning and innovation, and the coordination mechanism of cluster. Development status of wolfberry industrial cluster in Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region of China is studied by using interview, questionnaire and other forms. Existing problems are put forward, including the relatively small processing and marketing enterprises in general, unclear product positioning of enterprise and poor transformation ability, insufficient brand propaganda and lack of a sound marketing network, single investment and financing channel for small and medium-sized enterprises, and poor planting organization of peasant household. Functions of sourcing factors of competitive advantage in Ningxia wolfberry industrial cluster at the formation and growth stages are analyzed, such as regional resources, government function, and scale and scope economy. Source model of competitive advantage of Ningxia wolfberry industrial cluster is constructed and compared with the evolution model of competitive advantage of small and medium-sized enterprises in China. Result shows that there are significant differences between the two due to their building foundations.

articleTitle: Dynamics of output with real exchange rate in open economy system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The research of a small open economy system dynamics is based on the goods and finance markets equilibriums by modeling with gradually adjusting nominal exchange rates and prices in crisis period. It discusses the dynamics of two scenarios of successful and failed currency peg at low and high interest rate elasticity of the aggregate investment in the case of partial liability dollarization and short term policy responses of decreasing interest rate by monetary authorities. At last, it tries to describe the dynamics of output with real exchange rate in China through empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Construction of the Conceptual Framework for Financial Accounting
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper is mainly aimed at the fundamental defect In IASC and FASB Conceptual Framework of Financial Accounting (CFFA), with new thought of the conceptual framework for financial accounting brought forward (i.e.: respective construction of conceptual framework for financial statement and other financial report systems); reflecting the transactions or affairs that have occurred in financial statement, taking exchange price (mainly refers to the history cost) as the measurement of the financial statement, building the profit index on “realized” basis, and using profit and overall yield to represent the operating results in the financial statements; showing current market price (including floating profit and loss) information and forecast information in other financial reports. This new thought, compared with the way popular abroad of “integrating” information of the finished transactions or affairs and current market price into financial statement, has an advantage over improvement of accountability and usefulness of decision of financial accounting evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the simulated triaxial compression test teaching platform of soil mechanics based on Flash
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Triaxial compression plays an important role in learning process of soil mechanics and soil test. Based on the multimedia tools of Flash MX, by using the text, image, audio and video, it is possible to obtain the simulated multimedia test teaching system of triaxial compression experiments in this research. Based on the good visibility and the vivid learning process, the difficulty of operating of the triaxial apparatus and the insipid text learning has been resolved. Because of its many advantages, such as simulation, interaction, repetition, low cost and web popularity, the simulated multimedia test teaching system can not only be useful to distance education, web teaching and normal teaching, but also meet the requirements of personnel training, which is advanced, pertinent and suitable.

articleTitle: Supplier evaluation via AHP and PROMETHEE
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The purchasing function directly affects the competitive ability of a firm. Purchasing managers need to periodically evaluate supplier performance in order to retain those suppliers who meet their requirements. This paper provides a more accurate and easier method for evaluating supplier's performance integrating analytical hierarchy process (AHP) and PROMETHEE. An example for supplier evaluation and selection is also presented to demonstrate the functional application of the model.

articleTitle: Barriers of RFID adoption and diffusion on supply chains
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Over past few decades, RFID researches and applications have made remarkable achievements. But during the industrialization process, it has to confront significant obstacles and difficulties. Its innovative attribute and industry characteristic have deep influence on its decision-making and diffusion path. RFID is facing virtual and physical barriers with various problems on supply chains. These barriers can be break out step by step from the aspects of technical, cost and regulation.

articleTitle: Process innovation and product innovation aimed at differentiation in industries with network externalities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By modifying Cournot model, the relationship between the process innovation and horizontal product innovation is investigated in a duopoly industry exhibiting network externalities. The purpose of horizontal product innovation (resp. process innovation) is to increase product differentiation (resp. lower marginal cost). The following conclusions are found: (i) when firms perform process innovation first and then horizontal product innovation, process innovation lowers product innovation efforts (i.e. they are substitutes), and the intensity of network externality increases the degree of R&D innovation substitution; (ii) when firms perform horizontal product innovation first and then process innovation, product innovation lowers or induces process innovation efforts (i.e. they are substitutes or complements) depends on the network externality, product compatibility and initial product differentiation.

articleTitle: Decoration project quality management based on process control approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A decoration project could be disassembled to some subentries or described as some processes, so its project quality management could be summed up to process control. This paper presents an issue of using process approach and project lifecycle to manage decoration project. It analyses the five steps such as primary decoration conceiving, technician and builder choosing and signing up contract, decoration work plan designing, material stocking and field constructing, checking and accepting. By using process approach to the project flow control, the decoration project management validity and constructing quality could be ensured well.

articleTitle: Diffusion of information product with network effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the replacing market, diffusion of information product is influenced by users' interaction and cooperating function between the complementary software and hardware. Therefore, this paper creates the direct network effect function which is based on the interpersonal relationship, and the indirect network effect function which is composed by the utility of the software and hardware. Based on the scale-free social network and the economic analysis of network effect, as well as the decision-making transfer function, this paper simulates the microcosmic diffusion process upon the user's utility. The simulation result demonstrates: Due to the network effect, it will appear the phenomenon that old and new product will coexist in the replacing market. The number of initial subscribers and the interaction plays important part in the takeoff time and amount of diffusion. After the takeoff threshold, the indirect network effect determines the market share of the new product.

articleTitle: Computer Audit process based on different ERP application patterns
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As an effective tool to raise the business management level comprehensively, ERP(Enterprise Resources Planning) is becoming the modern enterprise's movement pattern; however its complex internal function structure as well as the flexible application pattern, actually intensify the technical difficulty of Audit and cause the audit environment to be more complex. How to resolve the problem under the Audit environment is an issue that present audit occupation should face with. This article takes the ERP software's application pattern as a breakthrough point, analyzes the different application patterns of ERP software and the operation flow, based on which, from a scope and angle of the computer Audit, the paper has carried on the analysis of the process on the computer Audit.

articleTitle: The agile software development method in the domain of digital standard test
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the development of network technology in modern society, various industries have raised their own standards, the standard test is the test information generated by the system description model to xml standards to judge whether the information system standards. This paper proposes an agile software development method in the domain of digital standard test: component-based product line, and designs product line architecture, core asset library framework and trustworthiness assurance framework.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The influence factors of firm innovation based on organizational learning and knowledge management are deeply analyzed theoretically in this paper. The relationships model between organizational learning, knowledge management and firm innovation is built and tested empirically. The result of the study indicates that knowledge management plays an important role between organizational learning and firm innovation. It develops and enriches the theories of organizational learning and firm innovation, and has a helpful practical guidance significance to increase the innovation capacity of firms.

abstract: According to the analysis of calculation business and the usage of correlation function in Excel, some examples were proposed using Excel function in tendering agency business. The model of calculation management system was established by Excel VBA. To use Excel VBA is basis for management system implementation and other small-scale management system.

articleTitle: Research of multi_interactive behavior of human resources training on Web-based environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Currently, the Web-based training of human resources to carry out the research focus has gradually shifted from learning platform development, design resources on the network turned to the analysis of learning behavior. From the perspective of educational technology theory, we study the learning behavior theory of human resources training on Web-based environment and analysis of the network environment interactions deeply. For learning disability problem in web learning, multi-interactive behavior and some reasonable proposals is proposed in the paper. It has a certain depth guidance and reference function to the network human resources training of enterprise.

articleTitle: The images filtering information system for website images
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is an internal requirement for filtering the data in a web application. Methods are mature for text context filtering, but they are difficult to filter images for some troublesome reasons: one is the requirement of accuracy rate and efficiency another one is the combination with the exist application system to improve the value of images retrieval system. For filtering the image, the first task is the image's retrieval problem. In this paper, a method of color correlogram is applied for retrieval system and the architecture is given to control users' uploading images. Lastly, a real system is presented to prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the payment guarantee and operation sustainability of maternity insurance fund: Analysis of three simulation conditions on Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the actuarial model, this paper analyzes the payment guarantee and operation sustainability of maternity insurance fund. By forecasting different economic growth situations, average level of annual salary, insured maternity population and medical expenditure growth rates, this paper has done a simulation research on the different policies scenarios. The result shows: the current residual ratio of maternity insurance fund is high and there exists policy adjustable space to improve the efficiency of the maternity insurance mechanism such as broaden the insurance coverage, take a higher payment ratio.

articleTitle: Financial exclusion of migrant workers: The evidence from eastern typical city investigation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the investigation on 800 migrant workers in Hangzhou, this report analyses the factors impacting financial investment behavior of migrant workers quantitatively by binary Logistic model. It draws a conclusion that the income and the family scale are the most important two factors impacting financial exclusion degree of migrant workers. The lower the educational level, the higher the financial exclusion degree. Different kinds of financial exclusion have different influencing factor. Based on the above discovery, we put forward propositions to improve financial investment behavior of migrant workers, thus raise the property income of migrant workers.

abstract: The level of knowledge management of Doctor and Master Degree Programs directly affects quality of university degree education. On the basis of analysis of university degree programs knowledge management and its performance evaluation, we established the university degree programs knowledge management performance evaluation system, through combining the analytical hierarchy process with fuzzy evaluation based on triangular fuzzy numbers, evaluation model was put forward, it provides a new method for the evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on enterprise knowledge management strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The knowledge management is the inevitable product of the information tehnology's swift development and the era of knowledge economy's arrival. It is essential to have a research on the knowledge management. This article analyses primary mission and influencing factor in knowledge management, and analyses the knowledge management question based on knowledge management's three big classical models deeply. Based on these, this article proposes knowledge management strategies about balancing the technique and person, and the recessive knowledge dominance in knowledge management. It provides a new mentality which has the reference value for the knowledge management.

articleTitle: Research of customer churn prediction model in a supermarket
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With economic development and social progress, supermarket has become the main channel of everyday consumption of people. How to keep existing customers in the fierce competition is the key problem of the competition between supermarket enterprises. The weighted factor and weighted entropy of information were introduced on the basis of traditional C4.5 decision making tree arithmetic. The customer churn prediction model in a supermarket was established based on the improved C4.5 decision making tree arithmetic, which predicted the loss of supermarket customers. The results show that the prediction model has the better validity and stability, and can provide more effective support for decision-making of governor in the area of supermarket customer management.

Finally, it makes a rough theoretical frame for the supply chain management of metropolitan areas.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This study intends to validate the DeLone and McLean's IS success model in the context of hotels from the perspective of employees. The model consists of six constructs: information quality, system quality, service quality, systems use, user satisfaction, and net benefits. Structural equation modeling techniques are applied to data collected by the questionnaires from 303 employees of the hotels in Taiwan. Except for the path from information quality to systems use, the hypothesized relationships between the six success variables are significantly supported by the data. The findings provide several important implications for hotel information systems success research and practice.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

Through an overall consideration of various factors of trade finance risk, it breakdowns indicators step by step from banks' risk aspect, clients' risk aspect and counterparties' risk aspeck, computes the trade finance business comprehensive risk degree. articleTitle: The application of link prediction in web recommendation systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The link prediction in complex networks is about how to predict the possibility about the connection of unknown nodes via analyzing known nodes inside the network. Considering the current needs of the education websites as the starting point, this paper introduces the specific content of the link prediction based on detailed link-node similarity prediction methods. And this paper describes the measurement accuracy of the node similarity. This provides a guideline for the development of web recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Grey decision making on selection mode of B2C e-business logistics distribution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Logistics distribution of business model is divided into four categories in the paper. Analyzing the intrinsic properties of all kinds of logistics distribution modes, the paper uses the grey situation decision method to compare with and analyze four main logistics distribution modes. It can help enterprises to choose the right distribution model, reduce costs and improve customer service levels. Provide theoretical reference in the choice of B2C e-commerce business logistics distribution models on the overall evaluation of each factor.

articleTitle: Research of the campus E-government network security management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

So it's not convenient for buyers to compare the target sellers. This paper analyzes the c2c platform in China and proposes an improved model. The improved model considers the total numbers of exchanging, taking the average exchange credit score as the index which assess the seller's exchanging credit. Besides, the improved model uses entropy theory to propose a compound credit index to assess the seller's comprehensive credit. In order to determine each coefficient in the model, large scale of real c2c market data is required, so this study develops an data collection program to crawl data from current c2c platform, taobao is the target because of its market share in China. Finally this study uses another part of data to analyze the result of computation.

articleTitle: The impact of the tradeoff between incentives and spillovers on intellectual property rights system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper builds a model for evaluating the influence of innovation spillovers on innovation activity and benefits, based on the tradeoff between innovation incentives and spillovers. Some major findings are: 1) The decline in innovation activity caused by spillovers is partially offset by the beneficially distributive externalities from spillovers; 2) The relationship between total innovation benefit and spillover ratio takes on approximately inverted U-shaped, so do workers' benefit and innovators' benefit. Spillover ratios corresponding to workers' and innovators' benefit maximization constitute a Pareto optimal ratio interval of spillover. Moreover, the ratio corresponding to total innovation benefit maximization is within the interval; 3) The shape of total innovation benefit curve depends on the nature of innovation and intellectual property rights system. In addition, the smoother the total innovation benefit curve is, the wider the Pareto optimal ratio interval of spillover becomes. This study sharpens our understanding on innovation spillover effects. In practice, it sheds light on design and implementation of intellectual property rights system.

So, utilizing existed data to do statistic analysis and determine the efficiency of future promotions becomes essential and available. In this article, we use Generalized Linear Models to analyze data, get the prediction results and propose ROC, AUC statistics to test the model. Finally, we use the Cumulative Proportional Odds Model to categorize the different customers, and assess customer's response probability of buying goods. These analyses can provide data support to the promotion plans.

However, only a part of return used products from customers are recovered and the rest are disposed off due to the lower price of the recovered products. The inventory decision-making models on the unit time total profit are formulated under one manufacturing setup and one recovering setup policy, and these models are reduced to the functions with respect only to recovery ratio and recovering lot-size by the elimination theory, and finally the formulae on the optimal manufacturing and recovering lot-sizes, recovery ratio and others are derived. abstract: With the help of principal component analysis, by constructing the index system of regional cultural competition, the regional cultural competition in Henan Province is analyzed. The results show that the model of regional culture competition can fully reflect the cultural competition of urban area, which reflects the input level and consumption level on culture. It is conducive to fully reflect and measure the regional level of urbanization, and find defects and deficiencies of the development process. It can also provide the basis to improve the level for the city.

articleTitle: Research on risk cost measure of large project based on VaR theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Useing Var theory to measure cost risk of large project is new idea in measure risk cost. The paper extended Var concept and calculating principle in Finance to project cost management field, establishing investment portfolio based on construction project and proposing new connotation of Var calculating theory in cost risk management area. Then an example was applicated to verify the feasibility of this research thought. At last further research focused in Var calculated method to be applied to cost risk. This explore is the foundation of deep research cost risk management of large project and its purpose is to provide quantitative decision-making support of the field.

articleTitle: Political business cycles: Evidence from Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea using panel data approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper uses a panel vector autoregressive model to examine the existence of political business cycles across Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea over the 1988 to 2008 period. The empirical results indicate that the electoral dummy variable has a significantly positive impact on the government expenditures. The government expenditures in the election year and the previous year of election are significantly increased. There is evidence supporting the political business cycles across Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea. Therefore, reducing public debts caused by the candidates' election promises may be a way to improve the situation of government fiscal worsening.

articleTitle: Competition among local governments under transition of economic development models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Since 1978 of reform and opening up policy, China's economy achieved an average annual 9.67 % growth rate. It's well known as the "China miracle". What are the factors relating to China's economic miracle? Taking such basic conditions as natural resource, human capital and R&D, China has no obvious advantage which compared to other countries. In recent years, more and more scholars think that the competition among local governments is a major cause of China's economic growth. Competition is inevitable under scarcity. Currently, China's development faces a crucial period of transition, Which effects competition to the economic transformation. Does the existing mode of competition sustain? The purpose of this paper is to make competition among local government into a good mode by promoting government's capacity. This paper attempts to discuss the behavior of local government in change of economic development models. This paper could be divided into four parts. The first part introduces the background and significance of the research. The second part discusses the active and negative effects brought by the competition to economic development. The third part analyzes how local governments adjust their objectives, behavior, method and model in the competition. The last part gives some suggestions about constructing new local government competition.

articleTitle: Modeling dependence structure of the risk measure on exchange market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper examines the structure of dependence in Europe and in Asia international exchange rate markets using extreme value theory and copula functions. We nest copula function to construct the joint distribution so that the linear correlation coefficient, which is the far most used measure to test dependence in financial community, can be well represented by nonlinear dependent construction. And the joint distribution can be divided into dependence pattern and margin distribution. Thus, the margin distribution is described by General Pareto Distribution (GPD) and the dependence structure is used copula functions. The empirical results show that the Copula-GPD model is able to characterize the exchange rate market, and their dependence patterns can be thoroughly described using the mixed copula.

articleTitle: The impact of technology-sourcing outward FDI in the upgrading of global value chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The developing countries who are embedded in the low end of global value chain can realize industrial upgrading through outward FDI, which helps them to be geographically adjacent to companies with high technology and take the advantage of technological diffusion. The precondition for outward FDI is that the net present value of the marginal cost reduction brought by Outward FDI is larger than its average fixed cost. The conceptual framework of Outward FDI of two companies is constructed. It is found that sales turnover and industrial wage are two key factors impacting on outward FDI despite that it is process upgrading or product upgrading that contributes to its moving forward in value chain. Large global sales turnover helps realizing economy of scale and splitting investment cost. The high wage rate improves the importance of technology in the competition with companies in developed countries.

articleTitle: Stochastic scheduling algorithm for multiple mould and die manufacturing projects and its simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Through the analysis of uncertainties of the durations, costs and rewards as well as the characteristic of frequent repairing in the mould and die manufacturing project, this paper proposed a stochastic evolution model of multiple mould and die manufacturing projects, which was on the basis of a discrete time Markov chain. With the aim to overcome the ‘curse of dimensionality’, an algorithm framework combining parallel simulation of heuristic policies with MATLAB Distributed Computing Server and Q-Learning was put forward to solve the above stochastic dynamic programming model. Finally, such an algorithm framework was explained with a sample example. The results show that the model is applicable and the algorithm is reliable and effective as well.

Author Keywords: multiple mould and die manufacturing projects

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The correct investment decision is the key to achieve the objective of the electric power projects. As the increasing to the investment amount of the electric power projects in China, how to select an optimal investment program has became a important problem to the related party. The paper established a investment decision evaluation system about the electric power projects and a grey relational assessment model based on Entropy theory, that based on the characteristics of the electric power projects and the principle of establishing the evaluation indicators, which not only reflected the relevancy of each indicator, but also embody the difference of the indicators. The result showed that the credit evaluation system and assessment model would provide a perfect guide to the choice of investment program about the electric power projects.

articleTitle: Application and influence of reputation model in domain name management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Domain Name is a scarcity finite resource and is the base for internet business operation well. Enterprises could build websites to expand its value chain through register domain names. But the phenomenon of improper competition frequently occurred because of many companies domain name has been Cyber-squatting, so brought very large negative impact to the function of market reputation mechanisms. This thesis analyzing the many problems of improper domain management used reputation model, demonstrated and discusses the problems in the domain management how to impact the corporate reputation, and that provides a theoretical reference for motivating enterprises to formulate their perfect domain name management strategies and systems. Finally give some suggestions to the domain name management.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The rapid develop and broad apply of modern information technology, has already impact profoundly on teaching and learning. Through the analysis on web-based "Jusu-In-Time Teaching (JiTT)" pattern, and the application in the open course of "Video Art and DV", we discussed the practical effect of this teaching pattern. The results show that this model can greatly enhance students' interest on independently learning; improve students' capability of active thinking and practical skills, and promote the formation and ability of innovation. That's to say, it gets great achievements in teaching.

articleTitle: Game analysis of buyer power's impact on the manufacturer's quality improvements
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Enterprise innovation has always been a hot global topic. Combining with the reality of the increasing buyer power in recent years, this paper analyzes the impact of buyer power on manufacturers' product quality improvements. Our game model shows that an increase in buyer power will lower the level of product quality supplied to consumers, and eventually do harm to the social welfare.

This paper provides a theoretical framework to analyze how the heterogeneity promoting industrial evolution under the conditions of cost difference and product diversity. Then we draw a conclusion that both the heterogeneity among firms and the technology innovation could promote industrial evolution.

articleTitle: Knowledge management system on outsourcing service enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Under the circumstances of economic globalization, outsourcing is becoming the dominant mode in the wave of global industrial transfer. The Outsourcing Service industry in China is rapidly developing, so is Outsourcing Service enterprise, and knowledge management has become the core competitiveness in this field resulting from the special function of knowledge in Outsourcing Service enterprises. The knowledge management system on Outsourcing Service enterprise has been designed according to the work flow of the knowledge management on service outsourcing, in order to improve the core competitiveness of the enterprise. There are mainly six parts in the system, which are knowledge acquisition, knowledge sharing, knowledge transfer, knowledge creation and application process of knowledge. Knowledge acquisition needs to build a large knowledge warehouse, and knowledge sharing can integrate knowledge to form one of the enterprise's own, then, undergoing transfer and creativity for knowledge, the goal of enterprise to apply knowledge can be achieved, and the core competitiveness of Outsourcing Service enterprise can be improved.

In the era of e-commerce, enterprise all must adapt to the e-commerce requirements. Logistics activities are an important part of e-commerce, the value realization of electronic commerce plays a vital role. The relationship between e-commerce, logistics and information technology has been explored in detail. At the same time their mutual promoting development has been analyzed in the paper.

articleTitle: Situation analysis of boxed pigs games
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to obtain the solutions coinciding with qualitative results appeared in some literatures to boxed pigs game by strict mathematical tools, we use situation analysis of 2 person double action games with entropy to study the model on games boxed pigs with variable parameters. We obtain the probability distribution with the smallest information entropy over the set of all the pure situations whose marginal distributions form the unique completely mixed Nash equilibrium. Empirical results show that our results can be used as the problem of indicator design about games of boxed pigs and the analysis methods are mathematical and deep, instead of intuitive.

articleTitle: A novel CAPTCHA based on digital image information hiding
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is a normal method that CAPTCHA is used to distinguish general users from software robots in E-Business website. With the rapid development of reCAPTCHA, traditional simple CAPTCHA is facing the challenge of being cracked, while too complicated CAPTCHA is difficult for users to identify. This paper proposes a novel CAPTCHA based on digital image information hiding, which is easy for users to identify while hardly cracked by the robots. Theoretical analysis and simulation experiments indicate that this method is effective and safe.

articleTitle: A study on clothing e-commerce based on Web Competitive Intelligence System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Facing the fierce competition at home and abroad, the Chinese clothing enterprises' should not only improve their innovative ability and brand reputations, but also know well about their competitors and the whole fashion industry, if they want to survive and develop in today's global market. Ecommerce platforms and the Competitive Intelligence Systems (CIS) can provide the most effective means for them to get such useful information. However, despite the fact that most small and medium-sized Chinese clothing enterprises have begun to use clothing e-commerce platforms to release or get supply-demand information, most of them have a lot of difficulties building their own competitive intelligence systems for human or financial reasons. This paper is based on a study which is designed to establish a seamless connection between the clothing e-commerce systems and the Competitive Intelligence Systems in order to provide an integrated platform of e-commerce and competitive intelligence system for the small and medium-sized enterprises so that they can make efficient and right decisions.

articleTitle: Economic analysis on the implementation effect of the proactive fiscal policy in Liaoning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the Liaoning economic time series data from 1985 to 2009, The paper applies VAR mode and VEC model to analyze the implementation effects of fiscal policy in Liaoning. The empirical study indicates that among fiscal expenditure, money supply, and real GDP in Liaoning, there exists a co-integration relationship. Fiscal expenditure will promote the economic growth. It can be supported by relevant empirical tests that the proactive fiscal policies which were implemented in Liaoning have a long effect on the problems of driving investment, stimulating economic growth, adjusting the industrial structure, and solving the insufficient domestic demand and so on.

articleTitle: A study on system construction of community service informatization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Great achievements have been made since the development of information construction of urban community-based service in China. However, the unified network platform of community service has not appeared which can effectively integrate all the information of government, enterprise, nonprofit organization and resident. It remains a challenge to build up a future oriented information system of community service. Based on the driving force analysis, this paper attempts to design the structure and operation mode of information system of community service tentatively, and describe the concrete construction content in detail.

articleTitle: Discussion on the theories for the appearance of the 4PL: The integration of modern division and exchange cost in the background of booming E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: 4PL is the new type of outsourcing in logistics services, of which the appearance is not only on the basis of the development of IT, but also the application of the Theories about the Modern Division and Exchange Cost. This paper analyzes the feasibility and necessity of the appearance of the 4PL from the prospective of the E-commerce as the basis of the 4PL, according to the Modern Division Theory and the Exchange Cost Theory, and then gets the proof to illustrate that the appearance of 4Pl is the final result of cost-cut and the increase of efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance-evaluation modeling of reverse logistics systems implementing in palletrental industries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Rapid growth of raw material usage has resulted in supply shortages and soaring prices worldwide, where eco-solutions become promisingly important and thus a trend. Under such a situation and a heavily competitive environment, enterprises desiring to remain current are required not only to enhance their competitiveness but, more importantly, to reduce their costs. Reverse logistics is a eco-strategy for reducing production cost; however, it accompanies with an even higher managerial counterpart. In this research, we establish a model in which prediction and decision supporting are conducted in order to greatly reduce managerial cost as well as increase performances. The model integrates a vendor manage inventory concept, the UHF RFID technology, a simulation system (e.g. eM-Plant) and a neural-based predicting component for achieving the goal of reducing managerial cost. With the proposed model, enterprises could determine the indices of recycling, production and scheduling, and therefore a dynamic approach for estimating shortages at each workstation can be accomplished, which could dramatically decrease the cost suffered from routing, inventory and resource allocations. Future work will be focused on optimization of the estimated indices, where a decision supporting system for reverse logistics could be accomplished.

articleTitle: A study on the developmental transfer model of surplus rural labor in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to statistic data, there are more than five million surplus labors in rural area of Hubei Province that need to be transferred. Namely, even though surplus labor can be transferred with an annual number of 450000 people, the pressure of employment will still be a great problem by the year of 2020. In fact, the transfer process of rural surplus labors should also be taken as a promotion process of rural human capital to the largest degree. So it is an essential issue to explore a new transfer model of rural surplus labors in Hubei province which focus more on the qualification requirements of non-agricultural industry in the urban area. In this transfer model, rural surplus labors are taken as precious human resource. They are properly developed with well-planed program like: skill-training, employment guidance, skill improvement and security system. The professional skill training grogram should be designed with regional features, for example, surplus labors of each county may focus on one special skill in order to form regional advantage of cluster and bring competitive and influential labor brand into being. To effectively transfer rural surplus labors, researchers of all countries around the world have explored many unique and useful models. But most of them have obvious defects at the same time since most models can only desire the quantity needs, but not the quality needs of urban development. They are a transfer of rural surplus labors with low professional skills and education level. Transferred rural labors are facing great challenge of employment and survival in their urban life. With prospect of human resource training and development, this article discusses the developmental transfer model and its significances in transfer of Hubei rural surplus labors.

articleTitle: Using decomposed theory of Planned Behavior to explain virtual currency use intention
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Virtual currency has become an increasingly popular business model in famous social networking sites in recent years. (e.g., Facebook, i-part, Tencent QQ). Virtual currency, therefore, users can easily complete their trade online. In this study, a theoretical model based on decomposed Theory of Planned Behaviors(TPB) is proposed to explain and predict users' intentions to continue using virtual currency. The hypothesized model is validated empirically by using a sample collected from 421 experienced users. The results demonstrate that use intention of virtual currency is strongly associated with TPB factors: attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavior control. The effect of decomposed factors, micropayment has the most influential effect on attitude; close friends influence is a major determinant of subjective norms; and internet self-efficacy is a major determinant of perceived behavior control. Suggestions and implications are proposed in the final section.

articleTitle: Combining partial least squares regression and least squares support vector machine for data mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: PLS can effectively eliminate the multicolinearity among explanatory variables and LSSVM can reflect the nonlinear relations between dependent variable and explanatory variables. PLS and LSSVM are combined together. In PLS-LSSVM model, PLS is used to extract the independent components, then the extracted components is input to the LSSVM with radial basis kernel function for predicting. The LSSVM parameters are determined by cross validation based on grid search. The experiment results of PLS-LSSVM are compared with partial least squares regress, which show that PLS-LSSVM model can be trained quickly and has good generalization.

articleTitle: Evaluating the static and dynamic environmental performance of HSFs: Based on DEA and MPI approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Due to long-term exploration with insufficient conservation, the resources and environment in Heilongjiang state farms (HSFs) have been impacted and influenced to some extent. However, the environmental problem of HSFS has received minimum attention, so it is very important to evaluate the environmental production efficiency and the productivity of HSFs. In this article, methods of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and Malmquist Productivity Index (MPI) are applied to examine the environmental production of 10 bureaus in HSFS for 5 consecutive years. Consequently, inefficiencies are found in 8 of the total 10 bureaus from static perspective, and the great improvement has taken place in each bureau's overall environmental performance toward a dynamic perspective, especially in its technical change, which can provide helpful information to improve the environmental performance of HSFs.

articleTitle: A AHP(analytic hierarchy process) strategic decision model study of Chinese retail industry green supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The retail industry is connecting the upstream Production enterprise and downstream consumer, and Chinese retail industry has already been deepened from own energy conservation environmental protection, gradually to green supply chain management. In view of China domestic Retail business's development present situation, this article starts from the analysis of the environment friendly practice's environmental standard and the system, the green cooperation, the recycling use and the waste disposal. Basing on hierarchical framework, and using the AHP law analysis tool, we use an example to analyse the implementation situation of environment friendly practice part in the retail industry green supply chain, and emphasize the importance of environment friendly practice for developing the retail industry green supply chain.

articleTitle: The metadata encoding of digital content
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to the Dublin Core, the international Cataloguing Principles and survey results, we determine the basic metadata elements of digital content and get the metadata table including essential elements and non-essential elements. Based on the sort of metadata elements obtained in survey results, we encode the metadata with main elements, which customers are most concerned about. And then we make a detailed code design of the most complex field-theme, forming a unique identifier for digital contents, which will improve the efficiency of digital content's storage and retrieval.

articleTitle: The practice research of process-oriented knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to effectively manage a large number enterprise knowledge scattered in the process, this paper dose some detailed analysis and design in steps and methods of process-oriented knowledge management, puts forward a kind of knowledge management process, creates a route of knowledge accumulation and mining, and knowledge organization and storage from process, which provides a reference for knowledge management practice of small and medium-sized enterprises.

articleTitle: The equilibrium model between the financial risk and the efficiency for diversified financial operation: An example of financial conglomerates model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Diversified financial operation has its advantages such as the economics of scale, economics of scope and X-efficiency. Meanwhile, it also causes complex special financial risks. When the cost of the integration and supervision equals the incremental non-risk return and risk premium return, the financial conglomerates achieve the equilibrium of the minimum of the risk and the maximum of the profit.

articleTitle: How to build an attractive corporate website — To business managers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the network technology and applications, more and more companies choose to create their own web site to open up new business market and enhance their core competitiveness. In this article, we first introduce what enterprises should analyse before building their website, and we focuse on definition of site objectives, site user analysis, the analysis of technical level, the cost and profit of site. And when designing the web site, what will be present in the site, the update of information and building brand should be considered. At the end of the paper, implementation and management are proposed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Challenges of mobile learning in 4G era
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The roadmap of ERP development research based on the information hierarchy value chain theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The ERP system collects the information through the firm's whole value creation process, so it is reasonable to use the value chain theory to analyze ERP development. Firstly, the extended information hierarchy value chain theory (EIHVCT) was advanced based on the value chain theory and information hierarchy theory. Second, the validity of EIHVCT was conducted through the elaboration of the ERP history and future trend. Finally, a case study was analyzed to further explain the practical effects of EIHVCT, and the porter's value chain theory was supplemented.

articleTitle: Classification of consumers' adoption of charged online movies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The consumers were divided into 5 types, i.e., the fashioners, the potentials, the bardians, the followers and the conservatives, based on the scores of the factors that affect consumers' adoption of the charged online movies (COM) by cluster analysis using the questionnaire data, and in which the largest part was the potentials where the least the followers. And, on the other hand, three types of consumers, the weak, the common and the strong, were classed according to their adoption extent to COM, and about 60% consumers were clustered to the weak category. The order of 5 types consumers according to their adoption extent to COM from strong to weak is the potentials, the fashioners, the bardians, the followers and the conservatives. In the end, the different marketing proposals were put forward to the different types of the consumers for the suppliers of online movies.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comparative analysis of Chinese and western sporting goods enterprises' growth pattern
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The research of the Broad-spectrum Philosophy as the foundational and original subject
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Board characteristics and board monitoring function — Evidence from listed company of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The literature on the relationships between board attributes and corporate performance is mixed, and one important reason is that the intermediate variable, i.e., board behaviors are ignored. With the data coming from listed company of China, the paper empirically researches the relationship between the characteristics and monitoring function of board. Using Principal Component Analysis, we get 6 variables reflecting the characteristics of board and 4 variables for the monitoring function. The study shows that the share held ratio of board's members has a negative impact on the directing function of board significantly, but the gender ratio and the average age of board members has a positive impact on the position function of board significantly. This may be valuable to regulate the behavior of board.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical analysis on the relationship between the values of real estate industry and the values of tertiary industry in China

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Blend-learning mode of artistic design education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on blend-learning and constructivism educational theory, comprehensive curriculum, assessment, and training resources can be designed to be perfect fit for college students who learn art and design so that students can be trained to use their brains more effectively.

articleTitle: Hierarchical linear analysis of the factors affecting C2C online bids
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The influencing factors on the C2C online bids can be divided in product level and seller level in this paper. We explore the relations between the cross-level using the HLM. The results show that the price and description will respectively have a major impact on the CSS and the CSS between different sellers also have significant differences. The Feedback score and the Positive feedback of sellers will respectively have an impact on the CSS. The Feedback score and the Positive feedback of sellers will respectively strengthen the negative correlation between price and the CSS as well as the positive correlation between information description and the CSS.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of northern existing residential buildings energy conservation retrofit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An empirical analysis on farmer investment in human capital effect on agricultural growth in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Management, supervision and innovation of investment and financing of the urban infrastructure in developed country
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Security function and mechanism of social networks on vulnerable groups: A theoretic framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the course to establish a harmonious society, social security of vulnerable groups has been catching special attentions from the government. But until recently, almost all the research on social security of vulnerable groups has focused on formal security systems, and research on informal systems as security functions and mechanisms of social networks severely lags behind. This study advances that there are four security functions of vulnerable groups' social networks: material security, safety security, spirit security, and respect security; deeply analyzes the achievement mechanisms of these four types of security functions. We further considers that social networks contains individual and social level social capital which can provide vulnerable groups with information, resources, prestige, social shelter and other network effects, and theses network effects achieve social security functions on vulnerable groups in the form of meeting their material, safety, spirit, respect needs.

articleTitle: Research and design of e-government teaching system in higher education institution: An example of e-government experiment course in school of public administration of Zhejiang Gongshang University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The experiment teaching is the important part of the e-government course. The demands of government infomationization also require the higher education institution to cultivate the students to have the advanced information technology and rich management theory. This requires the colleges and universities to innovate the e-government course. The practical experiment programs should be taken into the teaching system of e-government, and the teaching plan should be reformed. Based on the analysis of current situation of e-government experiment teaching, this paper would point out the building principles and objectives of the e-government experiment teaching system. And this paper would take the example of e-government experiment course in school of Public Administration of Zhejiang University, to analyze the reform and practice situation of e-government experiment teaching system from these four dimensions: the experimental environment, experimental content, teaching human resource and teaching hours.

articleTitle: Bank lending channel, informal finance and monetary transmission in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper discusses the bank lending channel in China. Through VAR analysis, this paper finds that the bank lending channel is relevant in transmitting monetary policies: both bank loans and GDP decrease after an interest rate decrease; we also show that securities are regarded as a “buffer stock” in banks to offset monetary shocks. This paper also highlights a “puzzle”: The decreasing of bank loans cannot quickly affect real GDP. In order to explain this puzzle, from the perspective of financing channels, this paper finds that the development of informal finance in China shows an important reason to restrict the effectiveness of the credit channel in transmitting monetary policy: through a model in which informal finance is included, this paper finds that a contractionary monetary policy will reduce the threshold so that the firms with lower assets can get the informal finance to carry out their projects. The existence of a great amount of informal financing in China has reduced the ability of monetary policy to control the economy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design method of air drying dehumidification system for main cables of suspension bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: University-entrepreneur trust and sustainable small business enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Model and path of low-carbon economic development of Eco-economy zone of Poyang Lake
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of low carbon development of this region, with ecological economics and scientific outlook on development as theoretical guidance, humans as orientation, and “low energy consumption, low pollution and low emission” as development core, the research worked out the four modes of low carbon development of this region: mode of energy science and technology innovation, mode of production system improvement, mode of industry structure optimization and mode of consumption concept transformation, proposed that Jiangxi should rely on science and technology, attach great importance to the development and utilization of clean energy such as solar power, hydropower and wind power; accomplish clean, intensive and cyclic production; vigorously develop eco-agriculture and eco-tourism through industry structure optimization and adjustment; cultivate people's habit of low carbon consumption.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Status and countermeasures of application of e-commerce in China's small and medium-sized enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Vitality evaluation of the grain lifeline system in Henan province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Grain is the key factor for social development. Through the vitality evaluation of the grain lifeline system of Henan province China, several appropriate proposals are provided in this paper to increase the vitality of the system. Firstly, the evaluation indexes are established based on process and security vitality indicators. Then the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation analysis is applied to evaluate the vitality level of the grain lifeline system. The results of the analysis, as long as the historical data comparison, show that the vitality level of the grain lifeline system is common, which mainly because of the weakly foundation security system of grain in Henan province. So the urgent task for increasing the vitality of the grain lifeline system in Henan province is to improve the effect of the grain security system.

articleTitle: State ownership, government intervention and big four's auditing quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Wang, Wong and Xia(2008) suggest that for ease of collusion, the local SOEs have incentives to choose local, small auditors in the under-marketization province. We argue this institutional environment affect auditing quality of big four too. This paper indicate that in the high local government intervention province, big four's local SOEs auditing quality is significantly lower than that of low local government intervention province. Also, because of the intervention, big four's non-state firms auditing quality is significantly higher than big four's local SOEs auditing quality. My findings suggest that ownership structure and institutional environment result in the cross sectional difference of big four's auditing quality in China.

articleTitle: A study on the coordination incentive strategy of new service development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In purpose of running new service development (NSD) better, service enterprises should establish an intimate relationship with relevant external subjects. How to acquire maximal benefits from the collaborative network through incentive is a problem to be solved immediately. This paper proposes a collaborative network of NSD among service enterprise, customers, suppliers, agents and competitors. A coordination incentive model of service enterprises is offered based on information sharing using the principal-agent theory. The model is analyzed from three aspects: external environment, network characteristics and network subjects. Finally, this paper provides some rational incentive strategies for service firms.

articleTitle: The influence of relational and structural embeddedness in Global Manufacturing Network on firm performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Global Manufacturing Network provides an opportunity for firms in developing country or region to join in the system of international division of labor, conduct technological learning and realize strategic upgrading. But how is the firm embedded in the GMN to acquire network resources? The paper explored the relationship between relational embeddedness and structural embeddedness and firm performance through the questionnaire survey. The paper found that the three dimensions of trust, information sharing and joint problem solving in relational embeddedness have positive effects on firm performance. And the centrality which is the indictor of structural embeddedness also has positive effects on firm performance. Some implications and limitations are discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Optimization management of nightscape lighting for high-rise dwellings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Analysis on key factors of private banking services quality management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Private banking services is a newly emerged business for chinese banking industry. Based on SERVQUAL model and considering the problems which exist in the quality management of chinese banking industry, this paper suggest that commercial bank should pay more attention on three key factors which include reliability, assurance and return on products.

articleTitle: Long-run and short-run budgeting for Taiwan and China: Evidence from panel data analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper we use multivariate panel error correction models (PECMs) to investigate the long and short-run budgetary decision making of Taiwan and China over the 1965 to 2008 period. The empirical results show that, in the long run, for both Taiwan and China, government revenues and expenditures adjust towards budgetary balance supporting the fiscal synchronization hypothesis. In the short run, incrementalism occurs in both Taiwan and China. Although Taiwan and China have similarities in culture, language, and even in way of living, the two have vastly different government systems. Interestingly, the nature of the long run and short-run budgetary process for these two countries are surprisingly similar.

articleTitle: Empirical research on relation of industrial structure and export structure of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Since reform and opening up, China's export trade has developed rapidly. This paper analyzes the relationship between industrial structure and the structure of exports basing on Granger Cointegration Test and Chenery Model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Portal websites evaluation of Heilongjiang municipal-scale e-government in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A novel career success evaluation model of Chinese managers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As Chinese managers concentrate on career success, one issue with the most concern is how their career success is prepared, realized, and evaluated. However, recent research neglects career success evaluation model of Chinese managers. Based on career theory with the theory applied in recent career success research, the paper aims at establishing a novel career success evaluation model of Chinese Managers. After collecting 466 questionnaires from Xi'an, Beijing, Shanghai and other cities, the author has analyzed and managed to establish career success evaluation model of Chinese managers. The model consists of 3 dimensions, 6 factors and 29 indexes. 29 indexes belong to six factors that is “self satisfaction”, “surrounding approval”, “personal wealth”, ” post influence”, “maintain and development ability” and “promotion capacity”. These factors that belongs to “career satisfaction”, “career objective results” and “professional core competitiveness” in three dimensions. The result of the studies indicates that the model has high reliability, the study on career success of the Chinese cultural context has an important theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute procurement auctions based on Cobb-Douglas utility function
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In practical multi-attribute procurement auctions, the profit and winning a contract have different importance to the suppliers. This paper assumes that the suppliers weight the profit and probability of winning a contract with Cobb-Douglas utility function, obtains the suppliers' equilibrium bidding strategies and the buyer' expected utilities in the first- and second-score auctions, and compares them with those under risk-neutral.

articleTitle: Adaptive selection relaying protocols with opportunistic relaying in multiple-relay cooperative networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Cooperative communications is a promising technique to improve high data-rate coverage in the future communications systems, the strategies about selection relays have a huge effect on the performance of system. In this letter, we study two strategies about adaptive selection relaying protocols with opportunistic relaying. Moreover, the asymptotic outage probability was derived. Results show that the outage probability of two strategies outperforms the traditional opportunistic relaying.

articleTitle: Research on competitive factors and critical success rules in e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet has created a significant level of variation in commerce. The commercial prototype trusted by the traditional entity market has no longer been suitable for the Internet virtual market. This paper focuses on the competitive factors that may impact e-commerce development and provides success laws. In this paper, we fist identify differences between traditional management and Internet management. Then we provide factors such as new entrant, substitute, buyers' bargaining power, suppliers' bargaining power, local area competition that influence every aspect of e-commerce. Our research also shows successful Internet market laws. These laws are learning laws, network laws, uniqueness laws, pricing laws, efficiency laws, searching laws and cooperation laws.

articleTitle: Research on the relevance of the provision of local public goods and fiscal decentralization in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper researches on the relevance of the provision of local public goods and fiscal decentralization system in China. In order to test if the China's current fiscal decentralization system is conducive to the provision of local public goods, the paper establishes a linear measurement model by using provision level of local public goods as a interpreted variable and the degree of fiscal decentralization\GDP\the net transfer payment \the population size as explanatory variables.

articleTitle: Evaluation research of marketing performance of city gas station based on the behavioral process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the competitive market model, the performance of city gas station is created by the acts of sales, while the sales generated by the behavior of consumer awareness, consumer behavior, the competitive environment, marketing innovation, and other elements of composition, and the performance of the sales is the result of all the marketing elements. Based on this understanding, we consider the sales of consumer awareness, buying behavior, market structure, innovation, ect. factors for as the overall index. Also, according to the inner system of main indicator, we decompose the main indicators and construct the Marketing Performance Evaluation index system of city gas station. According to the characters of the index system, using the hierarchical analysis, taking the specific stations, we check the index we have built. The result shows that consumers' satisfaction, loyalty and their appreciation to the quality of service have great impact on the performance of marketing.

articleTitle: The effect of the changes in China's population age structure on the resident's consumption
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to the traditional consumption function theory, his paper makes an empirical research. Based on the existing study, selecte resident's consumption data of China, using China's provincial panel consumer data from 2000 to 2008 to analysis the relationship between population age structure and consumer behavior. The results showed that the youth dependency ratio and the old dependency ratio are positively correlated with consumption rate. The conclusion consistent with the life-cycle hypothesis, indicating that the changes of population age structure is an important factor affecting the resident consumption.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Empirical study of microscopic mechanism of intellectual property strategy system-based on data testing of listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Being an effective strategy, intellectual property strategy and its implementation aim to improve Chinese competitive advantages. Analysis of microscopic mechanism of intellectual property strategy system helps to improve the implementation of intellectual property strategy. Based on the survey of Chinese enterprises practice of intellectual property strategy by means of structural equation model, empirical research reveals the micro-operation mechanism of Chinese intellectual property strategy system, so as to provide realistic theory references for Chinese intellectual property strategy improvement.

articleTitle: Fractal modeling of logistics enterprise spatial organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Logistics company organization form is the fundamental guarantee to complete the basic tasks (freight flow). This paper analyzes the spatial organization characteristics of logistics corporation, and demonstrates the feasibility of the use of fractal theory on the spatial organization. In accordance with the similarity of human's transport system, combined with city and transportation system fractal character, the establishing principles of the company fractal organization is given. Inspired by the natural evolution of mankind, spatial self-organization features can be deduced. The design of spatial organization, directed by fractal theory, provides new ideas and methods to the spatial construction of enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Psychological contract violation and workplace deviance: The moderating role of negative reciprocity beliefs
