articleTitle: How adoption is G2C model E-Government? — Evidence from Xi' an and Nan Jing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, since 1990s, E-Government has become a vital tool for government to change its ways of work. In this research, we took Xi'an and Nan Jing municipal's E-Government as example, using questionnaires to survey citizens' adoption of G2C model E-Government. Then we used structural equation model to explore what factors influence citizens' intention of using E-Government. From our research we found that nowadays citizens seldom use E-Government in their daily life. The factors which can influence citizens' using intention including using experience, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, perceived risk, compatibility of E-Government system, trust to E-Government and the result visibility of using E-Government.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: What matters? An investigation of student collaborative e-learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Hybrid retention strategy formulation in telecom based on k-means clustering analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The formulation of appropriate retention strategy is a core issue of CRM. This paper proposed an idea of formulating hybrid strategy to retain valuable customers using clustering technology. The hybrid strategy is composed of the sub-strategies for different levels. The dataset of a Chinese telecom company is used as an illustrative case study to demonstrate the feasibility and rationality of the method.

articleTitle: A simulation research of innovation diffusion based on network externality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Innovation diffusion is a complex and dynamical process, and the diffusion process of many products show not only positive network externality but also negative network externality which is ususlly neglected by people. Based on scale-free network and heterogeneity of consumers, this paper discusses network externality fully by using computer simulation. We find that when we take into consideration of the negative side of network externality, innovations usually cannot diffuse so fully as we usually believe. And if the negative effect emerges at a later time, there will be more final adopters in the network. What's more, the heterogeneity of consumes plays a negative role in the diffusion process.

articleTitle: Optimal contract design of reverse supply chain considering uncertain recycle price
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Considering Chinese unique national condition for rapidly developing country, the main recycle model of reverse supply chain include two types, which are the flow of individual commerce wandering about the streets and their family workshop recycle patterns. Some moral hazard problem appears in this market, because of uncertain recycle price. Manufacturer has more information about recycle price, and provides the corresponding recycling price through evaluating the waster quality and forcing down the waster prices, so the recycler is imperfective information. The paper analyzes the optimal contract design for Chinese adverse supply chain considering the uncertain recycle price. At first, the business profit functions of manufacturer, retailer and recycler are supposed under the balanced wholesale prices and retail price. Secondly, the paper constructs the optimal contract model of reverse supply chain under the uncertain recycling price, and then gets the optimal recycling schemes under certain theoretical restricted condition. Lastly, the paper proposes measures to overcome the moral hazard problem of reverse supply chain because of fluctuating recycle price.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A quantitative research of the time buffer of Critical Chain Project Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Applying RFID to reduce bullwhip effect in a FMCG supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper provides a quantitative analysis of the reduction in the bullwhip effect, and the potential benefits thanks to real-time visibility of production flows provided by the Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology and other technologies. This paper is based on a Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) supply chain; the supply chain is composed of there echelons, namely manufacturers, distributors and retailers of FMCG, the RFID-based intra-SC system is implemented for the enterprise's warehouse in JiangSu province, china. The result show that RFID application can dramatically improve the efficiency of FMCG supply chain, And real-time visibility of supply chain can markedly reduce the bullwhip effect, and substantially affecting the economical profitability of the whole FMCG supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of cloud computing trend on E-government framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on E-government framework, in-depth explored the application approach of cloud computing technology in the field of E-government, and given the "Integration, Applications, Services, Efficiency, " as the main idea, which promoted the integration of government information resource and the intensification construction in E-government area. Based on the in-depth analysis of drawbacks on traditional building model in E-government, described the impact of cloud computing trend on E-government framework, and then proposed the establishment of the internet public cloud, government coordination OA cloud and core business private cloud, which are composed of the E-government hybrid cloud architecture.

articleTitle: Insurance pricing under uncertainty by means of distortion function
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Premium calculation or insurance pricing under uncertainty is a prominent problem in actuarial science. In this paper we present the distortion premium calculation principle in uncertain environment. Firstly, we introduce the concept of distortion premium calculation principle based on uncertainty theory. Then, some fundamental properties of the proposed distortion premium calculation principle are investigated. Finally, some numerical examples are illustrated.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Review: Recommender system in e-commercial environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Design and implementation of e-commerce communication system based on fingerprint authentication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Business via Internet is gaining more and more popularity. Despite its rapid growth, there are limitations like safety problems that hinder the expansion of e-commerce. This paper introduces a new practical system to insure security in ecommerce communication. This system not only provides instant messaging, but also offers diverse fingerprint authentication methods to meet the demand of different consumers.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical study on evaluating E-government in promoting local tourism based on fuzzy TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Cloud model of strategic M&A pricing based on real option method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The current Black-Scholes option pricing model is based on the assumption that prices of assets such as stocks subject to ITO (continuous Markov process). However, the value of assets for project may not always meet this assumption. Therefore there is subjectivity and arbitrariness. Cloud model can reflect the associative characteristics of fuzziness and randomness. The reverse cloud generator algorithm based on interval data can express the randomness of the intervals, which estimated by experts and provide the numerical features of cloud formation objectively in the process of generating cloud formation model. In this paper, we applied the option pricing theory-based normal cloud model and interval analysis the normal reverse combining interval analysis and the algorithm of reverse cloud model to offer a reasonable estimate of the strategic mergers and acquisitions pricing. At the end, a example is given to simulate verification of the model.

articleTitle: Usability research of interaction design for e-commerce Website
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Interaction design is a new discipline which comes from Human-Computer interaction and includes ergonomics, computer science, engineering, aesthetics, psychology and social sciences. Under the rapid development of computer technology, interaction design for e-commerce website is no longer bound by development of new technology, and focusing more attention on usability research and user experience with the user-centric-oriented aim. This paper depicts the relevant usability research and research process that improved interaction design for the e-commerce website. It leads to the view that interaction design and usability research is complementary to each other, and gives a research about how to be user-centered-oriented throughout the entire process of interaction design and usability research.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous beliefs, investor sentiment and A-H share premium
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on monthly data of dual-listed companies in A share and H share markets from November 2006 to November 2009, this paper provides an explanation for A-H share premium by introducing two behavioral factors: heterogeneous beliefs and investor sentiment. The results show that, under the short-sales constraints of A share market, the stronger the heterogeneous beliefs, the higher the A-H premium rate. The higher the investor sentiment of A share market, the higher the A-H premium rate. Under higher investor sentiment, A shares of stocks whose intrinsic value is difficult to estimate are more likely to be overpriced, leading to a higher A-H premium rate. Moreover, higher investor sentiment can strengthen the effect of heterogeneous beliefs on AH premium rate. Overall, theories on heterogeneous beliefs and investor sentiment can well explain the irrational phenomenon of A-H share premium.

articleTitle: Optimal selection of composite web service based on QoS and risk evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: One of the most promising advantages of Web service technology is the possibility of creating added-value services by composing existing ones. A key step for composing services lies in the selection of the individual services. In this paper, we propose an approach for selecting optimal Web service composition plan and optimal candidate services, aimed at maximizing service quality and minimizing risk of service failure. It is an extension of previous QoS-driving service selection approaches, by adding consideration about the risk of service failure. The mathematical model is based on Petri net and fault tree in order to compute the risk for each abstract composition plan.

articleTitle: Loan portfolio pricing model based on default correlation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The default distances of listed corporation in different time intervals during the loan period are calculated following the KMV model. Then, the correlation coefficient matrix of default distances of listed corporations is calculated accordingly. Substituting the correlation coefficient matrix and the default distances into the Gaussian copula function, the joint default probability of each default status of listed corporations is calculated. The risk free interest rate during the loan period is forecasted by the CKLS model. Under no-arbitrage equilibrium condition, a loan portfolio pricing model is established which reflects not only the default correlation of the listed corporations but also the fluctuation of risk free interest rates.

articleTitle: A study on the model of trust system in B2C m-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Trust is the key factor for the sustainable development of whether e-commerce or m-commerce. Since the research on the trust of business-to-consumer m-commerce is a lack at present, this study analyzes concepts and characters of the trust of B2C m-commerce at first. Then it discusses the impact factors from the perspective of trading parties and environment. Finally a hierarchical model for the trust system of B2C m-commerce is drawn and an empirical approach of trust evaluation in B2C m-commerce that is applied to this model.

articleTitle: A brief study on second language acquisition and Web-based English teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of teaching and learning, teachers and researchers today have created the Web-based teaching (WBET) environment to facilitate L2 learners to master L2 better. Web-based English teaching and learning in China has been developing very fast. And this paper deals with the study of Second Language Acquisition (SLA) and WEBT, and the problem of how to facilitate SLA theories better in WEBT in order to improve students learning effectiveness in English.

articleTitle: The evaluation model for circular economy within industrial cluster based on BP artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper designed evaluation index system based on analyzing the relation between the industrial cluster and circular economy, and according to that established the BP artificial neural networks evaluation model. Finally it carried on the simulation calculating to the Shanxi Province YanLiang's development level of circular economy in aviation industrial cluster. And it pointed out the superiority and deficiency of this local developing circulation economy. The paper had certain theory and the practice significance to utilize the quantification method evaluating the development level of circular economy within in industrial cluster.

articleTitle: Combination-forecasting modeling for CPFR collaboration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The Collaborative Planning, Forecasting and Replenishment (CPFR) is an application of Supply Chain Management concept in the retailing. In this paper, the collaborative forecasting process between retailers and manufacturers which is the core of CPFR is mainly discussed. A combination-forecasting model is created to improve forecasting accuracy and collaboration in CPFR process. Finally, the formulation results showed the effectiveness of this combination-forecasting model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Compares Chinese and foreign Mobile TV service based on the customer demands
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: An ARDL bounds test approach to CO2 emissions, energy consumption and economic growth in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This study attempts to examine empirically the long and short-run relationships between CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions, energy consumption and economic growth in China using ARDL bounds test Approach for the period 1985–2008. The results indicate that there exist long and short-run relationships between the variables. Energy consumption has a positive impact on CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions and economic growth affects CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions negatively. Energy consumption is the most significant variable in explaining the carbon emissions, which suggests energy consumption can help to mitigate CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions greatly.

articleTitle: Study on risk assessment model based on Bayesian Belief Network for power supply companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Power Supply Company is affected by various risk factors, How to identify risk factors and control the risk so as to avoid losses causing by risk is of great significance to power supply companies. This paper briefly introduce the basic principle of Bayesian Belief Network, proposes a building method of Bayesian Belief Network based on ISM, and analyses the risk of Power Supply Companies using this model. The result indicates that this method is feasible and valid for Power Supply Companies controlling and avoiding operational risks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A case study of underground parking planning in Shenzhen, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Network Platform of General Archives Education at university
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: “The Interactive Network Platform is developed in the Support of a Dynamic Resource Repository of General Archives Education” on the basis of exploring general archives education — a new field. This Network Platform is able to solve many problems arising in the new field, which are difficult to tackle with traditional methods. It consists of archives information integration system, archives user feedback system, archives information security system and general archives education resource repository. The diversified columns set up by employing IM, Blog, Wiki, Podcast, RSS, Social Book Marking, SNS, can give full play to the superiority of the Network Platform in terms of its dynamic development and interaction.

articleTitle: Study on perceived service quality evaluation in power supply industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, a power supply service quality evaluation system is constructed based on SERVQUAL model and confirmatory factor analysis, and the index weight is determined by PLS modeling principle, for which data is collected from 8347 citizens of 13 cities in Jiangsu Province as samples. Empirical results show that the method is applicable and effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The characteristic analysis on the floating population in Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Studies on the comprehensive evaluation system of the green degree of green supply chain of fresh food
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Taking all the links of the supply chain of fresh food as evaluation factors, this paper establishes an evaluation system on the green degree of the green supply chain of fresh food and a comprehensive model of the green degree of green supply chain of fresh food by combining the methods such as analytic hierarchy process, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation combination and gray relational analysis.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the problems and countermeasures of e-government construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Teaching method innovation in "algorithm analysis and design"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research and application of e-Government system based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Virtual Reality(VR) and e-Government Technology both are achieved significant development in recent years, which provides possibility to realize anthropomorphic e-Government based on “anywhere” Internet. To reduce the big gap between VR Technology and e-Government application in terms of Technology Architecture and Development Process, in this paper, a design method on VR service Engine is proposed. Research on functionality of VR Service Engine, The theory and method of VR Service Engine Realization are given as well. The main focus of the paper is to describe PCS (Public Call Service) Interface of VR Service Engine, Design of Interpreter and drafting of specifications. etc.

articleTitle: A framework for building M-Learning environment based on micro-blogging and cellular phones
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Following the progress of social interaction technology, the learning and teaching environment has changed, especially in higher education, into a new learning environment called Mobile learning environment. This is a case study of M-learning environment based on micro-blogs and cellular phones, and the content of which is Educational Communication. In view of the advances of micro-blogging, and the status of cellular phone usage among college students, we try creating a highperformance learning mode which is a hybrid of traditional learning(face to face learning), e-learning(web-based learning) and m-learning, and we do find it is a productive and dynamic environment for collaborative learning. The innovation of this study is integrating micro-blogging and cellular phones into learning, and building a new architecture of m-learning for higher educator.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of folk tourism e-commerce system base on Web2.0 and Mashup
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is an effective means to promote the dissemination of culture and development of folk tourism market with the construction of folk culture electronic commerce and informationization and network of folk tourism. This paper analyses the characteristics of the folk tourism and builds the folk tourism e-commerce platform based on GeoWeb2.0, which is built based on Web Service combining Web2.0, WebGIS and multimedia technology, using tourism e-commerce models to achieve display of multimedia information Mashup linked by Spatial information with the aim of tourism. It provides an integrated platform for tourism resources information management and exchange for town management and tourism practitioners and tries to solve the problem about the intercommunion and popularization in the folk tour management.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the performance evaluation of logistic service supply chain based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On application of project management in distance education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The critical successful factors and strategic development path to IT governance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The in-depth and continuous developments of information infrastructure reinforce the dependence of organizations to information systems. Thus the risks, benefits and opportunities accompany IT make IT governance a crucial part of organization development. In this research, the critical successful factors of IT governance and the corresponding weights are derived by means of the methods developed in the literature, data collection, expert advice and questionnaire. Moreover, the strategic development path is defined via discussion of experts and the changing role of information department is explored. This paper is intended to provide some useful insights for researchers who are interested in the IT governance of government departments.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on urban ecological environment governance under the low-carbon economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Performance evaluation on China's fiscal agricultural expenditures since the Reform and Open Policy: Based on grey correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Towards an integrated maturity model of knowledge management capabilities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The resource-based view of the firm is used to study the role of organizational knowledge in establishing sustained competitive advantage. The concept of the organisational knowledge capabilities development analyzes the organisational capabilities in three principal dimensions: Knowledge Management (KM) infrastructures, KM processes and KM competences. Indeed, the literature in KM, management and information technology shows that the development of the organisational capabilities is strongly related to the use of a maturity model. Also, the literature establishes a link between the level of maturity in KM capabilities and the level of organizational performance. However, there is very little work on the literature which develops an integrated maturity model for KM capabilities that use together the three principal dimensions. This work proposes a maturity model of Knowledge Management capabilities with three principal.

articleTitle: The effect of Internet information on housing search process among different families in Beijing, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Cross section data was used from a field survey of 676 homebuyers in the city of Beijing, China in 2009. The decision of homebuyers to use the Internet as a search tool and its impact on the efficiency of buyers' search process was analyzed using a structural equation modeling (SEM). Three aspects of buyer character, Internet use and search behavior were selected as the latent variables in SEM. The path diagram and standardized regression weights were simulated, and the impacts of Internet information on the housing search efficiency among different families were compared. Results indicate that families living in the rent buildings are more apt to use the Internet in the housing search process than the families who have owned properties. The formers are slightly more effective in using the Internet to increase the search intensity, lower the search duration and reduce the time spent on viewing each house. Although the Internet information does have positive impact in the housing search process, the influence is not significant in China nowadays. It is important for the Chinese government to spread the general knowledge of the Internet search among the homebuyers, pay more attention to guide the online performance of the real estate firms and agencies, and take powerful actions to punish the illegal behavior of leaving false housing transaction information on websites.

articleTitle: Image database system of clothing emotion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the fields of apparel and artificial intelligence, clothing images, which are closely related to human life, have important theoretical and practical significance when they are used to assess, understand and analyze the clothing emotion of the image subjects. At present, the study of clothing emotion still stays at the stage of qualitative description, so it cannot meet the needs for people to do further study in both the above fields. In this paper, by taking the male western-style clothing as an example, we have established a clothing emotion image database, through gathering, selecting, and voting scoring the dress emotion vocabulary. With this database, we can determine the group of adjectives which can best describe people's emotion for men suits, realizing the quantitative description of clothing emotion words which can in turn be used to retrieve clothing images. Therefore, our study has laid a foundation for clothing evaluation as well as for clothing image pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Model of the ZI-C experiment for double auction system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Since Gode and Sunder had introduced zero intelligence with budget constraint (ZI-C) agents in the double auction experiments, there has much controversy in whether the pure market discipline in ZI-C system has the ability to let the transaction prices converge to the competitive equilibrium. In this paper, we introduce a probability model to simulate the ZI experiences and try to gauge the power from the pure market. We analyze the ZI experiments, and explain the relationship between the price clearing process and the experimental settings. Our model quantifies the price convergent process, and the outputs are generally consistent with many well known ZI-C experiments. The results demonstrate that it is the mechanism of the ZI-C experiment that determines the price convergent process, and the auction market discipline itself has no predictive power as often believed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Construction and practice of the public laboratory platforms for the postgraduates of electronic and information engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Analysis of macroeconomic time series by the HP filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the transmission characteristics of the Hodrick-Prescott (HP) filter and frequency characteristics of exponential series, defines 3dB bandwidths of both the HP filter and exponential time series. Formulas of the 3dB bandwidths of the HP filter and exponential time series are derived. Thus, a method to determine the smoothing parameters of the HP filter by the series length is proposed. The examples showed the proposed method can effectively control the magnitude of fluctuation components, provides a way for the HP filter to deal with different macroeconomic time series by selecting a suitable smoothing parameter.

articleTitle: The empirical research of coordinated development between Chinese manufacturing industry and logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The logistics industry is the foundation and guarantee of the rapid development of manufacturing industry, and the manufacturing industry makes a huge demand for the development of logistics industry, therefore, it shows coordinated development trend between manufacturing industry and logistics. Using Logistic model, this paper gives quantitative research in the impact of Chinese manufacturing industry in driving the development of logistics industry and the impact of Chinese logistics in promoting the development of manufactory industry, which is an empirical of coordinated development between Chinese manufacturing industry and logistics. The paper also raises some suggestions to accelerate the development between Chinese manufacturing industry and logistics.

articleTitle: An improved software reliability model incorporating detection process and the total number of faults
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Software reliability growth models base on the NHPP are quite successful tools that have been proposed to assess the software reliability. Various NHPP-SRGMs have been built upon various assumptions such as the number of remaining faults, software failure rate, and software reliability. But in realistic, the number of faults and the detection rate are not constants. They are time functions. In this paper, we aim to incorportate total number function of faults and detection rate function into conditional SRGMs. Experimental results indicate that the new model which proposed in this paper has a fairly accurate prediction capability.

articleTitle: Securing continuous auditing in wireless network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a security scheme for continuous auditing agent architecture. Current continuous auditing agent architecture does not take security into consideration. This makes it vulnerable to a variety of attacks. This paper proposes an elliptic curve based authentication scheme that can authenticate the data source and the continuous auditing agent. After authentication, a shared key is established between the data source and the continuous auditing agent. Therefore the auditing data is protected by that shared key.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Key technology in building a collaborative platform for the supply-chain of complex products manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: China's rice supply and trade: Constraints and potential
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Rice is the dominant staple crop and also is crucial to maintain food security in China. This paper provides empirical evidence on the supply, demand and stock of China rice from the econometric estimation of the elasticity with respect to the price and non-price factors, the main purpose is to identify the key variables of determining rice supply, to predict demand, supply and trade of China's rice in the foreseeable future. The result indicates that the elasticity value of the own price is 0.046; the elasticity value of labor input is 0.09. The price elasticity of demand is −0.115 and −0.140, the income elasticity of demand is −0.157 and −0.216. The predicted result shows that the total consumption will have a decreasing trend, but the total production will have an increasing slightly trend and the net export of China rice will rise in the coming decades.

articleTitle: Game analysis of enterprise behaviour motive under the mode of circular economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Successive years have witnessed our economy's sustainable and speedy growth; meanwhile, we have also accumulated a lot of problems, such as severe waste of resources and energies and grave environmental disruption, which hamper greatly our future development. As a kind of innovative economic operation model, circular economy proposes new content and requests for enterprise behaviour. This paper exploits the objects, principles and characteristics of enterprise behaviors under the mode of circular economy, applies game theory on their motives and expounds the importance of circular economy to the further development of an rational enterprise.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Index system construction of value-added tax audit selection case network platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Marketing management based on co-evolution between product innovation and customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Study of construction strategies for test paper based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the computer technology and artificial intelligence, and the rapid improvement of Chinese educational information level, It becomes the hot focus in IT industry and education domain to achieve paperless examination and networking examination. The thesis, firstly, introduces the research background, the art of the state of the domestic and foreign research works. In the analysis of a large number of research results domestically and abroad, the thesis analyzes the algorithms for automatically constructing test papers, and establishes the mathematical model for constructing test papers automatically, whose control parameters are the types of items, the difficulty of items, the distinguishing degrees, the cognitive classification, and the time of arraying paper. The test paper based on improved genetic algorithm strategy are proposed. Since the characteristics of finding global optimal solution adaptively and the high convergence speed, The proposed algorithms solves the problem of the code length of the chromosome too long, and the difficulties to compute the fitness. The chromosome structure and fitness function are constructed and described based on the requirements of organizing test paper. The genetic operation of the problem is designed and the corresponding application software based on the genetic algorithm proposed in this thesis is programmed. It is laid a solid foundation to further improve the construction of the network item bank. Finally, the basic structure of paperless examination system is explored to determine the overall function of the paperless system and determine the direction of studying

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Critical success factors of enterprise resource planning implementation in China: Case study in Shanghai city, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on correlation and improved weighted prediction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the case of data sparseness problem, the traditional methods are focused the rating differences of the common rated items instead of the quantity, which causes the unreasonable selection of neighbor set. Moreover, at the stage of predicting ratings, the higher or lower ratings of some individual neighbors will have a great impact on the final prediction. Meanwhile, the choice of mean rating in the Mean Average Method is not scientific because different people may like different kinds of items. To solve the above problems, we first use the cloud model to find users with the closest cloud characteristics to the object user, which can reduce the individual deviation effect. Then we put forward a concept of correlation and find the most the most relevant users and the most relevant items before calculating their similarities, which can make sure there are enough common items between the user and his neighbors and the item and its neighbors. Considering the classification of different items, we find the item neighbors within the relevant items and calculate their mean rating, then we combine the mean item neighbor rating and mean user neighbor rating in an weighted way to predict the final result. Experiments showed that our approach effectively alleviated the data sparseness problem and improved the quality of the recommendation system.

articleTitle: A study on the comovement between warrants and the underlying stocks based on a time-varying relevant bivariant normal copula model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The time-varying relevant bivariant normal copula model is applied to study the comovement between representative warrants and their underlying stocks in Mainland China's stocks market. The results indicate that there's a quite strong positive comovement between the call warrants and the underlying stocks during the entire duration, while this comovement weakens on the last trading day; As for the put warrant and the underlying stock, this comovement is weak and negative, while on the last trading day, this negative comovement weakens.

articleTitle: Research on trust model in optimal resource allocation for a virtual organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Trust model in optimal resource allocation for a virtual organization is proposed through the use of trust mechanism to improve service satisfaction. In this paper, firstly trust in the model is divided into direct and indirect trust. Trust values are classified according to time period of trust evaluation during computation of direct trust. Therefore, direct trust values are computed by using weight based on the time period. Secondly, a trust network is adopted to compute indirect trust values. Finally, resources are allocated based on overall trust value of each resource allocation chain.

articleTitle: Game analysis of construction safety supervision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The construction industry is a dangerous industry with high frequency of accidents resulting in financial losses, injuries, disabilities and deaths. Construction safety supervision helps to reduce the accident rate, lower the security costs and provide a safer production environment. In this paper, a game model of construction safety supervision is established based on evolutionary game theory, in which the two players are the government supervision department and the construction enterprise. Then the behavior of the contractor and government supervision department is analyzed. The study shows that the stable state of construction safety supervision is mainly related to the cost of regulatory procedures, the probability of accidents and the loss of construction enterprises when accidents happen. Finally, several effective measures of construction safety supervision are presented.

articleTitle: An empirical research on the transmission mechanism of RMB exchange rate movement-prices
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper employs two kinds of VAR models based on the direct and indirect pass-through effect of RMB exchange rate movement to investigate the impact of changes of RMB nominal effective exchange rate from August 2005 to October 2009 on domestic prices level. The results show that the transfer effect of import prices index is stronger than the export prices index, however, domestic consumer price is significantly affected by the world price via export price, namely, export price has effect to the domestic price to some extent.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Speed up the strategy of the Internet of Things industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Research on screening mechanism for banks under supply chain finance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The financial crisis of 2007 to the present highlights the importance of banks operating risk management, while screening mechanism is a key issue for banks risk control within an innovative supply chain finance (SCF). From the angle of commercial banks, this paper explores the interior mechanism of SCF and then uses fuzzy synthetic evaluation method, combining with meta-graphs to make a tentative investigation of screening mechanism of small and medium size enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The critical success factors for the banks implementing e-CRM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Analysis of agricultural products E-commerce models based on supply chain management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: E-commerce is not only helpful to create new virtual communities of customers, distributors and suppliers, but also improve the efficiency of agricultural products circulation. This article has analyzed the three typical modes of agricultural products on-line trading. According to the characteristics and the advantages of the different model, the author analyzed agricultural products E-commerce models based on supply chain management.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Evaluation and application for online advertising publisher based on hybrid multi-attribute decision making
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Assessment index system is constructed based on online advertising publisher viewpoint and this complete assessment index system consists of three class indicators. Maximum deviation method based on deviation degree and possibility degree of multi-attribute decision making was improved, and the exact data and interval data were integrated together, the problem of hybrid multi-attribute decision making are solved. At last, through a real example, the proposed method is objectively and evaluation results are reliable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An integrated research on programme risk management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: A new numerical method for pricing binary options in the CEV process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to study one of the valuation of the binary options in the constant elasticity of variance (CEV) process, by applying the Itô formula and no-arbitrage principle, derives the options pricing model and the differential equation of the options pricing model. Then, by means of semidiscretization for spatial variable, obtains the concrete semidiscretization numerical arithmetic scheme of the differential equation, conditional stability is proved, lastly numerical examples show that the algorithm is conditional stability and convergent.

articleTitle: The development of information technology applications in enterprise management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: At first, this article reviews the development of information technology applications in enterprise management. And then it analyzes the main types of information technology applications using in enterprise management. Finally, it looks forward the most likely using mode of information technology applications in enterprise management in the future.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A study on the influence of consumers' perceived control and perceived risk to new E-Commerce technology innovation resistance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Study on border effects for shipping trade based on gravity model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper puts forward a border effect model derived from the widespread Gravity Model for shipping industry to study the significance of trade barriers caused by the regional border in ports. The result shows that economic size, cargo handling capacity and berth number of a port greatly influence the bilateral shipping trade while pier length does not show an obvious effect on shipping trade. Border effects between China and US for shipping trade do exist but is not quite significant based on the data of 2004–2009.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of the optimized ways of mineral resource capitalizing reform of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on agile marketing for the modern enterprise information technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: Optimal system design of supply chain finance based on game analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Traditional studies of supply chain management focused too much upon the control of flows of goods and information; whereas neglected another important part-the control of financial flows. This paper presents the significant benefits brought by supply chain finance, for all the parties involved. In addition, three practical patterns are introduced and one, which is more widely adapted among them, is selected to build our game model. Through game analyzing, an equilibrium pricing mechanism can be formulated, which guarantees the maximum revenue for all participators.

articleTitle: Application of Markov chain in the teaching evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: After analyzing advantages and disadvantages of original methods that analyze students' grade and evaluate teaching quality with average grade, this paper proposed a new method that use the transfer matrix obtained by markov chain to analyze students' grade and evaluate teaching quality. Combined with the characters of biomass energy in Northeast China, this thesis analyzed the factors which are included basis, enterprise and market. Then we use AHP method to quantify them, constructed the index system, and analyzed the bottlenecks in developing biomass energy industry in Northeast China. abstract: A method for solving the production inventory control problem is presented here where the input data are described by fuzzy members. It is assumed that the imperfect products can be discounted instantaneously at the end of the production process in each cycle, and the shortage is permitted and replenished linearly in the next cycle. Using the graded mean integration representation technique for defuzzification, the defuzzified economic production quantity model is derived. According to the convex characteristic of the model, the optimal production quantity under a minimum of total inventory cost can be obtained. Finally, the numerical example and sensitivity analysis are made to explain the presented model.

articleTitle: Distributed denial of service attack detection based on IP Flow Interaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack is one of the major threats to the current Internet. It is challenging to detect DDoS attacks accurately and quickly. We propose a novel IP Flow Interaction Feature algorithm (FIF) based on multiple features of DDoS attack flows via IP addresses and ports. To increase the detection accuracy in various conditions, we describe the state characteristics of network flows using FIF time series, and a simple but efficient FIF-based DDoS attack detection model (FDAD) is proposed by associating with contextual information in observed FIF time series. Finally, we present a simple alarm evaluation mechanism based on the alarm frequency and time interval. Our analysis and experiment results demonstrate that FIF can well reflect the characteristics of DDoS attack flow and normal flow and can distinguish normal flow from attack flow effectively. FDAD can identify normal flow and abnormal flow with DDoS attack flow quickly, accurately, and reduce false alarm rate drastically.

articleTitle: Research of the civil engineering e-learning platform based on the Java technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

articleTitle: The function and Impacted Factors of Internet Reviews

In addition, the positive and negative property of Internet reviews has significant effect on its marketing function, especially the negative one.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on corporate tax compliance, corporate governance and tax policies in China: From the international studies on the undersheltering puzzle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The undersheltering puzzle, proposed by Weisbach, has brought the severe challenge to the pervious researches in tax avoidance field. The solution of the puzzle has to broaden the pervious researches' framework and change the pervious hypotheses, which will bring a series of changes to tax avoidance researches such as the re-definition of corporate tax system, the introduction of governance variables and the adjustment of tax collection and administration system. This paper, based on the undersheltering puzzle, analyzes the latest international research in the motivation of corporate tax avoidance, tax avoidance participation, and the related influence to tax policies system. The main findings included that the international researches of corporate tax avoidance have been divided into two directions after the undersheltering puzzle proposed by Weisbach in the first place. The first research direction is represented by Graham and Tucker who think corporate tax avoidance is only the tool to reduce the tax burden and increase values. They have continued the traditional framework, and consider the problem of agency at the same time. The other research direction is represented by Dysai, Dyck and Wilson who think agency problems are the inherent problems of the company, which is bound to have a great impact on tax avoidance. Second, the introduction of corporate governance variables expands the perspective for corporate tax avoidance. Therefore, it is of great significance to research the motives and behaviors of corporate tax avoidance in the Chinese legal environment and institutional background. Finally, the whole corporate governance system will be improved, which can provide a certain degree of protection to help Chinese companies to develop steadily. At the same time, Analyses of Chinese corporate tax system arrangement and tax policies enforcement is proposed.

articleTitle: Building of securities investment fund manager competency model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The competency model is a hot topic on today's global human resource development, which provides the integration of all human resource functions and services in enterprises with a method and a tool. In this paper, job analysis, behavioral events interviews are used for the collection of first-hand information. According to the interviews and surveys, and based on statistical methods, the competency of the securities investment fund managers is summed up and analyzed, and the competency model is then built. It is concluded that the competency model for securities investment fund managers is made up of two parts, recessive competency and dominant competency. This model can be effective to provide information for fund manager's selection, training and assessment.

The green degree of enterprise depends on these attributes: enterprise that belongs to industry, enterprise property, enterprise region, number of enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Rural-urban migrants' migration patterns and transformation in the process of urbanization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Rural-urban migrants' migration patterns play a crucial role in the process of Chinese urbanization. Summarizing literatures and experience, this paper constructs a comprehensive classification standard which is constituted by five variables reflecting the migrant workers' actual migration behaviors. Then migrant workers' migration patterns are divided into two categories: temporary migration and permanent migration. On this basis, this paper gets the transformation's conditions from temporary migration to permanent migration using the two selection model firstly. The result shows that migrant workers' age and occupational types and living ways significantly impact their actual migration actions. Because the influencing factors of rural-urban migrants' migration willingness are researched in a lot of existing literature, the migration willing is included in this study. We construct the binary choice model in order to find the main factors affecting their willingness and actual actions simultaneously. The results show that their permanent migration probability both on their willingness and their actual actions is 29.12%; Age shows an inverted U-relationship with migration probability; The probability of permanent migration of the unmarried is significantly higher than the married. The rural-urban migrants who have high occupational types and own strong social relationships have more probability of permanent migration. To help them make their living conditions better may also improve the probability of permanent migration both on their willingness and actual actions. So, the cities' managers should take measures to promote migrant workers' occupational upward mobility, and help them improve their living conditions. These measures may improve the probability of migrant workers' permanent migration, thus speed up the urbanization process in China.

abstract: The development and utilization for our government information resource is lagging for the increase in information infrastructure and aggregate information demand in recent years. This paper proposes model-mechanism-performance incorporate, bidirectional, interactive and circular governance architecture and analyzes the key steps and influential factors in the process of cooperative development and sharing for government information resource. Our study indicates that, (1) in the aspect of model choose, the government should take into account of the characteristics of information resource, building organization, business process, and power structure; (2) in the aspect of mechanism design, the government should import incentive and monitoring mechanisms, market-oriented mechanisms, and pricing and compensation mechanisms; (3) in the aspect of performance evaluation, the government should import the third party performance evaluation mechanism based on capability maturity model, establish performance evaluation index system, and design comprehensive hierarchical and multistage performance evaluation system; (4) the direct and reversed influential relationship of the alignment degree of model, mechanism and performance are formed finally.

This paper puts forward a kind of matching method based on the telecom service ontology description. This method describe the telecom services with the ontology technology first, and then match the activities in a workflow to some relative services through their function description, their interfaces parameters and their actuating logic definitions. This method could be also applied to some other domains in which it is necessary to improve the accuracy and efficiency for matching some services to the activities defined in a workflow with different granularities.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With 185 months Chinese capital market data, this paper proves that the Fama-French Three-Factor Model has an excellent explanation on the cross-sectional variation in average stock returns. Furthermore, the examination of long-term abnormal stock returns following stock dividends based on the three-factor model and zero-investment portfolio model shows that the corporations which have stock dividends suffered a lower returns compared to their matched firms which don't have the same company event. The results suggest that the long-term investment on such firms is not beneficial, which is a negative evidence of the signaling hypothesis.

Then, the improved model based on grey forecasting method is proposed to improve the precision degree of the original GM(1, 1) model. articleTitle: Forecasting of corporation cash flow from operating activity: Using grey topological model

In this paper, operating cash flow forecasting model is built using grey topological predicting approach, which could overcome the restriction of normal forecasting model on sample's characteristics. articleTitle: A survey of security middleware

abstract: Scientific and technological achievements plays an important role in the management. It can improve the level of management if the evaluation of transformation of scientific and technological achievements. This article in view of our country scientific and technical payoffs transformation's present situation innovation proposed that the BP neural network construction scientific and technical payoffs transformation's evaluation model, unifies the BP neural network and our country scientific of technical payoffs transformation's characteristic, The evaluation the scientific and technical payoffs transformation level is very effective. Finally through the training and the test utilization to the BP neural network model. It can promotion scientific and technical payoffs transformation level effective, it that can improve the level of management.

articleTitle: A research on E-learning process Capability Maturity Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper, as a research about the effectiveness and the dimensions of measurements, provides a formal definition of E-learning process measurement elements. Upon this definition, the E-learning Process Capability Maturity Model (ELPCMM) is set up, including the phase and continuous models, and the workflows of each process field with detailed studies about the characters and relationships of each workflow.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The professional knowledge of anti-dumping accountants is of great concern to the anti-dumping performance. In the condition of the talents shortage, this paper analyzes the knowledge structure and explores the education model of antidumping accountants, in order to support and direct the cultivation of anti-dumping accountants.

articleTitle: The pricing research on innovation ecosystem of hi-tech enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The innovation ecosystem of hi-tech enterprises is a technological innovation system with the similar characters of natural eco-system, it is composed of hi-tech enterprises worldwide based on the technology standard and platform. Pricing which causes the profits to flow among the copartners becomes the effective means of profits distribution in the innovation ecosystem. Plentiful cases contribute to prove that the pricing models about innovation ecosystem of hi-tech enterprises include the free model in which the system sells a lot of profitable products through the large customer scale expanded by ant economic effect, the price subsidy model which obtains benefits by selling amount of low-price products bundled with complementary product through cross network effects, the technology standard pricing model grounded on patent cross license and patent portfolio license, as well as the platform pricing including one-sided pricing and two-sides pricing.

articleTitle: Study on the impact of value density on profits of closed-loop supply chain with nonlinear demand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In connection with a secondary closed-loop supply chain composed of one manufacturer and one retailer, when on the basic of considering value density of waste products, the paper compares the profits of the open-loop chain and the closed-loop chain with manufacturer as a leader and analyzes the impact of value density of the wasted production on closed-loop supply chain. And then discusses the conditions that the value density should be satisfied when enterprises develop closed-loop supply chain. The results show that the manufacturer is more profits for developing closed-loop supply chain along with the growth of value density, when the other parameters are static and the value density meets a certain threshold. And only when value density is more than a particular value, the developing closed-loop supply chain can be possible.

articleTitle: The value relevence of earnings restatements — Empirical evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper studies earnings restatements' value relevence of Chinese listed companies with the price model and returns model, using earnings restatements announcement listed companies from 1999 to 2009 as the samples. The results show that earnings restatements aren't value relevent in Chinese capital market. Market's reliance on earnings restatements information is minimal, and restatements can't influence investors' value judgments. But there are negative market reactions to noncore restatements. Therefore, we should give more attention to earnings restatements, and strengthen regulation and supervision of information disclosure of listed companies.

articleTitle: A study on the impact of ICT product upgrade to customer satisfaction — Take cell phone as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper aims to find out how ICT product upgrades influence customer satisfaction. It introduces a common method by which the Quarter Model is used to divide ICT product attributes into four sectors that will be treated differently, and then multiple linear regression model is utilized to analyze how much those attribute changes influence customer satisfaction. An empirical study on cell phone is conducted to show how the method works. The results show that customers pay greatest emphasis on cell phone On-line Application and Appearance upgrade contributes most to customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of quantitative model of enterprise internal control assessment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The concept is to transform effectiveness assessment of internal control systems to indicator assessment and reassessment of results from comprehensive assessment of the indicator system, to reflect economy, efficiency and effectiveness of internal control system projects through the indicator system and comprehensive assessment results.

articleTitle: The empirical research of the trust mechanism in partners of firm networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Although the role of trust in partners of firm networks has been well established, less is known about its construction. This study is to identify and examine the influencing factors and their impact path to the trust construction of firm networks. Based on reviewing the literatures related, the conceptual framework of influencing factors of trust in partners is set up. 3 latent variables and 39 observed variables are conducted in structural equation model. The results of the study indicate that network strategic security significantly contributes to the trust in partners. Moreover, individual factors influence trust in partners indirectly through network strategic security, which is a mediating variable. Furthermore, organizational context of node-firms influences trust in partners indirectly through both network strategic security and individual factors, which are mediating variables.

articleTitle: Applied research of genetic algorithm in the demand of book resources
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Genetic algorithm is suitable for the complex and non-linear problem that can not be solved by traditional method, which has been widely used in many areas, and it will become one of main techniques in intelligent computation. This article takes the dynamic series of number of printed books in during several years as example, discussing modeling method of succession forecast model based on GA and validity of forecast precision.

articleTitle: Improving autocorrelation performance of Henon sequence based on APAS theorem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Chaotic sequences, as a kind of pseudorandom sequences, have been widely used. But some well known chaotic sequences, such as Henon sequence, have poor autocorrelation performance, and their applications are limited. Based on recently presented APAS theorem, we modified Henon map to S-Henon map, and S-Henon sequence has excellent autocorrelation performance and simple structure, whereas its other performances are remained invariant or become better, and can be used more widely.

articleTitle: An innovation logic model for business management and development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the ownership of a family business preference, this paper analyzes innovative management and factors demonstrate how to break ownership preference of family business. In order to reflect the dialectical relationship between family enterprise development and enterprise innovation more clearly, we constructed a innovation logical model, including ownership of a family business preference, family enterprise development, family enterprise innovation strength and innovation of the family enterprise management.

Based on feature research, the gray system model was built to forecast the development tendency of the balance between populations, the cultivated land and grain corps. Results show that before 2025 the supply of grain corps does not suffice the need of it.

Through the quantitative analysis for this model, the optimal solution of improving the competiveness of auto components of Shiyan is proposed. Then the proposed solution is discussed in further step as well, hopefully, this solution can bring the benefits for the development of auto components' firms in Shiyan city.

Furthermore, based on WSRP4J an integration framework between Struts 2 and WSRP is proposed in this paper. With the use of these technologies, the infrastructures of Digital Campus are better enriched.

articleTitle: The research on the incentive mechanism of stock options of the electronic commerce in China: The analysis based on the human capital theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This study examines the incentive mechanism of stock option of Chinese electronic commerce companies. Our sample is measured between 2005 and June, 30, 2010, obtained from the equity incentive plan of Chinese electronic commerce listed companies. Based on the human capital theory, we empirically analyze the current situation of the stock option incentive mechanism of the electronic commerce as a whole. We find that the human capital theory can explain the establishment of the incentive mechanism of electronic commerce companies. And, compared to the central and western regions, the human capital plays a more important role in the equity incentive plan in the electronic commerce in eastern region

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on capability evaluation indicators of government emergency management in the public emergency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: With the socio-economic structural adjustment and transition, and ecological environment destructions, more and more public emergencies are growing. From an objective point of view on the government's emergency management system and operational mechanism, it puts forward higher requirements, how to effectively prevent and solve all kinds of emergencies for protecting the people's life and property is a new era of major topics for government. Strengthening research on public emergencies, improving government's capability of emergency management is not only the important guarantee of government's effective function, but also the vital initiatives to enhance the level of public services, to improve performance and enhance public trust. This article based on the contents and classification of public emergency, firstly defines government's capabilities of emergency management and through comparison the analysis from overseas and inner scholars study evaluating system of government's capabilities of emergency management mainly from function operation, system performance, stage of events, and the balanced scorecard approach. From view of capability constitution of emergency management itself, the article, combined with the characteristics of the public emergencies, puts forward the capabilities of emergency management, including early warning capability, decision-directing capability, capability for mobilization, communication and collaboration capabilities, resource allocation, evaluating and learning capabilities. According to the characteristics of each capacity, it presents the secondary and level indicators in the evaluation of the capacity of government's emergency management, which can help the government to find weakness in the public incidents, and through targeted remediation to strengthen capability of emergency management.

articleTitle: Chinese investors' selections of consuming and investing under bounded rationality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Inter-temporal utility maximization is a kind of paradigms in economic and financial research. Assets pricing theory have made a breakthrough under the hypothesis of complete rationality. However, this kind of theory can't interpret economical phenomena perfectly such as the “puzzle of equity risk premium” and “consumption — smoothing puzzle”. In this paper, with the concept that consumption and wealth are substitutable, a new kind of utility function is raised to interpret the relationship of consumption, investment and return on assets. Empirical test is used to prove out its validity in economical phenomena interpreting.

articleTitle: Service trade competence research based on transaction cost theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Enhancing the service trade competence was the fundamental needs of economic development. The relationship between the transaction cost and service trade competence showed a negative correlation. Based on the mutual impact analysis between transaction cost and service trade competence, used comparative analysis method, got a result that saving transaction cost was an effective way of enhancing the service trade competence. Companies should establish the image, improve technologies and use GATS to save transaction cost in order to enhance service trade competence.

articleTitle: Study on graduate affairs information services of American University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

In this paper, the authors studied effective network platform in some outstanding American college, combined with the construction of graduate service network platform in Chinese University, made the recommendations of service network platform.

articleTitle: Government process reengineering based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the application of knowledge management in the course of government process reengineering. It contrasts the two different government processes in tradition and modern society, especially focus on the influence of knowledge management. The factors of government process reengineering based on knowledge management which obtained by calculation with values obtained by direct testing has been also paid attention to in the perspective of government innovation. Knowledge management engineering development and application of innovation has brought new challenges and opportunities to government management, how to enhance knowledge management execution, and build a responsible knowledge management and an clean government is an important issue for government process reengineering research and practice innovation. Government process reengineering based on knowledge management means an new typical model of combination of technological innovation and management innovation, has brought profound change to government management, and the nature of its characteristics has brought new elements to enhance management execution. We contend that effective communication standards, control systems, object oriented methods serve the dual purpose of promoting efficiency and the enhancement of government capability.

articleTitle: The study on relationship lending and small business financing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Compared with large enterprises, small businesses short starting time and lack of credit history, it is difficult to judge on financial operations and future prospects. Essentially, Relationship lending is a system arrangement on the banking and corporate financial transactions in order to overcome market failures. Through the theoretical framework of Duopoly competition, the paper studys the pricing behavior of lending and banking. The study shows lack of effective financing information forces small businesses to bear the high interest rates even if the existence of the long-term relation­ships with banks, while the paper explains the reasons by theory of small enterprises often borrowing constraints.
