articleTitle: Forecasting jump size of interest rate with ordered Probit model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The jump sizes of interest rate in the credit market in China can be represented by ordinal numbers. The interest rate level, the industrial output growth rate, and the inflation rate are key factors that influence the jump sizes of interest rate. An ordered Probit regression model is established to forecast the jump sizes of interest rate. The explanatory variables of the model are the deviation from the mean of interest rate, the deviation from the mean of industrial output growth rate, and inflation rate respectively. The empirical study shows that the coefficient of the deviation from the mean of interest rate is insignificant, while the coefficient of the deviation from the mean of industrial output growth rate, and the coefficient of inflation rates are significant.

articleTitle: Research on high-precise time transmission system over optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The paper presents a time transmission method over optical fiber, designs a prototype device and tests its performance. The advantages of time transmitting over optical fiber are described in this paper. In a measurement period, the master node sends measurement data of second pulse into the STM-N optical interface by F1 overhead byte and receives them from the slave node. The slave node performs the same operation so they do a cycle data exchange. The slave one calculates the interactive time difference and does compensation. For ensuring better delay performance, the multiplexer (WDM) can be used to achieve single fiber bi-directional transmission. Tested data show that time transmission accuracy is 10 ns level. The technology can be used in military, aerospace, power, telecommunications and other fields.

articleTitle: Study and practice: How to construct open classroom in higher education via virtual classroom
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: How to enhance teaching qualities in higher education by using information technology are important issues and tasks needed to be studied and solved by education technology researchers. This paper mainly focuses on exploring and practicing how to construct open classroom in higher education via combining the physical classroom space and virtual classroom space. Using virtual classroom to improve teaching enviroments is a tendency in global education environments. We also describe a framework about virtual classroom construction system based on traditional classroom. Four instructing models and cases via virtual classroom are described which are practiced by four professors from Peking University. Anyway, we find virtual classroom is a good and efficient way for expanding traditional classroom space to give more powerful technology support for classroom teaching though some problems about teaching and technology still exist and are needed to be improved in future.

articleTitle: Trade destruction and trade harassment effects of US antidumping petitions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the panel data integrated by import volume of US antidumping (AD) initiations (initiated in 1998∼2004) and correlative influencing factors, the Ordinary Least Square (OLS) and Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimators have examined the impact of AD on the import of the named commodities at a period of 3 years after the initiating years. The empirical results prove that, US antidumping petitions have significant trade destruction effect on depressing the import of named commodities which are finally imposed by dumping duties. On the other hand, even if in those cases without final dumping duties, the trade harassment effect also leads to a fall in the import. In addition, devaluation of U.S currency, GDP scale of initiated countries, and amount of US population leads to negative effects to US import, while population amount of initiated countries, GDP of US and its degree of openness has positive effect on the import.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Through the research, we think that the distributed energy can be used to effectively deal with the energy security and environmental protection issues. But, it is the slow development of the the distributed energy system in the industrial park, because there are some obstacles, such as lack of money. So, we analyzed the general financing model of distributed energy project, and its mainly impacting factors. Based on that, we built the Four index selective financing model of distributed energy for Chongqing industrial park. The model can better demarcate the conditions and environment of enterprises, foreign investment, park superintend department and government facing, and can effectively select the appropriate model of distributed energy project finance for the industial park.

articleTitle: Competitive interaction model of enterprises based on ecological theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to recent literatures about competitive models of enterprises based on ecological theory, an interactive competition difference system model of enterprises is put forward based the modeling thought that environment change and delay may affect the output level. And then using the properties of Logistic differential systems Mawhin continuity theorem, a sufficient condition of enterprise co-existence and periodic dynamic equilibrium of enterprises output is discussed. At last, the validity of the main conclusions is verified by numerical simulation of concrete example. The results show the interaction coefficient, intrinsic growth rate, self-inhibition rate, competitive inhibition rate and delays have a major impact t on the dynamic behavior, and the enterprises with different size and strength may coexist under certain conditions, which helps to expand the existing results.

articleTitle: Study on enterprise's brand innovation under background of economic globalization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: One of the important economic characteristics of the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century is the economic globalization. In the context of economic globalization, the brand Innovation of Chinese Enterprise is not only the necessary requirement for self-development of the brand, but also the best way to improve brand competitiveness through innovation. From both internal and external points of view, under the background of economic globalization, the motivations of brand innovation include technological progress, the brand of aging, changes in consumer demand and increased competition. The enterprise's brand innovation can be implemented according to the model of customer-based brand equity, which refers to the customer's differentiated response on brand marketing activities resulted by customer's brand knowledge existing in customer's minds. In accordance with the pyramid model of customer-based brand equity, the enterprise's brand innovation can be developed from the aspects of brand positioning, brand design, brand promotion and brand extension.

articleTitle: An optimal information extraction model and the efficiency of China's IPO pricing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The accuracy of pricing in initial public offering under book-building method is determined by the efficiency of the information extraction mechanism. This article discloses that mechanisms involving underpricing, discretionary allocation are key factors to enhance the efficiency of information extraction, through proposing a “truth-telling” model In China, mechanism of discretionary allocation is invalid owning to China's quantity restriction. Demonstrations about China's IPO book-building method discloses that during the first quotes it is relatively effective in information extraction, but it is not during the second quotes owning to the bidding behavior and the collusion of the institutional investors. According to the low efficiency of valuation of the stock and the collusion of institutional investors in China's book-building practice, we must strengthen the information extraction mechanism, standardize the process of the book-building, foster mature investors so as to promote the efficiency of the IPO pricing in China

articleTitle: SMEs: Strategy on selection of business model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It's an effective way for SMEs to select new business model to respond to more rigid competition of environment and to improve performance. The first step for SMEs to make choice of new business model is to identify the weakness of existing business model. Then identification of value creation sources in new business model is needed. Thirdly, SMEs should conduct designing of transaction structure of new business model. During this process, SMEs have to decide whether they play a role of focal business or not. If not, it means that SMEs abandon establishment of new business model and select participation of a new one built by other firms. After selection of new business model, SMEs will have to make adjustments of transaction content and transaction structure.

articleTitle: Design of computational experiment from individual behavior to group behavior on auditing

abstract: The analysis of experiment on auditing behavior is a new subject needed to study. The paper introduces the program of computational experiment which is widely used in social science. Then, analyze the modeling elements of auditing individual behavior, effects model from the individual to group behavior. The scheme of the computational experiment is constructed including the individual and group behavior to explorer the new idea and methods on the auditing behavior.

articleTitle: Research of regional power grid running state evaluation based on projection pursuit and ranking interval number
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: On the base of considering the safety, reliability, economy, power quality in the power grid running and so on, the paper established a set of comprehensive evaluation indexes system for the regional power grid running state. Then it determined the evaluation indexes weight by the projection pursuit method, and defined the priority order for the evaluation objects by the theory of possibility degree and ranking in the ranking interval number method. Therefore, it constructed a comprehensive evaluation model for the regional power grid running state. After a comprehensive evaluation analysis for the power grid running state in five regions, it showed that the comprehensive evaluation indexes system and model for regional power grid running state proposed in the paper was feasible.

abstract: The digital camera calibration is a digital camera to determine the parameters of internal and external parameters of the process. The purpose of calibration is to establish three-dimensional objects in the world coordinate system and image coordinates relations. The calibration method is usually photogrammetry traditional equipment calibration method, the direct linear transformation method, short perspective transformation and least square method. These methods are available through Matlab and photoshop End auxiliary procedures.

articleTitle: Financial time series difference analysis based on symbolic time series method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Symbolic time series analysis is introduced into the study of financial markets. On the basis of symbolizing time series and coding the symbolic time series, the characteristics of symbolic series are described by symbolic series histogram. The method of quantifying the difference of symbolic series by the Euclidean norm, χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> statistics and relative entropy so as to measure the difference between financial time series is proposed. The difference between the daily return series of Shanghai composite index and Shenzhen component index before and after June 1 2008 is analyzed to prove the effectiveness and feasibility of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the development of real estate e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The real estate is influenced by global e-commerce trend like other trades. In order to solve the problem of high vacancy rate of commodity apartment on the real estate market at present and better meet consumer's demands, it requires the property firm be devoted to making the real estate combine with e-commerce and take the road to industry's innovation. The property firm should set up effective e-commerce mode and characteristic marketing system combined with e-commerce, set up a website cooperatively and offer high-quality online characteristic service for consumer and implement the estate management of times of e-commerce with other companies, set up brand-new intelligent network community's life model With the development of informationization, the combining of real estate and e-commerce will promote real estate and e-commerce to develop to higher level

articleTitle: A multi-thread dynamic grading and grouping concurrent scheduling algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In this paper, a high efficient dynamic scheduling algorithm is developed to schedule a set of multi-thread on realtime multiprocessor systems. The algorithm divides two grades schedule. The one-grade-schedule inserts the new thread into thread-queue of thread-queue matrix according to the restriction rules and insertion rules, the two-grade-schedule places some threads chose from thread matrix into two-grade-windows, and then assigns multiple threads of two-grade-windows to processors concurrently reasonably. It has proved that this algorithm has higher efficiency and good effect in same structure multiprocessing system for multi-thread concurrent scheduling.

articleTitle: Analysis on knowledge flow mechanism of software requirement development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Requirement development for software project is the key to success, but the key of requirement development is the effective flow of knowledge between software demand-side and software development-side. From the perspective of knowledge flow mechanism, this paper analyzes the knowledge level and difference of knowledge power, and studies channels and ways of the requirements development knowledge flow and the principle and characteristics of knowledge flow. Besides, the efficiency of knowledge flow is discussed, and this paper puts forward some knowledge flow efficiency evaluation index for requirement development.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis on influence of air transport development to Chinese economic growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to the air transportation and economic development theories, based on the data of Chinese air transport industry and economic development during 1978–2009, this paper analyzes the relationships between the development of air transport and economic growth, and the contribution to economic growth in China. Empirical analysis shows that: there exists strong correlation between air transport industry and Chinese economy; air cargo is cause of economic growth, and economic growth will give a significant role in promoting the development of air transport; in the sample period, air passenger has greater contribution to economic growth than air cargo, but after 2002 civil aviation reform, air cargo's contribution exceeds that of air passenger, as an engine of economic growth, the role of air transport is more and more prominent role.

articleTitle: A positive study of China's residents consumption function and factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper gets an error correction model on China's resident consumption and income by means of the cointegration analysis. The findings are as follows: 1) In a short term, there will be a negative correlation between demand and income in China, and town people's short-term marginal propensity to consume is weaker than the long-term's; 2) The case in the countryside is on the contrary. The influence of interest rate and town Gini coefficient on the town people's consumption is insignificant. The influence of interest rate and rural Engel coefficient on rural people's consumption is insignificant. At last, some suggestions are given based on the findings.

Lastly, it brings forward that ‘goverment dominant, villiger willing, and developer participating’ reconstruction mode. It is currently the best one.

articleTitle: Grey clustering evaluation for urban road traffic environment quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to various factors including automobile exhaust pollution and noise pollution factors, a grey clustering analysis method was applied to evaluate the urban road traffic environment quality in this paper. Urban road traffic environment situation was divided into four grey grades, such as excellent(A-level), good(B-level), average(C-level) and poor(D-level). Base on the grey clustering method, the evaluation matrix, whiten weight functions of every grey grade and comprehensive decision weights were given. Evaluation results suggest that: the theory of grey clustering evaluation for urban road traffic environment quality is practicable and reliable, and may be used for other traffic environment quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Illustration about a Metacognition-based learning detection system conceived to improve web-based self-regulated learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Many learners have found that it is difficult to complete their web-based learning plan. Once on the Internet, they can't help browsing more interesting Web pages instead of continuing to do their learning tasks. This situation we called Information Trek. To solve this problem, this study proposes an learning detection system which can discover whether the contents of a web page a student viewing is about learning or not. If a student is detected to be in the state of viewing the non-learning pages, then the alert reinforcement window will be shown. If the attentive time in learning has been reached, then encouraging reinforcement feedback is given. We must consider adequately about personalization given the different levels of Metacognition. In this system, preferring the method to let learner go back to the learning state themselves, we design some functions to guide learners regulate themselves based on the essential process of online self-regulated leaning integrating Metacognitive process.

articleTitle: Research on driving forces and policy for agricultural sustainable development — An empirical study on grain production of Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Sustainable growth in agriculture is an important issue of economic security in the accelerated industrialization period. Based on the grain production data and its main influencing factors from 1990 to 2008 in Henan Province, this paper revealed the dynamic effects of variables, by constructing the State Space Equation of Time-Varying Parameter Model, conducted empirical analysis on the driving forces of Henan's grain yield and the dynamic change at different periods. Based on comparative dynamic analysis, we find that irrigation index has become the primary factor in the grain production influencing factors, the effect of fertilizer input and planting area experienced increase at the beginning and decrease later on. The contribution of the number of agricultural labor and agricultural mechanical input is turning from positive to negative. Finally, according to the result, the paper suggested several policy for agricultural sustainable development.

Author Keywords: state space equation of time-varying parameter model

Objects of evaluation involve travel agency, hotel and scenic area. Thirdly, entropy TOPSIS is reviewed and the important role is proved by evaluating the growth performance of entrepreneurship in tourism in a given city. By empirical Study, an evaluation is completed in tourism of Qinhuangdao. The difference of growth performance of entrepreneurship is compared in the situation of different years.

abstract: This article researches some problems in the automobile insurance in the non-life insurance, and calculates the posterior distribution of the claims frequency and posterior estimates of the missing parameter values by MCMC simulation. In the case of incomplete historical data, uses WinBUGS package to find the posterior distribution of the claim frequency parameters and the estimate of the correlation parameters. The results obtained show that the model not only to make up for the traditional model, but also improving the accuracy of the calculation. And also have a practical significance for improving the determining experience rating in automobile insurance.

articleTitle: Specialized cooperative economic organization of Chinese farmers: Growth model and implications
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper establishes a growth model to explain the growth of the specialized cooperative economic organizations of farmers(SCEOF), using survey data to test the growth model of SCEOF. To do the empirical study, an Ordered Probit Model is employed to explore the influencing factors which determinate the growth of SCEOF. The results shows that leaders' management ability, income distribution within the organization, sales ratio, proportion of production, procurement, financial information disclosure times, the internal oversight mechanisms, regulatory and administrative departments of government support to farmers have more significant positive impacts on the growth of SCEOF. Finally, the article puts forward some policy recommendations.

This paper presents architecture of GIS Crime Analysis System based on Trusted Network Connect (TNC), the system adopts the TNC Architecture, carry out identification and Integrity certification to the terminal. In this way, we can ensure the Credibility of terminal and the safety of connect network.

articleTitle: A research on the credit assessment of corporation borrower of commercial bank based on state space analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Credit assessment of corporation borrower is the main means to control credit risk and asset risk management for commercial bank. The parameters of Logistic default model for the listed company's credit risk assessment are represented the state space form, Then the parameters are estimated by Kalman filter. The results show that the Kalman filter model can be obtained optimum results compared with Logistic regression model and the BP network model. Conclusions of this study enrich credit risk assessment system and strengthen risk management of chinese commercial banks.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In order to solve the chaos recognition problem of short time series with noise in reality, a new method of data expansion combined with chaos theory and least square support vector machine is proposed. Then the fractal dimension and the largest lyapunov exponent are calculated on the basis of expansion data. Finally the simulation of Henon system indicats the effectiveness of this method, and explains that this method has some practical value.

articleTitle: An empirical study of influencing factors of absorbing FDI in Henan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: By use of the grey correlation analysis method, this paper comparatively analyzes the correlation degree of influencing factors of absorbing FDI in Henan between two periods (1990–1999 and 2000–2009). The results of this study indicate that the opening level has been the primary factor at present; the secondary industry, infrastructure and market scale are the traditional influencing factors; the influence degree of labor cost is rising, and the importance of talent superiority is appearing gradually. Finally, the study put forward some suggestions for reference based on the results.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation of farmer's credit based on the improved PCA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: No matter you poor or rich, you can secure a bank loan, except your credit is very low; credit is an important factor influencing the rural credit. The traditional model of credit evaluation, adopted in China's rural financial institutions at present, neglected the factors from the different contribution of indicators, social relationship capital etc., which leads to a great deviation from the accurate value. In this paper, on the foundation of the more reasonable index system of farmer's credit evaluation, we improved some aspects on the traditional principal component analysis, such as dimension, reverse index, nonlinear and so on. By using the uncertain type analysis of hierarchy process (UTAHP) we decided the first-level index weigh. The problems of current farmer's credit evaluation were overcame to offer an improved model, which will bring about a more practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on financial model of Henan expressway construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Expressway is an important regional economic development infrastructure and important material basis for the national economy. Expressway construction is inseparable from the strong capital support. Along with the changing economic environment, expressway construction in Henan Province has been developing rapidly. However, on the one hand, the advance of the national highway network is still a lot of money demand; on the other hand, prudent fiscal policy and tight monetary policy, which rely heavily on bank loans and the rapid development of the enormous impact of highway industry. Therefore, the future development of Henan expressway will be facing some new challenges. This paper analyzes the development process and financial model of Henan expressway construction, and put forward the problems of financing models and financing of innovative ideas.

articleTitle: Integrated inventory optimization in supply chain for deteriorating items with partially backorder
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: A single vendor single buyer integrated inventory optimization in supply chain for deteriorating items with shortage allowed is studied. The demand is supposed to be exponential time-varying and the buyer is allowed to backorder partially. The total inventory costs of vendor and buyer are explored respectively. An inventory model of the supply chain is developed accordingly to optimize the integrated total costs of vendor and buyer. An optimal algorithm is designed and numerical example is presented to illustrate the results of the proposed model.

articleTitle: The literature reviews on service flexibility theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: In the field of economic development, service industry is in a revolutionary period. Since the 1990s, the problem of service flexibility began to be concerned by the service management and service marketing investigators. This paper mainly conducts a comprehensive review on the concept and classification of flexibility and service flexibility, the type and evaluation latitude of the ability of service flexibility, ways to improve the ability of service flexibility. Finally, the paper discusses limitations and opportunities of the research of service flexibility.

abstract: Based on decomposing and estimating the cost of the construction machinery, machinery's efficiency and the cost are comprehensively analyzed. The cost-effectiveness analysis system and mathematical model is constructed based on those concepts, such as efficiency index, cost index and cost-effectiveness index. The model provides a way for selecting construction machinery in order to gain the maximal benefits.

articleTitle: Development of researches on nonlinear photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the concept of quasi-phase matching nonlinear interaction, and successful fabrication of nonlinear photonic crystal using high voltage electric field in 90's, studies on nonlinear photonic crystal were made by different research teams. The related works sharply developed from single one-dimensional superlattice to various structures. On the other hand, further fabrications were made in these crystals, for example, the fabrication of optical waveguides etc. Fabrications of multiple optical waveguides in one two-dimensional photonic crystal were suggested in this paper. This will be helpful to the extension of laser wavelengths, compact optical elements and all-optical switches.

articleTitle: The analysis of network congestion control founded on game theoretic frame
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper is a disquisition on congestion control in network founded on game theoretic frame. We give an integrated model of congestion externality and congestion pricing, study the network users' strategy of rate stream in repeated games. The influence of repeated times and information completeness is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Improved fuzzy c-means algorithm based on minimum of distance cost function
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The traditional fuzzy c-means (FCM) operates when cluster number c is assigned. The value of c makes a great influence on the cluster result. However, the value of cluster number can not be confirmed automatically and needs to be inputted manually, which results in hinders when using the fuzzy c-means. Some researchers have investigated the problem. By combining the concept of distance cost function with the character of fuzzy c-means, this paper improves the FCM algorithm based on new formula of distance cost function. According to calculation of the minimum of modified formula, the optimal cluster number c can be confirmed. The analysis of synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that, improved FCM based on minimum of distance cost function can reach the optimal cluster number.

articleTitle: Discuss on subject-based English teaching for HVAC

abstract: Subject-based English teaching should adapt the fast development of HVAC, which need teaching intention promotion, teaching content update, and teaching method optimization. Subject-based English teaching should pay more attention to specialized English structure and practical rules for cultivating High-quality talents under the era of knowledgement economy.

articleTitle: Game analysis of stakeholders's behavior for rural public goods supply in Public-Private Partnerships
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: As the goal is inconsistent, the stakeholder always makes the best choice for himself when facing the decision-making opportunity. This article analyzed the stakeholder's behavior in Public-Private Partnerships for supply rural public goods in economic model. The game analysis shows that, to perfect mutually restricted mechanism is the primary problem of Public-Private Partnerships. At last, proposing some suggestions for improving the Public-Private Partnerships.

abstract: This paper has constructed a measure model of macro social capital including three dimensions: network, trust, and institutions. Based on panel data of 23 provinces during 1997–2007 in China, this paper has empirically examined the influences of human capital and social capital on economic growth. We divide our sample into two groups according to the economic prosperity, and analyze the disparities in the function of human capital and social capital on economic growth in difference areas, thus providing policy suggestions on the investment priority in different areas.

articleTitle: Belief Function model of private equity fund performance measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This article applies Dempster-Shafer evidence theory to probe the private equity fund performance evaluation issues, get the Belief Function model to evaluate the performance of a private equity fund. This article does not intend to discuss the relevance and completeness of indicators, nor does it intend to submit other views and ideas. This article firstly assumes that the performance measurement system had already been established, and then discusses the problem how to quantify these indicators (including qualitative indicators and quantitative indicators) by scoring or other appropriate methods. Next all of the scores will be combined based on the theory of Belief Function to get a comprehensive performance measurement indicator. The final indicator can be used to fund ranking. It is expected that this ranking is more objective and more comprehensive than the one based on a single indicator, such as IRR. In addition, the indicator, as well as the method discussed in this article has a great reference value to help the institutional investors to choose the fund. In the PE firm, the indicator can be used as a benchmark for the performance measurement of fund managers or investment managers. Finally, the indicator is also helpful for the government regulators and industry associations to understand PE funds.

In this paper, a innovation-cultivation platform based on intelligent robotics is built up for university students. The requirements and robotics property are analyzed in details. Then, we depicted the construction thought and related contents. Specific steps are also presented. According to the constitute parts, the physical experiment systems are particularly elaborated. Finally, the platform application and a summary of the acquired result are introduced.

articleTitle: Studies on university students who trading stocks in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: There are students who trade in the stock market, which is no longer a fresh phenomenon. Several years ago, the media, schools, the education circles pay a certain degree of attention on it. But they always focused on the phenomenon itself and judge the merits and demerits. Now we have our focus on motivation in this research. We use a questionnaire to collect information and do descriptive and qualitative analysis with statistics and econometrics methods. After investigation, we found that today's college students have become more rational when trading stocks and their theoretical level of investment and risk awareness increased. In view of the benefits of trading stocks and the trend of social development, we believe that the behavior should be encouraged, but we should find an approach to guide students to be more rational when doing investment.

articleTitle: A universal steganalysis to steganographic images on frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Current steganalysis for images is not universal, which is usually special for one kind of steganography and not practical for others. Meanwhile the correct detection rate of these detecting methods is not high. After analyzing current steganalysis methods, a new steganalysis method for detection of steganography in image's frequency domain is proposed. The detecting method is universal and is not restrained to some special steganography method. Based on the spectrum analysis of difference histogram of frequency coefficients, the detection is achieved according to evident spectrum difference between non-steg-images and steg-images. The physical frame of the algorithm is easy and the detection method can be put into practice. Experimental results from detecting steganographic images of DCT domain and DWT domain show that the detection performance is satisfying. Compared to Stegdetect 0.6, which is a steganalysis system for JPEG images, the method shows much better performance.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Government investment projects play a pivotal role in socialist economic construction, and goverment indicate clearly that implementation construction-agency system in government investment projects. For the problems of credit missing in domestic construction market, the "dual identity" of construction-agency making itself be apt to dishonest, and the project performance capability of project companies being closely related to its credit level, a construction-agency cedit evaluation model is bulit on behalf of government in this paper, and improved multi-attribute group decision model based on TOPSIS is proposed to comprehensive evaluation, which achieving the government's requirement to quantitatively evulate credit level of construction-agency. In the model, entropy and AHP are used to detemine comprehensive weights, and Minkowski distance is adopted to improve TOPSIS model, solving the problem of over weighted in the original TOPSIS model and increasing the efficiency of construction-agency credit evaluation. Finally, a representative case is used to illuminate the application of the model in this paper, which pictures the calculation procedures and verify the operability of the model, making important reference value to improve construction-agency credit evaluation system.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Credibility is important for construction of credible E-Business and E-Businessmen credibility mining research based on web reviews has important practical significance. This paper introduces a web review-based E-Businessmen credibility mining mechanism and defines a calculation method of semantic relevance orientation and syntactic relevance orientation in Chinese sentences, meanwhile, for overall emotional orientation analysis of massive text in web reviews, proposes a D-S evidence theory-based opinion mining method of E-Businessmen credibility overall emotional orientation. Experiment results show that this method has good effect on the application of overall emotional orientation analysis of text about E-Businessmen credibility.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: China's Growth Enterprise Market has just started, because of the characteristics of the market itself, its risk is much higher than the ordinary securities investment markets. The risk of China's Growth Enterprise Market is can be reflected in many aspects, one of which from the investors is mainly caused by the excess of retail investors. abstract: Based on the time-series data from 1978 to 2008 in China, the paper develops a VAR models and analyzes the long-terms equilibrium relation through co-integration test, Granger causality test and impulse response function From the view of export and import, product categories and trade patterns. The results show that: The first industry improve the primary products trade; the secondary industry increase the trade of primary products and manufactured goods, it not only promoted the growth of general trade, but also processing trade.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and gray clustering method, the water environmental quality assessment of the BP neural network model are built by the application of neural network theory. articleTitle: The efficiency evaluation of food financial subsidy policies to Food Quantitative Security
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: We must consider not only the effect of policies, but also their costs on the study of food financial direct subsidies' efficiency. This paper utilize DEA model which is researched the standard efficiency problem evaluate Chinese current food financial direct policies to Food Quantitative Security with system efficiency and technological efficiency. We can get the basic conclusions, which include: System effective provinces concentrated in most major grain producing areas, and non-effective provinces concentrated in rapid economic developmental provinces and poor provinces. System effective provinces are all scale effective. And the return to scale of non-effective provinces is increasing. The analysis of the ineffective provinces' slack variable shows that there is a definite relation between input redundancy and output shortage of food subsidies, and improving efficiency is changing from the non-efficient cause, such as fair use of Subsidy for planting superior crop varieties, subsidy for farm machinery purchase, food comprehensive subsidies' standard, rice well-bred subsidies' standards. This will directly affect the increase of the total grain output, per capita amount of gain, and the farmers' enthusiasm.

abstract: The credit problem has been the development of Chinese e-commerce has had an important impact on both buyers and sellers of credit trends and third-party websites is forecast counterparties important reference factors in successful trading. Buyers and sellers and websites on the characteristics and factors as a whole system. Use of system dynamics theory to analyze the causal relationship of elements within the establishment of flow diagram, and then construct the system dynamics model and simulation carried out concluded that the next 100 months, the seller of all goodwill, customer confidence in credit and website degree of the curve showed an increasing tendency for the next multi-decision theory provides a basis for trading.

Then, we further observe a mediating effect of the instrumental use of information in the competence diversity — new product performance relationship. Finally, we discuss the moderating effect of familiarity among team members on the relationship between competence diversity and the instrumental use of information

articleTitle: Housing market dynamics in urban China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper applies an improved stock-flow model, which identifies the interrelated factors of housing demand and supply, to examine how housing markets operate across the national aggregate level in urban China. Estimating equations for housing prices and new construction are identified and estimated using generalized least squares with cross-section weights. The empirical results suggest that household income is the most significant factor causing housing prices to vary across the national market, while other two variables of user costs and stock/employment have less significant impacts. On the other hand, the positive sign of stock in the estimation of flow equation is against the specification by Dipasquale and Wheaton (1996).

The daily teachings of OR already can not go without the use of Modern Education Technology (or MET). Moreover, the OR experiment designing, case teaching and the practicing can not be done without MET. With the use of MET in the teaching process of OR, it stimulates the interests of the students, and it makes the student's unique character and initiative showing vividly, thus, it makes the student's devote their creativity and the abilities of analyzing and solving problems. In the practical teaching process of OR, it obtains very good effect and this indeed has been praised by the students.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: SoPC is a new concept & technique proposed by Altera Corporation at the beginning of the 21st century. With advance, high efficiency and economy, combined programmable logic elements, EDA, SoC, embedded system, DSP and IP, etc, it has advantages such as flexible design, tailorability, extension, upgradability and programmable software & hardware for the system. At present, some Chinese colleges try to start SoPC embedded class to pay attention to SoPC technical theory & concept and actual application. In general, it is mainly to introduce SoPC technical basic concept, usage method of Quartus Π software, DSP development technology on the basis of FPGA, NiosII embedded system development, NiosII common components & programming and SoPC technical application. abstract: Adopting distributed lag model and econometrics method, the paper tested the impacts of Japan and US FDI on China's industrial structure upgrading, employment and technology advancement. The result suggested that Japan had contributed more to China's economy than US in terms of the quantity, while US played more significant role in China's economic structure optimization from the perspective of quality. articleTitle: The strategic analysis of the distribution channel under the B2C e-business mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The network technology provides manufacturers with a new platform to contact with the consumers. Nowadays, in order to fulfill the rapid development, many manufacturers open B2C e-channel, while maintaining the traditional distribution channel. In this context, based on the theory of Cournot Game, this paper takes the duopoly manufacturers as an example, discusses the game process for their choice to open e-channel or not, and solves the Nash Equilibrium. The results indicates, when the cost of opening e-channel is lower than a critical value, the final equilibrium is both sides don't open e-channel; when the cost is higher than another critical value, the final equilibrium is both sides open e-channel; when the cost is between the two critical values, a coordination system should be built.

articleTitle: Moral hazard analysis of adverse supply chain based uncertain recycle quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The recycle model of reverse supply chain, which is suitable to Chinese national condition, is the flow of individual commerce wandering about the streets and their family workshop recycle patterns. Considering to uncertainty recycle quality, firstly, the paper analyses the business profit functions of manufacturer, retailer and recycler under the balanced wholesale prices and retail price. Secondly, recycler has more information about recycle quality, and manufacturer provides the corresponding recycling price through evaluating the waster quality, which is imperfective information as the principal role. So the paper constructs the moral hazard model of reverse supply chain under the uncertain recycling quality. Finally, it gets the optimal recycling schemes under certain theoretical restricted condition, and puts forward measures to overcome moral hazard problem of reverse supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on indicators system and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model for the city development potential
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: The city development potential is the dynamical force with which the urban systems can be supported to be integrated, comprehensive, and sustainable in the future. Several aspects including social, technological, economic, resources and environmental system should be considered in the evaluation of the city development potential. In this paper, firstly, an evaluation index system is developed based on these five aspects and the weight for different indexes is presented by expert scoring method. Then, a multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model (MFCEM) is proposed to evaluate the development potential of cities. Finally, Zhengzhou, the provincial capital of Henan province, is taken as an empirical analysis. The results indicate that Zhengzhou has a medium development potential degree and the proposed MFCEM is effective and feasible. The research would be viable in the comprehensive quantitative evaluation of development potential and helpful in the construction and development of Zhengzhou city.

publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper analysis the mature E-business model — the concentration of information exchanged E-business model and integrated supply chain E-business model, and emerging P2PEB model. The author comparatively studied the cost of the concentration of information exchanged E-business model and P2PEB model by introducing the theory and method of economics. The result demonstrates the feasibility and the necessity of P2PEB, and bring people new theoretical basis for the development of P2PEB.

articleTitle: Research on modular innovation model of complex product system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Complex Product System is playing an increasingly important role in the modern economic development, and even affects a country's overall competitiveness. According to the concepts and characteristics of COPS, and the relation between modularization and COPS, this paper has constructed three types of modular innovation model of COPS based on relationship between complex product and corporate, the first modular innovation model within single complex product in enterprise, the second model within complex products among enterprises for collaboration and supporting and the third model among products based on complementary resources. This paper has elaborated each model and its applicability. Finally, this paper has pointed out the application and development of three types of modular innovation model of COPS in China.

articleTitle: The influence of information structure on the transforming process of bargaining power: Based on game experiment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: Information structure has a profound influence on games of any kind, so dose on bargaining game. The purpose of this paper is to reveal the influencing effects of information structure on the process of inherent bargaining power to be transformed into actual bargaining power. The results of the game experiment indicate that three typical information types, which are alternative resources, personal utility and market average price, have a significant influence on the bargaining power transforming process. However, the influencing effects of the three information types are significantly different.

abstract: To scientifically assess the Hi-tech companies' competitive strength is the premise and foundation of effectively improving their competitiveness. This paper uses the methods of DEA (Data Envelopment Analysis) and selects the 14 industries' data from the state taxation investigation jointly carried out by the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration in 2007 as samples. It appraises the Hi-tech companies' competitiveness from three aspects: asset deployment status, profit-making capability and innovation ability, and in this way, eliminates the assessment s non-objectivity and non-fairness induced by the inadequate objective requisites. This paper improves the scientificalness, rationality and accuracy of the Hi-tech companies' competitiveness assessment from the aspects both of the model and the index.

articleTitle: Analysis of land use changes based on Markov's shift matrix model in Loess Hilly-gully region
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: According to statistical and survey data, land use survey data and TM imagines from 2000 to 2008, dynamic changes of quantitative and regional difference of land use in ShangHuang experiment area during the last 8 years are analyzed. Based upon the model of Markov's shift matrix, the land use changes are discussed. The results indicated that the general trend of cultivated land during the past 8 years was decreasing and regional differences of cultivated land was very notable. The dynamic change of cultivated land shows sloping farmland change to forest land and grassland, some good quality of cultivated land change to high economic beneficial garden plot.

articleTitle: An improved Collaborative Filtering approach based on combined clusters with modified prediction formula
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: This paper describes a new technique for making personalized recommendations. Among existing recommendation algorithms, user-based Collaborative Filtering (CF) approach is the most promising one. However, the problems like multiple-interests lead to a decline in recommendations' quality. To overcome the problem of multiple-interests and dimensionality curse as well, we propose a modified CF method based on combined clusters, which are obtained using EPCH. Further improvements are made by proposing a modified prediction formula. MovieLens dataset is used to evaluate our method and it's demonstrated that the new method outperforms traditional CF approach.

articleTitle: A fully Bayesian approach for unit root testing in Chinese stock market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government (ICEE)
abstract: It is well-known that Bayesian approaches can avoid the discontinuity problem of the classical frequent unit root testing statistics. In this paper, the main object is to develop a new fully Bayesian unit root approach based on Kullback-Leibler divergence function and the mixed prior specification. The finite sample behavior of the proposed test statistic is illustrated using Monte Carlo simulation. At last, the developed approach is used to investigate whether the reform of non-tradable shares has long persisted effect on Chinese financial market or not.
